remedies.name: Absinthium
remedies.text:
(Common Wormwood) A perfect picture of epileptiform seizure is produced by this drug. Nervous tremors precede attack. Sudden and severe giddiness, delirium with hallucinations and luss of consciousness. Cerebral irritation, hysterical aut infantile spasms come within range of this remedy. Poisoning by mushrooms. Chorea. Tremor, Nervoushess, excitement, and sleeplessness in children. Mind, — Hallucinations. Frightful visions. Kieptomania Loss of memory. Forgets what has recently happened. Wants nothing to do with anybody. Brutal. Head.—Vertigo. with tendency to fall backward. General coufusion, Wants head low. Pupils dilated unequally. Face blue Spasmodic facial twitching. Dull occipital headache.

Mouth. — Jaws fixed. Bites tongue; trembles; feels as if swollen and too large; protruding.

Throat. — Scalded sensation; as of a Jump.

Stomach. — Nausea; retching; eructation, Bloated around waist and abdomen. Wind colic.

Urine. — Constant desire. Very strong odor; deep yellow color. [Kali phos.] Heart.—- Tremor of heart felt toward the back; thumps, can be heard in back. Sexual. —- Darting pain in right ovary. Spermatorrhea, with relaxed parts.

Chest. — Sensation of weight on chest. Irregular, tumultuous action of heart can be heard in back, Extremities, — Pain in timls, Paralytic symptoms.

Relationship. — Compare: Alcohol; Artemisia; Hydrocy, acid; Cina; Cicuto. Dose, ~- First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Acalypha Indica
remedies.text:
(Indian. Nettle) A drug having a marked action on the alimentary cana! and respiratory organs, It is indicated in incipient phthisis, with hard, racking cough, bloody expectoration, arterial haemorrhage, but no febrile disturbance. Very weak in the morning, gains strength during day. Progressive emaciation. Atl pathological hemorrhages having notably @ morning aggravation.

Chest.— Cough dry, hard, followed by hemoptysis; worse in morning and at night, Constant and severe pain in chest. Blood bright red and not profuse in morning; dark and clotted in afternoon. Pulse soft and compressible, Burning in pharynx, esophagus, and stomach.

Abdomen. — Burning in intestines. Spluttering diarrhea with forcible expulsion of noisy flatus, bearingdown pains and tenesmus. Rumbling distention, and griping pam in abdomen, Rectal hemorrhage; worse in morning. Skin. -— Jaundice. Itching and circumscribed furanclelike swellings, Modalities. — !i/arse in morning.

Relationship. — Compare: Afillefol.; Phosphor.; Aces tic acid; Kali nit. Dose, — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Acetanilidum
remedies.text:
(Antifebrinum) Increased susceptibility to cold. Depresses heart, respiration and blued pressure, lowers temperature, Cyanosis and collapse.

Head. — ularged sensation. Fainting. Moral depravity, Eyes. — Pallor of optic discs, contracted visual fleid and shrmking retinal vessel; mydriasis, Heart. — Weak, irregular, with blue mucors membranes, alhamininia, edema uv) teet and ankles.

Relationship. — Compare: Asntipyrin.

Dose. — Used as a sedative and antipyretic for various forms of headache and neuralgia in doses of one to three grains. For the homeopathic indications use the third poteney,

remedies.name: Acetic Acid
remedies.text:
(Glacial Acetic Acid) This drug produces a condition of profound anemia, with some dropsical symptoms, great debility, frequent fainting, dyspncea, weak heart, vomiting, profuse urination and sweat. Hiemorrhag: from any part. Especially indicated in pale, lean persons, with lax, flabby muscles. Jf asting and debility. Acetic acid has the bower to liquify albuminous and fibrinous deposits. Epithelial cancer. Sycosis with nodules and formations in the joints. (C. M. Boger.) Mind. — Icritable, worried about business affairs, Head. — Nervous headache, from abuse of narcotics. Blood rushes to head with delirium. Temporal vessels distended. Pain across root of tangue.

Face. — Pale, waxcn, esmaciated. Eyes sunken, surrounded by dark rings. Bright red. Sweaty. Epithelioma of lip. Cheeks hot and flushed.

Stomach. — Salivatios, Fermentation in stomach, Intense burning thirst. Culd drinks distress. Vomits after every kind of food. Epigastric tenderness, Burning pain as of an ulcer. Cancer of stomach. Sour belching and vomiting, Purning waterbrash and profuse salivation. Violent burning pain in stomach and chest, followed by coldness of skin and cold sweat on forehead, Abdomen, — Feels as if abdomen was sinking in. Frequent watery stools, worse in morning, Tympanitte. Ascites, Hemorrhage from bowels. Urine, — Large quantities of pale urine, Diabetes, with great thirst and debility. [Phos. ac.]

Female. — Excessive catamenia. I/emorrhages after labor, Nausea of pregnancy. Breasts painfully enlarged, distended with milk, Milk impoverished, bluish, transparent, sour. Anawmia of nursing mothers, Respiratory. — Hoarse, hissing respiration; dificult breathing; cough when inhaling. Membraneous croup, Irritation of trachea and bronchial tubes, False membrane in throat. Profuse bronchorrhea, Back.— Pain in back, relieved only by lying on abdomen, Extremities, —- Emaciation, (Edema of feet and legs.

Skin. — Pale, waxen, edematous. Burning, dry, hot skin, or bathed in profuse sweat, Diminished sensibility of the surface of body. Useful after stings, bites, etc. Varicose swellings. Scurvy; anasarce, Bruises; sprains.

Fever. — Hectic, with drenching sight-sweats. Red spot on icft check, No thirst in fever. Ebullitions. Sweat profuse, cold, Relationship. — Acetic acid is antidotal to all anzsthetic vapors, Counteracts sausage poisoning. Compare: Ammon. acet. (Profuse saccharine urine, patient is bathed in sweat.) Ars.; China; Digitalis; Liatris, (General anaserca in heart and kidney disease, dropsy, aud chronic diarrhea.) Dose — Third to thirtieth potency, Not to be repeated too often, except in croup.

remedies.name: Aconitum Napellus
remedies.text:
(Monkshood) A state of fear, anxiety; anguish of mind and body. Physical and mental restlessness, fright, is the most characteristic manifestation of Aconitr. Acute, sudden, and violent invasion, with fever. call for it. Complaints and tension caused by exposure to dry, cold weather, draught of cold air, checked perspiration, also complaints from very hot weather, especially gastro-intestinal disturbances, ete. First remedy in inflammations, inflammatory fevers. Serous membranes and muscular tissues affected markedly. Burning in internal parts; tingling, coldness and sumbuess, Influenza, Tension ot arteries: emotional and physical mental tension explain many symptoms. When prescribing Aconite remember Aconite causes only functional disturbance, no evidence that it can produce tissue change—its action is brief and shows no periodicity. Its sphere is in the beginning of an acute disease and not to he continued after pathological change comes. In Hyperzmia, congestion not after exudation has set in. Mind,— Great fear, anxiety, and worry accompany every ailment, however trivial. Delirium is characterized by unhappiness, worry, fear, raving, rarely unconsciousness. Forchodings and fears. Fears death but believes that he will soon die; predicts the day. Fears the fulurc, a crowd, crossing the strect. Resilessness, tossing about. Tendency to start. Imagination acute, clairvoyance. Pains are intolerable; they drive him crazy, Music is unbearable; makes her sad. [Ambra.] Thinks his thoughts come from the stomach — that parts of his body are abnormally thick. Feels as if what had just been done was a dream.

Head. — Fullness; Accvy, pulsating, hot, bursting, bursing, undulating sensation. Burning headache, as if brain were moved by boiling water [/ndigo.]. Vertigo; twarse on rising [Nux. Optum} and shaking head. Sensation on vertex as if hair were ptlled or stood on end. Nocturnal furious delirium.

Eyes. — Red, inflamed. Feel dry and hot, as if sand in them. Lids swollen, hard and red. Aversion to light. Profuse watering after exposure to dry, cold winds, reficction from snow, after extraction of cinders and other foreign bodies.

Ears. — Very sensitive to noises; music is unbearable. External ear hot, red, painful, swollen. Earache. [Cham.] Sensation as of drop of water in left ear.

Nose. — Smell acutely sensitive. Pain at root of nose. Coryza; much sneezing; throbbing in nostrils, Hamorthage of bright red blood. Mucous membrane dry, nose stopped up; dry or with but scanty watery coryza.

Face.— Red, hot, flushed, swollen. One cheek red, the other pale (Cham., /pec.). On rising the red face becomes deathly pale, or he becomes dizzy. Tingling in cheeks and numbness. Neuralgia, especially of teft side, wth restlessness, tingling, and numbness. Pain in jaws.

Mouth. — Numb, dry, and tingling. Tongue swollen; tip fingics. Teeth sensitive ta cold. Constantly moves lower jaw as if chewing. Gums hot and inflamed, Tongue coated white, [Antim. crud} Throat.— fed, dry, constricted, numb, prickling, burning, stinging. Tonsils swollen and dry. Stomach, — Vomiting, vith fear, heat, thirst, profuse stownt aud increased tvination, Bitter taste of everything except water, Jufense thirst. Drinks, vomits, and dectarcs he will die. Vomiting, Dilious, mucus and hleody, greenish. Pressure in stomach with dyspnoea. Iliematemesis. Burning from stomach to osophagus.

Abdomen. — Hui, tense, cyinpanitic. Sensuice fo touch, Cote, no position relieves. Abdominal symptoms better after warm soup. Burning is: umbilical region Rectum, — Pain with nightly itching and stitching in anus. Frequent, small stool with tenesmus; green, like chopped herhs. White with red urine. Cboleraic discharge with collapse, anxiety, and restlessness. Bleeding hamorchoids, (/?eman.] Watery diarrhoea in children, ‘They ery and complain much, are sleepless and restless.

Urine. — Siaity, red, hot, painful. Tenesmus aad burning at nerk of Madder. Burning in urethra. Urine suppressed, Ioody. Anxiety always on beginning to urinate, Aetention, with sercaming and restlessness, and handling of genitais. Renal region sensitive. Profuse urination, with profuse perspiration and diarrhea. Male.-—- Crawling and stinging in glans. Bruised ACONITUM NAPELLUS Il pain in testicles, swollen, hard. Frequent erections and emissions. Painful erections.

Female.— Vagina dry, hot, sensitive. Menses too profuse, with nosebleed, too protracted, late. Frenzy on apnearance of menses. Suppressed from fright, cold, in plethoric snbiects. Ovaries congested and painful. Sharp shooting pains in womb. After-pains, with fear and restlessness, Respiratory. — Constant pressure in left chest; oppressed breathing on least motion. Hoarse, dry, croupy conagh; loud, labored breathing. Child erasps at throat every time he coughs, Very sensitive ta inspired air. Shortucss of breath, Larynx sensitive Stitches through chest. Cough, dry, short, hacking; worse at night and after midnight. Hot feeling in lungs. Blood comes up with hawking, Tingling in chest after cough.

Heart. — Palfitation, with anxicty, fainting, and tingling in fingers, Pulse full, hard; tense and boundfzg; sometimes intermits, Temporal and carotid arteries felt when sitting.

Back. — Numb, stiff, painful. Crawling and tingting, as if bruised. Stiffness in nape of neck. Bruised pain between scapula, Extremities. — Numbness and tingling; shooting pains; icy coldness and insensitbility of hands and feet. Arms feel lame, bruised, heavy, numb, Pain down left arm [Cact., Crotal., Kalinia, Tabac.) Hot hands and cold fect. (Rheumatic inflammation of joints; worse at night; red shining swelling, very senstitive.) Hip-joint and thigh feel lame, especially after lying down. Knees unsteady; disposition of foot to turn. [4scul.] Weak and lax ligaments of all joints. Painless cracking of all joints, Bright red hypothenar eminences on both hands. Sensation as if drops of water trickled down the thigh.

Sleep.— Nightmare, Nightly ravings. Anxious dreams. Sleepiessness, with restless and tossing about. Starts up in sleep. Long dreams, with anxiety in chest. Insomnia of the aged.

Skin. — Red, hot, swollen, dry, burning, Purpura miltaris. Rash like measles. Gooseflesh. Formication and numbness. Chilliness and formication down back. Pruritus relieved by stimulants.

Fever. — Dry heat; red face. Evening chilliness soot after going to bed. Sweat constant. Sweat on part lain on, Cold waves pass through him, Thirst and restlessness always present. Chilly if uncovered or touched. Modalities, —- ictter in open air; worse in warm room, in evening and night; worse lying on affected side, from music, from tobacco-smoke, dry, cold winds. Vinegar in large doses is antidotal to poisonous effects. Compare Cham, and Coffea in intcuse pai and sleeplessness.

Relationship. — Acids, wine and coffee, lemonade, aad acid fruits modify its action. Not indicated in malarial and low fevers or hectic and pyxmic conditions, and in inflammations when they tocalize themseives, Sulphur often follows it. Agrostis acts like Acon, in fever and inflammations, also Spirunthes. Complementary: Coffea; Sulph. Compare: Bellad.; Cham.; Coffea; Ferr. phos, Aconitine,— (Heavy feeling as of lead; pains in supraorbital nerve; ice cold sensations creep up; hydrophobia symptoms.) Aconitum Lycotonum,— Great yellow wolfsbane. — Swelling of glands; Hodgkin's disease. Diarrhcea after eating pork. Itching. Skin of nose cracked.

Aconiium ferox.— Indian

Aconite.— Rather more violent in its actions than A, napellus, It is more diuretic and less antipyretic, It has proved valuable in cardiac dyspn@a, neuralgia, and acute gout, Dyspawa, Must sit up. Rapid respiration. Anxiety, with suffocation from feeling of paralysis in respiratory muscles. [Curare; Phosph.] Qucbracho (cardiac dyspnoea.) Clchyranthes.— A Mexican drug—very similar to Aconite in fevers, but of larger range, being also adapted to typhoidal states and intermittents. Muscular rheumatism. A great diaphoretic. Use 6x.} Dose, — Sixth potency for sensory affections; first to third for congestive conditions. Must be repeated fre~ quently in acute diseases. Acon. is a rapid worker, In Neuralgias tincture of the root often preferable, one drap doses (poisonous), or again, the 30th potency, according to susceptibility of patient.

remedies.name: Actea Spicata
remedies.text:
(Baneberry) Is a rheumatic remedy, especially of the small joints; learing, tingling pains characterize it. Wrist-rheumatism. Pulsations over whole body, especially liver and renal region. Cardio-vascular spasm, Head. — Ebuliition of blood to head excited hy drinking coffee. Vertigu, tearing headache, better in open - air, throbbing in brain, pain from crown to between eyebrows; heat in forehead, pain in left frontal emirence as if bone were crushed. Itching of scalp alternating with heat; nose red at tip, fluent coryza. Face.-— Violent pain in upper jaw, running from teeth through malar bones to temples. Perspiration on face and head.

Stomach. — Teari: darting pains in epigastric region, with vomiting. Cramp-like pains in stomach aud epigastrium, with difficult breathing; sense of suffacation. Sudden lassitude after eating. Abdomen. ~~ Spasmodic retraction. Sticking pain and distension of hypogastrmm, Respiratory. — Short, irregular breathing at night, while lying, Great oppression, Shortness ef breath on exposure to cold air, Extremities. — Tearing pains in loins. Ahewmuativ pains in small joints, wrist, fingers, ankles, toes. Szviling of joints from slight fatiyue. Wrist swollen, red, worse any motion. Paralytie weakness in the hands. Sudden lassitude after talking or eating.

Relationship. — Compare: Cimicif.; Cauloph.; Led.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Adonis Vernalis
remedies.text:
(Peasant's Eye) A heart medicine, after rheumatism or influenza, where the muscles of the heart are in stage of fatty degeneration, regulating the pulse and increasing the power of contractions of heart, with increased urinary secretions, Valvular affections. Most valuable in cardiac drowsy. Low vitality, with weak heart and slow, weak pulse. Hydrothorax, ascites.

Head. — Feels light; aches across front, from occiput Ground tempirs to eyes, Vertigo on rising, turning head quickly or tying down. Tinnitus. Scalp feels tight, Mouth.— Slimy. Tongue dirty yellow, sore, feels scalded. Heart. —~ Mitral and aortic regurgitation. Pracerdiul pain, palpitation, and dyspnaa, Marked venous enforgement. Cardiac asthma. [Quebrache.] Fatty heart. Myocarditis, irregular cardiac action, constriction and vertigo. Pulse rapid, irregular. Stomach, — Heavy weight. Gnawing hunger. Faint feeling in epigastriam. Better out of doors, Urine, —- Ojly pellicle on urine. Scanty, albuminous.

Respiratory. — Frequent desire to take a Jong breath, Fecting of weight on chest.

Sleep. — Restless, with horrible dreams, Extremities. — Aching in nape. Spine stiff and aching. Relationship. -—- -’donidin is a cardiac tonic and diuretic. Quarter to baif grain daily, or two to five grains of first decimal! trit. Increases arterial pressure and protongs the diastole, favoring emptying engorged veins. Compare: Digit.; Cratag.; Conval.; Strophantus, Dose. — Five to ten drops of the tincture.

remedies.name: Adrenalin
remedies.commonName: An Internal Secretion of Suprarenai Glands
remedies.text:
(An Internal Secretion of Suprarenai Glands) Adrenalin or Epinephrin, the active principle of the suprarenal gland, is employed as a chemical messenger in the regulation of the activities of the body; in fact, its presence is essential to the activity of the sympathetic nerve, Adrenalin action on any part is the same as stimulation of the sympathetic nerve endings thereto. Local application [£: 1,000 solution] to mucous membranes promptly induces transient ischemia, scen in a blonching, persisting several hours from conjunctival instillation. Its action is very prompt, efficient, avasescent, owing to rapid oxidation and therefore practically harmless, unless too frequently repeated, when atheroma and heart lesions — myocardial — in animals have been reported. The main action of Adrenalin is stimulation of the sympathetic endings, notably the splanchnic area, causing constriction of the peripheral arterioles, with resultmg risc in bleed pressure. This is especially observed in stomach, intestines; less in uterus, skin; nil in brain and lungs. Furthermore, is noticed, slowing of pulse, medullary vagus stimulation, and strengthening of heart beat, increased myocardial contractility, resembling Digitalis; increased glandular activity, glycosuria: depression of respiratory center; contraction of muscular tissue of eye, nteris, vagina; relaxation of muscular tissue of stomach, intestines, bladder, Uses. — Its chief therapeutic use depends on its vasoconstriction action; therefore a most powerful and prompt astringent and Ae@mestatic; and invaluable in checking capillary hemorrhages from aff parts, where local or direct application is feasible, nose, ear, mouth, throat, larynx, stomach, rectum, uterus, bladder. Complete bloadiessness, ischamia, may be induced with impunity, Locally, solutions (1+ 10,00@-1 : 1,000} sprayed or applied on cotton have been very efficient in bloodless nperations alout the eye, nase, throat, and jar}nx Congestiuns of the ethmoid and sphenoid sinuses, also hay fever. have been markedly alleviated by warm spray of Adrenalin chloride, 1:5,000. Here compare Hepar 1x, which wilt start up secretions and so facilitate drainage. Werlhoff's disease hypodermically, 1: 1,000. Externally, it has been used in neuritis, neuralgia, reflex pains, gout, rheumatism, as an ointment, 1-2 m. of 10 per cent, solution, along the nerve trunk at point of skin nearest its origin. Therapeutically, Adrenalin has been suggested in acute congestion of lungs. Grave's and Addison's diseases, arterio-sclerosis, chronic aortitis, angina pectoris, haemophilia, chlorosis, ete. Dr. P. Jousset reports success in treatisg, homeeopathically, cases of angina and of aortitis, sub-acute and chronic, when Adrenalin has been prescribed per os and in infinitesimal! dose. The symptom guiding to this is, Sensation ej thoracic constriction with anguish. This, with vertigo, nausca and vomiting, have been produced by the drug. Addostinal foi, Shock or heart failure during anesthesia, as it causes very prompt rise of blood pressure by its action on nerve endings in the vessel wall.

Dose. — Hypodermicaily, 1-5 m. [1]: 1,000 solution] diluted in water. Internally, 5-30 m. of 1: 1,000 solution.

Caution. — On account of its affinity for oxygen, the drug easily decomposes in watery and dilute acid solutions. The solution must be protected from air and light. It must not be teo frequently repeated, owing to cardiac and arterial lesions. For homeopathic vse 2x to 6x attenuation.

remedies.name: Aesculus Hippocastanum
remedies.text:
(Horse Chestnut} The action of this drug is most marked on the lower bowel, producing engorged hemorrhoidal veins, with characteristic backache. Venous stasis general, varicose veins of purple color; everything is slowed down, digestion, heart, bowels, ete. Torpor and congestion of the liyer and portal system, with constipation. The back aches and gives out, and unfits the patient for business. Flying pains all over. Fullness in various parts; dry, swollen mucous membranes.

Head. — Depressed and irritatle. Head dull, confused. Pressure in forehead, with nausea, followed by stitches in cight hypechondrium. Pain from ecciput te frontal region, with Lruised sensation of the scalp; worse in the morning. Neuralgic stitches frem right to Icft through forghead, followed by flyimg pains in epigastrium.

Eyes.— Heavy and hot, with lachrymation, with cxlarged blood vessvls. Eyeballs sore. Nose, — Dry; inspired air feels cold, nasal pussages sensitive io it, Coryza, sneezing. Pressure at root of nuse. Membrane over turbinate hones distended and boggy, dependent upon hepatic disorders, Mouth. — Scalded feeling. Metallic taste. Salivation. Tongue thickly coated, feels as if scalded.

Throat. — Hot, drv, raw, stitching pain into cars when swallowing. Follicular pharyngitis connected with hepatic congestion, Veins in pharynx distended and tortuous. Throat sensitive to inspired air; feels excoriated and constricted, burns like fire on swallowing, in afternoon. Early stages of atrophic pharyngitis in dried-up, bilious subjects. Hawking of ropy mucus of swectish taste, Stomach. — Weight of a stone, with gnawing, aching pain; most manifest about three hours after meals. Tenderness and fullness in region of liver. Abdomen.-~ Dull aching in hiver and epigastrium. Pain at wmbilicus. Throbbing in hypogastrium and pelvis. JESCULUS HUPPOCASTANCM Wy

Rectum. — Dry, aching. Feels full of small stacks. Anus raw, sore. Much pain after stool, with prolapse. Hemorrhoids, with sharp shooting pains up the back; blind and bleeding; worse during climacteric. Large, hard, dry stools. Mucous membraue scems swollen and obstructs the passage. Irritation caused by ascarides and aids their expulsion. Burning in anus with chilis up ond down back. Urinary, —- Frequent, scant, hot urine, Pain in kidneys, especially left and ureter. Male. --- Discharge of prostatic fluid at stool, Femaie.— Constant throbbing behind symphysis pubis. Leucorrhea, with lamencss of buck acrass the sacro-~ iliac articulation; dack yellow, sticky corroding; worse after menses, Chest. — Feels constricted. Tleart’s action full and heavy, can feel putsations ali over. Laryngitis; coughs depending on hepatic disorders; hot feeling in chest; pain around heart.

Extremities. — Aching and soreness in limbs, in left acromion process with shooting down arms: finger tips numb.

Back.— Lameness in neck; aching between shoulder blades; region of spine fecls weak; back and legs give out. Backache affecting sacrum and hips; worse watking or stvoping, When walking feet turn under, Soles feel sore, tired, and swell. Hands and feet swell, and become red after washing, feel full.

Fever.— Chill at 4 p. m. Chilliness up and down back. Fever 7 to 12 p,m. Evening fever, skin hot and dry. Sweat profuse and hot with the fever.

Modalities. — IVorse, in morning on awaking, and from any motion; fiom moving bowels; after eating, afternoon, standing. Better, while at rest; walking; cool open air.

Comparison. — Aisculus ylabra — Ohio Buckeye — (Very painful, dark purple, external hemorrhoids, with constipation and vertigo and portal congestion. Speech thick, tickling in throat, impaired vision, paresis.) Aloes; Coltinsonia; Nux; Sulph. Phytolacca (throat dry, more often in acute cases.) Negundium Amcricannum — Boxelder — (Engorgements of rectum and piles with great pain, ten-drop doses of tincture every two hours.) Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Aethiops Mercurialis
remedies.commonName: Sulph. and Quicksilver, or Black Sulphur Mercury
remedies.text:
(Sulph. and Quicksilver, or Black Sulphur Mercury) This preparation is of use in scrofulous affections, ophthalmia, otorrheea, painful, irritating, scabby eruptions, hereditary syphilis. Skin. -- Eruptions, Favus-tike. scrafulous, herpetic and eczematous. Dose, — The lower triturations, especially the second decimal.

Relationship. — -Ethiops Antimonalis — ZZthiops plus Antimony —(often more effective than the above in scrofulous eruptions, glandular swellings, otorrhoa and scrofulous eye affections, corneal ulcers, Third trituration.) Cale.; Sil; Fsorin.

remedies.name: Aethusa Cynapium
remedies.text:
(Fool's Parsley) The characteristic symptoms relate mainly to the brain and nervous systein, connected with gastro-intestinal disturbance. Anguish, crying, and expression of uneasiness and discontent, lead to this remedy most frequently in disease in children, during dentition, summer complaint, when, with the diarrhea, there is marked inability to digest milk, and poor circulation. Symp~ toms set in with oolence, Mind, — Restless, anxious, crying. Sees rats, cats, dogs, etc. Unconscious, delirious. Jnabiltty to think, to fix the attention, Brain fag. [Picric actd.] Head, -— Feels bound up, or in a vise. Occipital pain extending down spine; better lying down and by pressure. Head symptoms relieved by expelling fiatus [Sanguis.] and by stool. Hair feels pulled. Vertigo with drowsincss, with palpitation; head hot after vertigo ceases. Eyes, — Photophohia; swetling of Meibomian glands. Rolling of eyes on falling asleep, Eyes drawn downward; pupils dilated.

Ears. — Feel obstructed. Sense of something hot from ears, Hissing sound. Nose, — Stopped up with much thick mucus. Herpetic eruption on tip of nose. Frequent ineffectual desire to sneeze.

Face.— Puffed, red-spotted, collapsed. Expression anxious, full of pain; linea nasalis marked. Mouth,— Dry. Apththe. Tongue seems too long, Burning and pustules in throat, with difficult swallowing. Stomach. —Jntolerance of milk; vomited as soon as swallowed or in large curds. [Voler.] Regurgitation of food about an hour after eating. Violent vomiting of a white frothy matter. Nausea at sight of food. Painful contraction of stomach, Vomiting, with sweat and great weakness, accompanied by anguish and distress, followed by sleepiness. Stomach feels turned upside down, with burning feeling up to the chest. Tearing pains in the stomach extending to cesophagus.

Abdomen. — Cold, internal and external, with aching pain in howels. Colic, followed by vomiting, vertigo, and weakness. Tense, inflated, and sensitive. Bubbling sensition around navel.

Stool. — Undigested, thin, greenish, preceded hy colic, with tenesmus, and followed by exhaustion and drowsiness. Cholera infantum; child cold, clammy, stupid, with staring eyes and dilated pupils. Obstinate constipation; feels as if all bowel action is lost. Choleraic affections in oid age.

Urinary. — Cutting pain in bladder, with frequent urging. Pain in hidneys.

Female. — Lancinating pains in sexual organs. Pimples; itching when warm. Menses watery. Swelling of mammary glands, with lancinating pains.

Respiratory. — Difficult, oppressed, anxious respiration, crampy constriction. Sufferings render patient specchless. Heart. ~— Violent palpitatioa, with vertigo, headache and restlessness, Pulse rapid, hard and small. Back and

Extremities. — Want of power to stand up or hold head up. Back feels as if in a vise. Aching in smail of back, Weakness of lower extremities. Fingers and thumbs clenched. Numbness of hands and feet. Violent spasms. Squinting of eyes downward.

Skin. — Excoriation of thighs in walking. Easy perspiration Surface of body cold and covercd with clammy sweat. Lamphatic glands swollen, Itching eruption around joints. Skin of hands dry and shrunken. Ecchymosis. Anasarca.

Fever. — Great heat; no thirst. Profuse, cold sweat. Must be covered during sweat, Sleep.— Disturbed by violent startings; cold perspiration. Dozing after vomiting or stool. Child is so exhausted, i falls asleep at once. Modalities. -- Worse, 3 to 4 a.m, and evenings; warmth, summer. Better in open air and company. Compare: Athamantha (confused head, vertigo better lying down, bilter taste and saliva. Hands and feet icy cold); Antimon.; Cale.; Ars.; Cicuta. Complementary: Cale. : Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Agaricus Muscarius
remedies.text:
(Bug Agaric — Amanita) Jerking, twitching, trembling, and itching are strong indications. Incipient phthisis; is related to the tubersular diathesis, anemia, chorea, various forms of neucalgia and spasmodic affections, and neurotic skin troubles are pictured in the symptomatology of this remedy. It corresponds to various forms of cerebral 2xcitement rather than congestion. Thus, in delirium of fevers, alcoholism, etc. General paralysis. Sensa- ‘ion as tf pierced by needles of tce. Sensitive to pressure and cold air. Viaient bearing-down pains. Symp- .oms appear diagonally as right arm and feft leg. Pains are accompanied by sensation of cold, numbness and ‘ingling. Mind, — Sings, talks, but does not answer. Loguacity. Aversion to work. Indifference. Fearlessness. Delirium characterized by singing, shouting, and mutering; rhymes and prophesies., Begins with paroxysm of yawning.

Head.— Vertigo from sunlight, and on walking. Head in constant motion, Falling backward, as if a weight in occiput. Lateral headache, as if from a nail. [Coff.; Zgnat.] Dull headache from prolonged deskwork. Icy coldness, ike icy needles, or splinters, Desire to cover head warmly. [Sifica.] Headache with nose-blecd or thick mucus discharge.

Eyes. — Reading dificull, as type seems io move, to swim. Vibrating specters. Double vision [Gels.], dim and flickering, Asthenopia from prolonged strain, spasm of accommodation. Twitching of lids and cyebails, [Cedein.] Margins of lids red; itch and burn and agglutinate. Inner angles very red.

Ears. — Burn and itch, as if frozen. Twitching and noises, Nose. — Nervows nasal disturbances. Itching internally and externally. Spasmodic sneezing after coughing; sensitiveness; watery non-iuflammatory discharge. Inner angles very red. Fetid, dark, bloody discharge. Nosebleed in old people, Face. — Facial muscles feel stiff; teitch: face itches and burns, Lancinating, tearing pain in cheeks, as of splinters, Neuralgia, as if cold needles ran through nerves or sharp ice touched them. Mouth. —- Herpes on tips. Twitching. Taste sweet. Aphthz on roof of mouth. Splinter-like pains in tongue. Thirsty all the time. Tremulous tongue. [Lach.) Tongue white.

Throat.— Stitches along eustachian tube to ear. Feels contracted. Small sotid balls of phlegm thrown up. Dryness of pharynx, swallowing difficult, Scratching in throat; cannot sing a note. sStomach.— Empty eructations, tasting of apples. Nervous disturbances, with spasmodic contractions, hiccough, Unnatural hunger. Flatulent distention of stomach and abdomen, Profuse inodorous flatus. Burning in stomach about three hours after a meal, changing into a dull pressure. Gastric disturbance with sharp pains ot liver region. Abdomen, — Stitching pains in liver, spleen and abdomen. Stitches under short ribs, left side. Diarrhea with much fetid flatus. Fetid stools, Urinary, — Stitches in urethra. Sudden and viclent urging te urinate. Frequent urination.

Female. — Menses, increased, earlier, Itching and tearing, pressive pains of genitals and back. Spasmodic dysmerorrheea. Severe bearing-down pains, especially after menopausc, Sexual excitement. Nipples itch, burn. Complaints following parturition and coitus. Leucorrheea, with much itching, Respiratory Organs,— Violent attacks of coughing that can be suppressed by effort of will. Spasmadic cough at night after falling asleep, wtth expectoration of little balls of mucus. Labored, oppressed breathing. Cough ends in a sneeze. Heart.—Jrregular, iumultnous palpitation, after tebacco. Pulse intermittent and irregular. Cardiac region oppressed, as if thorax were narrowed. Palpitation with redness of face. Back, — Pain, with sensitiveness of spine to touch; worse in dorsal region. Lumbago; worse in open air. Crick in back. Teevitching of cervical muscles.

Extremities. — Stiff all over. Pain over hips. Weakness in loins, Uncertain gait. Trembling. itching of toes and feet as if frozex. Cramp in soles of feet. Pain in shin-bone. Neuralgia in locomotor ataxia, Paralysis of lower limbs, with spasmodic condition of arms. Numbness of legs on crossing them, Paralytic pain in left arm followed by palpitation, Skin. — Burning, itching, redness, and swelling, as from frost-bites. Pimples, hard, like flea-bites. Miliary eruption, with intolerable itching and burning. Chilblains. Angioneurotic oedema; rosacea. Swollen veins with cold skin. Circumscribed erythematous, papular and pustular and aedcmatous lesions.

Sleep. — Purorysms of yawning. Restless from vio-~ lent itching and burning. On falling asleep, starts, twitches, and awakens often, Vivid dreams. Drowsy in daytime. Yawning, followed by involuntary laughter

Fever. — Very sensitive to cool air. Violent attacks of heat in evening. Copious sweat. Burning spots.

Modalities. — Worse, open cold air, after eating, after coitus. In cold weather, before a thunder-storm. Worse, pressure on dorsal spine, which causes involuntary laughter, Better, moving about slowly.

Relationship.— Compare: Cimicif.; Cann. ind.; Hyos.; Tarantula: Muscatine, the alkaloid of Agaricus {has much power over secretions, increasing lachrymal, salivary, hepatic, etc, but diminishing renal; probably neurotic in origin, stimulating the terminal fibres of the secretory nerves of all these structures, hence salivation, lachrymation and excessive perspiration, Atropin exactly opposes Muscarine, Resembles Pilocarpin in action.) .fmanita vernus— spring mushroom—a variety of Agar Phalloides; (vomiting and purging. Continuous urging to stool, but sa gastric, abdominal or rectal pain. Intense thirst for cold water, dry skin. Lethargic but menialiy clear. Sharp changes from rapid to slow and from slow to rapid breathing, extreme collapse, suppressed urine, but mo cold extremities or cramps.) <lgaric. emet, (severe vertigo; all symptoms better, cold water; longing for te-rwater), Agar. Phalfoides (cholera, incessant cramps in stomach; prostration). Tamus (chilblans). Antidote: Absinth.; Coffea; Camphkor, Dose. —- Third to thirtieth and two hundredth potency. In skin affections give the lower attenuations.

remedies.name: Agave Americana
remedies.text: (Century Plant) Indicated in stomacace, and painful erections in gonorrhea, Hydrophobia. Scurvy; coutitenance pale, gums swollen and bieeding, legs covered with dark purple blotches, swollen, painful and hard. Appetite poor; bowels constipated, Relationship. — Compare: Lyssin; Lach.; Aloe; Phos. Dose. -- Tincture,

remedies.name: Agnus Castus
remedies.text:
(The Chaste Tree) The most effective point of attack of Agnus upon the organism is the sexual organism. It lowers sexual vitality, with corresponding mental depression and loss oi nervous energy. It shows this distinctive influence in both sexes, but is more pronounced in men. Premature old age from abuse of sexual power. History of repeated gonorrhceas. A prominent remedy for sprains and strains. Gnawing itching in all parts, especially eyes. Tachycardia caused by tobacco in neurotic young men, Mind.— Sexual melancholy. Fear of death. Sadness with impression of speedy death, Absentmintled, forgetful, lack of courage. Illusion of smell —- herrings, musk. Nervous depression and mental forebodings. Eyes,— Pupits dilated. [Bell] Itching about eyes; photophobia. Nose, ~ Odor of herring or musk. Aching in dorsum better pressure.

Abdomen. — Spleen swollen, sore. Stools soft, recede, difficult. Deep fissures in anus. Nausea with sensation as if intestines were pressed downwards; wants te support bowels.

Male.— Yellow discharge from urethra. No erections. fmpotence. Parts cold, relaxed. Desire gone. [Seien.; Con.; Sabal.] Scanty emission without ejaculation. Loss of prostatic fluid on straining, Gleety discharge. Testicles cold, swollen, hard, and painful.

Female. — Scanty menses. Abhorrence of sexual intercourse. Relaxation of genitals, with leucorrhea. Agalactia; with sadness. Sterility. {Awr.; Nat m.; Bor.) Leucorrheea staining yellow; transparent. Relationship, — Compare: Selenium; Phosph. ac. ; Camphor; Lycop. Dose. -— First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Agraphis Nutans
remedies.text:
(Bluebell) A tendency to free discharge from mucous membranes, a relaxed condition of the system generally and @ proneness to take cold on exposure to cold winds. (Cooper.) Catarrhal conditions; obstruction of nostrils. Adenoids, throat deafness. Enlarged tonsils. Mucous diarthea from cold, Chill from cold winds. [Acon.; Silica.} Throat and ear troubles with tendency to free discharge from mucous membrancs, Mutinism of childhood unconnected with deafness.

Relationship. — Compare: Hydrast.; Cepe; Cale. phos.; Squitia, Dose.— Third potency. Single doses of tincture.

remedies.name: Ailanthus Glandulosa
remedies.text:
(Chinese Sumach) This remedy shows by its peculiar skin symptoms its Qyonounced power of disorganizing the blood, causing conditions we meet with in low fevers, low types of eruptive diseases, diphtheria, follicular tonsillitis, etc. The skin appears livid or purplish; face dark as mahogany, hot; sordes; throat swollen, purple, livid; semi-~ conscious, delirious; weak pulse, general torpor and prostration. Symptoms remarkably alike to malignant scarlatina. Diarrhea, dysentery and great weakness are very marked. Adynamia characterizes all its conditions. Lividity, stupor and matignancy. Head. ~~ General stupor, with sighing. Confused mind, mental depression. Headache, frontal, with drowsiness. Suffused, dilated eyes; photophobia, Face dusky. Thin, copious, ichorous, Woody nasal discharge.

Throat. — Inflamed, edematous, dusky red. Much swelling, internal and external. Dry, rough, scraping, choking feeling. Neck tender and swollen. Hoarse, croupy voice. Tongue dry and brown. Teeth covered with sordes. Pam in swallowing extends to the ears.

Respiratory. — Hurried breathing: irregular. Dry, hacking cough, Lungs sore and tired.

Sleep. — Drowsy, restless. Heavy, disturbed, unrefreshing.

Skin. — Miliary, livid rash, returns annually, Large IMisters filled with dark serum. Irregular, patchy, livid cruption, disappearing on pressure, Cold.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Rhus; Nux. Compare: Ammon. carb.; Bapt.; Arn.; Mur. ac.; Lach.; Rhus. , Dose. — First to sixth potency,

remedies.name: Aletris Farinosa
remedies.text:
(Stargrass) An anzmic, relaxed condition, especially of the female organism, is protrayed by this remedy. The patient is tired all the time, and suffers from prolapsus, leucorrhea, rectal distress, etc. Marked anemia. Chlorotic girls and pregnant women. Mind, — Power and energy weakened. Confused feelings. Cannot concentrate mind, Fainting, with vertigo. Mouth, — Much frothy saliva.

Stomach. — Diszust for food. Least food causes distress. Fainting spells, with vertigo. Vomiting during Pregnancy. Nervous dyspepsia. Flatulent colic. (Magnes, phos.) Rectum. — Loads up with faces— paretic condition. Stool Jarge, hard, difficult, great pain. Female, — Premature and profuse menses, with laborlike pains. [Bell.; Cham.; Kali c.; Plat.] Retarded and scanty flow. (Senecio.) Uterus seems heavy. Prolapse, with pain in right inguina] region. Leucorthea. Habitual tendency to abortion. Muscular pains during pregnancy. Relationship, — Compare: Heionias;. Hydrastis; Tanacel,; China, Dose. -- Tincture to third potency.

remedies.name: Alfalfa
remedies.commonName: Medicago Sativa. California Clover or Lucerne
remedies.text:
(Medicago Sativa. California Clover or Lucerne) From its action on the sympathetic, Alfalfa favorably influences nutrition, evidenced in “toning up” the appetite and digestion resulting in greatly improved mental and physical vigor, with gain in weight. [Hydr.] Disorders characterized by malnutrition are mainly within its therapeutic range, for example, neurasthenia, splanchnic blues, nervousness, insomnia, nervous indigestion, etc. Its pronounced urinary action suggests it clinically in diabetes insipidus.and phosphaturia; and it is claimed to allay vesical irritability of prostatic hypertrophy. The rheumatic diathesis secms especially amenable to its action, Mind. —It induces mental exhilaration of buoyancy, f. ¢,, a general feeling of well being; clear and bright, so that all blues are dissipated. Dull, drowsy, stupid [Geis.}; gloomy and irritable, worse during evening.

Head. — Dull, heavy feeling in occiput, in and ahove the eyes, worse toward evening. Pain in left side of head.

Ears. — Stuffed feeling in eustachian tubes [Kali mur.) at night; patulous in morning. Stomach —- Increased thirst. Appetite impaired, but chiefly increased even to bulimia. He must eat frequently, so that he cannot wait for regular meals; hungry in forenoon. [Sul] Much nibbling of food and craving for swects.

Abdomen. — Flatulence with distention. Shifting, flatulent pain along colon several hours after meals. Frequent, loose, yellow, painful stools, with burning of flatulence, Urine. — Kidneys inactive; frequent urging to urinate. Polyuria. [Phos. o¢.] Increased elimination of urea, indican and phosphates. Sleep.-- Slept better than usual, especially in early morning; it induces quiet, reposeful and refreshing sleep.

Relationship.— Compare: Avena sat.; Dipodium punct.; Gels.; Hydr.; Kali phos.; Phos. ac.; Zinc.

Dose. — The best results are elicited with material doses (5-10) drops of tincture, several times daily. Continue its use until tonic effects ensue.

remedies.name: Allium Cepa
remedies.text:
(Red Onion) A picture of coryza, with acrid nasal discharge and laryngeal symptoms (nasal secretion acrid, ocular dland) Euphrasia opposite, singers’ cold, worse in worm room aud toward evening; better in open air is presented by this remedy. Neuralgic pains, like @ fine thread, following amputations or injuries tu nerves. Traumatic chronic neuritis, Burning in nose, mouth, throat, bladder and skin. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body.

Head. — Catarrhal headache, mostly in forehead; worse in warm room and towards evening. Threadlike pains in face. Headache ceases during menses; returns when flow disappears.

Eyes. — Red. Much burning and smarting lachrymation, Sensitive to light. Eyes suffused and watery; profuse, é/and lachrymation, better in open air. Burning in eyelids.

Ears. — Earache, shooting in eustachian tube.

Nose. — Sneezing, especially when entcring a warm room, (Copious, watery and extremely acrid discharge. Feeling of a Jump at root of tose. Hay-fever. [Sebad., Sifl.: Psor.J Fluent coryza with headache, cough, and hoarseness, Polypus, Stomach —Canine hunger. Pain in pyloric region. Thirst. Retching. Nausea. Abdomen. -— Rumlling, offensive flatus. Pains in left hypogastrium. Colic sitting, moving about, Rectum,— Diarrhea with very offensive flatus. Stitches in rectum ; itching and rhagades in anus, Glowing heat in rectum.

Urinary. — Sensation of weakness in bladder and urethra, increased secretion of urine with coryza. Urine red with much pressure and burning in urethia.

Respiratory. — Hoarsencss. Hackiny cough on inspiring cold air. Tickling in larynx. Sensation as sf larynx ts split er torn, Oppressed breathing, Constricted feeling m region of epiglotiis. Pain extending to ear, Extremities. — Lame joints. Ulcers on heel, Painful affections of fingers ahout nails. Neuralgia of stump. Bad effects from getting feet wet. Limbs, especially arms, feel sore and tired, Sleep.— Yawning with headache and drowsiness. Gaping in deep sleep, Dreams. Wakes at 2 a. M.

Modalities. — Worse, in the evening, in warm room, Better, in open air, and in cold room. Relationship -- Compare: Gels.; Euph.; Kali hyd.; Aconite; Ipecac. Complementary: Phosphor.; Thuja; Puls, Antidotes: drn.; Cham.; Verat.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Allium Sativum
remedies.text:
(Garlic) Adapted to fleshy subjects with dyspepsia and catarrhal affections. High livers. Patients who eat a great deal more than they drink. Pain im hip, pain in psons and iliac muscles. Pulmonary tuberculosis. Cough and expectoration diminishes, temperature becomes normal, weight is gained, and sleep becomes regular, Hamoaptysis.

Head. — Heavy; pulsation in temples; catarrhal deafness. Mouth — Much swectish saliva after meals and at night.

Stomach. — Voracious appetite. Burning eructations. Le&st change in dict causes trouble. Constipation, with constant dull pains in bowels. Tongue pate, red papille.

Respiratory. — Constant rattling of mucus in bronchi. Cough in the morning after leaving bedroom, with mucous expectoration, which is tenacious and difficult to raise. Sensitive to cold air. Dilated bronchi, with fetid expectoration, Darting pain in chest. Relationship, — Compare: Capsicum ; Arsenic; Senega; Kali nit. Complementary: Arsenic. Antidote: Lycopod. Dose, — Third to sixth potency. In tuberculosis, dose, four to six grammes in moderate state of dessication daily, in divided doses.

remedies.name: Alnus
remedies.text: {Red Alder) Tlas some reputation as a remedy for skin affections, glandular enlargements, and indigestion from imperfect secretion of gastric juice. It stimulates nutrition, and thus acts favorably upon strumous disorders, enlarged glands, etc, Ulcerated mucous membranes of mouth and throat, Fingers covered by crust caused by pustules, disagrevable odor. Female. —~ Leucorrhwa, with erosions of cervix, bleeding easily. Amenortinea, with Luruing pains from back 10 pubis, Sktn.--Chronic herpes, Eularged sub-maxiliary glands. Eczema, prurigo, Purpura hamorrhagica. Poisoa-nax. Use locally, Dose. — Tincture to third potency.

remedies.name: Aloe
remedies.text:
(Socotrine Aloes) An excellent remedy to aid in re-establishing physiological equilibrium after much dosing, where disease and drug s;mptoms are much mixed, There is no remedy richer in symptoms of portal congestion and none that kas given better clinical results, both for the primary pathological condition and secondary phenumena al effects from sedentary life or habits. Especially suitable to lymphatic and hypochondriacal patients. The rectal symptoms usually determine the choice. Adapted to weary people, the aged, and phlegmatic, old beer-drinkers. Dissatisfied and angry about himself, atternating with lumbago. Heat internally and externally. Has heen used successfully in the treatment of consumption by giving the pure juice.

Head. — Headache alternates with Iumbago, with intestinal and uterine affections. Disinclination to mental labor, Aches above forehead, with heaviness in cyes, must partially clase them. Headache after stool. Dull, pressive pain; worse from heat. Eyes. —-Compelled to make small during pain in forehead. Tlickering before eyes. Redness of eyes with yellow vision. Pain decp in orbits. Face. —- Marked redness of lips.

Ears. — Cracking when chewing. Sudden explosion and clashing in left ear, Tinkling as of some thin, shivered, metallic globe in head.

Nose. — Coldness of tip. Bleeding in morning on awakening. : Mouth. — Taste bitter and sour. Tasteless eructatons.

Throat.— Thick lumps of tough mucus. Varicose condition of veins in pharynx.

Stomach. — Aversion to meat, Longing for juicy things. After eating, flatulence, pulsation in rectum, and sexual irritation. Nausea, with headache, Pain in pit when making false step.

Abdomen.— Pain around navel, worse pressure. Fullness in region of liver, pain under right ribs. Abdomen fecls full, heavy, hot, bloated, Pulsating pain around navel. Weak feeling, as if diarrhoea would come on. Sensation of plug between symphysis pubis and os coccygis, with urging to stool. Great accumulation of ftatus, pressing downwards, causing distress in lower bowels. Colic before and during stool, Burning, copious flatus. Rectum, — Constant bearing down in rectum; bleeding, sore, and hot; relieved by cold water. Feeling of weakness and loss of power of sphincter ani. Sense of insecurity in rectum, when passing flatus, Uncertain whether gas or stool will come. Stool passes without effort, almost unnoticed. Lumpy, watery stool. Jelly-like stools, with soreness in rectum after stool. A: lot of mucus, with pain in rectum after stool. Hemorrhoids protrude like grapes; very sore and tender; better cald water application. Burning in anus and rectum. Constipation, with heavy pressure in lower part of abdomen, Diarrheea from beer.

Urinary.— Incontinence in aged, bearing-down sen- Female, — Bearing down in rectum, worse standing and during menses, Uterus feels heavy, cannot walk much on that. account. Labor-like pains in foins: extend down legs. Climacteric hemorrhage. Menses too early and too profuse. Respiratory. -- Winter coughs, with itching. Difficult respiration, with stitches from liver to chest.

Back.— Pain in small of back: worse moving. Stitches through sacrum. Cusmbago alternating with headache and piles, Extremities. — Lameness in all limbs. Drawing paint in joints. Soules pain when walking Modalities, —[orse, early morning; summer; heat; in hot, dry weather; after cating or drinking. Better, from cold, open air.

Relationship. — Complementary: Sulphur; compare: Kali bich.; Lycop.; Allium sat. Antidotes: Opiun; Sulph, Dose. — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Alstonia
remedies.text:
(Dita Bark) Malarial diseases, with diarrhea, dysentery, ania, feeble digestion, are the general conditions suggesting this remedy. Characteristics are the gone sensation in stomach and sinking in abdomen, with debility. 4 tonic after exhausting fezcrs, Abdomen, — Violcut purging and cramp in bowels. Heat and irritation in lower howels Camp diarrhoea, bloody stool, dysentery; diarrha@a from bad water and malaria. Painless watery stools, [Phosph. ac.) Diarrheea immediately after eating.

Relationship. — Compare: Ditain (active principle, is auti-periodic, like quinine, but without unpleasant effects). Cinchona (similar in diarrhoea, chronic dyspepsia and debility}. /7ydrastis; Fer. cit, ct chin.

Dose. — Tincture to third potency. Locally, for ulcers and rheumatic pains.

remedies.name: Alumen
remedies.text:
(Common Potash Alum) The clinical application of this remedy points to its howel symptoms, both in chstinate constipation and in haemorrhage from bowels in the course of typhoid — one phase of the paralytic weakness of the muscles in all parts of the body. Tendency to induration is also marked, a low form of tissue-making is favored. Hardening of tissues of tongue, rectum, uterus, etc.; ulcers with indurated base. Adapted to old people, especially bronchial catarrhs. Sensation of dryness and constriction. Mental paresis: dysphagia especially to figuids. Tendency to induration.

Head. — Burning pain as of weight on top of head; better by pressure of hand. Vertigo, with weakness in pit of stomach.

Throat. — Throat relaxed. Mucous membrane red and swollen. Cough. Tickling in throat. Tendency to throat colds. Lutarged and indurated tonsils, Burning pain down the cesophagus. Complete aphonia. Every cold settles in throat. Constriction of esophagus. [Bapt.]

Heart. — Palpitation, from lying down on right side.

Rectum. — Constipation of the most aayravated kind. No desire for stoul for days, Violcnt ineffectual urging to stool. No ability iv expel sluol Marble-dike masses pass, but rectuin still feels full, Itching after stool. Itching in anus. Long lasting pain and smarting in rectum after stool; also hemorrhoids. Yellow, like an infant's. Hemorrhage from bowels.

Female. — Tendency to induration of neck of uterus and mammary glands. [Carb. ax.; Con.] Chronic yellow vaginal discharge. Chronic gonorrhoea, yellow, with little lumps along urethra, Aphthous patches in vagina. [Cax!.j Menses watery.

Respiratory. — Hamoptysis, great weakness of chest; difficult to expel mucus. Copious, ropy morning ex+ pectoration in old people, Asthma.

Skin. — Ulcers, with indurated base. To be thought of in indurated glands, epithehoma, ete.; veins become varignts, and bleed. Indurations resulting from longcontinued inflammatory irritations. Glands inflame and harden. Alopecia, Extremities. —}’cakness of all muscles, especially arms and legs. Constricted feeling around limbs. Modalities. —J¥orse, cold except headache, which is relieved by cold.

Dose. — First to thirtieth potency. The very highest potencies have proved efficacious. Powdered alum, 10 grains, placed on tongue, said to arrest au attack of asthma,

remedies.name: Alumina
remedies.text:
(Oxide of Aluminum — Argilla) A very general condition corresponding to this drug is dryness of mucous membranes and skin, and tendency to paretic musculur states. Old peopte, with lack of vital heat, or prematurely old, with debility. Sluggish functions, heaviness, numbness, and staggering, and the characteristic constipation find an excellent remedy in Alumina. Disposition to colds in the head, and eructations in spare, dry, thin subjects.

Mind. — Low-spirited; fears loss of reason, Confused as to personal identity. Hasty, hurried. Time passes slowly. Variable mood. Better as day advances. Suicidal tendency when seeing knife or blood. Head, — Stitching, burning pain in head, with vertigo, worse in morning, but relieved by food. Pressure in forehead as from a tight hat. Inability to walk except with eyes open. Throbbing headache, with constipation, Vertigo, with nausea; better after breakfast. Falling out of hair; scalp itches and is numb, Eyes. — Objects look yellow. Eyes feel cold. Lids dry, burn, smart, thickened, aggravated in morning; chronic conjunctivitis. Ptosis. Strabismus.

Ears. — Humming; roaring. Eustachian tube feels plugged. Nose, — Pain at root of nose, Sense of smell diminished. Fluent coryza. Point of nose cracked, nostrils sore, red, worse touch. Scabs with thick yellow mucus. Tettery redness, Osana atrophica sicca, Membranes distended and boggy.

Face. — Feels as if albuminous substance had dried on it, Bload-bails and pimples. Twitchmg of lower jaw. Rush of bleed to face after eating, Mouth. — Sore. Bad odor from it, Teeth covered with sordes, Gums sore, bleeding. Tensive pain in articulation of jaw when opening mouth or chewing. Throat..— Dry, sore; food cannot pass, cesophagus contracted. Feels as if splinter or plug were iu throat. Irritable, and relaxed uiroat. Looks parched and glazed. Clergyman’s sore throat iu thin subjects, Thick, tenacious tucus drops from posterior nares.

Stomach. — Almormal cravings — chalk, charcoal, dry food, tea-grounds, Hearthurn; feels constricted. Aversion to meat. [Craph.; .tra., Puls} Potatoes disagree. No desire to eat. Can swallow but small morsels at a time, Constriction of cesophagus.

Abdomen. — Colic, like painter’s colic, Pressing in hoth groins toward sexual organs, Left-sided abdominal complaints, Stool. Hard, dry, knotty; no desire, Rectum sore, dry, inflamed, bleeding. Itching and burning at anus. Even a soft stool is passed with difficulty. Great straining. Constipation of infants [Collins.; Psor.: Parof.] and old people from inactive rectum, and in women of very sedentary habit. Diarrhoea on urinating. Evarwation preceacd by painful urging long before stool, and then straining at stool.

Urine. — Muscles of bladder paretic, must strain at stool tn order to urinate, Pain in kidneys, with mental confusion. Frequent desire to trinate in old people. Difficult starting.

Male.— Excessive desire, Involuntary emissions when straining at stool. Prostatic discharge.

Female. — Menses too early, short, scanty, pate, followed by great exhaustion, (Carb, an.; Coccul.] Leucorrheea acrid, profuse, transparent, ropy, with burning; worse during daytime. and after menses. Relieved by washing with cold water. Respiratory. -— Cough soon after waking in the morning. Hoarse, aphonia, tickling in larynx; wheezing, rattling respiration, Cough on talking or singing, in the morning. Chest feels constricted. Condiments produce cough. Talking aggravates sorencss of chest.

Back. — Stitches, Gnawing pain, as if from hot iron. Pain along cord, with paralytic weakness.

Extremities. — Pain in arm and fingers, as if hot iron penetrated, Arms feel paralyzed, Legs feel asleep, especially when sitting with legs crossed. Staggers on walking, Heels feel numb. Soles tender; on stepping, feel soft and swollen, Pain in shoulder and upper arm. Gnawing beneath finger nails, Brittle nails. Inability to walk, except when eyes are open or in daytime, Sleep. — Restless; anxtous and confused dreains. Sleepy in morning.

Skin. — Chapped and dry. Brittle nails, Jntolerable tiching whon getting warm in bed. Must scratch until it bleeds; then becomes painfus. Brittle skin on fingers.

Modalities. — Worse, periodically; in afternoon; from potatoes. Worse, in morning on awaking; warm room. Better, in open air; from cold washing; in evening and on alternate days. Better, damp weather.

Relationship. — Compare: Silico —Swulphocalcite of Alumina 3x (anal itching, piles, constipation, flatulent distention); Secale; Lathyr.; Plumb, Aluminum acetate solution. (Externally as lotion for putrid wounds and skin infections.) Alumina silicate, Andalasite rock (Alumina 63 and Silica 37 parts). (Deep actitig remedy for chronic complaints of brain, spine and nerves, Constriction is a marked general symptom, also constriction ef orifices. Venous distention. Weakness, especially spinal, Aching and burning in spine. Formication, numbness, pain in all limbs, Epileptiform convulsion. Coldness during pains.) Complementary: Bryonia. Antidotes: /pecac.; Chamoam.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth and higher, Action slow in developing,

remedies.name: Ambra Grisea
remedies.commonName: Ambergis — A Morbid Secretion of the Whale
remedies.text:
(Ambergis — A Morbid Secretion of the Whale) Suitable to excitable, nervous children and thin, nervous patients. Extreme nervous hypersensitiveness. Externai numbness of whole body in the morning and weakness. Nervous hilious temperament. Thin, scrawny women. Adapted to hysterical subjects, or those suffering from spinal irritation, with convulsive cough, eructation, etc, Also for patients weakened by aye or overwork, who are anaemic and sleepless. Onesided complaints call for it. Music aggravates sympfoms.

Mind.— Dread of people, and desire to be alone. Cannot do anything in the presence of others. Music causes weeping. Despair, loathing of life, Fantastic illusions, Rashful. Loss of love of life. Restless, excited, very loquacious, Time passes slowly. Thinking. dificult in the morning with old people.

Head. — Slow comprehension. Vertigo, with weakness in head and stomach. Tearing pain in upper half of brain. Rush of blood to head, when listening to music, Hearing impaired, Epistaxis, especially in the morning. Profuse bleeding from teeth. Hair fails out, Stomach. — Eructations, with violent, convulsive cough. Acid eructations, like heartburn. Distention of stomach and abdomen after midnight. Sensation of coldness in abdomen. Urinary. --- Pain in bladder and rectum at the same time. Burning in orifice of urethra and anus Fechag in urethra as tf a few drops passed out, Burning and itching in urethra while urinating. Urine turbid, even during emission, forming a brown sediment, Femaje,— Nymphomania, ditching of pudendum, with soreness and swelling, Menses too early. Profuse, bluish leucorrhoea. Worse at night, Discharge of blood betiecen periods, at every little accident.

Male.— Voluptuous itching of scrotum. Parts externally numb; burn internally. Violent erections without voluptuous sensations.

Respiratory.— Asthmatic breathing with eructation of gas. Nervous, spasmodic cough, with hoarseness and ersctation, on waking in morning; worse in presence of people. Tickling in throat, larynx and trachea, chest oppressed, gets out of breath when coughing. Hollow, spasmodic, barking cough, coming from decp in chest. Choking when hawking up phlegm.

Heart. — Palpitation, with pressure in chest as from a lump lodged there, or as if chest was obstructed. Conscious of the pulse. Palpitation in open air with pale face.

Sleep.— Cennot sicep from worry; must get up. Anxious dreams. Coldness of hody and twitching of limbs, dusing sleep, Skin. — Itching and soreness, especially around genitals. Numbness of skin. Arms “go to sleep.” Extremities. — Cramps in hands and fingers, worse grasping anything, Cramps in legs. Modalities, -~ Worsc, music; presence of strangers; from any unusual thing; morning, warm room. Better, slow motion in open air; lying on painful part; cold drinks, Relationship. — 10 not confound with Amber — Succinum. q. v. Moschus frequently follows advantageously, Compare: Oleunt suceinum Chiccough), Sumbul; Castor.; ctsaf, Dose. — Second and third potencies,

remedies.name: Ambrosia
remedies.text:
(Rag-Weed) A remedy for hay-fever, and some forms of whooping-congh. Respiratary tract in its entire length stopped up. Many forms of diarrhea, especially during summer motiths, also dysentery, Nose. —- Watery coryza; sneezing; watery discharge. Nasebleed, Irritation of trachea and bronchial tubes, with asthmatic attacks. [fraf; Eucclypt.]) Wheezy cough, Eyes.— Smart and burn. Lachrymation.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency; 10 drops in water during and after attack of epistaxis.

remedies.name: Ammoniacum
remedies.text:
(Gum Ammoniac) A remedy for the aged and feeble, especially in chronic brouchilis. Tl humor. Sensitive to cold. * Eyes.— Dim sight. Stars and fiery points float hefore eves. Easily fatigued from reading.

Respiratory. — Throat dry; worse inhaling fresh air. Difficult breathing. Chronic bronchial catarrh. Large accumulation of purutent matter and feeble expectoration; worse cold weather. Mucus tough and hard, Heart beats stronger, extends to pit of stomach, Coarse rattling of chest in old people.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Bry.; Arnica, Compare: Senega: Tart. emet.; Balsam Peru.

Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Ammonium Benzoicum
remedies.text:
(Benzoate of Ammonia) One of the remedies for alhuminuria, especially in the gouty, Gout. with fluid in large toe-joint, Head. — Heavy, stupid.

Face. — Bloated, swollen eyelids. swelling under tongue like ranula, Urine. — Smoky, seanty. Albuminous, Back. — Pain across sacrum, with urgency to stool. Soreness in region of right kidney. Relationship. -- Compare: Terebinth.; Bens, ac.; Ammonia salis; Caust. In albuminuria compare: Kalmia; Helon; Merc. cor.; Berb.; Canth, Dose, — Second tritusation.

remedies.name: Ammonium Bromatum
remedies.text:
(Bromide of Ammonia) Indicated in chronic jaryngeal and pharyngeal catarrh, neuralgic headaches, and obesity. Constructive pain in head, chest, leys, ete. Irritable feeling under finger nails; relieved onty by biting them, Head, — Feeling of a band xbove ears. Sneezing; thick nasal! discharge.

Eyes. — Edges of lids red and swollen, also Meibomian glands. Eyehalls feel large and pain around eyes into head, Throat,—Smartng in mouth. Tickling in throat, with inclination to dry, spasmodic cough, especially at night. Burning in fauces, White, sticky, mucus. Chronic speakers’ catarrh. Catarrh of posterior nares and fauces with thick, stringy mucus.

Respiratory.— Sudden, short cough, strangling. Tickling in trachea and bronchial tuhes. Wakes at 3 A.M. with cough, Feels suffocated; continuous cough, when lying down at night; sharp pain in lungs, Whooping

Cough.— Dry, spasmodic cough, Relationship. — Hyos.: Con.; Ary. nit.: Keli bich, Dose. -- First potency.

remedies.name: Ammonium Carb
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Ammonia) The diseased conditions met by this remedy are stich as we find often in rather stout women who are always tired aud weary, take cold easily, suffer from cholera-like symptoms before menses, lead a sedentary life, have a slow reaction generally, and are disposed to frequent use of the smelling-bottle. Too frequent and profuse menses. Mucous membranes of the res- Piratory organs are especially affected, Fat patients with weak heart, wheezing, feel suffocated. Very sensitive to cold air. Great aversion to water; cannot bear to touch it. Malignant scarlatina, with somnolence, swollen glands, dark red sore throat, faintly developed eruption. Uremia. Heaziness ts all organs. Uncleanness in bodily habits, Swelling of parts, glands, etc. Acid secretions, Mind. —Forgetful, ill-humored, gloomy during stormy weather, Head. — Pulsating forehead; better, pressure and in warm room. Shocks through head.

Eyes. — Burning of eyes with aversion to light. Eyestrain. [Not, mur.} Ears, — Hardness of hearing. Shocks through ears, eyes, and vose, when gnashing teeth.

Nose. — Discharge of sharp, burning water Stuppage at night, with long-continued corysa. Cannot breathe through nose. Snuffles of children. Episiaxis after washing and after eating. Ozana, blows bloody mucus from nose. Tip of nose congested, Face. — Tetters araund mouth. Boils and pustules, during menses, Corners of mouth sore, cracked, and burn, Mouth, — Great dryness of mouth and throat. Toothache. Pressing tecth tegether sends shocks through heed, eyes, and ears. Vesicles on tongue. Taste sour; metallic, Cracking of jaw on chewing.

Throat. — Enlarged tonsils and glands of neck. Burning pain all down throat. Tendency to gangrenous ulceration of tonsils, Dipbtheria when nose is stopped up. Stomach, — Pain at pit of stomach, with heartburn, nausea, waterbrash, and chilliness, Great appetite, but easily satished.

Abdomen. — Noise and pain in abdomen. Filatulent hernia, Stools difficult, hard, and knotty, Bleeding piles; worse during menses, Itching at anus. Protruding piles, worse after stool, better lying down. Urine. Frequent desire; involuntary at night. Tenesmus of bladder, Urine white, sandy, hloody, copious, turbid, and fetid.

Male. — Itching and pain of scrotum and spermatic cords. Erection without desire. Seminal emissions, Female. — Itching, swelling and burning of pudendum, Leucorrheea burning, acrid, watery. Aversion to the other sex. Menses too frequens, profuse, early, copious, clotted, black; colicky pains, and hard, difficult stool, with fatigue, especially of thighs; yawning and chilliness, Respiratory. — Horseness. Cough every morning about three o'clock, with dyspnea, palpitation, burning in chest; worse ascending. Chest feels tired. Emphysema. Much oppression in breathing; worse after any effort, and entering warm room, or ascending even a few steps. Slow labored, stertorous breathing; bubbling sound. Winter catarrh,, with slimy sputum and specks of blood.

Heart.— Audible palpitation with fear, cold sweat, lachrymation, inability to speak, toud breathing and trembling hands. Heart weak. wakes with difficult preathing and palpitation. Extremities. —- Tearing in joints relieved by heat of bed; inclination to stretch limbs. Hands cold and blue; distended veius. Fingers swell when arm is hanging down. Panaritium, dep-seated periosteal pain, Cramps yin calves and soles, Big toe painful and swollen. ,Felons in the beginning. Heel painful on standing. Tearipa in ankle and bones of feet, better when warm ig. pede

Bleep. — Sleepiness during the day. Starts from sleep strangling. Skin. ~ Violent itching and burning blisters. Scarlet rash. Miliary rash, Malignant scarlatiua. Faintly developed eruptions from defective vitality, Erysipelas in the aged, with brain symptoms. Eczema in the bends of extremities, between legs, about anus and genitals. Modalities. —- Worse, from cold, wet weather, wet applications, washing, and during 3 to 4 a.M., during menses. Better, lying on painful side and on stomach; in dry weather.

Relationship. — Inimicai to Lachesis, Antidotes: Arnica; Camphor. Compare: Rhus; Muriatic acid; Tartar emet, Of use in poisoning by charcoal fumes.

Dose. — Lower potencies,

remedies.name: Ammonium Causticum
remedies.text:
(Hydrate of Ammonia) This is a powerful cardiac stimulant. As such in syncope, thrombosis, hamorrhage, snake-bites, chforoform narcosis, may be given by inhalation. The cdema and ulceration of mucous membranes produced by this powerful drug have been utilized as guiding symptoms for its use; hence in membranous troup with burning in @sophagus, Aphonia, Respiratory. — Difficult respiration. Accumulation of mucus with incessant coughing. Less of voice, Burning rawness in throat. Spasm of the glottis with suffocation ; patient gasps for breath. Pain in @sophagus on breathing deeply. Scraping and burning in throat and cesophagus. Uvula covered with white mucus. Nasal diphtheria, with burning excoriating discharge.

Extremities. — Excessive exhaustion and muscular debility. Rheumatism of shoulders, Skin hot and dry.

Dose. — First to third potency,

remedies.name: Ammonium Muriaticum
remedies.text:
(Sal Ammoniac) A state of prostralion bordering on a typhoid state is produced by this remedy. All mucous secretions are increased and retained. It is especially adapted to fat and sluggish patients who have respiratory troubles. A tendency to irregular circulation, blood seems to be in constant turmoil, pulsations, etc. Many groups of symptoms are accompanied hy cough, profuse gisiry seerctions. Its periods of aggravations are peculiarly divided as to the bodily region affected; thus the head an chest symptoms are worse mornings, the abdominal in the afternoon, the pams in the limbs, the skin and febrile symptoms, in the evenings. “Boiling” sensation.

Mind. — Melancholy, apprehensive; like from internal grief. Desire to cry, but cannot. Consequences of grief, Head. -- Hair falls out, with itchings and dandruff. Feels full, compressed; worse mornings, Eyes. -- Mist before eyes, optical illusions in incipient cataract; capsular cataract. Nose.—-Free acrid, hot watery discharge corroding the lip. Sneezing. Nose sore to touch; ulcerative pain in nostrils, Loss of smell. Obstructed, stuffy feeling; constant and unavailing efforts to blow it out. Itching.

Face. — Inflammatory faceache. Mouth and lips sore and excoriated.

Throat.— Throbbing in, and swelling of tousils, can scarcely swallow. Sore spot behind uvula, relieved by eating. Internal and external swelling of throat with viscid phlegm. So tough, it cannot be hawked up. Tonsiltitis. Stricture of esophagus.

Stomach. — Thirst for femonade, regurgitation of food, Litter waterbrash. Nausea. Gnawing in stomach. Epigastric pain immediately after eating. Cancer of stomach, Abdomen. — Splenic stitches, especially in the morning, with diflicult breathing Pain around navel. Abdominal symptoms appear during pregnancy. Chronic congestion of liver. Excessive fatty deposit around abdomen. Much flatus. Strained feeling in groin. Rectum, —Jtching and hemorrhoids, soreness with pustules, Hard, crumbly stool, or covered with glairy mucus. Stinging im perinwzum. Grecn mucus stools alternate with constipation. During and .after stool, burning and smarting in rectum. Hemorrhoids after suppressed leucurrhcea.

Female. — Menses too eariy, too free, dark, clotted; flow more at night. Pain as if sprained in teft side of abdomen duting pregnancy. Diarrhea, greenish mucous stoofs, and navel pain during menses. Leucorrheea, like white of an egg [Alum.; Bor.; Cale, p.); with pain about the navel; brown, slimy after every urination, Respiratory. Hoarseness and burning in larynx. Dry, hacking, scraping cough; worse lying on back or right side. Stitches in chest. Cough loose in afterhoon, with profuse expectoration and rattling of mucus. Oppression of chest. Burning at small spots in chest. Scanty secretion. Cough with profuse salivation, Back, —Jey coldness between shoulders; not relieved by warm covering, followed by itching. Bruised pain in coccyx when sitting. Backache, as if in a vise when sitting. Extremities, — Pain as from ulceration in finger tips. Shooting and tearing in tips of finger and toes. Ulcerative pain in heels, Contraction of hantstring tendons. Sciatica, worse siting, better lying. Neuralgic pain in amputated limbs, Offensive sweaty feet. Pain in feet during menses.

Skin. — Itching, generally evenings. Blisters on various parts. Intense burning better cold applications, Fever. — Chilliness evenings after lying down and on awakening, without thirst. Heat in palms and soles.

Modalities. — Better, open air. Worse, head and chest symptoms in the morning; abdominal symptoms in the afternoon, Relationship. ~— Antidotes: Coffea; Nux; Caust, Compare: Culcarea; Scucga; Caustic, Dose. — Third to eixth potency.

remedies.name: Ammonium Phosphoricum
remedies.text:
(Phosphate of Ammonia) A remedy for chronic gouty patients; indicated in bronchitis and nodosities of the joints of the fingers and backs of the hands. Facia! paralysis. Pain in shoulderjoint, Tightness around chest. Heaviness of limbs, unsteady, tottering gait. Coldness from least draft of air, Head. — Sneezing with excessive running from nose and eyes, only in morning.* Respiratory. —- Deep rough cough with grcenish expectoration.

Urine. — Rose-colored sediment.

Doge.— Third decimat trituration,

remedies.name: Ammonium Picratum
remedies.text: {Picrate of Ammonia) A remedy for malarial fever and neuralgias and socalled bilious headaches. Pain in occiput and mastoid region, Head, — Periodical neuralgia in right side of occiput; boring extends to ear, orbit, and jaw. Vertigo on rising. Periodic bilious headaches. [Sanguin.] Dose,—Third trituration,

remedies.name: Ampelopsis
remedies.text:
(Virginia Creeper) Renal dropsies, hydrocele, and chronic hoarseness in scrofulous patients have been benefited by this drug. Choleric symptoms. Generally worse about 6 p.m. Dilated pupils, Left costal region sore and sensitive. Elbow joints pain, back secre. Soreness of all limbs. Vomiting, purging with tenesmus. Rumbling in abdomen.

Dose. — Second to third potency.

remedies.name: Amygdalus Persica
remedies.text:
(Peach Bark) A most valuable remedy in vomiting of various kinds; morning sickness. Irritation of eyes. Hemorrhage from the bladder. Gastric irritation of children; no form of food tolerated. Loss of smell and taste. Gastric and intestina) irritation when the tongue is elongated ané pointed, tip and edges red.

Relationship. — Compare: Amygd. amara — Bitter Almond. (Pains through tonsils, throat dark, difficult swallowing, vomiting, cough with sore chest. Dose. Fresh infusion or mother tincture.

remedies.name: Amyl Nitrosum
remedies.text:
(Amy! Nitrite} On inhaling this drug, it rapidly dilates all arterioles and capillaries, producing flushing of face, heat, and throbbing in the head. Palpitation of the heart and. similar conditions are readily cured by it, especially the -flushings and other discomforts at climacteric. [Hiccough and yawning, Often relieves temporarily epileptic convulsrons.

Head. — Anvicty, as if something might happen; must have fresh air. Surging of blood to head and face, sensation as if biood would start through skin, with heat and redness, Flushings, followed by sweat at climacteric. Ears hyperemic. Throbbing.

Throat. — Constriction; collar seems too tight.

Chest. — Dyspnea and asthmatic feelings. Great op- Pression and fullness of chest; spasmodic, suffocative cough. Precordial anxiety. Tumuliuous action of heart. Pain and constriction around heart, Fluttering at slightest excitement.

Female. — After-pains; hemorrhage associated with facial flushing. Climacteric headache and flushes of heat, with anxicty and palpitation, Fever.— Much flushing of heat; sometimes followed by, gold and clammy skin and profuse sweat. Throbbing yughout whole body, Abnormal sweat after influenza. Extremities, — Constant stretching for hours. Veins «f hands dilated; pulsations felt in tips of fingers.

Relationship. — Compare: Glonoine; Lachesis. Antidotes: Cactus; Strychn.; Ergot. Dose, - Third potency, For pattiations, In all conditions where the bloadvessels are spasmodically contracted, as in angina pec-" toris, epileptic seizure, megrim, accompanied hy cold, pallor, etc., also im paraxysms of asthma, inhalation of the Amyl. nit. will give immediate relief. For this nenhomeopathic application, two to five minims (put up in fearls} dropped on a handkerchief may be required ANACARDIUM * oy: (Marking Nut) The Anacardium patient is “found mostly among the neurasthenics; such have a type of nervous dyspepsia, relieved by food; tmpatred memory, depression, and irritability ; diminution of senses (sincll, sight, hearing). Syphilitic patients often suffer with these conditions. Intermittency of symptoms Fear of examination in students. Aversion ta wark; lacks self-confidence; irresistible desire to swear and curse. Svusation of a plug in various parts — eyes, rectum, hladder, etc., also of a band. Empty feeling in stomach: eating temporarily relieves all discomfort, This is a sure indication, often verified. Its skin symptoms are similar to Rhus, and it has proved a valuable antidote to Poison-Oak.

Mind. — Fixed ideas, Hallucinations, thinks he is possessed of two persons vr wills, Anxiety when wailking, as if pursued. Profound melancholy and nypochondriasis, with fendency to use violent language. Brain-fag, Impaired memory, Very casily offended. Malicious; seems bent on wickedness. Lack of confidence in himself or others. Suspicious [Hyas-]. Clairaudient, hears voices far away or of the dead.

Head.— Vertigo. Pressing pain, as from a plug; worse after mental exertion —in forehead; occiput, temples, vertex; better during a meal, Itching and little boils on scalp, Eyes. — Pressure like a fig on upper orbit. Indistinct vision,. Objects appear too far off. Ears, — Pressing in the ears as from a plug. Hard of hearing, Nose. — Freduent sneezing. Sense of smell perverted, Coryza with palpitation, especialy in the aged.

Face. — Blue rings around eyes.

Face pale. - Mouth. — Painful vesicles; fetid odor, Tongue feels swollen. impeding speech and motion, with saliva in mouth. Burning around lips as from pepper. _Stomach,— Weak digestion, with fullness and distention. Empty feeling in stomach, Eructation, nausea, vomiting. Fating relicves the Anacaratum dyspepsit. Apt to choke when eating or drinking. Swallows food and drinks hastily. Abdomen. —~ Pain as if dull plug were pressed into intestincs. Rumbling, pinching, and griping. Rectum. -— Bowels inactive. Jneffectual desire; rectum seems powcrless. as if plugged up; spasmodic contriction of sphincter ani; even soft stool passes with ifficulty, Mehing at anus; amoaisture from rectum. Bamorrhage during stool, Painful hemorrhoids. EN itr. ac.; Hyper; Ratanh.]

Male. — Voluptuous itching; increased desire; seminal emissions without dreams. Prostatic discharge during stool. Female. -—Leucorrhaa, with soreness and_ itching. Menses scanty.
