Respiratory. — Pressure in chest. as from a dull plug. Oppression of chest, with iuternal heat and anxiety, driving him into open air. Cough excited by talking, in children, after fit cf temper, Cough aftcr eating with vomiting of food and pain in occiput. Heart. -- Palpitation, with weak memory, with coryza im the aged; stitches in heart region. Rhenmatic pericarditis with double stitches. Back, — Dui] pressure in the shoulders, as from a weighi, Stiffness at nape of neck. . Extremities, — Neuralgia in thumb. Paralytic weakness. Knees feel paralyzed or bandaged. Cramp in calves. Pressure as from 2 plug in the glutei. Warts on palms of hands, Fingers swollen with vesicular eruptio: Sleep.-—~ Spells of sleeplessness lasting for several nights, Anxious dreams, Skin. — Intense itching eczema, with mental irritability; vesicular eruption; swelling, urticaria; eruption like that of Poison-Oak. [Xerophyl.; Grindel.; Croton.] Lichen planus; neurotic eczema.

Modalities. — ’orsc, on application of hot water. Better, fram eating. When lying on side, from rubbing and talking hold of anything.

Relationship. — Antidete: Grindclia; Coffea; Juglans; Rhus. Compare: 4Anacard. occidentale (cashew nut) (erysipelas, vesicular facial eruptions), anasthetic variety of feprosy; warts, corns, ulcers, cracking of the skin on soles of fect). Rhus; Cypriped.; Chelidon.; Xerophyl. Platina follows well. Dose, —- Sixth tu two hundredth potency.

remedies.name: Anagallis
remedies.text:
(Scarlet Pimpernel) Marked action on skin, characterized by great itching and tingling everywhere. Favors expulsion of splinters, An old medicine for hydrophobia and dropsy. Tossesses power of softening flesh and destroying warts, Head. ~ Great hilarity; headache over supra-orhital ridges, with rumbling in bowels and eructations; better trom coffee. Pain in facial muscles.

Extremities. — Kheumatic and gouty pains. Pain in shoulder and arm, Cramp in bail] of thumbs and fingers.

Urine. — More or less irsitaticn in urethra, inclining to caition. Burning pain on urinating, with agglutination of orifice. Urine passes in several streams; must press befure it passes, Skin. -—/tching; dry, bran-like ereption, especially on hands and fingers. Palms especialy affected. Vesicles in groups. Ulcers and swellings on joints, Relationship. ~ Anagallis contams Saponin, g. v. Compare: Cyclamen; Primula obcon.

Dose. — First to third potency,

remedies.name: Anatherum
remedies.text:
(Cuscus — An East Indian Grass) A skin remedy of high order. Painful swelling of vations parts, going on to supguration. Glandular inflammation. "% Plead. — Pains pierce brain tike pointed arrows: worse in afternoon, Herpes, ulcers, and tumers on scalp. Wartlike growth on eyebrows. Boils and tumors on tip of nose. Tongue fissured, as if cut on edges; copious salivation.

Urine. — Turbid, thick, full of mucus. Constant urging, Bladder cannot hold smailest quantity, Invotuntary. Cystitis, Sexual. -~ Chancre-tike sores. Scirrhus-like swelling of cervix, Breasts swollen, indurated, nipples excoriated, Skin. — Diseased and «leformed nails. Offensive footsweat. bsecsses, bvils, wdcers. Erysipelas. Pruritus, herpes: Relationship. — Compare: Stephisay.; Mercur.; Thuja.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Anhalonium
remedies.text:
(Mescal Button) Causes a form of intoxication accompanied by wonderful visions, remarkably beautiful and varied kaleidoscopic changes, and a sensation of increased physical ability. A remedy for brain-tag, delirium, megrim, hallucinations, with colored brilliant visions. Motor incoordination. Extreme muscular depression; increased patellar reflex. Paraplegia, Mind. — Loss of conception of time. Difficult enunciation. Distrust and resentment. Lazy contentment.

Head.— Aches, with disturbed vision. Fantastic, arilliant, moving colored objects. Affected by heating time. Pupils dilated, vertigo, brain tired. Pofychrome spectra, Exaggerated reverberation of ordinary sounds.

Dose. — Tincture,

remedies.name: Anemopsis Californica
remedies.text: (Yerba Mansa — Household Herb) Chief value in catarrhal states. Not yet proven, but found useiul in profuse mucous or serous discharges; in nasal and pharyngeal catarrh, diarrhoea and urethritis. Recommended in heart disease, as a quicting agent when unduly excited. Flatulence; promotes digestion. Dose, — The tincture internally and locally.

remedies.name: Angustura Vera
remedies.text:
(Bark of Galipea Cusparia) Rheumatic and paralytic complaints — great difficulty in walking, Cracking in all joints. The greatest craving for coffee is a characteristic symptom. Caries of long bones. Paralysis. Tetanus. Stiffness of muscles and joints. versensitive. Principal action on spinal motor nerves and mucous menibranes.

Head. — Oversensitive. Headache, with heat of face. Acute pain in cheeks. Drawing in facial muscles, Pain in temporal muscles, when opening the jaws. Pain in articulation of jaw, in masseter muscles, as if fatigued by chewing too much. Cramp-pain on the zygomatic arch. Stomach, — Pitter taste. Irresistible desire for coffec. Pain from navel into sternum. Atonic dyspepsia, Belching, with cough, [fnbra.j

Abdomen. — Diarrhoea and colic, Tenesmus with soft _ftool; chronic diarrhoea, with debility and loss of flesh. Burning in anus, Back. — Itching along back. Pain in cervical vertebra. Drawing in the neck, Pain in spine, at nape of neck and sacrum, worse on pressure. Twitching and jerking along back. Bends backward, Extremities. — Stiffness and tension of muscles and joints. Pain in limbs on walking. Arms tired and heavy. Caries of long hones, Coldness of fingers. Pain at knees. Cracking ir joints. Skin. -~ Caries, very painful ulcers which affect the bone, Relationship. Compare: Nur; Ruto, Mercur.; Prucea—Bark of Nux vomica or angustiura falsa. (Tetanic spasms with undisturbed consciousness, worse noise, liguids, paralyzed lower extremities.) Dose, -— Sixth potency,

remedies.name: Anilinum
remedies.text:
(Coal Tar Product — Amidobenzene) Marked giddiuess and pain in head: face has a purple hue, Pain in penis and scrotum with swelling. Trmors of the urinary passages, Profound anwmia with discoloration of skin, biue tips, auorexia, gastric disturbances. Swelling of skin.

Relationship. — Compare: drsenic: Antipyrin,

remedies.name: Anthemis Nobilis
remedies.text: (Roman Chamomile) This remedy is akin to the ordinary Chamomilla, Respiratory.— Coryza with much fachrymation, sneezing, and discharge of clear water from the nose Symptoms worse indoors. Constriction and rawness of throat. Cough, tickling; worse in warm room. Abdomen. —- Aching in region of liver; griping and chilliness inside of abdomcn and into legs. Itching of anus, with white putty-like stools, Urinary. — ladder feels distended. Pain along spermatic cord, which feels full, as if varicosed. Frequent urination. Skin. —Itching of the soles, as if from chilblains. Goose-ftesh, Dose. — Use the third potency.

remedies.name: Anthracinum
remedies.text:
(Anthrax Poison) This nosnde has proven a great remedy in epidemic spleen diseases of domestic animals, and in septic inflammation, carbiuncles, avd maligquant ulcers, in botls and boil-tike eruptions, acne. Terrible burning. Induratiote of cellular tissue, aliscess, bubo, and all infiammation of connective tissne in which there exists a purulent focus. Tissues—Hamorrhages, black, thick, tar-like, rapidly decomposing, from any orifice. Glands swollen, ceflular tissues @dematous and indurated, Septicemia. Ulceration, sloughing, and intelerable burning. Erysipelas. Black and blue blisters. Dissecting wounds. Insect stings. Bad effects irom inhaling foul odors. Gangrencus parotitis. Succession of boils.

Relationship. — Similar tu Arsenic, which it often follows. Compare: Pyrogen; Lachesis; Crotalus; Hipfozan,; Echinzc.; Silica fotlows well.

Dose. — Thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Anthrakokali
remedies.text:
(Anthracite Coal Dissolved in Boiling Caustic Potash) Useful in skin affections, scabies, prurigo, chronic herpes, cracks and ulcerations. Intense thirst. Chronic rheumatism, Bilious attacks, vomiting of bite, tympanic distention of abdomen.

Dose. — Low triturations.

remedies.name: Antimonium Arsenicosum
remedies.text:
(Arsenite of Antimony) Found useful in emphysema with excessive dyspnaa and cough. Worse on eating and lying down, Catarrhal preumonia, Pleurisy, especially of left side, with exudation, and pericarditis, with effusion. Sense of weakness, Inflammation of eyes and oedema of face.

Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Antimonium Crudum
remedies.text:
(Black Sulphide of Antimony) For homeopathic employment, the mental symptoms, and those of the gastric sphere, determine its choice. Excessive irritability and fretfulness, together with a thickly-coated white tongue, are true guiding symptoms to many forms of disease calling for this remedy, All the conditions are aggravated by hcat ond cold bathing. Cannot bear heat of sun. Tendency to grow fat. An absence of pain, where it could be expected, is noticeable. Gout with gastric symptoms.

Mind. — Much concerned about his fate. Cross and contradictive; whatever is done fails to give satisfaction. Sulky; does not wish to speak. Peevish; vexed without cause. Child cannot bear te be touched or looked at. Anyry at every little attention. Sentimenta? mood. Head, — Aching, worse in vertex, on ascending, from bathing, from disordered stomach, especially from eating candy or drinking acid wines. Suppressed eruptions. Heaviness in forehead, with vertigo; nausea, and nosebjeed. Headache with great loss of hair, Eyes. — Dull, sunken, red, itch, inflamed, agglutinated. Canthi raw and fissured. Chronic blephoritis. Pustules on cornea and lids, Ears.—Kedness; swelling; pain in eustachian tube. Ringing and deafness. Moist eruption around ear.

Nose.— Nostrils chapped and covercd with crusts. Evsema of nostrils, sore, cracked and scurfy.

Face. — Pimples, pustules, and boils on face. Fellow crusted eruption on chicks and chin, Sallow and haygard. Meuth.-- Cracks it corners of mouth. Dry lips. Saltish saliva. Much slimy mucus. Tongue coated thick white, as tf whitewashed. Gums detach from teeth; bleed easily. Toothache in hollow teeth. Rawness of palate, with expectoration of much mucus. Canker sores. Pappy taste. Sub-acute eczema about mouth.

Throat.— Much thick yetlowish mucus from posterior nares Hawking in open air. Stomach,— Loss of appetiic. Desire fer acids, pickles. Thirst in evening and night. Eructation tasting of the ingesta, Heartburn, nausea, vomiting. After nursing, the child vomits its milk in curds, and refuses to nurse afterwards, and is very cross. Gastric and intestinal complaints from bread and pastry, acids, sour wine, cold bathing, overheating, hot weather. Constant belching, Gouty metastasis to stomach and bowels. Sweetish waterbrash. Bloating after cating, Stool.— Anal itching. [Silpho-Cale, Ahon.| Diarrhoa alternates with constipation, especially in old people. Diarrhcea after acids, sour wine, baths, overeating; slimy, flatulent stools. Mucous piles, continued eosing of mucus, Hurd lumps mixcd with watery dtschorge. Catarrhal proctitis. Stools composed entirely of mucus.

Urine. — Frequent, with burning, and backache: terbid and foul odor. Male. -—- Eruption on scrotum and about genitals. Impotence, Atrophy of penis and testicles.

Female. — Excited; parts itch. Before menses, toothache; menses too early and profuse. Meuses suppressed from cold bathing, wich feeling of pressure in pelvis and tenderness in ovarian region. Leucorrhoea watery; acrid, lumpy.

Respiratory. — Cough worse coming into warm room, with burning sensation in chest, itching of chest, oppression. Loss of voice from becoming overheated, Voice harsh and badly pitched, Back, — Itching and pain of neck aud back, Extremities. — Twitching of muscles, Jerks in arms. Arthritic pain in fingers. Nails brittle; grow out of - shape. Horny warts on hands and soles. Weakness and shaking of hands in writing followed hy offensive flatulence. Feet very tender; covered with large horny places, Inflamcd corns.

Skin. — Eczema with gastric derangements. Pimples, vesicles, and pustules. Thick, hard, honey-colored scabs. Urticaria; measle-like eruption. Itching when warm in bed. Dry skin. Warts. [Thuja; Sabina; Caust.) Dry gangrene. Scaly, pustular eruption with burning and itching, worse at night.

Sleep. — Continual drowsiness in old people. Fever, — Chilly even in warm room. Intermittent with digust, wausea, vomiting, eructations, coated tongue, diarrhaa. Hut sweat. Modalities.—- H’orse in evening, from heat, acids, wine, water, and washing. Wet poultices. Acifer in open air, during rest.

Relationship. — Compare: datimoninm Chloridum. Butter of Antimony. (A remedy for cancer. Mucous membranes destroyed. Abrasions. Skin cold and clammy. Great prostration of strength, Dose— Third irituration. } alatimon. jodut. (Uterine hyperplasia; humid asthma, Pneurr and lronchitis: fess of strength and appetite, yellowish skin.) Puls.; /pec.; Sulph. Camplemestary: Sulph, Antidote: Hepar.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Antimonium Sulphuratum Auratum
remedies.text: (Golden Sulphuret of Antimony) A semarkable remedy for many forms of chronic nasal and bronchial catarrh. Acne. Amaurosis. Nose and Throat. —Nasebleed on washing. Increased secretion in nase and throat, Rough and scrapy feeling. Loss of smell. Metallic styptic taste, _Respiratory. — Tickling in larynx. Increased mucus with, fullness in bronchi. Respiration difficult, pressure in bronchi, with constriction. Tough mucus in bronchi and larynx. Dry hard cough, Congestion of upper lobe of left lung. Winter coughs, patient is sore all over. Pneumonia, when hepatization occurred and resolution failed to take place, Skin. — Acne (pustular variety). Itching on hands and feet, Dose. — Second or third trituration.

remedies.name: Antimonium Tartaricum
remedies.commonName: Tartar Emetic. Tartrate of Antimony and Potash
remedies.text:
(Tartar Emetic. Tartrate of Antimony and Potash) Has many symptoms in common with Antimonium Crudum, but also mapy peculiar to itself. Clinically, its therapeutic application has been confined largely to the treatment of respiratory diseases, rattling of stucus with betle cxpectorotion has been a guiding symptom, There is much drowsiness, debility and szeat characteristic of the drug, which group should always be mure or less present, when the drug is prescribed, Gastric affections of drunkards and gouty subjects. Cholera morbus. Sensation of coldness in blood-vessels. Bilharsiasts. Antimonium tart is homeopathic to dysuria strangury, hematuria, albuminuria, catarrh of bladder and urethra, burning in rectum, bloody mucous stools, etc. Antimon tart acts indirectly on the parasites by stimulating the oxidizing action of the protective substance. Trembling of whole body, great prostration and faintness. Lumbago. Chills, contractures and muscular pains, Mind and

Head.— Vertigo alternates with drowsiness. Great despondency. Fear of being alone, Muttering, delirium, and stupor. Vertigo, with dullness and confusion. Band-like ferting over forehead. Face pale and sunken. Child will not be touched without whining. Headache as from a band compressing. [Nit. ac. ; Carbol. ac.) Tongue. — Coated, pasty, thick white, with red edges. Red and dry, especially in the center, Brown, Face,—~- Cold, blue, pale; covercd with cold sweat. Incessant quivering of chin and lower juw. [Gelsem.]

Stomach. — Difficult deglutition of liquids. Vomiting in any position, excepting lying on right side. Naxsca, retching, and vontiting, especially after food,” with deathly faintness and prostration. Thirst for cold water, ttle and often, and desire for apples, fruits, and acids gencrolly. Nausea produces fear; with pressure in precordial region, followed by headache with yawning and lachrymation and vomiting.

Abdomen. — Spasmodic colic, much flatus, Pressure in abdomen, especially on stooping forward, Cholera morbns diarrhea in eruptive diseases.

Urinary. — Burning in urethra during and after urinating, Last drops bleody with pain in bladder. Urging jucreased. Catarrh of bladder and urethra, Respiratory

Organs. — Hoarseness. Great rartling of mucus, but very little is expectorated. Velvety feeling in chest. Burning sensation in chest, which ascends to throat. Rapid, short, dificult breathing: seems as if he would suffocate; must sit up. Coughing and gaping consecutively. Bronchial tubes overloaded with mucus. Cough excited by eating, with pain in chest and larynx. Gdema und impending paralysis of lungs. Much paipitation, with uncomfortable hot feeling. Pulse rapid, weak, trembling. Dizziness, with cough. Dyspag@a 1¢- Hieved by eructation. Cough and dyspnea better lying on sight side — (opposite Badiaga). Back. -- Mioleat pain in sacro-tumbar region. Stightest effort to move may cause retching and cold, clammy sweat. Sensation of heavy weight at the coceya, dragging downward all the time. Twitching of muscles; limbs tremulous.

Skin. — Pustular eruption, leaving a bluish-red mark. Small-pox. Warts. Fever, — Coldness, trembling, and chilliness. Intense heat. Copious perspiration. Cold, clammy sweat, with great faintness. Intermittent fever with lethargic condition, Sleep. -- Great drowsiness. On falling asleep electriclike shocks. Irresistible inclination to sleep with nearly all complaints. Modalities, — Worse, in evening: from lying down at night; from warmth; in damp cold weather; from all sour things and milk. Better, from sitting erect; from eructation and expectoration.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Puls.; Scpia. Compare: Kati sulph.; Ipecac.

Dose. — Second and sixth trituration. The lower potency sometimes aggravates.

remedies.name: Antipyrine
remedies.text:
(Phenazone— A Coal-tar Derivative) Antipyrine is one of the drugs that induce leucocytosis, similar to ergotin, salicylates, and tuberculin, Acts specially on the vaso-motor centers, causing dilation of capillaries of skin and consequent circumscribed patches of hyperemia and swelling. In large doses causes profuse perspiration, dizziness, cyanosis, and somnolence, albumen and blood in urine.

Mind. — Fear of becoming insane; nervous anxiety; hallucinations of sight and hearing.

Head.— Throbbing headache; sensation of constric- Non. Flashes of heat. Headache under ears with eartche, Eyes. — Pufliness of lids. Conjunctiva red and ceodematous, with lochrymation, Red spots. [Apis.} Ears. — Pains and buzzing. Tinitus.

Face. — Gidema and puffiness. Red and swollen.

Mouth. — Swelling of lips. Burning of mouth and gums. Ulceration of lips and tongue; vesicles and bullz. Small lump in check. Tongue swollen. Bloody sativa. Toothache along lower jaw. Throat, — Pain on swallowing. Expectoration of fetid pus. Abscess, white false membrane. Sensation of burning. Stomach, — Nausea and vomiting; burning and pain.

Urine. — Diminished. Penis black. Female, — Itching and burning in vagina. Menses suppressed. Watery Jeucorrhoea. Respiratory. -— Fluent coryza. Nasal mucous membrave swollen, Dull pains in froutal sinus, Aphonia, Oppression and dyspneea, Cheyne-Stokes respiration.

Heart. — Faintness, with sensation ot stoppage of heart. Throbbing throughout the body. Rapid, weak, irregular pulse.

Nerves. — Epileptiform seizures, Contractures, Trembling and cramps. Crawling and numbness. General prostration.

Skin. — Erythema, eczema, pemphigus. Intense pruritus, Urticaria, appearing and disappearing suddenly, with internal coldness. Angioneurotic-edema, Dark blotches on skin of penis, sometimes with adema, Dose. — Second decimal potency.

remedies.name: Apis Mellifica
remedies.text:
(The Honey-Bee) Acts on cellular tissues causing oedema of skin and faucous membranes. The very characteristic effects of the sting of the bee furnish unerring indications for its employment in disease. Swelling or puffing up of various parts, cedema, red rosy hue, stinging pains, soreness, intolerance of heat, and afternoon aggravation are some of the general guiding symptoms. Erysipelatous inflammations, dropsical effusions and anmasarca, acute, inflammation of kidneys, and other parenchymatous tissues are characteristic pathological states corresponding to Apis, Extreme sensitiveness to touch and general soreness is marked. Constricted sensations. Sensation as of something torn off in the interior of the body. Mind, -- Apathy, indifference, and unconscionsness. Awkward; drops things readily. Stupor, with sudden sharp cries and startings. Stupor alternating with erotic mania. Sensation of dying. Listiess; cannot think clearly. Jealous, fidgety, hard to please. Sudden shrill, piercing screams. Whining. Tearfulness. Jealousy, fright, rage, vexation, grief, Head, -~ Whole brain feels very tired. Vertigo with sneezing, worse on lying or closing eyes. Heat, throbbing, distensive pains, better on pressure, and worse on motion, Sudden stabbing pains, Dull, heavy sensation in occiput, as from a blow, extending to neck (better on pressure), accompanied with sexual excitement. Bores head into pillow and screams out.

Eyes. — Lids swollen, red, edematous, everted, inflamed; burn and sting. Conjunctiva bright red, puffy. Lachrymation hot. Photophobia, Sudden piercing pains. Pain around orbits. Serous exudation, edema, and sharp pains, Suppurative infummation of eyes. Keratitis with intense chemosis of ocular conjunctive. Staphyloma of cornea following suppurative inflammation. Styes, also prevents their recurrence. Eare,—- External ear red, inflamed, sore; stinging pains, Nose. — Coldness of tip of nose, Red, swollen, inflamed, with sharp pains.

Face. — Swollen, red, with piercing pain. Waxy, pale, cedematous. [Acrt. ac.]

Mouth.— Tongue swollen, sore, and raw, with vesictes. Scalding in mouth and throat. Tongue feels scalded, red hot, trembling. Gums swollen. Lips swollen, especially upper. Membrane of mouth and throat glossy, as if varnished, Red, shining, and puffy, like erysipetas, Throat. — Constricted, stinging pains, Ucule swollen, sac-like, Throat swollen, inside and out; tonsils swollen, puffy, fiery red. Ulcers on tonsils, Fiery red margin around leathery membrane. Sensation of fishboue in throat.

Stomach. — Sore feeling. Thristless. Vomiting of food. Craving for milk. [Rhus.J Abdomen. —- Sorc, bruised on pressure, when sneezing. Extremely tender. Dropsy of abdomen. Peritonitis. Swelling in right groin, Stool — Involuntary on every motion; anus secms open, Bloody, painless, Anus feels raw. Hemorrhoids, with stinging pain, after confinement. Diarrhcea watery, yellow; cholera infantum type. Cannot urinate without a stool. Dark, fetid, worse after eating. Constipation; feels as if something would break on straining.

Urine. — Burning and soreness when urinating. Suppressed, loaded with casts; frequent and involuntary; stinging pain and strangury; scanty, high colored. Incontinence. Last drops burn and smart.

Female. — (Edema of fabia; relieved by cold water. Soreness and stinging pains; worse in right ovary. Menses suppressed, with cerebral and head symptoms, especially in young girls. Dysmenorrheea, with severe ovarian pains. Metrorrhagia profuse, with heavy abdomen, faintness, stinging pain. Sense of tightness. Bearing-down, as if menses were to appear. Ovarian tumors, metritis with stinging pains. | Respiratory. — Hoarseness; dyspnoea, breathing hurried and difficult. CEdema of larynx. Feels as if Ac could not draw another breath, Suffocation; short, dry cough, suprasternal. Hydrothorax. Extremities, — CEdematous. Synovitis. Knee swollen, shiny, sensitive, sore, with stinging pain. Feet swollen and stitf, Teel too large. Rheumatic pain in hack and limbs. Tired, bruised feeling.

Skin. — Swellings after bites; sore, sensitive. Stinging. Erysipelas, with sensitiveness and swelling, rosy hue, Urticaria, Carbuncles, with burning, stinging pain. [-irs.; Anthrac.] Sudden puffing up of whole body.

Sleep. — Very drowsy. Dreams full of care and toil. Screams and sudden starting during steep.

Fever. — Afternoon c rill, with thirst; worse on motion and Avat. External heat, with smothering feeling. Sweat slight, with sleepiness, Perspiration breaks out and dries up fregnently. Sleeps after the fever paroxysm. After perspiration, nettle rash, also with shuddering.

Modalities. — Worse, warmth in any form; touch; pressure; late in afternoon; after sleeping; in closed and heated rooms. Right side. Better, in open air, uncovering, and cold bathing. Relationship—Complementary: Nat, mur. The “chronic,” Apis.; also Baryta carb, Inimical, Rhus. Compare: Apium virus (auto-toxemia. with pus produes)" Zinc.; Canth.; Vespa; Lathesis, Dose. Tincture to thirtieth potency. Sometimes action is slow; so several days elapse before it is seen to act, and then urine is increased, Apium virus, sixth trituration.

remedies.name: Apium Graveclens
remedies.text:
(Common Celery) Obstinate retention of urine, throbbing headaches and heartburn, have been produced by celery. Swelling of throat, face, and hands. Dysmenorrhea.

Head. — Depressed ; energetic; feeling of fidgets; cannot sleep from thinking. Headache; better eating. Eyeballs feel sunken. Itching in eyes. Itching and smarting in inner canthus of left eye.

Abdomen. — Sore; sharp sticking pain as if stool was coming on; diarrlwea, sharp poin in left iliac region going over to right. Nausea inercases with pains.

Femals.— Sharp sticking pains in both ovarian regions, leit, better bending over, by lying on left side, with legs flexed; nipples tender. Respiratory, — Tickling, dry cough. Intense constrice tion over sternum, with drawing feeling through to back on lying down, Skin. —- itching blotches; burning, creeping sensation. Profuse discharge from .granulating ulcers. Urticaria with shnddering, Sleep. —- Unrefreshed: sleepless. Wakes from 1 to 3 a.M, Hungry for apples. Eating does not help sleep. Not fatigued from loss of sleep Dose, — First to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Apocynum Androsae Mifolium
remedies.text: (Dogbane) The rheumatic symptoms of this remedy promise most curative results. Its pains are of a wandering nature, with much stiffness and drawing, Everything smells and tastes like honey. Worms, Trembling and prostration. Swollen sensations, Extremities. —- Pain in alt joints. Pain in toes and soles. Swelling of hands and feet. Profuse sweat, with much heat in soles. Tingling pain in toes. Cramps in soles. Violent heat in soles. [Sulph,} Dose. -— Tincture and first potency.

remedies.name: Apocynum Cannabinum
remedies.text:
(Indian Hemp) This is one of our most efficient remedies, in dropsses and urinary troubles, especially suppression and strangury. In the digestive complaints of Bright's disease, with the nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, difficult breathing, it will be found of frequent service. The dropsy is characterized by great thirst and gastric irritability. Arhythmia. Mitral ond tricuspid regurgitation. Acute alcoholism, Mind. — Bewildered. Low spirited, Nose. — Long-continued sneezing. Snuffles of children. [Sambucus.] Chronic nasal catarrh with tendency to acute stuffiness with dull, sluggish memory. Dull headache. Takes cold easily, nostrils become congested and blocked up easily, Stomach. — Nansea, with drowsiness. Thirst on walking. Excessive vomiting. Food or water is immediately ejected, Dull, heavy, sick feeling. Oppression in epigastrium and chest, impeding breathing. Sensation of sinking in stomach, Abdomen bloated. Ascites. Stool —/¥atery, fiatulent, with soreness in anus; worse after eating.

Urine. — Bladder much distended, Turbid, hot urine, with thick mucus and burning in urethra, after urinating, Little expulsive power. Dribbling. Strangury. Female, — Amenorrhcea, with bloating; metrorrhagia with nausea: fainting, vital depression. Hamorrhages at change of life.

Respiratory. — Short, dry cough, Respiration shurt and unsatisfactory, Sighing. Oppression about epigastrium and chest.

Heart. — Tricuspid regurgitation; rapid and feeble cardiac action, low arterial tension, pulsating jugulars. genera’? cyanosis and general dropsy. Sleep, — Great restlessness and little sleep.

Modalities. — Worse, cold weather; cold drinks; uncovering, Relationship. — Cymarin is the active principle of Apecsn., lowers pulse rate and increases Llood-pressure. Strophanthus (extreme cardiac depression with intense gastric disturbance; dropsy). Aralia hispado (useiul in urinary disorders, especially with dropsy). Apis, Ars senic; Diantoi.; Heiled, Dose. — Tincture (ten drops three times daily} and in acute atcoholisin 1 dram of decoction in 4 oz. water.

remedies.name: Apomorphia
remedies.text:
(Alkaloid from Decomposition of Morphine by Hydrochloric Acid) The chief power of this drug lies in the speedy and effective vomiting that it produces, which becomes a strong guiding symptom to its homceopathic use. Pneu~ monia with vomiting. Combined alcoholism, with constant nausea, constipation, insomnia, Head and

Stomach. — Vertigo. Dilated pupils. Nawsea and vomiting. Violent inclination to vomit Hot feeling all over body, especially head. Empty retching and headache; heartburn; pain between shoulder-blades. Reflex vomiting — pregnancy. Seasickness. Non-Homeopathic

Uses.— The hypodermic injection of one-sixtcenth of a grain will cause full emesis within five to fifteen minutes in an adult. Do not use in opium pvisoning. Apomorph, hypodermicajly, onethirtieth grain or loss, acts as a safe and sure hypnotic. Acts well even in delirium. Sleep comes on in half an hour, Dose. — Third to sixth patency.

remedies.name: Aquilegia
remedies.text:
(Columbine) A remedy for hysteria, Globus and clavus hystericus, Women at climaxis, with vomiting of green substance, especialy, in the ‘morning. Sleeplessness. Nervous trembling of body; sensitive to light and noise, Dysmenorrhea of young girls.

Female. — Menses scanty, with dull, painful, nightly increasing pressure in the right lumbar region.

Dose. — First potency.

remedies.name: Aragallus Lamberti
remedies.text:
(White Loco Weed — Rattle Weed) Acts principally on nervous system, preducing a bewildered, confused state. Symptoms of incoordination and paralysis. Locomotor ataxia. Tired in the morning.

Mind. — Great depression; worse in morning or evening. Cannot study. Cross, irritable, restless, Hewitidercd, Mental confusion and apathy. Desires to be alone. Difficulty in concentrating mind, absent-minded. Lack of ambition. Defective expression in writing. Restlessness and aimless wandering. Must concentrate his mind on walking, Head.-- Diplopia. Burning in eyes. Cracking of lower lip. Throat,— Aches. Feels full. Sore with nausea. Pharynx dark, swollen, glazed. Relationship. -- Compare: Astrayalius and Oxytropis, two varieties of Loco Weed; also Aaryta, Dose. — Sixth and two hundredth potencies.

remedies.name: Aralia Racemosa
remedies.text:
(American Spikenard) ‘This is a remedy for asthmatic conditions, with cough aggravated on lying down, Extreme sensitiyeness to draughts. Diarrhoea, prolapse of rectum.

Respiratory. — Dry cough coming on after first sleep, about middle of night. Asthma on lying down at night with spasmodic cough; worse after first sleep, with tickling in thtoat. Coustriction of chest; feels as if o foreign’ body were im throat. Obstruction worse in spring. Hay-fever; frequent sneesing. The least current of air causes sncezing, with copious watery, excoriating nasal discharge, of salty acrid taste.

Female. — Menses suppressed ; leucorrhaa four-smeliing, acrid, with pressing-down pain. Lochia suppressed, with tympanites.

Modalities. — Worse about 11 p.m. (cough).

Relationship. — Compare: Pecten —Scalfop (bumid asthma. Quick, labored breathing. Constriction of chest, especially right side, Asthma preceded by coryza and burning in throat and chest. Attack ends with copious expectoration of tough, frothy mucus. Worse at night.) Ars, iod.; Naphthaline; Copa; Resa; Sabad.; Sinapis.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency. ARANEA DIADEMA {Papal-Cross Spider) All spider poisons powerfully affect the nervous system. (Sce tarentula, Mygale, ete.) All symptoms of Aranea are characterized by periodicity, and coldness, and great susceptibility to dampness. It is the remedy for the constitution favorable to malarial poisoning, where every damp day or place favors chilliness. Patient feels cold to the very bones. Coldness not relieved by anything. Fecling as if ports were enlarged and heavier. Wake up at night with hands feeling twice their natural size. Spleen swollen.

Head. — Pain in right trifacial nerve from periphery inwards. Confusion; better by smoking in open air. Heat and flickering in eyes; worse in damp weather. Sudden violent pain in teeth at night immediately after Iving down, Extremities. — Left knee stiff and painful, Feet swollen. Modalities — Worse at noon (weakness). Dose. -— Sixth potency. Fresh juice is applied to ulcers and warts.

remedies.name: Argentum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Silver) The chief action is centered qn the articulations and their component elements, bones, cartilages, and figaments, The larynx is also a special center for this drug. Mental. —Ilurried feeling; time passes slowly; melancholy, Head. — Dull paroxysmal neuralgia over left side, gradually increasing and ceasing suddenly. Scalp very tender to touch. Vertigo, with intoxicated feeling, on looking at running water, Ifead feeis empiy, hollow, Eyelids red and thick, Exhausting coryza, with sneezing, Pain in facial bones, Throat. — Raw, hawking, gray, jelly-like mucus, and throat sore on coughing. Profuse and easy morning expectoration. Respiratory. —- Hoarseness Aphonia, Total loss of voice of professional singers, Larynx feels sore and raw. Easy cxpectoration, looking like boiled starch. Feeling of saw spot near supra sternal fossa. Worse from use ef voice. Cough from laughing. Hectic fever at noon. On reading aloud, must hem and hawk. Great weakness of chest: worse left side. Alteration in timbre of voice Back. --- Severe hackache; must walk bent, with oppression of chest.

Urine. — Diuresis. Urine profuse, turbid, sweet odor. Frequent urination. Polyuria.

Extremities. — Rheumatic affections of joints, especially elhow, and knee, Legs weak and trembling. Involuntary contractions of fingers, partial paralysis of forearm; writer’s cramp, Sweiling of ankies. Male, — Crushed pain in testicles. Seminal emissions, without sexual excitement, Female. — Ovaries feel too large. Bearing-down pain, Prolapse of womb. Eroded spongy cervix, Leucorrhaa, foul, excoriating. Palliative in scitrhus of uterus, Pain in left ovary. Climacteric hemorrhage. Sore feeling throughout abdomen; worse by jarring, Modalities — Worse from touch, teward noon, Better in open air; cough at night when lying down (opposite Hyoscy.). Relationship. ~~ Antidotes: Mercur.; Puls, Compare: Selen.; Alum.; Platina; Stannum; Ampelopsis, (Chronic hoarseness in scrofulous patients.) Dose. — Third to sixth trituration. ARGENTUM NITRICUM {Nitrate of Silver) In this drug the neurotic effects are very marked, many brain and spinal symptoms presenting themselves which give certain indications for its homeopathic employment. Symptoms of inco-ordination, loss of control and want of balance everywhere, mentally and physically; trembling in affected parts. It produces violent inflaromation of the throat, and a marked gastro-enteritis. Very characteristic is the great desire for sweets, the splinter-like pains, and free muco-purulent discharge in the inflamed and ulcerated mucous membranes. Sensation as if a part were expanding and other errors of perception are characteristic, Withered-up and dried constitutions preseul a favorable field for its action. Pains increase and decrease gradually. Flatulent state and permaturely aged look, Explosive belching, especially in neurotics, Upper abdominal affections~brought on by undue mental exertion.

Mind. — Thinks his understanding will and must fail. Fearful aud sxerzous; impulse to jump out of window. Faintish and tremulous. Melancholic; appreheusive of serious disease, ime passes slowly. [Cain. ind.) Memory weak. Errors of perception. {mpulsive ; wants to do things ina hurry, [Lilium] Peculiar mental impulses. .

Head.— Headache with coldness and trembling. Emotional disturbances cause appearance of hemicranial attacks. Sense of expansion. Brain-fag, with general debility and trembling. Headache from mental exertion, from dancing, Vertigo, with buzzing in ears, Aching in frontal eminence, with enlaryed feeling in corresponding eye, Roring pain: hetter on taht bandaging and pressure. tching of scalp. Hemicrania; bones of head feel as if separated. Diseases from unusual or long-continued mental exertion, Eyes. -~-Inner canthi swolicn and red. Spots before the vision. Blurred vision. Photophobia in warm room. Purulent ophthaimia, Great swelling of conjunctiva; discharge abundant and purulent, Chronic ulceration of margin of lids; sore, thick, swollen. Unable to keep eyes fixed steadily. Eye-strain from sewing; worse in warm room, [Nut. mur.} Paretic condition of ciliary muscle. Acute granular conjunctivitis. Cornea opaque Ulcer in cornea, Nose. — Loss of smell. Itching. Ulcers in septum. Coryza, with chilliness, laclrrymation, and headache. .

Face.— Sunken, old, pale, and bluish, Old man’s fook; tight drawing of skin over bones, Mouth. — Gums tender and bleed easily. Tongue has prominent papillae; tip is red and painful, Pain in sound teeth. Taste coppery, like ink.

Throat.— Much thick mucus in throat and mouth causes hawking. Raw, rough and sore. Sensation of @ splinter in throat on swallowing. Dark redness of throat. Catarrh of smokers, with tickling as of hair in throat. Stranyulated feeling.

Stomach. — Belching accompanies most gastric ailments. Nausea, retching, vomiting of glairy mucus. Flatulence; painful swelling of pit. Gnawing ulcerating pain; burning and constriction, Ineflectual effort at eructation. Great craving for swects. Gastritis of drunkards. Ulcerative pain in left side under ribs. Trembling and throbbing in stomach, Enormous distention, Ulceration of stomach, with radiating pain. Desire for cheese.

Abdomen. — Colic, with flatulent distention Stitchy ulcerative pain on left side ef stomach, below short ribs. Stool — Watery, noisy, flatulent; green, ike chopped spinach, with shreddy mucus and enormous distention of abdomen; very offensive, Diarrhora immediately after eating or drinking. Fluids go right through him; after sweets. After any emotion with flatulence, “Itching of anus, Urine. — Urine passes -unconsciously, day and night. Urethra inflamed, with pain, burning, itching; pain as from a splinter, Urine scanty and dark. Emission of a few drops aiter having finished. Divided stream. Early stage of gonorrhoea; profuse discharge and terrible cutting pains; bloody urine. Male.—Impotence. Erection fails when coition is attempted. Cancer-like ulcers. Desire wanting. Gentitals shrivel, Coition painful.

Female. — Gastialgia at beginning of menses. Intense spasm of chest muscles, Orgasms at night. Nervous erethism at change of life. Leucorrhaa profuse, with erosion of cervix; bleeding easily. Uterine hemorrhage, two weeks after menses, Respiratory. — High motes cause cough. Chronic hoarseness. Suffocative cough, as if from a hair in throat. Dyspnoea. Chest feels as if a bar were around it. Palpitation, pulse irregular and intermittent; worse lying on right side. [Alumen.] Painful spots in chest. Many people in a room seem to take away his breath.

Back. — Much pain. Spine sensitive with nocturnal pains, [Oxral. acid.) paraplegia; posterior spinal sclerosis.

Extremities. — Cannot walk with eyes closed. Trembling, with general debility. Paralysis, with mental and abdominal symptoms. Rigidity of calves. Debility in calves especially. Walks and stands unsteadily, especially when unobserved, Skin. —- Brown, tense, and hard. Drawing in skin, as from a spider-web, or dried albuminous substance, withered and dried up.

Sleep. — Sleepless, from fancies before his imaginalion; horrible dreams of snakes, and of sexual gratification, Drowsy stupor. Fever, — Chills with nausea. Chilly when uncovered, yet feels smothered if wrapped up. Modalities, — }/"orse, warmth in any form; at night; from cold food; sweets; after eating; at menstrual period; from emotions, Jeit side. Better, from eructation; fresh air; cold; pressure.

Relationship. — Antidote: Nat. mur, Compare: Ars. Merc.; Fhos.; Putsat.; Argent, cyo~ natum (angina pectoris, asthma, spasin of oesophagus) ; Argent, iodat, (throat disorders, hoarseness, gland affected). Protergal (gonorrhea after acute stage 2 per cent. solution; syphilitic mucons patches, chancres and chancroids, 10 per cent. solution applied twice a day; ophthalmia neonatorum, 2 drops of 10 per cent, solution}. Aristolochia Serpenteris. (Symptoms of intestinal tract; colliquative diarrhoea, meteorism, Fiatulent dyspepsia, Brain congestion, Distention and cutting pains in abdomen.) Symptoms like those of Poison-Oak and proved in fluid extract an excellent remedy for this. Argent. phosph. (An excellent diuretic in dropsy.) Argent. oxyd, (Chlorosis with menorrhagia and diarrheea.) Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. Solution in water preferable to lower triturations; unless fresh, these readily decompose into the oxide.

remedies.name: Arnica
remedies.text:
(Leopard’s Bane) Produces conditions upon the system quite similar to those resulting from injuries, falls, blows, contusions. Tinnitus aurium. Putrid phcnomena. Septic conditions; prophylactic of pus infection, — It is especially suited to cases when any injury, however remote, seems to have caused the present trouble. After traumatic injuries, overuse of any organ, strains, Arnica is disposed to cerebral congestion, Acts best in plethoric, feebly in debilitated with impoverished blood, cardiac dropsy with dyspnoea. A muscular tonic. Traumatism of grief, remorse or sudden realization of financial loss. Limbs and body ache as if beaten; joints as if sprained. Bed feels too hard. Marked effect on the blood. Relaxed blood vessels, black and blue spots. Tendency to hamorrhage and low-fever states, Tendency to tissue degeneration, septic conditions, abscesses that do not mature. Sore, lame, bruised feeling, Neuralgias originating in disturbances of pneumo-gastric. Rheumatism of muscular and tendinous tissue, especially of back and shoulders. Aversion ta tobacco. Influenza, Mind, — Fears touch, or the approach of anyone. Unconscious; when spoken to answers correctly, but relapses. Indifference; inability to perform continuous active work; morose, delirious, Nervous; cannot bear pain; whole body oversensitive. Says there is nothing the matter with him, Wants to be fet alone. Agoraphobia (fear of space}, After mental strain or shock.

Head. — /lot, with cold body; confused; sensitiveness of brain, with sharp, pinching pains, Scalp feels contracted. Cold spot on forehead, Eyes, — Diplopia from traumatism, muscular paralysis, retinal hainorrhage. Bruised, sore feeling in eyes after close work, Must keep eycs open. Dizzy on closing them. Feel tired and weary after sight-seeing, moving pictures, etc, Ears. — Noises in ear caused by rush of blood to the head. Shooting in and around ears, Blood from ears. Dullness of hearing after concussion, Pain in cartilages of ears as if bruised. Nose, — Bleeding after every fit of coughing, dark fluid Iood. Nose feels sore; cold. : . Mouth, -- f’viid breath, Dry and thirsty, Bitter taste. [Colocy.} Taste as from bad eggs. Soreness of gums after teeth extraction, [Scpia.] Empyema of maxillary sinus.

Face.— Sunken: very red. Heat in lips. Herpes in face. Stomach. --Longing for vinegar. Distaste for milk and meat. Vomiting of blood. Pain in stomach during eating. Repletion with loathing, Oppressive gases pass upward and downward. Pressure as from a stone. Fecling as if stomach were passing against spine. Fetid vomiting.

Abdomen. — Stitches under false ribs. Distended; offensive flatus. Sharp thrusts through abdomen.

Rectum. — Straining of tenesmus in diarrhaa.

Stool. — Ofensive, brown, bloody, putrid, involuntary. Looks like brown yeast. Must lie down after every stool. Diarrhea of consumption; worse lying on left side, Urine. — Retained from over-exertion. Dark brickred sediment.

Female.— Bruised parts after labor. Violent afterpains. Uterine hemorrhage from mechanical injury after coition. Sore nipples. Mastitis from injury. Feeling as if foetus were lying crosswise, Respiratory. —- Coughs depending on cardiac fesion, paroxysmal, at night, during slecp, worse exercise. Angina pectoris; pain especially severe m elbow of left arm. Hoarseness from overuse of voice. Raw, sore feeling in morning. Cough produced hy weeping and lamenting. Dry, from tickling low down in trachea. Bloody expectoration. Dyspnea with hemoptysis, All Lones and cartilages of chest painful. Stitches in heart, Pulse feeble and irregular. Violent spasmodic cough, with facial herpes, Whooping cough, child cries before coughing, Pleurodynic, [Ranunc.; Cimictf.] Extremities.-~ Gout. Great fear of beig touched or approached. Pain in back and limbs, as if bruised or beaten. Sprained and dislocated feeling. Soreness after overexertion. Everything on which he lies seems too hard. Deathly coldness of forearm. Cannot walk erect, on account af bruised pain in pelvic region. Rheumatism begins iow down and works up. [Ledum.]

Skin. — Rieck and blue. Itching, burning, eruption of small pimples. Crops of small boils. [Ichthyol; Silica.] Ecchymosis. ed sores. [Bovinine locaily.] Acne indurata, characterized hy symmetry in distribution.

Sleep. — Comatose drowsiness; awakens with hot head; dreams of death, mutilated Lodies, anxious and terrible. Horrors in the night. Involuatary stools during sleep. Fever, — Shivering over whole body. Heat and redness of head, with coolness of rest of body. Internal heat; feet and hands cold, Nightly sour sweats.

Modalities. — }t’orse, least touch; motion; rest; wine; damp cold. Better, lying down, or with head low. Relationship.—Antidotes: Camph, Complementary: -lcon.; Ipec. Compare: Aryvostis (externally after injuries) ; 4con.; Bapt.; Bellis; Haman,; Rhus, Dose, -— First to twelfth potency. Locally, the tincture, but should uever be applied kot or at all when eabrasions or cuts are present.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Album
remedies.text:
(Arsenious Acid) A profoundly acting remedy on every organ and tissue. Its clear-cut characteristic symptoms and correspondence to many severe types of disease make its homeeopathic eruployment constant and certain. Its general symptoms often alone lead to its successful application. Among these the all-prevailing debility, ex- ARSENICUM ALBUM ot haustion, and restlessness, with nightly aggravation, are most important. Great exhaustion after the slightest exertion. This, with the peculiar irritability of fiber, gives the characteristic irritable weakness. Burning patus. Unqueuchable thirst. Seaside complaints [Nat. mur.; dqua Marina]. Injurious effects of fruits, especially more watery ones, Gives quiet and ease to the last moments of life when given in high potency. Fear fright and worry, Green discharges. Ars, should ve thought of in ailments from alcoholism, ptomaine poisoning, stings, dissecting wounds, chewing tobacco; ill effects from decayed food or animal matter; ador of discharges is puirid; in complaints that return annually. Anemia and chlorosis, Degenerative changes. Gradual loss of weight from impaired nutrition, Malarial cachexia, Septic infections and low vitality.

Mind. — Great anguish and restlessness. Changes place continually. Fears, of death, of being left alone. Great fear, with cold sweat. Thinks it useless to take medicine. Snicidat. Hallucinations of smell and sight Despair drives him from place to place. Miserly, malicious, selfish, lacks courage. General sensibility increased [Hep.]

Head. — Headaches relieved by cold, other symptoms worse, Periodical burning pains, with restlessness; with cold skin. Hemicrania, with icy feeling of scalp and great weakness, Sensitive head in open air. Delirium tremens; cursing and raving; vicious. Head is in constant motion. Scalp itches intolerably; circular patches of bare spots; rough, dirty, sensitive, and covered with dry scales; nightly burning and itching; dandruff. Scalp very sensitive; cannot brush hair.

Eyes. — Burning in eyes, with acrid lachrymation. Lids red, ulcerated, scabby, scaly, granulated. CEdema around eyes, External inflammation, with extreme painfulness; burning, hot, and excoriating lachrymation. Corneal ulceration. Intense photophobia; better external warmth. Ciliary neuralgia, with fine burning pain.

Ears.— Skin within, raw and burning. Thin, excoriating, offensive otorrhceea. Roaring in ears, during a paroxysm of pain.

Nose. — Thin, watery, excoriating discharge. Nose feels stopped up, Sneezing without relief. Hay-fever and coryza; worse in open air; better indoors. Burning and bleeding. Acne of nose. Lupus.

Face. — Swullen, pale, yellow, cachectic, sunken, cold, and covered with sweat. [Acetic acid.} Expression of agony, Tearing, secdf-like pains; burning. Lips black, livid. Angry, circumscribed flush of cheeks, Mouth. — Unhealthy, casily-bleeding gums. Ulceration of mouth with dryness and burning heat. Tongue ary, clean, and red; stitching and burning pain in tongue. Bloody saliva. Neuralgia of teeth; feel long and very sore; worse after midnight; better warmth. Metallic taste. Gulping up of burning water. Throat, — Swollen, o:dematous, constricted, burning, unable to swallow. Diphtheritic membrane, looks dry aad wrinkled. Stomach. ~-Cannot bear the sight or smcll of food. Great thirst; drinks much, but little at o time, Nausea, retching, vomiting, after eating or drinking. Anxiety in pit of stomach. Burning pain, Craves acids and coffee. Heartburn; pulping up of acid and bitter substances which seem to excoriate the throat, Longlasting eructations. Vomiting of blood, bile, green Waucus, or brown-black mixed with blood. Stomach “extremely irritable; seems raw, as if torn, Gastralgia from slighest food or drink. Dyspepsia from vinegar, acids, ice-cream, ice-water, tobacco, Terrible fear and dyspnoea, with gastralgia; also faintness, icy coldness, great exhaustion. Malignant symptoms. Everything swallowed seems to lodge in the cesophagus, which seems as if closed and nothing would pass, fl effects of vegetable dict, melons, and watery fruits generally. Craves milk, Abdomen. — Gnawing, burning pains like coals of fire; relieved by heat. Liver ond spleen enlarged and painful. Ascites and anasarca. Abdomen swollen and painful. Pain as from a wound in abdomen on coughing.

Rectum. — Painful, spasmodic protrusion of rectum, Tenesmus. Burning pain and pressure in rectum and anus, Stool — Small, offensive, dark, with much prostration. Worse at night, and after cating and drinking; _from chilling stomach, alcoholic abuse, spoiled meat. Dysentery dark, hicody, very offensive. Cholera, with itense agony, prostration. and burning thirst. Body cold as ice. (Verat.] Hamorrhoids burn like fire; relieved by heat. Skin excoriated about anus.

Urine. — Scanty, burning, iuvoluntary. Bladder as if paralyzed. lbuminous. Epithelial cells; cylindrica} clois of fibrin and gtohules of pus and blood. After urinating, feeling of weakness in abdomen. Bright's disease. Diabetes.

Female.— Menses too profuse and too soon. Burning in ovarian region. Leucoriheea, acrid, burning, offensive, thin. Pain as from red-hot wires; worse least exertion; causes great fatigue; better in warm room. Menorrhagia.

Respiratory. — Unable to tie down; fears suffocation. Air-passages constricted. Asthma worse midnight. Burning in chest. Suffocative catarrh. Cough worse after midnight; worse lying on back. Expectoration scanty, frothy. Darting pain through upper third of right lung. Wheezing respiration, Hzemoptysis with pain between shoulders; burning heat all over. Cough dry, as from sulphur fumes; after drinking.

Heart. — Paipitation, pain, dyspnea, faintness. Irritable heart in smokers and tobacco-chewers. Pulse more rapid in morning. [Sulph.] Dilatation. Cyanosis. Fatty degeneration. Angina pectoris, with pain in nec!: and occiput.

Back. — Weakness in small of back. Drawing in of shoulders. Pain and burning in back. [O.ral, ac.} Extremities. — Trembling, twitching, spasms, weakness, heaviness, uneasiness. Cramps in calves. Swelling of feet. Sciatica. Burning pains. Peripheral neuritis. Diabetic gangrene, Skin. — Itching, burning, swellings; cedema, eruption, papular, dry, rough, scaly; worse cold and scratching. Malignant pustules. Ulcers with offensive discharge, Anthrax. Poisoned wounds. Urticaria, with burning and restlessness, Psordssis. Scirrhus, Icy coldness of body. Epithelioma. [Nat. cecodyl.} Sleep, — Disturbed, anxious, restless. Suffocative fits during sleep. Sieeps with hands over head, Dreams are full of care and fear. Drowsy, sleeping sickness. Fever, — High temperature. Periodicity marked with adynamia, Septic fevers. Intermittent, Paroxrysms incomplete, with marked exhaustion, Hay-fever. Coid sweats. Typhoid, not too early; often after Rhus. Complete exhaustion. Delirium ; worse after midnight. Great restlessness. Great heat about 3 a. mM. Sordes.

Modalities. — IV orse, wet weather, after midnight; from cold, cold drinks, or food. Right side. Better from heat; from head elevated; warm drinks. Complementary: Rhus; Carbo; Phos.; Thuja; All. sat, Antidotal to lead poison, Antidotes: Opium; Carbo; China; Hepar; Nur. Chemical Antidotes: Charcoal; Hydrated Peroxide of lron; Line Water, Compare: Cenchris contortrix; lod.; Phosph.; China; Verat, alb.: Carbo; Kali phos. Epilobium (intractable Miarrhoea of typhoid), Hoang Non. —Strychnos Gaultheriana (Exhaustion with vertigo, numbness and tingling in hands and feet; involuntary action of lower jaw. Pustules and boils, tertiary syphilis and cancer of glandular structures). Atoxyl, — Sodium arsanilate 3x, sleeping sickness; commencing optic atrophy. « Levica Water — (vontaining Ars. Iron and Copper). (Chronic and dyscratic skin diseases, chorea minor and spasms in scrofulous and anemic children.) Sarcolactic acid (influenza with violent vomiting).

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. The very highest potencies have often yielded brilliant results. Low attenuations in gastric, intestinal, and kidney diseases; higher in neuralgias, nervous diseases, and skin. But if only surface conditions call for it, give the lowest potencies, 2x to 3x trit.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Bromatum
remedies.text: (Bromide of Arsenic) Has proven a great auti-psoric and anti-syphititie remedy. Herpetic eruptions, syphilitic excrescences, glandular tumors and indurations, carcinoma, locomotor ataxia, and obstinate intermittents, and diabetes are all greatly influenced by this preparation. Face. —.fene rosacea, with violet papules on nose; worse in the spring. Dose, — Tincture, two to four drops daily in water. In diabetes, three drops three times a day in a glass o: water.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Hydrogenisatum
remedies.text:
(Arseniuretted Hydrogen) The general action of Arsenic more accentuated, Anemia. Anxiety; despair. Harmaturia, with general blood disorganization. Haemorrhages from mucous membrancs. Urine suppressed, followed by vomiting. Prepuce and glans covered with pustules and round superficial ulcers. Collapse. Coldness; prostration. Sudden weakness and nausea. Skin becomes dark brown, Head.— Violent vertigo on going upstairs, Eyes sunken; broad, bine circles around. Violent sneezins. Nose cold. Must be wrapped up with warm cloths.

Mouth.— Tongue enlarged; deep, irregular ulcer; modular swelling, Mouth hot and dry; jittle thirst.

Dase. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Iodatum
remedies.text:
(Iodide of Arsenic) Is to be preferred for persistently irritating, corrosive discharges. The discharge irritates the membrane frem which it flows and over which it ows. The discharge may be fetid, watery, and the mucous membrane is always red, angry, swollen: itches and burns. Anfiuenza, hay-fever, old nasal catarrhs, and catarrh of _iniddle ear, Swelling of tissues within the nose. Hypertrephied vondition of eustachian tube and deafness, Senile heart, myocarditis and fatty degeneration. Puise shotty. Chronic aortitis, It seems probable that in Arsenic iod., we have a remedy most closely allied to manifestations of tuberculosis. It will be indicated by a profound prostration, rapid, irritahle pulse, recurring fever and sweats, emaciation; tendency to diarrhea. Chronic pneumonia, with abscess in lung. Hectic; debility; night sweats. This remedy is also to be remembered in phthisis with hoarse, racking cough aud profuse expectoration of a purulent nature, and attended with cardiac weakness, emaciation and general debility; in chronic, watery diarrhea in phthisical subjects; in cases of emaciation with good appetite; i amenorrhoea, with anzmic palpitation and dyspnea. In chronic pneumonia, when abscess ts about to form. Great emaciation, Threatened pymmia. [Pyrog.; Methyl. bluc.] Head, —Jertigo, with tremulous feeling, especiclly in aged.

Nose. — Thin, watery, irritating, excoriating discharge from anterior and pasterior nares; sneecing. Hayfever. [Pollanin.} Chronic nasal catarrh; swollea nose; profuse, thick, yellow discharge; ulcers; membrane sore and excoriated. Aggravation by sneezing.

Throat.— Burning in pharynx. Tonsils swoilen. Thick membrane from fauces to lips. Breath fetid, glandular involvement. Diphtheria. Eyes and

Ears. — Scrofulous ophthalmia. Otitis, with fetid, corrosive discharge. Tickening of tympanum. Burning, acrid coryza, Stomach.— Pain and pyrosis. Vomiting an hour after food, Nausea distressing. Pain in epigastrium Intense thirst; water is immediately ejected, Respiratory — Slight hacking cough, with dry and stopped-vp nostrils, Pneumonia that fails to clear up. Broncho-pneumonia after grippe. Aphonia.

Fever.— Recurrent fever and sweats, Drenching nighf-sweats. Pulse rapid, feeble, weak, irregular. Chitly, cannot endure cold, Skin. — Dry, scaly, itching. Marked exfoliation of skin in large scalcs, leaving a raw exuding surface beneath. Jehihyosis. Hnlarged scrofulous glands, Venereal bubo. Debilitating night-sweats. Eczema of the beard; watery, oozing, itching; worse, washing. Emaciation, Tsoriasis.

Relationship. — Compare: Tuberculinum; Antimon. tod. In hay-fever, compare: Aralia; Naphthalin; Rosa; Sang, wit, Dose, — Second and third trituration. ARSENICUM METALLICUM {Metallic Arsenic) Arouses latent syphilis. Periodically very marked; symptoms recur every two aud ihree weeks, Weakness. Swollen feeling of parts.

Head. — Low spirited, memory weak. Desire to be alone, Annoyed by visions, causing her to ery. Head feels too large. Left-sided headache up to eyes and into ears. Headache worse stooping and lying down. CEdematous swelling of forehead.

Face.— Red, itching, burning and bloated. Eyes swelled and watery, burn with coryza. Eyes weak, day and gas light unpleasant, Mouth, --The tongue coated white, and shows imprint of the teeth. Mouth sore and ulcerated.

Abdomen. — Sore pain in liver goes through to shoulders and spine. Pain iu spleen down to groin. Pain in breast extends to hip and spleen. Diarrhova, burning watery stools with relief of pain. ase, —- Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Arsenicum Sulfuratum Flavum
remedies.text: (Yellow Sulphuret of Arsenic. Orpiment) Difficult respiration. Skin chafed about genitals. Leucoderma and squamous syphilides. Sciatica and pain around the knee, Relationship. — Compare: drs; Sulph. rub. (influenza with intense catarrhal symptoms, great prostration and high temperature. purulent discharges, psoriasis, acne, and sciatica. Chilly even before a fire. Itching in various parts.) Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Artemisia Vulgaris
remedies.text:
(Mugwort) Has some reputation as a remedy for epileptic conditions, and convulsive diseases of childhood and girls at puberty, Locally and internally is injurious to eyes. Petit mal. Epilepsy without aura; after fright and other violent emotions and after masturbation, Several convulsions close together, Somnambulism, Gets up at night and works, remembers nothing in the morning. [Kalt phos.} Head. — Drawn back by spasmodic twitchings. Mouth drawn to left. Congestion of brain. Eyes. ~ Colored light produces dizziness. Pain and blurring of vision; better, rubbing; worse, using eyes.

Female. — Profuse menses. Violent uterine contrac: tions. Spasms during menses.

Fever. — Profuse sweat, smelling like garlic, Relationship, — Compare: Absinth.; Cina; Cicuta, Dose. — First to third potency. Said to act better when givep with wine.

remedies.name: Arum Dracontium
remedies.text:
(Green Dragon) Head, — Heavy; shooting pain in ears, aching pair behind right ear. ‘ Throat.— Dry, sore, worse swallowing. Raw and tender. Continued disposition to clear throat. Croupy, hoarse cough with sore throat.

Urinary. — [Irresistible desire to pass urine, burns and smarts. Respiratory. —IJoarseness; excess of mucus in larynx. Asthmatic at night. Expectoration thick, heavy, Dose, — First potency.

remedies.name: Arum Triphyllum
remedies.text:
(Jack-in-the-Pulpit) Arum maculatum, Italicum, Dracontium, have the same action as the Triphy!lum. They ali contain an irritant poison, causing inflammation of mucous surfaces and destruction of tissue. Acridity is the keynote of the kind of action characteristic of Arum. Head.-— Bores head in pillow. Headache from toy warm clothing, from hot coffee.

Eyes. — Quivering of upper eyelids, especially left.

Nose. — Soreness of nostrils, Acrid, excoriating cischarge, producing raw sores. Nose obstructed; nrust breathe through mouth. Boring in the nose. Coryza: discharge ilood-streaked, watery. Nose completely stopped, with fluent, acrid discharge. Hay-fever, with pain over root aj nose. Large scahs high wp ou right side of nose. Fare feels chapped, as if from cold wind; feels hot. Constunt picking at nose until if bleeds. Mouth. ~~ Row feeling at roof and palate. Lips and soft palate sore and burning. Lips chapped and burning. Corners of mouth sore and cracked. Tongue red, sore; whole mouth raw. Picking Jips until they bleed. Saliva profuse, acrid, corroding.

Throat. — Swelling of sub-maxillary glands. Constricted and swollen: burns; raw. Constant hawking. Hoarseness, Expectoration of much mucus. Lungs feel sore. Clerzyman’s sore throat. Voice uncertain, uncontrollable Worse, talking, singing.

Skin. — Scarlet rash; raw, bloody surfuccs anywhere. Modalities, — Horse, northwest wind, lying down, Relationship. — Compare: -tmmon, carh.: Ailanthus; Cepa, Antidotes: Buttermith; Aect, ac.: Puls, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Arundo
remedies.text:
(Reed) A remedy for catarrhat states. Hay-fever.

Head. — Itching; falling off of hair; roots of hair painful. Pustules. Pair in occiput, extends ta right ciliary region. Deep seated pain in sides of head, Ears. — Burning and itching in auditory canals. Eczema behind ears.

Nose. — Hay-fever begins with burning and itching of palate and conjunctiva, Annoying itching in the nostrils and roof of the mouth, [IVyethia.) Coryza; loss of smell. [Nat mur.} Sneezing, itching of nosfrils, ' Mouth.— Burning and itching; bleeding of gurrs. Ulcers and exfoliations in the commissures, Fissures in tongue. Stomach, — Coldness in stomach. Longing for acids. [Antim.; Ars.; China; Phos.} Abdomen. -- Movement as from something alive. Flatulence, pain at pubic region, Stool. Greenish. Burning at anus. Diarrhoea of nursing children. [Chau.; Cale. phos.) Urine. — Burning. Ked sediment, [Lyc.]

Male. — Pain in spermatic cord after embrace.

Female. — Menses too early and profuse. Neuralgic pains from face to shuulders and pubis. Desire with vaginal pruritus, Respiratory. — dyspnoea; cough; dluish expectoration. Burning and pain in nipples, Extremities, — itching, burning; edema of hands aud feet. Burning and swelling of soles. Capious and offensive sweat of feet, Skin. — Eczema; itching and crawling, especially of chest, upper extremities. Fissures in fingers and heels.

Relationship. — Compare: Anthoxantum -— sweet vernal grass (a popular medicine for hay-fever and coryza). Lolium: Cepa; Sabad,; Silica. Dose, -- Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Asafoetida
remedies.text:
(Gum of the Stinkasand) The flatulence and spasmodic contraction of stomach and csepbagus with reverse peristalsis are the most marked symptoms. In its selection, its relation to the hysterical and hypachondriacal patients, must be borne in mind. Besides these superficial symptoms, it has been found to affect favorably deep ulcerations, caries of bones, especially in the syphilitic organism; here, the extreme sensitiveness and terrihle throbbing, nightly Pains, guiding to its use. Head, — Irritable; complains of her troubles; sensitive. Boring above eyebrows. Pressive pain from within outward. Eyes, — Orbital neuralgia; better, pressure and rest Iritis and intraocular infammations, with boring, throbbing pains at night. Stitches under left frontal eminences, Boring pains in and around eyes. Syphiltic iritis, Superficial corneai ulcer with digging pains; worse at night.

Ears. — Offensive otorrhaa, with boriug pains in mas~ toid bone. Mastoid disease with pain in temporal region with prshinty out sensation. Offensive, purulent discharge.

Nose. — Syphilitic ozena, with very offensive purulent discharge. Caries of nasal bones. [Aurum.] Throat, -—- Globus hystcricus. Ball rises in throat. Sensation as if peristaltic motion were reversed, and esophagus were driven from stomach to throat. Stomach, — Great difficulty ‘n bringing up wind. Flatulence and regurgitation of liquid, Hysterical flatulence. Great distention. Sensation of emptiness and weakness, with distention and beating in stomach and abdomen, Forcible eructation of gas. Pwlsation in pit of stomach. Violent gastralgia; cutting and burning in stomach and region of diaphragm. Gurgling and rolling of wind, which escapes afterwards with loud and difficult eructation, Female.—-Mammz turgid with milk in the unimpregnated. Deficient milk, with oversensitiveness, Rectum. — Distended, griping, with hunger. Obstinate constipation. Pain in perineum, as if something dull pressed out, Diarrhea, extremely offensive, with meteorism, and regurgitation of food.

Chest. — Spasmodic tightness, as if lungs could not be fully expanded. Palpitation more like a tremor. Bones, — Darting pain and caries in bones. Periosteum painful, swollen, enlarged. Ulcers affecting bones; thin, ichorous pus. Skin, — ltching, better scratching; ulcers painful on edges. Suppressed skis. symptoms produce nervous disorders.

Modalities. — i} 'orse, at night; from touch; left side, during rest, warm applications. Setter, open air; from motion, pressure.

Relationship. — Antidotes: China; Mercur. Compare: Afoschus; China; Mercur,; Auruin, Dose. — Second to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Asarum Europum
remedies.text:
(European Snake-root) A remedy for nervous affections, loss of energy, with excessive erethism, Seraiching on silk or linen or paper unicarable. Pains and spasmodic mmscular actions. Nervous deafness and asthenopia. Cold shivers from any emotion. Feels as it parts were pressed together. Tension and contractive sensations. Always feels cold. Mind, — Thoughts vanish, with drawing pressure in forchead. Sensibility inercased, ever from mere imagination, Head. — Compressive pain. Tension of scalp; hair painful, {Chisa.] Coryza, with sneezing.

Eyes. — Feel stiff; burn; feel cold. Better, in cold air or water; worse, sunlight and wind. Darting pains in eyes after operations. Asthenopia.

Ears.— Sensation as if plugged up, Catarrh with deafness, Stomach.— Loss of appetite, flatulence, eructation, and vomiting. Desire for alcoholic drinks. Smokingtobacco tastes bitter. Nausea: worse after eating. Clean tongue. Great faintness. Accumulation of cold, watery saliva.

Rectum. — Strings of odorless, yellow mucus pass from bowels. Diarrhoea of tough mucus. Undigested stools. Prolapse, Female, — Menses too early, long lasting, black. Vio- Jent pain in small of back. Tenacious, yellow leucorthera, .

Respiratory. — Nervous, backing cough. Short r2s- Piration.

Back. — Paralytic pain in muscles of nape of neck. Weakness, with staggering.

Fever. — Chilliness, single parts get icy cold. Easily excited perspiration.

Modalities. — Worse, in cold dry weather; penetrating sounds, Aetier, from washing; in damp and wet weather, Relationship. —- Compare: /pecac., especially in diarrhea; Silica; Nux; China, Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Asclepias Syriaca
remedies.text:
(Silkweed) A remedy for dropsy, hepatic, renal or cardiac and post-scarlatinal; causes diaphoresis and augments the urinary secretion. Acute rheumatic inflammation of large joints. Intermittent, pressing-down uterine pains.

Head. — Feels as if a sharp instrument were thrust through from temple to temple. Constriction across forehead, Nervous headache, after suppressed perspiration, followed by increased urine, with increase of specific gravity. Headache from retention of effete matters in system. Relationship. —- Compare: Asclepias Vineetoxicum. ~ Swallow-wort — Cynanchum-- 4 gastro-intestinal irritant, producing vomiting and purgation. — (Useful in dropsy, diabetes, great thirst, profuse urination.) Dose. — Tincture.

remedies.name: Asclepias Tuberosa
remedies.text:
(Pleurisy-root) Its action on the chest muscles is most marked, and has been verified. Sick headache, with flatulence in stomach and bowels. Dyspepsia. Bronchitis and pleurisy come within its range. Catarrhal states from cold and damp weather. Irritation of larynx with huskiness; grip, with pleuritic pain.

Respiratory. — Respiration painful, especially at base of left lung. Dry cough; throat constricted; causes pain in head and abdomen. Pain in chest; shooting downward from left nipple. A general eliminative remedy, acting specially on che sudoriparous glands. Chest pains are relieved by bending forward. Spaces between ribs close to sternum tender. Lancinating pain between shoulders. Catarrh, with frontal headache, and sticky yellow discharge, Stomach. — Fuliness, pressure, weight. Flatulence after meals. Sensitive to tobacco, Rectum. — Catarrhal dysentery, with rheumatic pains all over, Stools smel! like rotten eggs.

Extremities. — Rheumatic joints give sensation as if adhesions being broken up on bending.

Relationship. — Compare: Bryonia; Dutc.

Dose. — Tincture and first potency.

remedies.name: Asimina Triloba
remedies.text:
(Papaw) Produces a series of symptums much like scariet fgyer; sore throat, fever, vomiting, scarlet eruption; tonsils and sub-maxillary glands enlarged, with diarrhea. Desire for ice-cold things. /oarseness. Acne. Itching in evening on undressing.

Relationship. — Compare: Capsic.; Bellad.

remedies.name: Asparagus Officinalis
remedies.text:
(Common Garden Asparagus) Its marked and immediate action on the urinary secretion 1s well known, It causes weakness and cardiac depression. Rheumatic pains. Head, — Confused. Coryza, with profuse, thin fluid. Aching in forehead and root of nose. Migrainious morning headache with scetoma, Throat feels rough, with hawking copious, tenacious mucus from throat.

Urine. — Frequent, with fine stitches in orifice of urethra; burning; of peculiar odor. Cystitis, with pus, mucus and tenesmus. Lithiasis.

Heart. — Palpitation, with oppression of chest. Pulse weak, pain about left shoulder and heart, associated with bladder disturbances. Great oppression in breathing. Hydrothorax, Extremities. — Rheumatic pain in back, especiatly near shoulder and limbs. Pain at acromion process of left scapula under clavicle and down arm, with feeble pulse.

Relationship. — Antidote: Acon.; Apis. Compare: Physalis Alkekungi— Winter cherry — ( Enurcsis; Lithiasis; has marked diuretic action.) Digital.; Sarsap.; Spigelia.

Dose. — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Aspidosperma
remedies.text:
(Quebracho) The digitalis of the lungs. (Hale.) Removes temporary obstruction to the oxidation of the blood by stimulating respiratory centres, increasing oxidation and excretion of carbonic acid, Pulmonary stenosis. Thrombosis of pulmonary artery. Uraemic dyspncea, An effective remedy in many cases of asthma. It stimwlates the respiratory centers and increases the oxygen in the blood. “Want of breath” during exertion is the guiding symptom. Cardiac asthma.

Relationship. — Compare: Ceca; Arsenic: Coffea. — Catalpa (difficult respiration).

Dose. — First trituration ar tincture, or Aspidospermio hydrochjorid 1 grain ef 1x trit. Every hour for a few doses, (Crawtish) Skin symptoms most important, Urticaria, Skin.— Nettle-rash over whole body. — Itching. Crusta lactca, with enlarged lymphatic glands, Erysipelas, and fiver affections with netile-rash. Swelling of cervical glands, Jaundice.

Fever. — Inward chilliness; very sensitive to air, worse uncovering; violent fever, with headache.

Relationship. — Compare: Rombyx — Caterpitlar — ttching of whole body, (Urticaria.) Apis; Rhus; Nat. m.; Homer, Antidote: Poison Oak, Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Asterias Rubens
remedies.text:
(Red Starfish) A remedy for the syeotie diathesis; flabby, lymphatic constitution, flabby with red face, Lancinating pains, Nervous disturbances, neuralgias, chorea, and hysteria come within the range of this remedy. Has been used for cancer of the breast, and has an unquestioned influence over cancer disease, Excitement in both sexes.

Head. — Cannot bear contradiction, Shocks in brain; throbbing; Acat ix head, as if surrounded by hot air.

Face.— Red. Pimples on side of nose, chin and mouth. Disposition to pimples at adolescence.

Female. — Colic and other sufferings cease with appearance of flow. Breasts swell and pain in breasts: worse left. Ulceration with sharp pains, piercing to scapule. Pains down leit arm to fingers, worse motion, Excitement of sexual instinct with nervous agitation. Nodes and indurations of mammary gland, dull aching, neuralgic pain in this region. [Coniumm.]

Chest. — Breasts swollen, indurated. Neuralgia of left breast and arm. [#resst.] Pain under sternum and in muscles of precordial region. Left breast feels as tf fulled inward, ard pain extends over inner arm to end of little finger. Numbness of hand and fingers of left side. Cancer mamma ever in ulcerative stage. Acute, lancinating pain. Axillary glands swolicn hard and knotted, Nervous

System. — Gait unsteady; muscles refuse to obey the will, Epilepsy; preceded by twitching over whole body, Stool. — Constipation. Ineffectual desire. Stool like olives. Diarrhaa, watery brown, gushing out in jet.

Skin. — Destitute of pliability and elasticity, Itching spots. Ulcers, with fetid ichor. Acne. Psoriasis and herpes zoster worse left arm and chest. Enlarged axillary glands, worse, at night and in damp weather. Relationship, — Antidotes: Plumb.; Zinc. Compare: Contum:; Carbo; Ars.; Condurango, Incompatible: Nuw, Coffea.

Modalities. — Werse, coffee, night; cold damp weather. Left side. Dose.~-Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Astragalus Mollissimus
remedies.text:
(Purple or Woolly Loco-weed) Irregularities in gait— paralytic affections. Loss of muscular co-ordination, Head. — Fullness in right temple and upper jaw. Pain over left eyebrow. Painful facial bones. Dizzy. Pressive pain in temples. Pain and pressure in maxilla.

Stomach. — Weakness and emptiness. Burning in esophagus and stomach, Extremities. — Purring sensation in right foot outer side from heel to toe. Icy coldness of left calf.

Relationship. — Compare: Aragallus Lamberti— White Loco-weed — Rattleweed; Baryta; Oxytropis.

Dose. — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Aurum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Metallic Gold) Given full play, Aurum develops in the organism, by attacking the blood, glands, and bene, conditions bearing striking resemblance to mercurial and syphilitic infections; and it is just for such deteriorations of the bodily fluids and alterations in the tissues, that Aurum assumes great importance as a remedy. Like the victim of syphilis, mental states of great depression are produced by it. Hopeless, despondent, and great desire to commit suicide. Every opportunity is sought for self-destruction, Exostosis, caries, nightly bone-pains, AURUM METALLICUM i especially cranial, nasal, and palatine, Glands swollen in scrofulous subjects. Palpitation and congestious. Frequently indicated in secondary syphilis and effects of mercury. This use of gold as an anti-venereal and anti-scrofulous remedy is very old, but has been wellnigh forgotten by the old school until rediscovered and placed on its scientific basis hy homceopathy, and now it can never he lost again. When syphilis is implanted on the scrofulous constitution, we have one of the most intractable morbid conditions, and gold seems to be especially suited to the vile combination. Exnni. Ozena; sexua)] hyperesthesia. Arterioscierosis, high ‘blood pressure; nightly paroxysms of pain behind sternum, Sclerosis of liver, arterial system, brain.

Mind. — Profound despondency, with thorough déz-, gust of life, and thoughts of suicide. Talks of commiting suicide, Great fear of death. Peevish and vehement at Jeast contradiction. Anthropophobia. Mental derangements. Constant rapid questioning without waiting for reply. Pining boys; low spirited, lifeless, weak memory. Cannot do things fast enough. Oversensitiveness; [Staph.] to noise, excitement, confusion.

Head. — Violent pain in head; worse at night, outward pressure. Roaring in head. Vertigo. Tearing through brain to forehead. Pain in bones extending to face. Congestion to head. Boils on scalp.

Eyes.— Extreme photophobia. Great soreness all about the eyes and into eyeballs, Double vision; uppes half of objects invisible. Feel tense. Sees fiery objects. Violent pains in bones around eye [Asaf.) Interstitial keratitis, Vascular cornea. Pains from without inward. Sticking pains inword. Trachoma with pannus. Ears, — Caries of ossicula and of mastoid. Obstinate fetid otorrhea after scarlatina. External meatus bathed in pus, Chronic nerye deafness; Labyrinthine disease due to syphilis, Nose. — Ulecrated, painful, swollen, obstructed. Inflammation of nose; caries; fetid discharge, purulent, bloody. Boring paius in nose; worse at night. Puirid smell from nose. Sensitive smell. [Carbol. ac.} Horrible odar frorm nose and mouth, Knobby tip of nose.

Mouth.— Foul breath in girls at puberty, Taste putrid or bitter, Ulceration of gums.

Face. — Tearing in zygoma. Mastoid and other facial bones inflamed. Throat, — Stitches when swallowing; pain in glands, Caries of the palate. Stomach,— Appetite and thirst increased, with qualmishness. Swelling of epigastrium. Burning at stomach and hot eructations.

Abdomen. — Right hypochondrium hot and painful. Incarcerated flatus. Swelling and suppuration of iuguinal glands, Urine. — Turbid, like buttermilk, with thick sediment. Painful retention, Rectum. — Constipation, stools hard and knotty. Nocturnal diarrhea, with burning in rectum. Male, — Pain and sweciling of testicles, Chronic induration of testicles. Violent erections, Atrophy of testicles in boys. Hydrocele. : Female. — Great sensitiveness of vagina. Uterus enlarged and prolapsed. Sterility; vaginismus, Heart. — Sensation as if the heart stopped beating for two or three seconds, immediately followed by a tumultuous rebowid, with sinking at the epigastrium Palpitation, Pulse rapid, feeble, irregular.
