Hypertrophy, Respiratory. — Dyspnea at night. Frequent, deep breathing ; stitches in sternum. Bones, —- Destruction of bones, like secondary syphilis. Caries of the nasal, palatine, and mastoid bones. Extremities, — All the blood seems to rush from head to lower limbs. Dropsy of lower limbs. Orgasm, as if blood were boiling in all veins. Paralytic, tearing pains in joints, Knees weak.

Sleep. — Sleepless. Sobs aloud in sleep. Frightful dreams. Modalities, — Worse, in cold weather when getting cold, Many complaints come on only in winter, from sunset to sunrise.

Relationship. — Compare: Aur. ars. (chronic aortitis ; lupus, phthisis) in syphilitic headaches; also in anaemia and chlorosis. It causes rapid increase of appetite. alur. brom. (in headaches with neurasthenia, megrim, night terrors, valvular diseases). ati, mur. (Burning, yellow, acrid leucorrhea; heart symptoms, glandular affections; warts on tongue and genitals; sclerotic and exudative degeneration of the nervous system. Multiple sclerosis. Morvan's disease, Second trituration. Aur. mur. is a sycutic remedy, causing suppressed discharges to reappear. Valuable in climacteric hemorrhages from the womb, [Hydyastinin,]) Stitching pain in left side of forehead Weariness, aversion to all work. Drawing feeling in stomach.) Aur, mur. Kali, — Doubse chloride of Potassium and gold. (In uterine induration and haemorrhage.) Aur, iod. (Chronic pericarditis, valvular diseases, arteriosclerosis, ozena, lupus, osteitis, ovarjan cysts, myomata uteri, are pathological lesions, that offer favorable ground fer the action of this powerful drug Senile paresis.) Aur. sulph. (Paralysis agitans; constant nodding of the head; affections of mammz; swelling, pain, cracked nipples with fancinating pains.) Also, Asafet, (in caries of bones of ears and nose). Syphilin; Koli iod.; Hep.; Merc.; Mes.; Nit. ae; Phosph. Antidotes: Bell,; Cinch.; Cupr.; Mere.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Aurum Muriaticum Natronatum
remedies.text:
(Sodium Chloroaurate) This remedy has a most pronounced effect on the female organs, and most of its clinical application has been based thereon. Tsoriasis syphilitica. Periosteat swelling on lower jaw. Swelling of testicle. High blood pressure due to disturbed function of nervous mechanism, Arteriv-sclernsis, Syphilitic Ataxia.

Tongue. — Burning; stitches, and induration.

Female. — Indurated cervix. Coldness in abdomen, Chronic metritis and prolapsus. Uterus fills up whole pelvis, Ulceration of neck of womb and vagina. Leucorrha@a, with spasmodic contraction of vagina. Ovaries indurated. Ovarian dropsy. Swub-involution.

Dose. — Second and third trituration.

remedies.name: Avena Sativa
remedies.text:
(Common Oat) Has a selective action on brain and nervous system, favorably influencing their nutritive function. Nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, and the morphine habit call for this remedy in rather material dosmee. Best tonic for debility after exhausting diseases. “Nerve tremors of the aged; chorea, paralysis agitans, epilepsy. Post-diphtheritic paralysis, Rheumatism of heart, Colds. Alcoholism. Sleeplessness, especially oi alcoholics. Tad effects of Morphine habit. Nervous states of many female troubles.

Mind. — Inability to keep mind on any one subject. Head, — Nervous headache at menstrual period, with burning at top of head. Occipital headache, with phosphatic urine. Female.-- Amenorrhea and dysmenorrheea, with weak circulation.

Male. — Spermatorrhea; impotency; after too much indulgence, Extremities. — Numbness of limbs, as if paralyzed. Strength of hand diminished.

Relationship.— Compare: Alfaifa. (General tonic similar to avena——- also in scanty and suppressed urine.) Dose, — Tincture ten to twenty drop doses, preferably in hot water.

remedies.name: Azadirachta Indica
remedies.text:
{Margosa Bark) An afternoon fever and rheumatic pains in various parts are caused by this remedy. Pain in sternum and ribs, in back and shoulders and extremities; heat, pricking and aching in hands, especially paims, fingers, also toes, .

Head. — Forgetful; giddy on rising; head aches, scaip sensitive; eyes burn, pain in right eyeball, Fever. — Siight chill, afternoon fever, glowing heat in face, hands, and feet, copious sweat on upper pa-t of body.

Relationship.— Compare: Cedron; Natr. mur.; Arsenic,

remedies.name: Bacillinum
remedies.commonName: A Maceration of a Typical Tuberculous Lung
remedies.text:
(A Maceration of a Typical Tuberculous Lung) Introduced by Dr. Burnett Has been employed successfully in the treatment of tuberculosis; its guod effects seen in the change of the sputum, which hecomes decreased and more aerated and less purulent. Many forms of chronic non-tubercular disease are influenced favorably by Baciltinum, especially when bronchorrhaa and dyspnoea are present; the patient expectorates less, * Bacitlinum is especially indicated for lungs of old people, with chronic catarrhal condition and enfeebled pulmonary circulation, attacks of suffocation at niglit with dificult cough. Tubereular meningitis. Favors falling off of tartar of teeth, Constant disposition to take cold. Head,— Irritable, depressed. Severe, deep-in headache, also as cf a tight hoop. Kingworm. Eczema of eyelids.

Abdomen.— Abdominal pains, enlarged glands in groins, tabes mesenterica. Sudden diarrhea before breakfast. Obstinate coustipation, with offensive flatus

Respiratory. — Oppression. Coatarrhal dyspnaa. Hue mid asthma. Rubbling rales and muco-purulent expectoraiion, Note, This muco-purulent expectoration of bronchitic patients is equally poly-bacillary; it is a mixture of diverse species and hence Bacillinum is truly indicated, (Cartier.) Often relieves congestion of the fungs, thus paving way for other remedies in Tuber- :culosis. > reSkin. — Ringworm of the scalp; pityriasis. Eczema wieyelids. Glands of neck evlarged and tender. 4pModalities. — Horse, night and early morning; cold air.

Relationship. — Antimon. tod.; Lach.; Arsentc. iod.; Mvyosotis. Levico, 5-10 drops, follows as an intercurrent where much debility is present (Burnett). Complementary: Calc. phos.; Kali carb, Compare: Its effects seem to be identical to that of Koch’s Tuberculinum. Both are useful in the tubercular diathesis before phthisis has developed. In the carly stages of tubercular disease of glands, joints, skin and bones. Psorinten. Seems to be its chronic equivalent. Bacillin. testinm (acts especially on lower hali of the body.

Dose. — The dose is important. Should not be given below the thirtieth, and not repeated frequently. One dose a week often sufficient to bring about reaction. It is rapid in action and guod results ought to be seen svon, otherwise there is no need of repetition.

remedies.name: Badiaga
remedies.text:
(Fresh-water Sponge) »' Soreness of muscles and integuments ; worse motion and “friction of” clothes, with sensitiveness to co'd, Glands swollen. General paresis.

Head. — Sensation of enlargement and fullness. Pam in forehead and temple, extending to eyebails, worse 1% afternoon, Blueness under eyes. Dandruff; scalp sore, dry, tetter-like. Dull, dizzy feeling in head. Coryza, sneezing, watery discharge, with asthmatic breathing and suffacative cough, Influenza. Slight sounds are greatly accentuated, Eyes. — Twitching of left upper lid; eyeballs tender; aching in eyeballs. Intermittent sore pain in eyeball, coming on at 3 P. M.

Respiratory.— Cough; worse in afternoon. better in warm room. The mucus flies out of mouth and nostrils. -cough, with thick yellaw expectoration; flies y-fever, with asthmatic hreathing. Pleuritic stitches in chest, neck, and hack, Stomach.— Mouth hot. Much thirst. Lancinatiny, pain in pit of stomach extending to vertebra aul scapula. Female, —- Metrorrhagia; worse at night, with feeling of enlargement of head. [Arg.] “Cancer of breast. [Asterias; Con.; Carbo an.; Plumb. iod.]

Heart. — Indescribable bad feeling about the heast with soreness and pain, flying stitches af] over.

Skin. — Sore ta touch. Freckles. Rhogadcs. Back. Stitches in nape, scapula. Pain in small of “hack-“hips and™tower limbs.“ Very stiff neck. Muscles and skin sore, as if beaten, 7 Modalities. — Worse by cold. Better, by heat.

Relationship. — Compare: Merc. similar but opposite modalities. Spongia; Kali hyd.; Phytol.; Conium. Complementary: Sulph.; Mere.; lod, Dose. — First to sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Balsamum Peruvianum
remedies.text: (Peruvian Balsam) Useful in bronchial catarrh, with copious, purulent expectoration, Debility; hectic fever 6x. Nose, — Profuse, thick discharge. Eczema, with ulceration. Chronic, fetid, nasal catarrh, Stomach. —- Vomiting of food and mucus, Catarrh of stomach, Chest. — Bronchitis, and phthisis, with muco-purulent, thick, creamy expectoration. oud rales in chest. [Koki sulph.; Ant. tart] Very loose cough. Hectic fever and night-sweats, with irritating, short cough and scanty expectoration. Urine, — Scanty; much mucus sediment. Catarrh of Dadder. [Chimapi.} Relationship. — Balsamun: Tolutatan (chronic bronchitis with profuse expectoration). (Oleum caryophyilum —oil of cloves--in profuse septic expectoration —3 te 5 minims in milk or capsules.) Dose. — First attenuation: In hectic 6x. Extra homeopathic uses focally :-—~As a stimulant to raw surtaces in indolent ulcers, scabies, cracked nipples, rhagades, itch, Internally, as an expectarant, in chronic bronchitis. Dose, 5 to 15 M., made inte an emulsion with mucilage or yolk of egg.

remedies.name: Baptisia
remedies.text:
(Wild Indigo) The symptoms of this drug ave of an asthenic type. simulating low fevers, septic conditions of the blood, malarial poisoning, and extreme prostration. Indeseribable sick feeling. Great muscular soreness and putrid fhenomena always are present, All the secretions are offensive — breath, stool, urine, sweat, ctc. Epidemic influenza. Chronic intestinal toxwmias of children with fetid stools and eructatiuns. Baptisia in Jow dilutions produces a form of am hadies to the bac. typhosus, viz. the agglutinina, (MeHon.] Thus it raises the natural bodily resistance to the invasion of the bacillary intoxication, which produces the typhoid syndrome. Typhoid carriers. After inoculation with anti-typhoid serum. Intermittent pulse, especially in the aged, Mind. — Wild, wandering feeling. Inability to think, Brain-fag. Ideas confused. Thinks he is broken or double, and tosses about the bed trying to get pieces together. [Cajeput.] Dehrimn, wandering, muttering Perfect indifference. Falls asleep while being spoken to. Melancholia, with stupor.

Head. — Confused, swimming feeling. Vertigo; pressure at root of nose. Skin of forehead feels tight: seems drawn to back of head. Feels too large, heavy, numb. Soreness of eyeballs. Brain feels sore. Stupor; falts asleep while spoken to. Early deafness in typhoid conditions.

Face. — Besotted look. Dark red. Pain at root of nose. Muscles of jaw rigid. Mouth. -~ Taste flat, bitter. Teeth and gums sore, ulcerated. Breath fetid. Tongue feels burned; yellawish-brown; edges red and shining. Dry and brown in center, with dry and glistening edges; surface cracked and sore. Can swallow liquids only; least solid food gags. Throat. -— Dark reduess of tonsils and soft palate. Constriction, contraction of q@sophagus, ([Cajeput.] Great difficulty in swallowing solid tood. Pointless sore throat, and offensive discharge. Contraction at cardiac orifice, Stomach. — No appetite. Constant desire for water. Sinking feeling at stomach. Pain in episgastric region. Feeling of hard substance. [Abies niy.] All symptoms worse from heer. {Kali beh]. Cardiac orifice contracted convulsively and ulcerative inflammation of stomach and bowels, Abdomen. - - Right side markedly affected. Distended and rumbling. Soreness over region of gall-bladder, with diarrhoea. Stools very offensive, thin, dark, bloody. Soreness of abdomen, in region of liver. Dysentery of old people, Female. — Threatened miscarriage from mental depression. shock, watching, low fevers. Menses too early, too profuse. Lochia acrid, fetid. Puerperal fever.

Respiratory. — Lungs feel compressed, breathing difficult. Fears going to sleep on account of nightmare and sense of suffocation.* Constriction of chest. Back and

Extremities. — Neck tired. Stiffness and pain, aching and drawing in arms and legs. Pain in sacrum, around hips and legs. Sore and bruised. Decubitus, Sleep. — Sleepless and restless. Nightmare and frightful dreams. Cannot get herself together, feels scattered about bed. Falls asleep while avswering a question. .

Skin. — Livid spots all over body and limhs. Burning and heat in skin. ([Arsenic.] Putrid ulcers with stupor, low delirium and prostration. Fever, — Chill, with rheumatic pains and soreness all over body. Heat afl over, with occasional chills. Chill about I] a.m. Typhus fever. Shipboard fever, Modalities. ~— Worse: Humid heat: fog; indoors. Relationship. Compare: Ailanthus differs, being more painful, Baptisia more painless. Rhus; Muriat. acid; Arsenic; Bryon.; Arnica; Echinac, Baptisia confusia. (Pain in right jaw and oppression in left hypochondrium, producing dyspnoea and necessity to assume erect position.) Dose, — Tincture, to twelfth attenuation.

remedies.name: Barosma
remedies.text: (Buchu) Marked specific effects on genito-urinary system; muco-purulent discharges. Irritable bladder, with vest cal catarrh; prostatic disorders. Gravel. Letcorrheea. Relationship, — Compare: Copaiva; Thuja; Populus; Chimaph. Dose, — Tincture or tea from leaves.

remedies.name: Baryta Acetica
remedies.text:
(Acetate of Baryta) Mind. -- orgetiul; wavering long between opposite resolutions.

Face. — Feeling of colweb in face.

Extremities. — Drawing pain down whole left teg. Crawling, with burning stitches. Paralysis, Dose. — Second and third trituration.

remedies.name: Baryta Carb
remedies.text:
(Carbonate of Baryta) This remedy brings aid to scrofulous children, especially if they are backward mentally and physically, are dwarfish, do nat grow and develop. have screfulous ophthalmia, swollen abdomen, take cold easily, and then always have siwelien tonsils. Persons subject to quinsy which is prone to suppurate; gums bleed easily. Dis-~ eases cf old meu when degenerative changes begin; who have hypertrophied prostate or indurated testes, very sensitive to cold, offensive foot-sweats, very weak and weary, must sit or lie down or lean on something Very averse to meeting strangers. Catarrh of posterior nares, with frequent epistaxis, Often useful in the dyspepsias of the young who have masturbated and who suffer from seminal emissions, together with cardiac irritability and palpitation. Affects glandular structures, and useful it) general degenerative changes, especially in coats of arteries, ancurism, and senility. Baryta is. a cardio-vascular poison acting on the muscular coats of heart and vessels. Arterial fibrosis. Blood-vessels soften and degenerate, become distetded, and aneurisms, ruptures, and apuplexies result, Mind. — Loss af memory, mental weakness, Irresolute. Lost confidence in himself. Senile dementia. Confusion. Bashful. Aversion to strangers, Childish; grief over trifics. Head, — Vertigo; stitches, when standing in the sun, extending through head. Brain feels as if loose. Hair falls out, Confusion. Fens, Eyes. — Alternate dilatation and contraction of pupils. Fhotephobia. Gauze before eyes. Cataracts. [Cale.; Phos.; Sil]

Ears.— Hardness of hearing. Crackling noise. Glands around cars painful and swollen. Reverbveration on blowing nose, Nose -- Dry; sneezing; coryza, with swelling of upper lip and nose. Sensation of smoke in nose. Discharge of thick, yellow mucus. Frequent bleeding. Scabs around wings of nose, Face.— Pale, puffed; sensation as of cobwelx [-ddsming.) Upper lip swollen, Mouth, — Awakes with dry mouth. Gums bleed and retract. Teeth ache before menses. Mouth filled with inflamed vesicles, foul taste. Paralysis of tongue. Smarting, burning pain in tip of tongue. Dribbling of saliva at dawn.

Throat. — Submaxillary glands and tonsils swollen. Tokes cold easily, with. stitches and smarting pain. Quinsy. Suppurating tonsils from every cold. Tonsils inflammed,, with swollen veins. Smarting-pain when swallowing; worse empty swallowing. Feeling of a plug in pharynx. Can only swallow liquids. Spasm of cesophagus as soon as food enters oesophagus, causes gagging and choking. [Merc. cor.; Graphit.] Throat troubles from over use of voice. Stinging pain in tonsils, pharynx or larynx. Stomach — Waterbrash, hiccough, and eructationy which relieves pressure as of a stone. Hungry, but refuses food. Pain and weight immediately after a meal, with epigastric tenderness. [Kali carb.] Worse after warm food. Abdomen, — Herd and tcnse, distended. Colicky. Enlarged mesenteric glands. Pain in abdomen swallowing food. Habitual colic, with hunger, but food is refused. Rectum, — Constipation, with hard, knotty stools. Hemorrhoids protrude on urinating. Crawling in rectum, Oozing at anus.

Urinary. — Every time patient urinates, his piles come down. Urging to urinate. Burning in urethra on urinating.

Male. — Diminished desire and premature impotence, Enlarged prostate. (Tjuju, Arg. nit.; Digit.) Female. — Before menses, pain in stomach and small of back. Menses scanty.

Respiratory. — Dry, suffocative cough, especially in old people. [Sencga.} Larynx feels as if smoke were inhaled. Chronic aphonia, Stitches in chest; worse, inspiration. Lungs feel fuli of smoke.

Heart. — Paipitation and distress in region of heart. Aneurism. [Lycop.) Accelerates the heart's action at first, blood pressure much increased, contraction of blood vessels. Palpitation when lying on left side, when thinking of it especialiy; pulse fuil and hard, Cardiac symptoms after suppressed foot-sweat.

Back. — Swollen glands in nape of occiput. Fatty tumors about neck. Bruised pain hetween scapule. Stiffness in sacrum. Weakness of spine.

Extremities. — Pain in axillary glands. Cold, clammy feet. [Calc.] Fetid foot-sweats, Numbness of limbs. Numb feeling from knees to scrotum; disappears when sitting down. Toes and soles sore; soles painful when walking. Pain in joints; burning pains in lower limbs, Sleep. — Talking in sleep; awakens frequently; feels too hot. Twitching during sleep.

Modalities. — Worse, while thinking of symptoms; from washing; lying on painful side, Better, walking in open air, Relationship. — Compare: Digitalis; Radium; Aragallus; Oxytrop; Astray. Complementary: Duic.; Silica; Psorin. Incompatible: Cafe. Antidote for poisonous doses: Epsom satis.

Dose.— Third to thirtieth potency, the latter to remove the predisposition to quinsy.

remedies.name: Baryta Iodata
remedies.text:
(Iodide of Baryta) Acts on the lymphatic system, increased leucocytosis. Quinsy. Indurated glands, especially tonsils. Strumous ophthalmia, with tumefaction of cervical glands and stunted growth.

Relationship. — Compare: Acon, lycotonum (swelling of cervical, axillary, and mammary glands). Lapis; Con.; Merc. iod,; Carbo an. : Dose. — Second and third trituration.

remedies.name: Baryta Muriatica
remedies.text:
(Barium Chloride) The different salts of Baryta are called for in organic lesions of the aged and dwarfish, both mentally and physically. Arteriv-sclerosis and cerebral affections due to this condition. Headaches, but without acute crisis, occurring in old people; heaviness rather than pain. Vertigo, due to cerebral anamia and noises in ears. {Cartiey.] Acts on Jower alimentary canal, especially rectum; on muscles and joints, giving stiffness and weakness as from overwalking. The white blood corpuscles increased (leucocytosis). Increased tension of pulse. Arterio-sclerosis f[Aurum; Secale) where a high systolic pressure with a comparatively low diastolic tension is attended by cerebral and cardiac symptoms. This remedy has indurated and narrowing of the cardiac orifice with pain, immediately after eating, and epigastric tenderness, which has been repeatedly verified, also its use in ancurisn: end chronic hyperthrophy of the tonsils. Nymphomania and satyriasis, In every form of mania when the sexual desire is increased. Jey colducss of body, with parclysis. Multiple sclerosis of brain and cord, Voluntary muscular power gone but perfectly sensible, Paresis after influenza and diphtheria. Genera! feeling of lassitude in the morning, especially weakness of the legs, with muscular stiffness. Children who go around with their mouth open and who talk through the nose. Stupid-appearing, hard of hearing.

Ears. — Whizzing and buzzing. Noises on chewing and swallowing, or sneezing. Earache; better sipping cold water. Parotids swollen. Offensive otorrhosa, Inflates middie ear on blowing nose, Throat.— Difficult swallowing. Tonsits enlarged. Paresis of pharynx and eustachian tubes, with sneezing and noises. Tubes feel too wide open. Respiratory. —- Pronchial affections af old people with cardiac dilatation Facilitates expectoration, Great accumulation and rattling of mucus with difficult expectoration. Arterio-sclerosis of the lung, thus in senile asthma modifies the arterial tension, * Stomach.— Gone feeling at cpigastrium a good guiding symptom for it in chronic affections. Retching and vomiting. Sensation of heat ascending to head.

Urine. — Great increase in uric acid, diminution of chlorides.

Abdomen. — Throbbing [Selen.]; induration of pancreas; abdominal aneurism. Inguinal glands swollen. Spasmodic pain in rectum, Relationship. Compare in sclerotic degenerations, especially of spinal cord, liver, and heart, Plenbum met. and Plumb. iod. Atso Aurum atur. (which will often accomplish more m sclerotic and exudative degenerations than other remedies. Multiple sclerosis, fulgurating pains, tremors, Morvan’s disease, -hypertrophy of fingers.} Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Belladonna
remedies.text:
(Deadly Nightshade) Belladonna acts upon every part of the nervous system, producing active congestion, furious excitement, perverted special senses, twitching, convulsions and pain. It has a marked action on the vascular system, skin and glands. Belladonna always is associated with hot, red skin, flushed face, glaring eyes, throbbing carotids, excited mental state, hyperasthesia of all senses, delirium, restless sleep, convulsive movements, dryness of mouth and throat with aversion to water, neuralgic pains that come and go suddenly, [Oxytropis.] Heat, redness, throbbing and burning. Great , childrgn’s remedy, Epileptic spasms followed by nausea and vomiting. Scarlet fever and also prophylactic. Here use the thirtieth” potency. Exophthalmic goitre. Corresponds to the symptoms of “air-sickness” in aviators, Give as preventive. No thirst, anxiely or fear. Belladonna stands for violence of attack and suddenness of onset. .

Mind. — Patient lives in a world of his own, engrossed by spectres and visions and oblivious to surrounding realities. While the retina is insensihle to actual objects, a host of visual hallucinations throng about him and come to him from within. He is acutely alive and crazed by a flood of subjective visual impressions and fantastic illusions. Hallucinations ; sees monsters, hideous faces. Delirium; frightful images; furious; rages, hites, strikes: desire to escape, Loss of consciousness, Disinclined to talk. Perversity, with tears.” Acutencss of all senses. Head, — Vertigo, with falling to left side or backwards. Sensitive to feast contact. Much throbbing and heat. Pain; fullness, especially in forehead, also occiput, and temples. Headache from suppressed catarrhal flow. Sudden outcries. Pain worse light, noisc, jar, lying down and in afternoon; better by pressure and semi-erect posture. Boring of head into pitlow; drawn backward and rolls from side to side. Constant moaning. Hair splits; is dry and comes out. Headache worse on right side and when lying down; from having hair cut.

Face. — Red, hot, swollen, shining; convulsive motion of muscles of face. Swelling of upper lip. Eyes.-—Throbbing deep in eyes on lying down. Pupils dilated. [Agnus.) Eyes feel swollen and protruding, staring, brilliant; conjunctiva red; dry, burn; ,Photophobia; shooting in eyes. ‘Ocular illusions; fiery appearance, Diplopia; squinting, spasm of lids . Sensation as if eyes were half closed. Eyelids swollen. Bundus congested. : Ears.— Tearing pain. Humming noises. Membrana tympani bulges and injected. Parotid gland swollen. Sensitive to loud tones. Hearing very acute. Otits media, Pain causes delirium. Child cries out in sleep; throbbing and beating pain deep in ear, synchronous with heart beat.

Nose. — Imaginary odors. Tingling in tip of nose. Red and swollen, #leeding of nose, with red face. Coryza: mucus mixed with blood, Mouth — Dry. Throbbing pain in teeth. Gumboil. Tongue red on edges. Strawberry tongue. Grinding of teeth. Tongtte swollen and painful. Stammering. [Siram.]

Throat. — Dry, as if glazed; angry-looking congestion [Ginseng]; red, worse on right side. Tonsils enlarged; throat feels constricted; difficult deylutition; worse, liquids. Sensation of a jump. CEsophagus dry; feels contracted, Spasms in throat. Continual ‘inclination to swallow. Scraping sensation. Muscles of deglutition very sensitive, Stomach. —- Loss of appetite. Averse to meat and milk, Spasmodic pain in epigastrium. Constriction; pain runs to spine. Nausea and vomiting. Great thirst for cold water. Spasms of stomach. Empty retching. Abhorrence of liquids. Spasmodic hiccough. Aversion to water. Dread of drinking. Uncontrollable vomiting. Abdomen, — Distended, hot. Transverse colon protrudes fike a pad. Tender, swollen. Pain as if clutched by a hand; worse, jar, pressure. Cutting pain across; stitches in left side of abdomen, when coughing, sneezing, or touching it. Extreme sensitiveness to touch, bed-clothes, etc. [Laches.]

Stools. — Thin, green, dysenteric; in lumps like chalk, Shuddering during stool. Stinging pain in rectum; spasmodic stricture. Piles more sensitive with backache, Prolapsus ani. [/onatia; Podoph.]

Urine. — Sensation of motion in bladder as of 2 worm. Urine scanty, with tenesmus: dark and turbid, loaded with phosphates. Vesical region sensitive, Incontinence, continuous dropping. Frequent and profuse.

Male. — Testicles bard, drawn up, inflamed. | Nocturnal sweat of genitals. Flow af prostatic fluid. Desire diminished. Female. ~~ Sensitive forcing dawnwards, as if all the viscera would protrude at genitals, Dryness and heat of vagina, Dragging around loins. Pain in sacrum. Menses increased; bright red, too carly, too profuse, Hemorrhage hot, Cutting pain from hip to hip. Monses and lochia very offensive and hot. Labor-pains come and go suddenly. Afestitis pain, throbbing, redness, streaks radiate from nipple. Breasts feel heavy; are hard and red. Tumors of breast, pain worse lying down, Badly smelling hemorrhages, hot gushes of blood. Diminished tochia.

Reapiratory.— Drying in nose, fauces, larynx, and trachea, Tickling, short, dry cough: worse af night. Larynx feels sore. Respiration oppressed, quick, unequal. Cheyne-Stokes respiration [Cocuin; Opium.] Hoarse; loss of voice. Paintess hoarseness. Cough with pain in left hip. Barking cough, whooping cough, with pain in stomach before attack, with expectoration of blood. Stitches in chest when coughing. Lerynr very painful; feels as if a foreign body were in it, with cough. High, piping voice, Moaning at every breath.

Heart.— Violent palpitation, reverberating in head, with labored breathing. Paipitation from least exertion, Throbbing all through body. Dichrotism. Heart seetned too large. Rapid but weakened pulse.

Extremities. — Shooting pains along limbs. Joints swollen, red, shining, with red streaks radiating, Tottering gait. Shifting rheumatic pains. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Jerking limbs, Spasms, Involuntary limping.. Cald extremities.

Back. — Stiff neck. Swelling of glands of neck, Pain in nape. as if it would break. Pressure on dorsal region most painful. Lumbago, with pain in hips and thighs.

Skin. — Dry and fot: swollen, sensitive; burns, searfet, smooth, Eruption like searlatina, suddealy spreading. Erythema; pustules on face, Glands swollen, tender, red. Boils, Acne rosacea. Suppurative wouads. (Atropia has the power of greatly increasing the phagocytic activity of the jeucocytes. } Fever.— A high feverish state with comparative absense of toxemia Burning, pungent Avat. Feet icy cold, Superficial blood-vessels, distended. Perspiration dry only on head. No thirst with fever. Sleep. -— Restless, crying out, gritting of teeth. Kept awake by pulsation of blaod-vessels. Screams out iu sleep, Sleeplessness, with drowsiness. Starting when closing the eyes or durirg sleep. Sleeps with hands under head. [Ars.; Plat.]

Modalities. — W’orse, touch, jar, noise, draught, after neon, lying down. Better, semi-erect, Relationship. — Compare: Hyos. (fess fever, more agitation) ; Stram. (more sensorial excitement, frenzy) ; Hoitsia—A Mexican drug, similar in action to Bellad. (Useful in fever, scarlatinal eruption, measles, urticatia, etc, High fever with eruptive fevers. Dry mouth and throat, red face, injected eyes, delirium). Calcar. is often required after Beli.; Atropia. (Great dryness of throat, almost impossible to swallow. Almost identical in action, with accentuation of the nerv- + ous phenomena; chronic stomach affections, with great pain and vomiting of all food. Peritonitis. All kind of illusions of sight. Everything appears large. Platina opposite.) | Hypochlorhydria; pyrosis, Motes over everything. On reading, words run together; double vision, all objects scem to be elongated. Eustachian tube and tympanic congestion. Affinity for the pancreas, Hyperacidity of stomach, Paroxysms of gastric pain. 3x. Antidates: Camph.; Coff.; Opium; Acon. Complementary: Cate. Incompatible: Acet. ac.

Dose. — First to thirtieth potency and higher. Must be repeated frequently in acute diseases, . Non-Homeeopathic Uses, — Atropia and its salts are used for ophthalmic purposes, to dilate the pupil and paralyze the accommodation. Given internally or hypodermically, it is antagonistic to Opium and Morphine. Physostigma and Prussic Acid. Atropia 1-20 gr. is antagonistic toe 1 gr. Morphine. Also used as a local anesthetic, antispasmodic, and. to dry up secretions, milk, etc.

Dose. — Atropia Sulph,, 1-120 to 1-60 grain.

remedies.name: Bellis Perennis
remedies.text:
(Daisy) Tt acts upon the muscular fibers of the blood-vessels. Much muscular soreness. Lameness, as if sprained. Venous congestion, due to mechanical causes. First remedy in injuries to the deeper tissues, after major surgical work, Kesults of injuries to nerves with intense soreness anil intolerance of culd bathing. After goygt, debility of limbs, [Cyprip.] Traumatism of the pelvic organs, auto-traumatism, expresses the condition calling for this remedy; ill effects from masturbation. Excellent remedy for sprains and bruises. Complaints due to cold food or drink when the body is heated, and in affections due to cold wind, Externally, in nevi. Acne. Boils all over. Sore, bruised feeling in the pelvic region, Exudations, stasis, swelling, come within the range of this remedy. Rheumatic symptoms, Does not vitiate the secretions.

Head. — Vertigo in elderly people. Headache from occiput to top of head. Forehead feels contracted. Bruised soreness. Itching around scalp and over back, worse from hot bath and bed.

Femaje.— Breasts and uterus engorged. Varicose veins in pregnancy. During pregnancy inability to walk. Abdeminal muscles fame, Utcrus feels sore, as if squeesed.

Sleep. — Wakes early in morning and cannot get to sleep again. Abdomen, — Sorencss of abdominal walls and of uterus, Stitches in spleen, sore, enlarged. Yellow, painless diarrhea, foul oder, worse at night. Bloated; tumbling in bowels. Skin. —- Boils. Ecchymosis, swelling, very sensitive to touch, Venous congestion due to mechanical causes. Varicose veins with bruised sore feeling. Exudations and swellings. Acne, Extremities. — Joints sore, muscular soreness, Itching on back and flexor surfaces of thighs. Pain down anterior of thighs, Wrist feels contracted as from elastic band around joint. Sprains with great soreness.

Relationship. — Compare: Arnica; Arsenic; Staphis.: Hamamelis; Bryonia; Vanadium (degenerative states), Modalities. — [orse, ieft side; hot bath and warmth of bed; before storms, Better, cold; continued motion. Dose. —- Tincture to third potency,

remedies.name: Benzenum
remedies.text:
(Benzol, C6, H6) The most striking fact in the proving of Benzol seems to be the influence it had on the circulatory system. Jt caused a slowing of the pulse stream which in the guinea-pigs brought about the formation of infarcts. Tu the human provers it resulted in a decrease of the red and increase of white cells. (R. F. Rabe, M.D.) It ought to be uf use in Leucamia. Eye symptoms striking.

Head. — Sense of falling through bed and floor. Pains from below upward... Tired and nervous, Frontal headache to root of nose. Dizzy, Pressing feeling in head.

Eyes. — Illusion of vision with wide open eyes. Twitching of fids. Photophobia, objects blurred, Aching in eyes aud lids. Marked dilation of pupils. Fai!- ure to react to light, particularly daylight, Nose. — Profuse fluent coryza, Especially in afternoon. Violent sneezing, Extremities. —- Heavy limbs, cold legs, exaggerated knee-jerk. Pains from below upward. Skin, — Eruption like measles. Perspiration on side not fain upon, Itching all over back. Modalities, — Worse at night. Worse right side.

Dose. — Sixth potency. Relationship, -- Compare: Benzin. — Petroleum ether — not as pure a compound as Benzene (Benzol). It is the same, but with a mixture of hydrocarbons. It seems to exercise a special influence on the nervous system and on the blood. Oxyhaemoglobinemia, Physical weakness, cramps, exaggeration of knee jerks, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, Azavincss and coldness of limbs. Tremor of eyelids and tongue. Bensin. dinitricum —D. N. B.— The most obvious results of poisoning by skin absorption are changes in the red bloodcorpuscles aud liver degeneration (in amblyopia, colorblindness, retinitis. Field of vision contracted. Black urine). Rersin, nitricum, Mirbane, Dark, black blood, coagulates with difliculty; venous hyperemia of the brain and general venous engorgement. Burning taste in mouth. Blue lips, tongue, skin, nails and conjunctive. Cold skin, pulse small, weak, breathing slow and irregular, unconsciousness, symptoms of apoplectic coma. Relling of eyeballs in their vertical axes; pupils dilated, Nystagmus, Respiration very slow, difficult, sighing. Yvrinitroteluene (T. N. T.), Trotyl — is a high explosive, obtained by nitrating toluene —a product of coal tar distillation. When the skin or hair is exposed to T. N. T. by contact a characteristic yellow or tawny-orange stain is produced, which lasts for some weeks. Produces fatal toxic jaundice. Dose. ~ Third potency.

remedies.name: Benzoicum Acidum
remedies.text:
{Benzoic Acid) The most marked characteristic pertains to the odor and color of the urine. It has a marked action on metabolism. It produces and cures symptoms of a uric acid diathesis, with urine highly colored and very offensive, and gouty symptoms. Child wants to be nursed in the arms, will not be laid down. Pains suddenly change their locality, Antisycotic.

Mind. — Omits words in writing. Depression.

Head. — Throbbing in temporal arteries, causes puffing around ears. Noises when swallowing. Ulceration of tongue, Swelling behind ears. [Caps.] Cold sweat on forehead. Pricking, puckered constriction of mouth, bluish and bleeding gums.

Nose. — Itching of septum. Pain in nasal bones. Face. —~ Copper-cotored spots. Red, with little blisters. Circumscribed redness of cheeks. Stomach. ~ Sweat while eating; pressure in stomach, sensation of a lump. Abdomen. -- Cutting about navel. Stitching in liver region.

Rectum. — Stitches and constricted feeling. Puckering constriction of rectum. Itching and watery elevations around anus, Stool. —Frothy, offensive, ltquid, light-colored, like soapsuds, bowel movements mostly windy.

Urine. — Repulsive odor; changeable cotor; brown, acid. Enuresis; dribbling urine of old men. Excess of uric acid, Vesical catarrh from suppressed gonorrhoea.

Respiratory. — Hoarse in morning. Asthmatic cough ; worse night; lying on right side. Chest very tender. Pain in region of heart. Expectoration, green mucus.

Back.— Pressure on spinal column. Coldness in sacrum. Dull pain im region of kidneys; worse, wine.

Extremities. — Joints crack on motion. Tearing with stitches, Pain in tendo Achillis. Rheumatic gout; nodes very painful. Gouty deposits. Ganglion; swelling of the wrist. Pain and swelling in knees. Bunion of great toe. Tearing pain in great toe. Fever,— Cold hands, feet, back, knees. Chilliness; cold sweat. Internal heat on awakening, Skin. — Red spots. Itching in spots, Modalities. — Worse, in open air; by. uncovering.

Relationship. — Useful after Colchic., fails in gout; after Copaiva in gonorrhcea. Compare: Nitric acid; Ammon, benz.; Sabina; Tropeolum — Garden Nasturtium — (fetid urine). Antidote: Copaiva, Incompatible: Wine.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Berberis Aquifolium
remedies.text:
(Mountain Grape) A remedy for the skin, chronic catarrhal affections, secondary syphilis. Hepatic torpor, lassitude and other evidences of incomplete metamorphosis. Head, — Sensation of a band just above ears. Bilious headache. Face. —Blotches and pimples. [Cérmicif.] Stomach, — Tongue thickly coaced, yellowish-brown; feels blistered. Burning in stomach. Nausea and hunger alter eating.

Urine. — Stitching, crampy pains; thick mucus, and bright-red, mealy sediment, Skin. — Pimply, dry, rough, scaly. Eruption on scalp extending to face and neck, Tumor of breast, with pain, Psoriasis. Acne. Dry Eczema. Relationship, — Carbol. acid.; Euonym.; Berd. vulg.; Hydr, Dose. — Tincture in rather material doses,

remedies.name: Berberis Vulgaris
remedies.text:
(Barberry) Rapid change of symptoms — pains change in regard to place and character—thirst alternates with thirstlessness, hunger, and loss of appetite, ete. , Hepatic, and rheumatic affections, particularly with urinary, hemorrhoidal and menstrual complaints. Old gouty constitutions, Pain im region of kidneys is most marked; hence its use in renal and vesical troubles, gall-stones, and vesical catarrh. Pains may be felt all over body, emanating from small of back. Tt has also marked action on the liver, promoting the flow_of bile. Often called for in arthritic affections with urinary disturbances, Wandering, radiating pains. Acts well in fleshy persons, good livers, but with little endurance, Al! paius radiate.

Head. — Lisiless, apathetic, indifferent. Puffy sensation, Feeling as if becoming larger. Vertigo with attacks of fainting. Frontal headache. Chilliness in hack and occiput. Tearing pain in auricle, and gouty concretions. Sensation of a tight cup pressing upon the whale scalp, Face. — Pale, sickly. Sunken cheeks and eyes, with bluish circles. Mouth, — Sticky sensation. Diminished saliva. Sticky, frothy saliva, like cotton. [Nur meosch.} Stomach. — Nausea before breakfast. Wearthurn. Abdomen, — Stitches in region of gall-bladder ; worse, pressure, extending to stomach. Catarrh of the gallbladder with constipation and yellow complexion. Stitching pain in front of kidneys extending to liver, spleen, stomach, groins, Poupart's ligament. Sticking deep is ilinm.

Stool. — Constant urging to stool. Diarrhoea painless, clay-colored. burning, and smarting in anus and perineum, Tearing around anus. Fistula in ano.

Urinary.— Burning pains. Sensation as if some urine remained after urinating. Urine with thick mucus and bright-red, mealy sediment. Bubbling, sore sensation in kidneys. Pain in bladder region. Pain in the thighs and loins on urinating. Frequent urina-» tion; urethra burns when not urinating.

Male. — Neuralgia of spermatic cord and testicies. Smarting, burning, stitching in testicles, in prepuce and scrotum.

Female. — Pinching constriction in mons veneris, vaginismus, contraction and tenderness of vagina. Burning and soreness in yagina. Desire diminished, cutting pain during coition, Menses scanty, gray mucus, with pain in kidneys aad chilliness, pain down thighs. Leucorrhora; grayish mucus, with painful urinary symptoms.

Respiratory. — Hoarseness; polypus of Jarynx, Tear-~ ing stitches in chest and region of heart. Back, — Stitches in neck and back; worse, respiration. Sticking pain in region of kidneys radsating thence around abdomen, to hips and groins. Numb, bruised sensation. Stitches {rom kidneys into bladder. Tearing, sticking with stiffness, making rising dificult, involving hips, nates, limbs, with numbness. Lumbago. [Rhus; Fart. cm.) Metatarsus and metacarpus feel sprained. Post-operative pain in lumbar region; soreness with sharp pain following course of circumftex iliac nerve to Madder with frequent urination.

Extremities. — Rheumatic paralytic pain in shoulders, arms, hands and fingers, legs and feet. Neuralgia under finger-nails, with swelling of finger-joints. Sensation of cold on outside of thighs. Heels pain, as if ulcerated. Pain in balls of feet on stepping. Intense weariness and lameness of legs after walking a short distance.

Skin. — Flat warts. Jiching, burning and smarting; worse, scratching; better, cold applications. Smali pustules over whole body. Eczema of anus and hands, Circumscribed pigmentation following eczematous in- . Aamrnation, Fever. -—~ Cold sensation in various parts, as if spattered with cold water. Warmth in lower part of back, hips, and thighs.

Modalities. — Worse, motion, standing. It brings on, or increases, urinary complaints, Relationship.—Compare : Jpomea—Convoloulus Duartinus--Morning Glory.—Pain in left lumbar muscles on stooping. Kidney disorders with pain in back. Much abdominal flatulence, Aching in top of right shoulder (renal colic; aching in small of back and extremities), 4loc.; Lycopad.; Nux; Sarsap. Nanthorrkaa arborca (severe pain in kidneys, cystitis and gravel. Pam from ureter to bladder and testicles; pain in small of back returns from least chill or damp). Mohonia ayuifolium (chronic syphilis; eczema, acne, Pityriasis; headache, as of an iron band: better, coffee; mountain fever}. Xanthorrhisa apifelia contains Berberine. Dilatation of stomach and intestines, atony, enlarged spleen. Antidotes: Camphor; Bell.

Dore. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Betonica
remedies.text:
(Betony Wood) Produces pains in various parts

Head. — Stitches in right temple. Inability to concentrate mind. Abdomen, — Pains in abdomen, hepatic region and of transverse coton, also in gall-bladder and right inguinal region and spermatic cords.

Extremities. — Shooting pain in back of both wrist joints. Wrist drops. Pain in right popliteal space down leg, which feels paralyzed.

remedies.name: Bismuthum
remedies.text:
(Precipitated Sub-Nitrate of Bismuth) Irritation and catarrhal inflammation of the alimentary canal, is the chief action of this drug.

Mind. — Solitude is unbearable. Desire for company. Complains about his condition. Anguish. Discontented. Head. -—- Headache alternates with gastralgia. Neuralgic pain, as if torn by pincers; involves face and teeth; worse, eating; better, cold; alternate with gastralgia. Cutting or pressure above right orbit extending to occiput. Pressure in occiput; worse, motion; with heaviness. Mouth. —- Gums swollen, Toothache; bdetter, cold water in mouth. [Coff.] Tongue white. Swollen. Black, gangrenous looking wedges om dorsum and sides of tongue. Profnse salivation, teeth loose. Thirst for cold drinks.

Stomach. — Vomits, with convulsive gagging and pain. FVater is vomited as soon as tt reaches the stomach, Eructation after drinking. Vomits all fwids. Burning; feeling of a load. Wilt eat for several days; then vomit. Slow digestion, with fetid eructations. Gastralgia; pain from stomach through to spine. Gastritis. Better, cold drinks, but vomiting when stomach becomes full, Tongue coated white; sweetish, metallic taste. Inexpressible pain in stomach; must bend backwards. Pressure as from a load in one spot, alternating with burning, crampy pain and pyrosis.

Stool. — Painless diarrhcea, with great thirst, and frequent micturition and vomiting. Pinching in lower abdomen, with rumbling.

Respiratory. — Pinching in middle of diaphragm, ex tending transversely through chest. Angina pectoris; pain around heart, left arm to fingers. ya

Extremities. — Cramps in hands and feet. Tearing in wrist. Paralytic weakness, especially right arm. Tearing in tips of fingers under nails. [Berb.] Itching erosion near tibia and back of feet near joints. Cold limbs.

Sleep. — Restless on account of voluptuous dreams. Sleepy in murmmg, a few hours after eating, Relationship. — Antidotes: Nur; Capsic.; Cate. Compare: datimon.; clrs.; Bellad.; Kreosot, Dose. — First to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Blatta Americana
remedies.text: (Cockroach) Ascites. Various forms of dropsy. Yellow complexion. Extreme weariness. Pain in urethra on urinating. Wearivess on going upstairs, Dose, — Sixth potency.

remedies.name: Blatya Urientalis
remedies.text:
(Indian Cockroach) A remedy for asthina, Cough with dysprara in bronchitis and phthists, Acts dest in stout and carpulent patients.

Dose. — Lowest putencies during an attack. After the spasm, for the remaining cough, use the higher.

remedies.name: Officinale
remedies.text:
(White Agaric) Quotidian intermittent fever. Sweat is light, and without relief. Night-sweat iv phthisis.

Head. — Feels light and hollow with deep frontal headache, Thick, yellow coating of tongue; teeth indented. Constant nausea.

Fever. — Chilliness along spine, with frequent, hotflashes. Yawns and stretches when chilly. Severe aching in shoulders and joints and small of back. Profuse perspiration at night, with hectic chills and fever. Skin, — Hot and dry. especially in palms. Itching more between scapule: and on forearms. Relationship, — Compare: 4garicin, active constituent of Polyporus officinale {phthisical and other enervating night-sweats 1-4 to 1-2 gr. doses}. Boletus luridus, (Violent pain in epigastrium, urticaria trbernsa.) Roletus satauus (dysentery).

Dose. — First attenuation.

remedies.name: Boricum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Boracic Acid) Pain in region of ureters, with frequent urging to urjnate. Colduess. [ffcloderm.] Diabetes, tongue dry, red, and cracked.

Skin. — Multiform erythema of trunk and upper extremities. (Edema around eyes. Exfoliating dermatitis, Female. — Climacteric flushings. [Lack.; Amy. nit.] Vagina cold, as if packed with ice. Frequent urination with burning and tenesmus.

Dose. — Third trituration. Non-Homeopathic

Uses. — When the diplococcus of Weichselbaum is present in the sputum of pharyngitis or bronchitis, pneumonia with tenacious sputum, hacking cough and pain, five-grain doses six times daily. A solution of Boracie Acid, as an injection, in chronic, cystitis, or. a teaspoonful to a glass of hot milk, taken internally. Boro-Glyceride in solution (1:40) is a powerful antiseptic. Styeys, 15 gr, to 1 oz. water externally.

remedies.name: Borax
remedies.text:
(Borate of Sodium) Gastro-intestinal irritation. Salivation, nausea, vomiting, colic, diarrhea, collapse, albuminuria, casts and vesical spasm, Delirium, visual changes, hematuria, and skin eruptions have all been observed from overdosing. Dread of duwnward motion in nearly all complaints. For homeopathic purposes, the peculiar nervous symptums are very characteristic, and have frequently been verified, especially in the therapeutics of children. Of much value in epilepsy. Aphthous ulceration of mucots membranes. Mind, — Extreme anxiety, especially from motions which have a downward direction, rocking, being carried downstairs, laid down Anxious expression of face during the downward motions, starts and throws up hands on laying patient down, as if afraid of falling. Excessively nervous, casily frigtcned. Sensitive to suddcu noises. Violent fright from report of a guu, even at a distance, Fear of thunder.

Head. — Aches, with nausea and trembling of whole body. Hair tangled at tips, cannot be separated, as in Plica Polonica. [Vinca min]

Eyes.— Lashes turn inward. Visions of bright waves. Eyelids inflamed, lids cut against eyeball. Entropium, Ears. — Very sensitive to slightest noise, not so much disturbed by louder ones.

Nose. — Red nose, of young women. Red and slining swelling, with throhbing and tensive sensation. Tip swollen and ulcerated Diy crusts, Face.—TYale, earthy, vith suffering expression. Swollen, with pimples on nose and lips. Feeling of cobwebs.

Mouth. — 4phthe, Mouth hot and tender; ulcers bleed on touch and eating. Painful gumbpil. Crying when nursing. Taste bitter. [Bry.; Puls; Cup.) Taste of “cellar mould.” Stomach and Abdomen, — Distention after eating; vomiting. Gastralgia, depending upon uterine disturbance. Pain as if diarrhoea would result.

Stool.— Loose, pappy, offensive stools in children. Diarrhea, offensive, preceded by colic; stools mucus, with aphthous sore mouth. Urine, — Hot, smarting pain in orifice. Pungent smell, Child afraid to urinate, screams before urinaling. [Sarsap.] Female. —Lahor pains with frequent eructations. GalectoPrhaa. [Cal.; Con.; Bell} In nursing, pain st opposite breast. Leucorrhoea like white of eggs, with sensation as if warm water was flowing. Menses too soon, profuse, with griping, nausea and pain in stomach extending into small of back. Membranous dysmenorrhaa. Sterility. Favors easy conception. Sensation of distention in clitoris with sticking.

Respiratory. — Hacking and violent cough; expectoration, mouldy taste and smell. Stitches in chest, with inspiration and cough. Cough with mouldy taste —breath smells mouldy, Pleurodynia; worse upper part of right chest, Arrest of breathing when lying; is obliged to jump up and. catch breath, which causes pain in right side. Out of breath on ‘going up stairs.

Extremities. — Feeling as of cobwebs on hands. Itching on back of finger-joints and hands. Throbbing pain in tip of thumb. Stitches in sole. Burning pain in great toe; inflammation of balls of toes. Eczema of toes and fingers with loss of nails, Skin. — Erysipelas in face. Itching on back of finger-joints. Unhealthy skin; slight injuries suppurate. Herpes, [Ahus.J Erysipelatous inflammation with swelling and tension. Chilblains relieved in open air. Trade eruptions on fingers and hands, itching and stinging, Ends of hair become tangled, Sleep. — Voluptuous dreams. Cannot sleep on account af heat, especially in head. Cries out of sleep as if frightened. [Beli]

Modalities. — [forse, downward motion, noise, smoking, warm weather, after menses. Better, presstire, evening, cold weather.

Relationship. — Acetic acid, vinegar, and wine are incompatible. Antidote: Cham.; Coffea. Compare: Cale.; Bryon.; Sanicula; Suiph, ac, Dose.— First to third trituration. in skin diseases continue its use for several weeks. A piece of borax, the size of a pea, dissolved in the mouth, acts magically in testoring the vaice in cases of sudden hoarseness brought on by cold, and frequently for an hour or so, it renders the voice silvery and clear. LANCIOLATUS {Yellow Viper) Broken-down, hemorrhagic constitutions; — septic states, Great lassitude and sluggishness; hamorrhages from every orifice of the body; black spots. Hemiplegia with aphasia. Inability to articulate, without any affection of the tongue. Nervous trembling. Pain iu right big toe. Diagonal course of symptoms, Pulmonary congestion, Eyes. —-Hemuralopia, day blindness, can hardly see her way after sunrise; conjunctivial hemorrhage, Face, — Swollen and puffy, Besotted expression.

Throat. — Red, dry, constricted; swallowing difficult, caunot pass liquids.

Stomach. — Epigastric distress. Black yomiting. Intense hamatemesis, Tympanitis and bloody stuols.

Skin. — Swollen, livid, cold with hemorrhagic infiltration. Gangrene. Lymphatics swollen. Anthrax. Malignant erysipelas.

Modalities. — Worse, right side. Relationship. —Compare: Torxicophis.. Moccasin Snake (pain and fever recur annually, after bite from this snake, aud sometimes change location with disappearance of first symptoms. An wuusual dryness ot skin follows the bite. CEdematous swellings and peri-~ odical neuralgia. Other snake poisons, notably Lachesis Trachinus—-Stingfish (intolerable pains, swelling, acute blood poisoning, gangrene.) .

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Bovista
remedies.text:
(Puff-Ball) Has a marked effect on the skin, producing eruption like eczema, also upon the circulation, predisposing to hemorrhages; marked Janguor and __lassitude. Adapted to stammering children, old maids with pal- Pitation, and “tettery” patients. Stage of numbness and tingling in multiple neuritis, Mind. — Enlarged sensation, (Arg. ».]) Awkward; everything falls from his hands. Sensitive.

Head. — Sensation as tf fead were enlarging, especially of occiput. Distensive headache; worse early morning, open air, lying. Discharge from nose stringy, tough, Dull, bruised pain in brain. Stammering. [Stram.; Merc.] Scalp itches; worse, warmth; sensitive; must scratch until sore, Face, — Scurf and crusts about nostrils and corners of mouth. Lips chapped. Bleeding of nose and gums. Cheeks and lips feel swollen. Acne worse in summer; due to use of cosmetics, Stomach. — Sensation as of a lump of ice. Intolerant of tight clothing around waist.

Female.— Diarrhoea before and during menses. Menses too early and profuse; worse at night. Voluptuous sensation. Leucorrheea acrid, thick, tough, greenish, follows menses. Cannot bear tight clothing areund waist [Lach.]. Traces of menses between menstruation, Soreness of pubes during menses, Abdomen. — Colic, with red urine; relieved by eating. Must bend double, Pain around umbilicus. Stitches through perineum towards rectum and genitals.

Stool.— Chronic diarrhcea of old people; worse at night and early morning. Diarrhea before and during menstruation. Extremities. -- Great weakness of ail joints; clumsiness with her hands, drops things from hands. Weariness of hands and feet. Sweat in axilla; onion smell. Tip of coccyx tiches intolerably. Moist eczema on back of hand. Itching of feet and legs, CEdema in joints after fracture.

Skin. — Blunt instruments leave deep impression on the skin, Urticaria on excitement, with rheumatic lameness, paipitation and diarrhaa. [Duic.] Itching on getting warm. Eczema, moist; formation of thick crusts. Pimples cover the entire body; scurvy; herpetic eruptions, Pruritus ani, Urticaria on waking in the morning, worse from bathing. Pellagra.

Relationship. — Bovista antidotes tar applications. Suffocation from gas. Aiter Rhus in chronic urticaria. Compare: Calc.; Rhus; Sepia; Cicuta.

Dose. — Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Brachyglottis
remedies.text:
(Puka-Puka) Fluttering sensction. Kidney and bladder symptoms predominate, Produces symptoms of albuminuria. Itching in ears and nostrils. Bright's disease. Oppression of chest. Writer's cramp.

Abdomen. — Feeling as if something ‘rolling about. Fluttering in region of ovary. Urinary. -- Pressure in neck of bladder; urging to urinate. Sense of swashing in bladder. Soreness in urethra; feeling as if urine could not be retained. Urine contains mucous corpuscles and epithelium, albumen and casts.

Extremities. — Cramp in fingers, thumb, and wrist when writing — soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris.

Relationship. — Compare: Apis; Helonias; Merc. cor.; Plumbum, Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Branca Ursina
remedies.text:
(Heracleum-Hogweed Headache, gouty and skin symptoms. Head, Aches with drowsiness; worse moving in open air, Seborrhea capitis.

Extremities. — Gouty tearing in limbs. Burning pain in feet.

Female. — Fluttering in right ovary and abdomen. Dysmenorrheea.

Relationship. — Compare: Berberis; Apis.

Dose. — Third attenuation.

remedies.name: Bromium
remedies.text:
(Bromine) Most marked effects are seen in the respiratory symptoms, especially in farynx and trachea. It seems to affect especially scrofulous children with enlarged glands. Rlond tvpe. Enlarged parotid and goitre. Tendency to spasmodic attacks, Lefi-sided mumps. Sense of suffocation; excoriating discharges. profuse sweats and great weakness. Complaints from being over-heated. Tendency to, infiltrate glands, become hard, but seldom suppurate, Mind. — Delusion that strange persons are looking over patient's shoulder and that she would see some one on turning.

Head. — Megrim of leit side; worse stooping, especially after drinking milk. Headache: worse heat of sun and by rapid motion. Sharp pain through eyes. Nose. —Coryza, with rnrrosive soreness of nose. Stoppage of rigtt nostril, Pressure at root of nose, Sickling, smarting, as from cobwebs. Fan-like motion of al. [Lyc.] Bleeding from nose relieving the chest. Throat. -— Throat feels raw, evening, with hoarseness. Tonsils pain on swallowing, deep red, with network of dilated blood vessels. Tickling in trachea during inspiration, Hoarseness coming on from being overheated. Stomach and

Abdomen.— Sharp burning from tongue to stomach, Pressure as of stone. Gastralgia; better eating. Tympanitic distention of abdomen. Painful hemorrhoids, with black stool. Respiratory. ~ Whooping cough. (Use persistently for about ten days.) Dry cough, with hoarseness and burning pain behind sternum. Spasmodic cough, with vatiling of mucus in the larynx; suffucative. Hoarseness. Croup after febrile symptoms have subsided. Difficult and painful breathing. Violent cramping of chest. Chest pains run upward. Cold sensation when inspiring. Every inspiration provokes cough. Laryngeal diphtheria; membrane begins in larynx and spreads upward. Spasmodic constriction. Asthma; better at sea, of seafaring men when they come on land, Hypertrophy of heart from gymnastics. [Rhws.]

Male. — Swelling of testicles. Indurated, with pains worse slight jar.

Female. — Swelling of ovaries. Meuses too carly; too profuse, with membranous shreds. Low spirited before menses. Tumor in breasts, with stitching pains; worse left. Stitch pains from breast to axille, Sharp shooting pain in left breast, worse pressure.

Sleep. — Full of dreams; jerking and starting during sleep, full of fantasy; trembling and weak on awaking.

Skin. — Acne, pimples and pustules, Boils on arms and face. Glands stony, hard, especially on lower jaw and throat. Hard goitre. [Spong.} Modalities. —- Worse, from evening, until midnight, and when sitting in warm room; warm damp weather. Better, from any motion; exercise; at sea. .

Relationship. — Antidotes: Amman. carb.; Camph. Salt inhibits the action of Brom. Compare: Contum; Spongie; Iod.; Aster.; Arg. nit. Avoid milk when taking Brom. Hydrobromic acid. (Throat dry and puckering; constriction in pharynx and chest; waves of heat over face and neck; tinnitus; vertigo, palpitation; arms heavy; seemed as if parts did not belong to him. Seems to have a specific effect on the inferior cervical ganglion, increasing the tonic action of the sympathetic, thiss promoting vaso-constriction. Relieves headache, tinnitus and vertigo, especiatly in vaso-motor stomach disturbance. Dose, 20 minims.) Dose. — First to third attennation. Must be prepared fresh, as it is liable to rapid deterioration.

remedies.name: Bryonia
remedies.text:
(Wild Hops) Acts on all serous membranes and the viscera they contain. The general character of the pain here produced is a@ stitching, tearing; worse by mation, better rest. These characteristic stitching pains, greatly aggravated by any stiotion, are found everywhere, but especially in the chest; worse pressure. Mucous membranes are oll dry. The Bryonia patient is irritable; has vertigo from raising the head, pressive headache ; firy, parched lips, mouth; excessive thirst, bitter taste, sensitive epigastrium, and feeling of a stone in the stomach; stools large, dry, hard; dry cough: rheumatic pains and swellings; dropsical effusions into synovial and serous membranes. Bryonia affects especially the constitution of a robust, firm fiber and dark complexion, with tendency to leanness and irritability, It prefers the right side, the evening, and open air, warm weather after’ cold days, to manitest its action most markedly. Children dislike to be carried or raised. Physical tecakness, all-pervading apathy. Complfaints apt to develop slowly.

Mind. — Exceedingly irritable; everything puts him out of humor. Delirium; wants tu go home; talks of business. - Head. — Vertigo, nausea, faintness on rising, confusion. Bursting, splitting headache, as if everything would be pressed out; worse from motion, stooping. opening eyes. Headache becomes seated in occiput. Drawing in bones towards zygoma. Headache; worse on motion, even of eyeballs, Nose. — Frequent bdlecding of nose when menses should appear. Coryza with shooting and aching in the forehead. Swelling of tip of nose, feels as if it would ulcerate when touched. Ears, -- Aura! vertigo. [ 4ur.; Nat. sal.; Sil; Chin.) Roaring, buzzing. Eyes, — Pressing, crushmg, aching pain. Glaucoma. Sore to touch and when moving them.

Mouth. — Lips parched, dry, cracked. Dryness of south, tonguc, and throat, with excessive thirst. Tongue coated yellowish, dark brown; heavily white in gastric derangement. Bitter taste. [Nux; Col] Burning in lower lip in old smokers. Lip swollen, dry, black and cracked, Throat ~~ Dryness, sticking on swallowing, scraped and constricted. [Beli.) Tough mucus in larynx and trachea, loosened only after much hawking; worse coming into warm room.

Stomach. — Nausea and faininess when rising “up. Abnormal hunger, Joss of taste, Thirst for large draughts. Vomiting of bile and water immediately after eating. Worse, warm drinks, which are vomited. Stomach sensitive to touch. Pressure in stomach after cating, as of a stone. Soreness in stomach when coughing. Dyspeptic ailments during summer heat. Sensitiveness of epigastrium to touch. Abdomen, — Liver region swollen, sore, tensive. Burning pain, stitches; worse, pressure, coughing, breathing. Tenderness of abdominal walls, Stool. — Constipation; stools hard, dry, as if burnt; seem too large. Stools brown, thick, bloody; worse tn morning, from moving, in hot weather, after being heated, from cold drinks, every spell of hot weather.

Urine. — Red. brown, like beer; scanty, hot.

Female. — Mcuses tao early, too profuse; worse from motion, with tearing pains in legs; suppressed, with vicarious discharge, or splitting headache. Stitching pains in ovaries on taking a deep inspiration; very setsitive to touch. Pain in right ovary as if torn, extending to thigh. ([Lilimm; Croc.) Milk fever. Pain in breasts at menstrual period. Breasts het and painful, hard. Abscess of mammz, Frequent bleeding of nose at appcarance of menses, Menstrual irregularities, with gastric symptoms. Ovaritis. Jntermenstrual pain, with great abdominal and pelvic soreness. [Ham.] + Respiratory.— Soreness in larynx and trachea. Hoarseness; worse in open air. Dry, hacking cougly frotn irritation in upper trachea, Cough, dry, at night; must sit up; worse after cating or drinking, with vomiting, ctth stiches in chest, and expectoration of rustcolored sputa. Frequent desire to take a long breath; must expand lungs, Difficult, quick respiration; worse every movement; caused hy stitches in chest. Cough, with feeling as if chest would fly to pieces; presses his head on sternum; must support chest. Croupous and pleuro-pneumonia. Expectoration brick shade, tough, and falls like jumps of jelly. Tough mucus in trachea, loosened only with much hawking. Coming isto warm room excites cough. [Nat. carb.] Heaviness beneath the sternum extending towards the right shoulder.

Back. — Painfulness stiffness in nape of neck. Stitches and stiffness in small of back, Extremities. — Knees stiff and painful. Hot swelling of feet. Joints red, swetlen, hot, with stitches and tearing; worse on least movement. Every spot is painful on pressure. Constant motion of left arm and leg. [Heilled.] .

Fever. — Easy, profuse perspiration, Rheumatic and typhoid marked by gastro-hepatic complications. Skin, — Yellow; pale, swollen, dropsical; het and painful. Seborrheea oleasa. Hair very greasy.

Sleep. — Drowsy; starting when falling asleep. Delirtam; busy with business matters and what he had read.

Fever. — Pulse full, hard, tense, and quick. Chill with external coldness, dry cough, stitches. Internal heat. Sour sweat after slight exertion. Relationship, --- Complementary: Upas when Bryonia fails. Rhus; Alumina, [lecebrum.— A Mexican drug. —-(Fever with catarrhal symptoms, gastric and typhoid fever symptoms.) Antidotes: Acon.; Cham; Nax. Compare: Asclep. tub.; Kali mur.; Ptelia, Modalities. — Worse, warmth, any motion, morning, eating, hot weather, exertion, touch. Cannot sit up; gets faint and sick. Better, lying on painful side, pressure, rest, cold things.

Dose. — First to twelfth attenuation.

remedies.name: Bufo
remedies.text:
(Poison of the Toad) Acts on the nervous system and skin. Arouses the lowest passions. Causes a desire for intoxicating drink, and produces impotence. Of use in feeble-minded children, Prematurely senile. Epileptic symptoms, more or less connected with derangements of the sexual sphere, seem to come within the range of this remedy. Injuries to fingers; pain runs in streaks up the arms. Mind, — Propensity to bite, Howling: impatient; nervous; imbecile. Desire for solitude, Feeble-minded.

Head. — Sensation as if hot vapor rose to top of head, Numbness of brain. Face bathed in sweat.

Eyes. — Cannot bear sight of brilliant objects. Little blisters form on eye. Ears. —~ Music is unbearable. [Ambra.] Every little noise distresses.

Heart. — Feels too large. Palpitation. Constriction about heart. Female, — Menses too early, watery leucorrhea. Excitement, with epileptic attacks, Epilepsy at time of menses. Induration in mammary glands. Palliative in cancer of the mammz. Burning in ovaries and uterus. Ulceration of cervix. Offensive bloody discharge. Pains run into legs. Bloody milk. Milk-leg. Veins swollen. Male, — Involuntary emissions; spotence, discharge too quick, spasms during coition. Buboes. Disposition to handJe organs. [Hyes.; Zinc.]

Skin.— Panaritum; pain runs “up erm. Patches of skin lose sensation. Pustules, suppuration from every slight injury, Pemphigus. Bullg which open and leave a raw surface, exuding an ichorous fluid. Blisters on palms and soles. Itching and burning. Carbuncle. Relationship, — Compare: Baryt, corb.; Astcrias; Salamend. (Epilepsy and softening of brain.) Antidotes: Laches.; Seneg. Complementary : Salamandra, Modalities. — Worse, in warm room, on awakening. Better, from bathing or cold air; from putting feet in hot water.

Dose. — Sixth potency and higher.

remedies.name: Butyric Acid
remedies.commonName: A volatile acid obtained chiefly from butter
remedies.text:
(A volatile acid obtained chiefly from butter) Head. — Worries over trifles; impulsive thoughts of suicide; constant state of fear and nervousness. Headache makes him apprehensive about trifles; worse going upstairs or rapid motion. Dull, hazy ache of head. Stomach, —- Poor appetite. Much gas in stomach and bowels, Cramps in pit of stomach, worse at night. Stomach feels heavy and overloaded. Cramp in abdomen below umbilicus. Bowels irregular. Stool accompanied by pain and straining.

Back. — Tired feeling and dull pain in small of back, worse walking. Pain in ankles and up back of leg. Pain low down in back and extremities.

Sleep. — Pronounced sleeplessness; dreams of serious nature while, asleep.

Skin. — Perspiration on slight exertion. Profuse, offensiwe sweat of feet, Crumbling away of finger-nails.

Modalities. — Worse, at night, fast walking, going upstairs. Dose. —- Third attenuation.

remedies.name: Cactus Grandiflorus
remedies.text:
CNight-blooming Cereus) Acts on circular muscular fibers, hence constrictions. It is the heart and arteries especially that at once respond to the influence of Cactus, producing very characteristic constrictions, as of an iron band. This sensation is found in various places, esophagus, bladder, etc. The mental symptoms produced correspond to those found when there are hearst affections, sadness, and melancholy. //Zemorrhage, constrictions, periodicity, and spasmodic pains. Whole body feels as if caged, each wire heing twisted tighter. Atheromatous asteries and weak heart. Congestions; irregular distribution of blood. Favors formation of clots speedily.

Mind. — Melancholy, taciturn, sad, ill-humored. Fear of death. Screams with pain.

Head. — Headache if obliged ta pass dmuer hour. [.4rs.; Lach.; Lyc.} Sensation as of a weight on verter. Right-sided pulsating pain. Congestive headaches, periodical, threatening apoplexy. Blood-vessels to the head distended. Feels as if head were compressed in a vise. Pulsation in ears. Dim sight. Righisided prosopalgia, constricting pains, returns at same hour daily. [Cedron.]

Nose. — Profuse bleeding from nose. Fluent coryza.

Throat.— Constriction of oesophagus. Dryness of tongue, as if burnt; needs much liquid to get food down. Suffocative constriction at throat, with full, throbbing carotids in angina pecteris. Stomach, — Consiriction, pulsation, or heaviness in stomach, Vomiting of blood.

Stool.— Hard, black stools. Diarrhea in morning. Hemorrhoids swollen and painful. Sensation of great weight in anus. Hemorrhage from bowels in malarial fevers and with heart symptoms, Urine. — Constriction of neck of bladder, causing retention of urine. Hamorrhage from bladder. Clots of blood in urethra. Constant urination.

Female. — Constriction in uterine region and ovaries. Dysmenorrhara; pulsating spain in uterus and ovaries. Vaginismus. Menses early, dark, pitch-like, [Cocc.; Mag. ¢.}; cease on lying down, with heart symptoms, Chest. — Oppressed breathing as from a weight on chest. Constriction in chest, as if bound, hindering respiration, Inflammation of diaphragm, Heart-coustriction, as from an iron band, Angina pectoris. Palpitation; pain shooting down left arm. Hzmoptysis, with convulsive, spasmodic cough. Diaphragmitis, with great difficulty of breathing. Heart. -- Endocarditis with mitral insufficiency together with violent and rapid action. Acts best in the incipiency of cardiac incompetence. Heart weakness of arteriosclerosis. Violent palpitation; worse lying on left side, at approach of menses. Angina pectoris, with suffocation, cold sweat, and ever-present iron-band feeling. Pain in apex, shooting down left arm. Palpitation, with vertigo, dyspnoea, flatulence. Constriction; very acute pains and stitches in heart; pulse feeble, irregular, Endocardial murmurs, excessive impulse, increased precordia! dullness, enlarged ventricle.

Extremities. — (Edema of hands and feet. Hands soft; feet enlarged. Numbness of left arm. Iey-cold hands. Restless legs.

Sleep. — Sleepless on account of pulsation in different parts of body. Frightful dreams.

Fever. — Fever every day at same hour. Coldness in back and icy-cold hands. Intermittent; paroxysms about midday (11 a.m.) incomplete in their stages, accompanied by hemorrhages. Coldness predominates; cold sweat, with great anguish.

Modalities. — Worse, lying on left side; walking, going upstairs, 11 am. and ll p.m. Better, open air, Relationship. — Antidotes: Acon.; Camph.; China, Compare: Digital.; Spigel.; Convallar.; Kalmia; Naja; Magnol.

Dose. — Tincture, to third attenuation. Higher in nervous palpitation,

remedies.name: Cadmium Sulph
remedies.text:
(Cadmic Sulphate) Its pathogenesis gives symptoms corresponding to very low forms of disease, as in cholera, yellow fever, where, with exhaustion, vomiting, and extreme prostra~ tion, the disease runs deathward. Important gastric symptoms, The attack is upon the stomach more especially. Patients must keep quiet. Cuhilliness and coldness even when near the fire, Mind and

Head. — Unconscious. Vertigo; room and ted seem to spin around. Hammering in head. Heat in head, .

Nose. — Osana. Tightness at root. Nose obstructed ; polypus, Caries of nasal benes. Boils on nose, Nostrils ulcerated.

Eyes. — Opacity of cornea. Blue circle around eyes. One pupit dilated. Night blindness. Face,— Distortion of mouth. Trembling of jaw. Facial paralysis; more left side.

Mouth. — Difficult swallowing. Csophagus constricted. [Bapi.] Salty belching. Intense nausea, with pain and cold. Stringy, offensive exudation on mucous membrane, Salty taste. Throat, — Sore throat, constant tickling; gagging and nausea, worse deep breathing; chilliness and aching.

Stomach. — Soreness in pit of stomach on pressure. Violent nausea; retching. Black vomit. Vomiting of mucus, green stime, blood, with great prostration, and fgttet fendcrness over the stomach. Burning and cutting pains in stomach, Carcinoma, helps the persistent vomiting. Coffee ground vomiting.

Abdomen. — Sore, tender, tympanitic. Region of liver sore. Coldness. Black, offensive clots of blood from bowels, Pain in abdomen, with vomiting. Tenderness and tympanites.

Stool.— Gelatinous stools. Bloody, black, and offensive. Gelatinous, yellowish green; semi-fluid, with urinary suppression. Urine.—-Rawness and soreness in urethra, urine mixed with pus and blood.

Heart. — Palpitation, with constriction of chest.

Fever. — icy coldness. [Camph.; Verat.; Heloderm.] Yellow fever. [Crotalus; Carbo.]

Skin. — Blue, yellow, sallow, scaly, cracking. Itching; better scratching. Chloasma, yellowish stains on nose and cheeks; worse exposure to sun and wind. Chitblains.

Sleep. — Stops breathing on going to sleep. Wakes up suffocating. Fears to go to sleep again. Protracted sleeplessness. Modalities, — }’orse, walking or carrying burdens; after sleep; from open air, stimulants. Better, eating and rest, Relationship, —- Compare: Cadmium oxide; Cad. brom. (pain and burning in stomach, and vomiting) ; Cadmium jodat. (Itching of anus and rectum felt during the day only; constipation, frequent desire, tenesmus, abdomen bloated) ; Zinc., Ars.; Carbo; Verat.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Cahinca
remedies.text:
(Brazilian Plant — Chiococca) This remedy has been found of use in dropsical affections. Its urinary symptoms are well marked. Albuminuria, with dyspnea on lying down at night. Ascites and anasarca, with dry skin.

Urinary.— Constant desire to urinate. Polyuria while traveling. Urine fiery. Burning pain in urethra, especially glandular portion, Mate, — Drawing in of testicles and spermatic cord. Pain worse during passage of pungent smelling urine.

Back. — Pain in region of kidneys; better lying bent backward. General fatigue.

Relationship. — Compare: Apocyn.; Ars.; Coffea (similar botanically and in relieving effects of fatigue}. Dose, — Third potency or lower,

remedies.name: Cajuputum (oleum Wittnebianum)
remedies.text:
(Cajuput Oil) Acts like Oil of Cloves. A remedy for jlatulence and affections of the tongue. Sense of enlargement. Causes copious diaphoresis. Retrocedent gout, Neuralgic affections not inflammatory. Nervous dyspnea. Head. —- Feels much enlarged. As if he could not get himself together. [Baptisia.] Mouth. -— Persistent sensation of choking. Spasmodic stricture of asophayus. Constricted sensation on swallowing solid food. Tongue feels swollen, fills whole mouth, Stomach—/ircough, on slightest provocation.

Abdomen. — Fiatulent colic; tympanites. [Tered.] Nervous distention of bowels. Urine smells like cat's urine. Spasmodic cholera.

Modalities. — Werse, about 5 a.M.; night, Relationship.—-Compare: Hovist.: Nux mosch.; Asaf.; Ign.: Bept. : Dose. — First to third potency. - (5 drops of oil.)

remedies.name: Caladium Seguinum
remedies.text:
(American Arum) This remedy has a marked action on the genital organs, and pruritus of this region. Coldness of single parts and inclination to lie down, with aggravation on lying on left side. Slightest noise startles from sleep. Dread from motion. Modifies craving for tobacco. Tobacco heart. Head, -- Headaches and mental states of smokers. Very forgetful, does not know about the occurrences of things, Confused headache with pain in shoulder, pressure in eyes and forehead; extremely sensitive to noise, throbbing in ear, Stomach. — Eructations. Stomach feels full of dry food; sensation of fluttering. Acrid vomiting, and tolerates only warm drinks. Sighing respiration.

Male. — Priuritus. Gilans very red. Organs seem larger, puffed, relaxed, cold, sweating; skin of scrotum thick. Erections when half-asleep; cease when fully awake. /ipotency;: relaxation of penis during excitement. No emission and no orgasm during embrace.

Female. — Prurttus of vulva [Ambr.; Kreos.) ana vagina during pregnancy. Voluptuousness. Cramp pains in uterus at night. Skin, — Sweet sweat—attracts flies. Insect bites burn and itch intensely, Itching rash alternates with asthma. Burning sensation and erysipelatous inflammation.

Respiratory. — Larynx seems constricted. Breathing impeded, Catarrhal asthma; mucus not readily raised. Patient afraid to go to sleep, Modalities. — Beticr, after sweat, after sleeping in daytime. Worse, motion.

Relationship. — Incompatible; Arum triph, Complementary: Nitr. ac. Compare: Capsic.; Phosph.; Caust.; Selen,; Lye. Ikshugandha (sexual weakness, emissions, prostatic enlargement).

Dose. — Third to sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Calarea Acetica
remedies.text:
(Acetate of Lime) Has had brilliant clinical results in inflammations of mucous membranes characterized by a membranous exudation; otherwise its action and application is like the carbonate. Cancer pains.

Head. — Vertigo in open air. Senses obscure while reading. Megrim, with great coldness in head and sour taste, Female.— Membranous dysmenorrliea [Borax]

Respiratory. — Rattling expiration, Cough foose, usth expectoration of large pieces like casts of bron- _chial tubes. Breathing difficult; better bending shoulders backward. Constrictive, anxious sensation in chest. Relationship, — Compare: Brom.; Borax; also Cale. oxal, (found as a constituent of cactus) in excruciating pains of open cancer.

Dose. — Third trituration. CALAREA ARSENICA (Arsenite of Lime) Epilepsy with rush of blood to the head before attack; aura felt in region of heart; flying sensation. Complaints in fat women around climacteric, Chronic malaria. Infantile enlarged liver and spleen. Nephritis, with great sensitiveness in kiduey region. Complaints of drunkards after abstaining. (Cerbon. sulph.] Fleshy women at climacteric, slightest emotion causing palpitation. Dyspneea, with feeble heart. Chilfiness. Albuniinuria. Dropsy. Affections of spleen and mesenteric glands. Hemoglobin and red corpuscles are low.

Mind. — Anger, anxiety. Desire for company. Confusion, delusions, illusions.

Head. — Vielent rush of blood to head with vertigo. Pain in head better by lying on painful side. Weekly headache. Benumbing headache mostly around ears.

Stomach. — Region of stomach distended. Enlarged liver and spleen in children. Pancreatic disease; relieves burning pain in cancer of pancreas.

Urinary. — Kidney region sensitive to pressure. Albuminuria, passes urine every hour. Heart. —Constriction and pain in region of heart, palpitation, oppression and throbbing.

Female. — Offensive, blondy leucorrheea. Cancer of uterus; burning pain in uterus and vagina.

Extremities. — Removes inflammatory products in veins of lower extremities. [A4pis.; Ars.]

Modalities. — Worse from slight exertion.

Dose. — Sixth trituration. (Carbonate of Lime) This great Hahnemannian anti-psoric is a constitutional remedy par excellence.
