Urinary. — Urging to urinate. Urine turbid, offensive, containing ropy or bloody mucus, and depositing a copious sediment, Burning and scalding during micturition, and straining afterwards. Afust strain before flow comes, Scanty urine. Acute prostatitis, retention, and feeling of a bait in perinenns. (Cann, ind.) Fluttering in region of kidney. Sugar in urine, [Caps.; Grindel.] Unable to urinate without standing with feet wide apart and body inclined forward. Female, — Labia inflamed, swollen. Pain in vagina. Hot flashes. Painful tumor of mamme, not ulcerated, with undue secretion af milk. Rapid atrophy of breasts. Women with very large breasts and tumor in the mamismary gland with sharp pain through it.

Male. — Smarting in urethra from neck of bladder to meatus, Glect. Loss of prostatie fluid. Prostatic enlargement and irritation.

Skin. — Sérofulous ulcers. Glandular enlargements. Extremities, — Feeling of a band above left knee. Modalities, -- !iorse, in damp weather; from sitting on cold stones or pavements; left side.

Relationship. — Compare: Chimaph. maculata (inteuse gnawing hunger: burning fever; sensation of swelling in arm pits); Uva.; Ledwm; Epigea.

Dose. — Tincture, to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Chininum Arsenicosum
remedies.text:
(Arsenite of Quinine) The symptoms of general weariness and prostration produced by the drug have been utilized in prescribing it homeeopathically as a general tonic, often with very marked beneficial and prompt effect. In diphtheria with great prostration, cases that are prolonged, especially, and in malarial affections, neuralgia, etc., it has been found curative Asthmatic attacks which recur periodically, with great prostration. Icy skin. Pressure in the solar plexus, with tender spine back of it. , Head. — Tired feeling. Head feels too full. Throbhing. Great anxiety. Great irritability. Vertigo; worse looking up. Dull, heavy headache, frontal and occipital. Darting pains running up into head.

Eyes. — Intense photophobia and orbicular spasm; rushing hot tears. Flickering with pain and lachrymation. Mouth, -— Tongue thickly furred; yellow, slimy cnating. Bitter taste. No appetite. .

Stomach. — Alternation of hyperacidity and decrease of acid. Hyperchlorhydria, [Robinia; Arg. wit.; Orexine tannate.) Thirst for water, yet it disturbs. daorexta, Eggs produce diarrhea.

Heart. — Palpitation, Sensation as if heart stopped. Suffocative attacks, occurring in periodical paroxysms. Must have open air.

Sleep. — Sleeplessness due to nervous causes. (Single dose of Sth or 6th potency.) Extremities, — Weak limbs. Coldness of hands and feet, knees and limbs, Tearing pains. . Fever.~~ Continuous, with weakness. System de- Pieted.

Relationship. — Compare: Chininum; also Ferro- Citricum (in nephritis with great anemia, Morbus maculosus Werlhoffii); Chinis. mur. (in severe neuralgic pains around eyes, with chills; exaggerated sensitiveness to alcohol and tobacco; prostration and restlessness}. CEnothera (effortless diarrhea with nervous exhaustion; incipient “hydrocephaloid). Macrozamia spiralis (extreme debility after illness; collapse). Dose, — Second and third trituration,

remedies.name: Chininum Sulphuricum
remedies.text:
(Sulphte of Quinine) A dose of Chinin. sulph. in high potency sometimes arouses suppressed malaria, and brings back the paroxysm. Aside from its undoubted influence over malaria, it is indicated homcopathically whenever there is marked periodicity and spinal sensitiveness. Acute articular rheumatism. Polyarticular gout. Symptoms of chronic interstitial nephritis, Blood. — An immediate and rapid decrease in red blood cells and reduction in hemoglobin with increase in elimination of chlorides. Tendency to polynucleated leucocytosis.

Head.— Pain in forehead and temples, increasing gradually at noon, of malarial origin, with vertigo and pulsation. Worse left side. Falling in street. Inability to remain standing. Amaurosis, Ears. — Violent ringing, buzzing, and roaring in ears, with deafness.

Face. — Neuralgia commences under eye; extends into and around it. Pains return with great regularity; relieved by pressure.

Spine. — Great sensitivencss of the dorsal vertebra; pain on pressure. Last cervical sensitive. Pain ex~- tends to head and neck.

Urine.— Bloody. Turbid, slimy, clay-colored, greasy sediment. Smal? amount of urea and phosphoric acid with excess of uric acid and abundance of chlorides, accompanied by subnormal temperature. Excessive flow. Albuminuria.

Skin. — Itching; erythema, urticaria, icterus, -vesication, pustules, purpura, Great sensitiveness. Shriveled skin.

Fever. — Painfu! swelling of various veins during a chill. Shivering even in a warm room. Anguish. Sweat with general shivering. Trembling in limbs, with slow pulse, Subnormal temperature, Relationship. -~- Compare: Chin, salicyl (Deafness, tinnitus, and Meniere's disease), 4rs.; Eupat.; Methyl, bluc. Camphor mono-bromide (is said to intensify the action of Quinine and render it more permanent.) Baja, an East Indian drug, (said to be almost infallible in intermittent fever, quartan type) ; also Pambotanc, Mexican remedy for intermittent and tropical fevers. Antidotes: Parthenum; Nair. mur.; Lach.; Arn.: Puis. Dose. —- First to third triturations; alse thirtieth potency and higher.

remedies.name: Chionanthus
remedies.text:
(Fringe-tree) This remedy is often of service in many types of headaches, neurasthenic, periodical sick, menstrual and bilious. Taken for several weeks, drop doses, will often break up the sick headache habit, The pain in the forehead, chiefly over eyes. Eyeballs very painful, with pressure over root of nose. Jaundice, Enlarged spleen. [Ceanoth,} Jaundice, with arrest of menses. A prominent liver remedy. Gallstones. (Berberis; Cholest.; Cale.) Diabetes mellitus. Paroxysmal, abdominal pain.

Head. — Listless, apathetic. Dull frontal headache, over root of nose, over eyes, through temples, worse stooping, motion, jar. Yellow conjunctiva.

Tongue. — Broad with thick yellow fur.

Mouth. — Dry sensation not relieved by water, also profuse saliva. Abdomen and

Liver. — Aching it umbilical region, Griping. Feels as if a string were tied in a “slip-knot” around intestines which was suddenly drawn tight and then gradually loosened. Sore; enlurged, with jaundice and constipation. Clay-colored stool, also soft, yellow and pasty. Tongue heavily coated. No appctite. Bilious colic. Hepatic region tender, Urine. -- Large amount of high specific gravity; frequent urination; bile and sugar in urine. Urine very dark, Skin. — Yellow; marked moisture of skin, Relationship, — Compare: Cinchona; Ceanoth.; Chelidon.; Carduus; Podophyl.; Lept.

Dose. — Tincture and first attenuation,

remedies.name: Chloralum
remedies.text:
(Chloral Hydrate) This drag, used in physiolegical doses, is a powerful hypnotic and cardiac depressant. Jt has a marked effect on the skin, producing erythema, eechymosis, etc., which symptoms have been utilized homeopathically with much success, especially in the treatment of hives. Emotional excitability, hallucinations. Night terrors im children, Head. — Morning headache; worse in forehead, on motion; better in open air. Fecling as if hot band were drawn from temple ta tempie.

Eyes. — Eyes biood-shot and watery. Circles of light, black spots. Dim vision. Conjunctivitis, burning in eye and lids; eyeball feels too large; everything looks white. Skin, — Red blotches, like measles. Urararia, worse, spirituous liquors, hot drinks. Erythema aggravated hy alcoholic drinks, with palpitation; causes pain in tendons and extensars, Intense itching. Surface af body «tone-cold. Wheals come on from a chill; better, warmth. Purpura. (PAoes.; Cretal.) Respiratory. — Extreme dyspnoea, with sensation of weight and constriction of chest. Asthma, with sleeplessness.

Steep. — Insomnia, hallucinations, horrid dreams.

Modalities. — [forse, after hot drinks, stimulants, cating, night.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Asmon.; Atrop.; Diy.; Mosch, Compare: Aecil.; Opium; Apis; Veronat (confluent, reddish spots; dermatitis, itching of glans and prepuce; circumscribed dermatitis patch on first metacarpal phalangeal joint).

Dose. — First trituration in hives, otherwise, higher potencies. Locally, in offensive foot-sweat, bathe with one per cent. solution. For its physiological effects, five to twenty grains, Use cautiously,

remedies.name: Chloroformum
remedies.text:
(Chloroform) General anzsthetic, antispasmodic. Complete muscular relaxation. Weak and quick pulse, shallow or stertorous breathing. Convulsions, nephritic or biliary colic, gastralgia.

Chloroform. — Symptoms obtained by Dr. D. Macfarlan with the 6th, potency : Great weakness, especially on right side. Limbs very tired from knees-down. Much perspiration all over face and chest; drowsy aud dizzy; dry lips and throat; dry tickling cough at night. Flatulence; food regurgitates; sore arid bruised feeling in stomach; catching pain around heart. Sharp pain in right chest when he takes Jong breath; shortness of breath on exertion.

Head. — Delirium where excitement and violence predominate, Head drawn down upon the shoulders, eyes opened and closed rapidly, pupils contracted; rapid convulsiye movements of face, of muscles, of extremities.

Dose. — Higher attenuations, or sixth. Phosphorus is the remedy to give in narcosis of chloroform.

remedies.name: Chlorum
remedies.text:
(Chlorine Gas in Water) The marked effect on the respiratory organs, producing spasm of the glottis, is the chief symptom of the drug. Asthma, to relieve the spasm of glottis. Useful externally and internally in gangrene.

Mind.— Fear of becoming crazy. Marked loss of memory, especially for names. __ Respiratory.— Sooty, smoky nostrils, [Heileb.) Coryza with sudden gushes of sharp, corroding fluid. Constriction, with suffocation. Spasm of the glottis. Irritation of epigidéttis, larynx, and bronchi. Loss of voice from damp air. Sudden dyspnea from spasm af the vocal cords, with staring protruding eyes, blue face, cold sweat, pulse small. /nspiration free, with obstructed expiration, {Mephit.] Livid face. Protonged, Joud, whistling rales. Extreme dryness of tongue. Dose,— Chlorine water, when required of full strength, must be freshly prepared. Fourth to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Cholesterinum
remedies.text:
(Cholesterine — The proximate principle. Furnished by the epithelium lining of gall bladder and the larger ducts} For cancer of the liver. Odbstinate hepatic engorgements. Bucning pain in side: on walking holds his hand on side, hurts him so. Opacities of the vitreous, Jaundice; galtstones. Cholesterine is the physiological opponent of Lecithin. Both seem to play some unknown part in the growth of tumors, Relationship, — Compare: Taurocholate of soda in

Homeeopathy.— Dr. I. P. Tessier, in an interesting study of the action of bile and its salts, in hepatic affections, analyzes a number of experiments by leading authorities, with the object of determining this action, and concludes that in the Taurocholate of Soda, homeeopathy has a useful remedy against certain forms of hypogiobular anamia. The claim that its pathogenesis and toxicology clearly indicate its value, and that it should also serve us as a temedy in cases of hypertrophy of the spleen and ganglia, He calls our attention to the fact, that it produces dyspnoza, the Cheyne- Stokes rhythm, acute pulmonary oedema, and intense exaggeration of the cardiac pulsations, offering a good field for clinical studies and experimentation of great interest, which may give fruitful and important results.

Dose. — Third trituration.

remedies.name: Chromicum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Chromic Acid) Diphtheria, post-nasal tumors, and epithelioma of the tongue have been benefited by this drug. Bloody, foulsmelling lochia. Symptoms come and go suddenly, and return periodically.

Nose.— Ulcer and scabs in nose, Offensive smell. Corrosive pain, Ozena. [4ur.]

Throat. — Diphtheria; sore throat. Tough mucus, with inclination to swallow it; worse, morning, causing hawking. Post-nasal tumors.

Extremities. — Uneasiness in limbs. Pain in shoulderblades and back of neck. Pain in knees and balls of feet, Stool. — Watery, frequent, copious, with nausea and vertigo. Hemorrhoids, internal and bleeding. Weak- Ness in small of back.

Relationship. — Compare: Kali bich.; Rhus; Chromium Sulphate (in locomoter ataxia, goitre, prostatic hypertrophy. Herpes preputialis. Wry neck. Also exophthmalic, inhibits the vagus, relieving tachycardia. Acts like a nerve tonic where there is lack of nervous tone, Fibrosd tumors. Infantile paralysis. Dose for adliiits, 3 to 5 grains after meals and at bedtime).

Dose. — Third to sixth trituration,

remedies.name: Chrysarobinum
remedies.text:
(Chrysophanic Acid) Used successfully in ringworm, sycosis, psoriasis, herpes tonsurans, and circinatus.— Acne rosacea, Eczema of lower extremities, with intense ttching; profuse and offensive discharge. Used externally, is a powerful stimulant and parasiticide in many skin affections, Alopecia.

Eyes. — Blepharitis, conjunctivitis, keratitis. Optical hyperasthesia.

Ears. — Fezematous, scabby condition. Whole ear and surrounding tissue appears to be oue scab.

Dose. — Locally, as a cerate, 4-8 grains ta the ounce, of vaseline. Internally. third to sixth potency,

remedies.name: Cicuta Virosa
remedies.text:
(Water Hemlock) The action on the nervaus system, producing spasmodic affections, viz., hiccough, trismus, tetanus, and convulsions, give the pathological picture calling especially for this remedy, whenever this is further characterized, by the more individual symptoms of the drug. Among these, are the bending of the head, neck, and spine backwards, and the general action of the patient is violent, with frightful distortions. Violent, strange desires, Sensation of internal chill, Moaning and howling. Does absurd things. Marked action on the skin.

Mind. — Delirium, with singing, dancing and funny gestures. Everything appears strange and terrible. Confounds present with the past; feels like a child. Stupid feeling. Melancholy, with indifference. Mistrustful.

Head. — Head turned or twisted to one side. Cercbrospinal meningitis. Cervical muscles contracted, Vertigo, with gastralgia, and muscular spasms. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Stares persistently at objects. Convulsions from concussion of brain, Thick, yellow scabs on head. Head symptoins relieved by emission of flatus.

Eyes.— When reading, lfetters disappear. Pupils dilaied, insensible strabismus. Objects recede, approach, and seem double, Eyes stare. Pupils get behind upper lids as head inclines. Effects of exposure to snow. Spasmodic affections of eyes and its appendages. Strabismus; periodic, spasmodic after a fall or a blow.

Ears. — Difficult hearing. Sudden detonations especially on swallowing. Haomerrhage frem cars. Face. -— Pustules which run together forming thick, yellow seals on face and head, corners of mouth and chin, with burning pain. Red facc. Trismus; disposition to grind teeth, Throat.— Dry. Feels as if grown together. Spasms of cesophagus; cannot swallow. Effects on cesophagus from swallowing sharp piece of bone. Stomach. -— Thirst; burning pressure; jriccough. Throbbing in pit of stomach, which has become raised to size of fist. Desire for unnatural things, lke coal. [Alnm.; Catc.] Indigestion, with insensibility, frothing at mouth.

Abdomen. — Distended and painful. Colic, with convulsions.

Rectum. — Diarrhea in morning, with irresistible defire to urinate, Itching in rectum.

Respiratory. — Chest feels tight; can hardly breathe. Tonic spasm in pectoral muscles, Heat in chest. Back and

Extremities. — Spasms and cramps in muscles of nape of neck, and spasmodic drawing backward of head. Curved limbs cannot be straightened nor straight ones bent. Back bent backward like an arch, Jerking, tearing in coccyx, especially during menses.

Skin. — Eczema; no itching; exudation forms into a hard, lemon-colored crust. Suppressed eruption causes brain disease. Elevated eruptions, as large as peas. Chronic impetigo, Modalities, — Worse, from touch, draughts, concussion, tobacca smoke. Relationship. -- Antidotes: Opium; Arn. Compare: Cicuta Maculata — Water Hemlock — (Effects very similar; the most prominent symptoms being: Falls unconscious, tetanic or clonic convulsions, Body covered with sweat. Consider in epilepsy and tetanus. Tincture and lower potencies.) Hydrocy, acid; Con.; GEnonth.; Sirychnia; Belted.

Dose. — Sixth to two hundredth attenuation. (Bedbug) Of use in intermittent fever, with weariness and inclination to stretch. Hamstrings feel too short. [Ammur.) Flexors mostly affected. Stretching.

Head. — Violent headache, caused by drinking. Great rage; vehement at beginning of chilly stage. Would like to tear everything to pieces. Pain under right frontal bone.

Female. — Shooting pain from vagina up towards left ovary. : Fever. — Chiiliness of whole body. Sensation as of wind blowing on knees, Pains in all foints, as tf fendons were too short, especially knee-joints. Chill; worse lying down. Thirst during apyrexia, but little during chitly stage; still Jess during hot stage, and none during sweating. Musty, offensive sweat.

Bowels. — Constipation, faces dry and in small balls [Op.; Plumb; Thuy.) and hard. Ulcer of rectum, Dose. — Sixth to two hundredth attenuation.

remedies.name: Mosa)
remedies.text:
(Black Snake-root) (Macrotys) Has a wide action upon the cerebrospinal and muscular system, as well as upon the uterus and ovaries. Tts muscular and crampy pains, primarily of neurotic origin, occurring im nearly every part cf the body, are characteristic. fgitation and pain indicate it. Pains like electric shocks here and there. Migraine. Symptoms referahic to the pelvic organs prominent. Mental. —- Sensation of a cloud enveloping her. Great depression, with dream of impending cvit. Fears riding in a closed carriage, of being obliged to jump out. Incessant talking. Visions of rats, mice; ete. Delirium tremens; trics to injure himself. Mania following disappearance of nenralgia.

Head. — Wild feeling in brain. Shooting and throhbing pains in head after mental worry, over-study, or reflex of uterine disease. faving sensation or opening and shutting sensation in brain. Brain feels tov large. Pressiny-outward pain. Tinnitus. Ears sensitive to: least noise. adres. — Asthenopia associated with pelvic trouble. Deep-seated throbhing and sheoting pains in eyes, with photophobia from artificial light. Intense aching of eyeball, Pain from eyes to top of head.

Stomach. — Nausea and vomiting caused by pressure on spine and cervical region. Sinking in epigastrium. [Sep.; Sufph.] Gnawing pain, Female, — Pain in ovarian region; shoots upward and down anterior surface of thighs. Pain immediately before menses Menses profuse, dark, coagulated, ottensive with backache, neryousness; always irregular. Ovarian neuralgia. Pain across pelvis, from hip to hip. After-pains, with great sensitiveness and intolerance to pain. Infra-mammary pains worse, left side, Facial blemishes in young women, Respiratory. — Tickling in throat. Dry, short cough, worse speaking and at night.

Heart. — Irregular, trembling pulse. Tremulous action. Angina pectoris. Numbness of left arm; feels as if bound to side. Heart’s action ceases suddenly, impending suffocation. Left-sided infra-mammary pam.

Back. — Spine very sensitive, especially upper part. stiffness and contraction in neck and back, Intercosta! rheumatism. Rheumatic pains in muscles of back and neck. Pain in lumbar and sacral region, dawn thighs, and through hips. Crick in hack.

Extremities. — Uneasy, restless feeling in limbs, Aching in limbs and muscular soreness, Rheumatism affecting the belly of muscles, especially large muscles. Choreic movements, accompanied by rheumatism, Jerking of limbs. Stiffness in tendo-Achilles, Heaviness in lower extremities.

Sleep. — Sleeptessness. Brain irritation of children during dentition.

Skin. — Locally and internalty for ivy poisoning.

Modalities. — Worse, during menses; the more profuse the flow, the greater the suffering, Better, warmth, eating.

Relationship. — Compare: Rhamnus Californica (muscular pains, lumbago, pleurodynia, acute rheumatism). Derris pinata (Neuralgic headaches of rheumatic origin). Aristolochia milkomens (pain in tendo- Achilles; diabetes). Caulophyl.; Pulsat.; Lilium, Agar.; Macrotin (especiatly for lumbago).

Dose. — Tincture, to thirtieth attenuation; third most frequently used.

remedies.name: Cina
remedies.text:
(Worm-seed) This is a children’s remedy, corresponding to many conditions that may be referred to intestinal irritation, such as worms and accompanying complaints. An irrita bility of temper, variable appetite, grinding of teeth, and even convulsions, with screams and violent jerkings of the hands and feet, are alf within its range of action. The Cina patient is hungry, cross, ugly, and wants to be rocked. Pain in shocks, Skin sensitive to touch. Mind. —Ill-humor, Child very cross; does not want to be touched, or crossed, or carried. Desires many things, but rejects everything offered. Abnormal consciousness, as if having committed some evil deed.

Head. — Headache, alternating with pain in abdomen. Relieved by stooping. [Afezer.] Pain in head when using eyes, Eyes. -— Dilated pupils; yellow vision. Weak sight from masturbation. Strabismus from abdominal irritation. Eyestrain, especially when presbyopia sets in. Pulsation of superciliary muscle.

Sars. — Digging and scratching in ears, Nose. — Itching of nose all the time. Wants to rub it and pick at it. Bores at nose till it bleeds. Face, — Intense, circumscribed redness of cheeks. Pale, hot, with dark rings around eyes. Cold perspiration. White and bluish about the mouth. Grits teeth during steep. Choreic movements of face and hands.

Stomach. — Gets hungry soon after a meal. Hungry, digging, gnawing sensation. LEpigastric pain; worse, first waking in morning and before meals, Vomiting and diarrhora immediately after eating or drinking. Vomiting with a clean tongue, Desires many and different things. Craving for sweets.

Abdomen. — Twisting pain about navel. ([Spig.] Bloated and hard abdomen, Stool, — White mucus, like smal! pieces of popped corn, preceded by pinching colic. Itching of anus. [Teuc.] Worms, [Sabad.; Naphth.; Nat. phos.) Urinr. — Turbid, white; turns milky on standing. Inyoluntary at night. Female, —- Uterine hemorrhage before puberty.

Respiratory.— Gagging cough in the morning. Whooping-cough. Violent recurring paroxysms, as of down in throat. Cough ends in a spasm. Cough so viotent as to bring tears and sternal pains; feels as if something had been torn off. Periodic; returning spring and fall. Swallows after coughing. Gurgling from throat to stomach after coughing. Child is afraid to speak or move for fear of bringing on paroxysm of coughing. After coughing, moaning, anxious, gasps for air and turns pale.

Extremities. — Twitching and jerking distortion of limbs, trembling. Paralyzed shocks; patient will jump suddenly, as though in pain, Child throws arms from side to side, Norturnal convulsions. Sudden inward ferking of fingers of right hand. Child stretches out fect spasmodically. Left foot in constant spasmodic motion.

Sleep. — Child gets on hands and knees in sleep; on abdomen. Night terrors of children; cries out, screams, wakes frightened. Troubics while yawning. Screams and talks in sleep. Grits teeth, Fever.— Light chill. Much fever, associated with clean tongue. Much hunger; colicky pains; chilliness, with thirst. Cold sweat on forehead, nose, and hands. In Cina fever, face is cold and hands warm. Modalities, —IW’orse, looking fixedly at an object, from worms, at night, in sun, in summer, Relationship. — Compare: Helnintochortos — Wormmoss (acts very powerfully on intestinal worms, especially the lumbricoid.) Teseritm; Ignat; Cham; Spig. Santonin (often preferable in worm affections; same symptoms as Cina. Lightning pains of locomotor ataxia (1 gr. doses, also im iaryngeal crises of tabes). Antidote: Cumph.; Caps, Dose, — First to third attenuation. For nervous irritable children, thirticth and two-hundredth preferable. Santonin iu first (with care) and third trituration.

remedies.name: Cinchona Officinalis
remedies.text:
(Peruvian Bark — China) Nebility from exhausting discharges, from loss of vital fluids, together with a nervous erethism, calls for this remedy, Periodicity is most marked. Sensitive to draughts Seldom indicated in the earlier stages of acute disease, Chronic gout. Chronic suppurative pye- Ws. despetidiny Iden indifferent, disobedient, taciturn, Ideas crowd in mind; prevent sleep. Disposition to hurt other people's feelings. Sudden crying and tossing about.

Head. — As if skull would burst. Sensation as if brain were balancing to and fro, and striking against skull, receiving great pain. ([Sulph.; Suiph, ac.] Intense throbbing of head and carotids. Spasmodic headache in vertex, with subsequent pain, as if bruised in sides of head. Face flushed after hamorrhages, or sexual excesses, or loss of vital fluids. Relieved from pressure and warm room. Scalp sensitive; worse combing hair. Aches worse in open air, from temple to temple. Worse hy contact. current of air, stepping. Dizzy when walking. Eyes, -- Blue color around eyes. Hollow eyes, Yel- Jowish selerotica. Black specks, bright dazzling illusions; night blindness in anamic retina. Spots before eyes. Photopholia. Distortion of eyeballs. Intermittent ciliary neuralgia. Pressure in eves, Amaurosis; scalding lachrymation, Ears. — Ringing in ears. External ear sensitive to touch, Hearing sensitive to noise, Lobules red and swollen.

Nose. — Checked catarrh. Easily bleeding from nose, especially on rising. Coryza, sneezing, watery discharge. Violent dry sneezing. Cold sweat about nose.

Face. — Sallow complexion. Face bloated; red.

Mouth. — Toothache ;.better pressing teeth firmly together, and by warmth. Tongue coated thick, dirty; tip burns, succeeded by ptyalism. Bitter taste. Food tasles too salty.

Stomach. — Tender, cold. Vomiting of undigested food. Slow digestion. Weight after eating. Ill effects of tea. Hungry without appetite. Fiat taste. Darting pain crosswise in hypogastric region. Milk disagrees. Hungry longing for food, which lies undigested. Floiulency; belching gives no relief ; worse eating fruit. Abdomen,— Much flatulent colic; better bending double, Tynpanitic abdomen, Pain in right hypechondrium, Gallstone colic. (Triumfetta semitriloba,} Liver and spleen swollen and enlarged. Jaundice. Internal coldness of stomach and abdomen. Gastro-duodenal catarrh.

Stool. — Undigested, frothy, yellow; painiess; worse at night, after meals, during hot weather, from frit, milk, beer. Very weakening, with much flatulence. Difficult even when soit. [Alum.; Piat.]

Male. — Excited lascivious fancy. Frequent emissions, followed hy great weakness. Orchitis, Female. — Menses tuo early, Dark clots and abdominal distention. Profuse menses with pain. Desire too strong. Bloody leucorrhrea. Painful heaviness in pelvis.

Respiratory. — Influenza, with debility. Cannot breathe with head low. Labored, slow respiration; con~- stant cheking. Suffocative catarrh; rattling in chest; vio-~ lent, hacking cough afier evtry meal. Hzmorrhage from lungs. Dyspnea, sharp pain in left lung. [Millefol.; Ferr.. phos.) Back. — Sharp pains across kidneys, worse movement and at night. Knife-like pains arcund back. (D. Mac- Farlan.) Extremities. — Pains tn limbs and joints, as if sprained; worse, slight touch; hard pressure relieves. Joints swollen; very sensitive, with dread of open air. Great debility, trembling, with numb sensation. Averse to exercee; sensitive to touch. Weariness of joints; worse, mornings and when sitting. Skin. -—- xtreme sensiliveness to toch, but hard pressure rcelicves. Coldness; much sweat. One hand icy cold, the other warm. Anasarca. [Ars.; Apis] Dermatitis; erysipelas. Indurated glands; scrofulous ulcers and caries, Sleep. —- Drowsiness. Unrefreshing or constant stupor, Wakens early. Protracted sleeplessness, Anxious, frightfnl dreams with confused consciousness on waking, so that the dream cannot be rid of and fear of dream remains. Snoring, especially with children, Fever. —- Intermittent, paroxysms anticipate; return every week, All stages well marked. Every little exertion causes free perspiration, Chill generally in forenoon, commencing in breast; thirst before chill, and little and often. Debilitating night-sweats.

Modalities. — Worse, slightest touch. [Plume ; Caps.], Draught of air; every other day; loss of vital fluids; at night; after eating; bending over. Better, bending double; hard pressure; open air; better warmth, Relationship. —- Antidotes; Arn.; Ars.; Nux; Ipec. Compare: Cephatonthus— Button Bush — Intermittent fever, sore throat, rheumatic symptoms, vivid dreams). <Ars.; Cedron; Nat, sulph, Cydonia vulgaris — Quince (supposed to be of use to strengthen the sexual organs and stomach), Complementary: Ferrum,; Calc. phos.

Dose. — Tincture, to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Cineraria
remedies.text: (Dusty Miller) Has some reputation in the cure of cataract and corneal opacities. Is used externally, by instilling into the eye one drop four or five times a day. This must be kept up for several months. Most effective in traumatic cases, Compare in cataract Phosph.; Platanus; Cannabis; Causticum; Naphthalin; Ledum; Nat, mur.; Silica,

remedies.name: Ruber
remedies.text:
(Mercuric Sulphide) For certain forms of ciliary neuralgia and ulceration upon a syphilitic base, this remedy is most effective.

Head. — Congestion to head; face purple red.

Eyes.— Pains from lachrymal duct around cye to temple, from inner canihus across brows to ear. Se vere shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running from inncr to owter canthus in the bonc, Redness of whole eye. Lids granulated; canthi and lids red.

Nose. — Pressive sensation, as from heavy spectacles, Pain about ront, extending into benes on each side. [Aur.; Kal. hyd] Throat,— Stringy mucus passed through posterior nares into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat; must tinse the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and throat.

Male. — Prepuce swollen; warts on it which bleed easily; testicles enlarged; buboes; angry-looking chancres, Syphilides, squamous and vesicular, Female.-—Leucorrheea. Feeling of pressure in vagina.

Extremities. — Pain in forearm from efbow down, including hands. Pain in long bones when harometer lowers; coldness of joints.

Skin. — Very fiery-red looking ulcers. Nodes on shinbones, Buboes. Condyloma, easity bleeding.

Modalities. — Morse, lying on right side (feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side), Relationship. — Compare: Hepar; Nitr. ac.; Thuja; Sep. Antidotes: Hepar; Sulph.

Dose. — First to third trituration.

remedies.name: Cinnamonum
remedies.text:
(Cinnamon) Cancer where pain and fetor are present. Best wheu skin is intact. Its use in hamorrhages has abundant clinical verification. Nosebleed. Hamorrhages from lowels; hemoptysis, ete. A strain in loins or false step brings on a profuse flaw of bright blood. Postpartum hemorrhage. Flatalencs and diarrhea. Feeble patients with languid circulation. Female, —- Bearing-down sensation. Menses carly, profuse, prolonged, bright red. Sleepy, No desire for anything, Fingers seem swollen. Uterine haemorrhages caused by overlifting, during puerperal state; menorrhagia.

Relationship. — Compare: Jpec.; Sil.; Trill, Antidote; Acon. .

Dose. — Tincture to third potency. For cancer, strong decoction, one-half pint in a day. Oi! of cinnamon in aqueous solution best local disinfectant. 3-4 drops in two quarts of water as a douche, wherever a germicide and disinfectant is needed. Three drops on sugar for hiccough.

remedies.name: Cistus Canadensis
remedies.text:
(Rock Rose) A deep-acting anti-psoric remedy, with marked action in glandular affections, herpetic eruptions, chronic swellings, when patient is extremely sensitive to cold. Sensation of coldness in various parts, Scrofulous ophthalmia. Poisoned wounds, bites, phagedenic ulcers. Malignant disease of the glands of the neck. Cistus has affinity for naso-pharynx; aborts colds that center in posterior nose. Sniffling. Face, — Itching, burning, and crusts on right zygoma. Lupus, caries; open, bleeding cancer, Tip of nose painful, Mouth. — Scorbutic swollen gums. Mouth fecls cold; putrid, impure breath. Pyorrhaa. {Merc. cor.; Caust.; Stoph.; Kreos.]) Hurts co protrude the tongue.

Ears.— Watery discharge; also fetid pus. Tetter on and around ears, extending to external meatus, Throat. — Spongy feeling; very dry and cold air passing over parts causes pain. Breath, tongue, and throat fel cold. Uvula and tonsils swollen. A small, dry spot in throat; must sip water frequently. Hawking of mucus. Swelling and suppuration of glands of throat. Head drawn to one side by swellings in meck. Sore throat from inhaling the least cold air. Heat and itching in throat. somach, — Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Cool feeling in whole abdomen. Desire for cheese, Stool. — Diarrhea from coffee and fruit, thin, yellow, urgent; worse in snorning. Chest.—-Coldness in chest. The neck is studded with tumors. Induration of mamme. Hemorrhage from lungs.

Extremities. — Sprained pain in wrist. Tips of fingers sensitive to cold. Tetter on hands. Cold fect. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs, with hard swelling around. White swelling, Sleep. — Cannot sleep from coldness in throat, Female. — Induration aud inflammation of mamme. Sensitive to cold air, Bad smelling leucorrhaea, Respiratory. — Asthmatic after lying down (trachea feels narrow), preceded by formication, Skin. — Itching all over. Small, painful pimples: lupus. Glands inflamed and indurated. Mercurio-syphilitic ulcers, Skin of hands hard, thick, dry, fissured; deep cracks. Itching of swollen bands and asins; general itching which prevents steep. Hemicrania, Modalities. — Worsc, slightest exposure to cold air. Better aiter eating.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Ahus; Sepia. Compare; Conium: Carbo; Calc; Arg. n.

Dose. — First to thirtieth attenuation. Locally as a wash to arrest fetid discharges.

remedies.name: Citrus Vulgaris
remedies.text:
(Bitter Orange) Headache with nausea, vomiting and vertigo. Facial neuralgias mostly right-sided. Thoracic oppression. Frequent and irresistible yawnings. Disturbed sleep.

Relationship. — Citrus decumona — Grape-fruit. (Tinnitus, head noises and ringing in ears. Sensation of pressure in the temporal region.) Aurantium-Orange {neuralgic and skin symptoms itching, redness and swelling of hands. Diseases of the aged with coldness and chilliness). Compare: Ciirus Limonum (scorbutus, sore throat and cancer pains; checks excessive menstruation).

remedies.name: Clematis Erecta
remedies.text:
(Virgin’s Bower) Scrofulous, rheumatic, gonorrhaal, and syphilite patients. Acts especially on skin, glands and genitourinary organs, especially testicles. A remedy of much importance in disturbances of sleep, and neuralgic pains in various parts. Muscles relaxed or twitching. Great emaciation. Acts promptly on urethra and genitals. Great sleepiness, Distant pulsation in whole body.

Head.— Boring pain in temples. Confused feeling. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular, sensitive, itching.

Eyes. — Heat in eyes and sensitive to air. Flickering before eyes. Pustular conjunctivitis, with tinea capitis; eyes inflamed and protruding.

Face. — White blisters on face and nose, as if burned by sun. Swelling of submaxillary glands, with hard tubercles; throbbing, aggravated on being touched. Pain in right side of face to eye, ear and temple; better, holding cold water in mouth.

Teeth. — Ache; worse, at night and from tobacco. Teeth feel too long. . Stomach. ~ After eating, weakness in all limbs and pulsation in arteries.

Male. — [lio-scrotat neuralgia. Testicles indurated {Kali ¢.; Spongia; Copaiva; Plumb.j, with brutsed feeling. Swelling of scrotum. (Ars.; Puils.; Canth.; fgn.; Brom; Rhus.) Right half only, Troubles from suppressed gonorrhoea. Violent erections with stitches in urethra. Testicles hang heavy or retracted, with pain along spermatic cord; worse, right side. [Atrsm ;~ Arg. ».; Nitr. ac.} Urinary. — Tingling in urethra lasting some time after urinating. Frequent, scanty urination; burning at orifice. Interrupted flow. Urethra feels constricted. Urine emitted drop by drop. Inability to pass all the urine; dribbling after urinating.

Skin. — Red, burning, vesicular, scaly, scabby. Itches terribly; worse, washing in cold water; worse face and hands and scalp around occiput. Glands hot, painful, swollen, Modalities. — Beticr, in open air. WWerse, at night, and warmth of bed (washing in colt water; new moon — (monthly aggravation).

Relationship. — Compare: Clematis vitalba (varicose and other ulcers}; Sil.; Staph.; Petrol; Oleand.; Sarsap.; Cants.; Phos. ac. Antidotes: Bryon.; Camph., Dose, — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Cobaltum
remedies.text:
(The Metal Cobalt) Adapted to neurasthenic spinal states. Sexual disturbances. Fatigue, agitation, and bone pains, worse in morning, Mind, — All mental excitement increases suffering. Constant interchange of mental moods. Head. -- Aches; worse, bending head forward. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.

Teeth. — Feel too tong. Pain in teeth. Cracks across tongue. Coated white. [Ant cr.} Abdomen. — Shooting in liver. Pain in spleen. Rectum, — Constant dropping of blood from the anus, no blood from the stools. Male, — Pain in right testicle; better, urinating. Emissions without erection. Impotence. Backache in lumbar region and weak legs. Lewd dreams. Pain in end of urethra; greenish discharge; brown spots on genitals and abdomen.

Back. — Pain in back and sacrum; worse while sitting; hetter, walking or lying. Weakness in legs and backache after emissions, Extremities, — Aching in wrist-joints, Shooting into thighs from liver, [V¥ecak knees, Trembling in limbs. Tingling in feet. Foot-sweat, mostly between toes.

Sleep. — Unrefreshing; disturbed by lewd dreams. Skin, — Dry and pimply. Pimples about nates, chin, hairy sealp.

Relationship.— Cumpare: Cusnab. Ind., Sepia; Zuie.; Agnus; Selon.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth pote y, (The Divine Plant of the Incas} The mountaineer’s remedy. Useful in a variety of complaints incidental to mountain climbing, such as palpitation, dyspnea, anxiety and insomnia. Exhausted nervous system from physical and mental strain. Caries oi teeth. Loss of veicc,— Give 5-0 drops, every half hour, two hours hefore expected demand on yoice. Nocturna] enuresis.

Mind. — Melancholy; bashful. ill ac ease in society, irritable, delights in solitude and obscurity. Sense of | right and wrong abolished.

Head.— Fainting fit from climbing mountains. ‘Bhbeks coming from occiput with vertigo, Noises in cay. Headache with vertigo, preceded by flashes of light. Like a band across forehead. Diplopia, Tongue furred. Headaches of high aititudes. Tinnitus, Stomach.— Peppery sensation in mouth. Longing for alcoholic liquors and tobacco. Great satiety for a Iong time. Incarcerated flatus; rises with noise and violence, as if it would split the oesophagus. Tympanitic distention of abdomen, No appetite but for sweets. Heart. —- Palpitation, with weak heart and dyspnoea, Male. — Diabetes, with impotency. [Phos, ac.]

Respiratory. — Hawking of small, transparent pieces of mucus, Weak vocal cords. Hoarseness; worse after talking. [Want of breath, short breath, especially in aged athletes, and alcoholic users. Hamoptysis. Asthma, spasmodic variety.

Sleep.— Can find no rest anywhere, but sleepy. Nervousness and nightly restlessness during tecthing.

Modalities. — Better, from wine; riding, quick motion in open air. Worse, ascending, high altitudes. Relationship. Compare: Ars.; Paulin.; Cyp.; Chamom. Antidote: Gels.

Dose. — Tincture to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Cocaina
remedies.text:
(An Alkaloid from Erythroxyion Coca) Besides the great useftlness af Cocaine as a local anzsthetic, it has specific hommopathic uses, though the symptoms are mainly clinical only. Sensation as if small foreign bodies or worms were under the skin. Mind. -- Talkative. Constant desire ta do something great, to undertake vast feats of strength, Cerebral activity. Frightful persecutory hallucinations; sees and feels bugs and worms. Moral sense blunted. Personal appearance neglected. Thinks he hears unpleasant remarks about himself. Hallucinations of hearing. Head,—- Throbbing and bursting sensation. Puptls dilated, Hearing greatly increased. Roaring and noises in head, Eyes. — Glaucoma, increased tension, decreased corneal sensibility. Eyes staring, expressionless.

Throat. — Dry, burning, tickling, constricted, paralysis of muscles of deglutitian. Speech difficult, Stomach, — Loss of appetite for solid food. Likes sweets, Hamorrhages from bowels, stomach.

Nervous System. — Chorea; paralysis agitans; afcoholic tremors and senile trembling. Local sensory paralysis, Formication and numbness in hands and forearms. Sleep. —- Restless, cannot sleep for hours after retiring. Fever, —Coldness with intense pallor.

Relationship. — Compare: Stovain (an analgesic, a vaso-motor dilator), Dose. — Lower potencies. As a local application to mucous membranes, 2-4%.

remedies.name: Coccinella Septempunctata
remedies.text:
(Lady Bug) _ This remedy ought ta be remembered in neuralgias, teeth, gums. mouth, etc. Is awakened by profuse accumulation of saliva. Uvula feels too long [Nur]. Symptoms of hydrophobia; worse, by any bright obitt. [Canth.] Head, — Pain in forehead over right eye, sensitive to touch; from superior molars to forehead. Aching in temples and occiput. Rush of blood to face. Throbbing toothache. Cold sensation in tecth and mouth, [Cistus.] Periodical attacks of frontal neuralgia, Cannot open eyes during paroxysm. Pain worse from any bright object; better, sleep.

Stomach. — Hiccough and burning in stomach. Back, — Pain in region of kidneys and loins. Icy cold extremities, Relationship. — Compare: Canth.; Magn. ¢.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Cocculus
remedies.text:
(Indian Cockle) Within the sphere of action of Cocculus are many spasmodic and paretic affections, notably those affecting one-half of the body. Affects the cerebrum, will not cure convulsive seizures proceeding from the spinal cord, (A, E. Hinsdale.) Painful contracture of limbs and trunk; tetanus, Many of the evil effects of nightwatching are relieved by it. it shows a special attraction for light-haired females, especially during preg- Naucy, causing much nausea and backache. Unmarried and childless women, sensitive and romantic girls, etc, All its symptoms are worse riding in a carriage or on shipboard; hence its use in seasickness. Sensation of hollowness, or emptiness, as if parts had gone to sleep. Feels too weak to talk toudly, Mind, — Capricious. Heavy and stupid. Time passes too quickly; absorbed in reveries. Inclination to sing irresistible. Slow of comprehension, Mind benumbed. Profound sadness, Catinot bear contradiction. Speaks hastily. Very anxious about the health of others. 254 cOccULUS Head. — Vertigo, nausea, especially when riding or sitting up. Sense of emptiness in head. Headache tx occiput and nape; worse, lying on back of head. Sick headache from carriage-riding, cannot lic om back part of head. Pupils contracted. Opening and shutting sensation, especially in ocviput. Trembling of head. Pain in eyes as if torn out of head.

Face. — Paralysis of facial nerve. Cramp-like pain in masseter muscle; worse, opening mouth. Prosopalgia in afiernoon, with wide radiations of pain. Stomach, —- Nausea from riding in cars, boat, etc., or looking at boat in motion; worse on becoming cold or taking cold. Ngusea, with faintness and vomiting. Aversion to food, drink, tobacco. Metallic taste. Paralysis of muscles preventing deglutition. Dryness of cesophagus. Seasickness, Cramp, in stomach during and after meal. Tlinuugh and spasmodic yawning. Loss of appetite. Desire for cold drinks, especiaily beer. Sensation in stomach as if one had been a long time without food until hunger was gone. Simell of food disgusts. [Cotch.} . Abdomen, — Distended, with wind, and feeling as tf full of sharp stoncs when moving; better, lying on one side or the other. Pain in abdominal ring, as if something were forced through. Abdominal muscles weak; it seems as if a hernia would take place.

Female. — Dysmenorrheea, with profuse dark menses Too early menses, clotted, with spasmodic colic. Painful pressing in uterine region, followed by hamorrhoids. Porulent, gushing leucorrheea between menses; very - weakening, can scarcely speak. So weak during men- ‘atriuition, scaicely able to stand. COccULUS 255 Respiratory. — Sensation of emptiness and cramp in chest, Iyspncea as from constriction of trachea, as if irritated hy smoke. Choking constriction in upper part of esophagus, oppressing breathing and inducing cough, Back, — Cracking of cervical vertebre when moving head. Paralytic pain in small of the back. Pain om shoulder and arms as if bruised, Pressure in scapula and tiape. Stiffness on moving shoulders. Extremities, —-Lameness; worse by bending. 7 rrmbling and pain in limbs. Arms go to sleep. One-sided paralysis; worse after sleep. Hands are alternately hot and cold; numbness and cold sweat now of one, now of the other hand, Numb and unsteady. Knees crack on motion, Lower limbs very weak. Inflammatory swell-y ing of knee, Intensely painful, paralytic drawing.« Limbs straightened out, painful when flexed. ‘ Sleep. — Spasmodic yawning. Coma vigil. Constant drowsiness. After loss of sleep, night-watching, nursing.

Fever. — Chill, with flatulent colic, nausea, vertigo, coldness of lower extremities, and heat of head. Sweat general. Nervous form of low fever. Chilliness, with perspiration, and heat of skin.

Modalities. — Horse, eating, after foss of sleep, open air, smoking, riding, swimming, touch, noise, jar; afternoon. Menstrual period. After emotional disturbance. Relationship, — Antidotes: Coffee; Nux, Compare: Picrotoxin —alkaluid of Cocculus — (epilepsy, attacks in the morning on leaving horizontal position, hernia, locomotor ataxia, night-sweats}; Symphoricarpus (morning sickness) ; Petrol.; Puls.; Tgnat.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Coccus Cacti
remedies.text:
(Cochineal) The clinical application of the symptoms of this remedy, place it among the medicines for spasmodic and whooping coughs, and catarrhal conditions of the bladder ; spasmodic pains in kidneys, with visceral tenesmus.

Mind. — Early morning or afternoon sadness.

Head. — Suboccipital soreness; worse after sleep and exertion, Headache, worse from lying on back, better with the head high. Dull pain over right eye in morning.

Respiratory. — Constant hawking from enlarged uvula; coryza, with inflamed fauces; accumulation of thick viscid mucus, which is expectorated with great difficulty. Tickling in larynx, Sensation of a crumb behind larynx, must swallow continually; brushing teeth causes cough. Fauces very sensitive. Suffocative cough; worse, first waking, with tough, white mucus, which strangles. Spasmodic morning cough. Whooping vough attacks end with vomiling of this tough mucus. Chronic bronchitis complicated with gravel; large quantities of albuminous, tenacious mucus, are expectorated. Walking against wind takes breath away. [Nux. mosch.] Heart. —- Sensation as if everything were pressed toward the heart.

Urinary. — Urging to urinate; drick-red sediment. Urinary calculi hematuria, urates, and uric acid; lancinating pains from kidney to bladder, Deep-colored, | thick urine, Dysuria. Péinale. — Menses too earty, profuse, black and thick; @erk clots, with dysuria. Intermittent menstruation; flow only in evening and at night. Large clots escape when passing water. Labia inflamed. Modalities, Worse, left side, after sleep, touch, pressure of clothing, brushing teeth, slightest exertion. Better, walking.

Relationship. — Compare: Canth.; Cact.; Sars, Dose. — Lower triturations.

remedies.name: Cochlearia Armoracea
remedies.text:
(Horse-radich) tsed as a gargle in scorbutic gums and sore throat. Hoarseness and in relaxed conditions of the fauces. Internally in gonorrhea. Useful as a condiment in enfeebled states of the stomach An infusion of the root in cider, for dropsy, causes copious diuresis. Localty cures dandruff. Eyes, —Sore and scrofulous; traumatic inflammation of eyes, blearedness and cataract.

Stomach. — Pain towards back; worse, pressure on dorsal vertebz. Belching and tramps. Colic with hackache. Respiratory. -- Dry, hacking, laryngeal cough, also post-influenzal cough, dry or Joose, worse lying down. Chest painful to touch, Coryza, with hoarseness. Mucous asthma, CEdema of lungs.

Urinary. — Burning and cutting at glans penis before, during, and after urination. Frequent urination.

Relationship. — Compare: Cannab.; Sinapis; Caps. Dose, — First to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Codeinum
remedies.text:
(An Alkaloid from Opium) Trembling of whele body. Involuntary twitching of muscles of arms and Jower limbs. Jiching, with feeling of warmth, numbness and prickling. Diabetes.

Head. — Pain from occiput to back of neck, Skin of face and scalp sore after neuralgia.

Eyes. — ]uvoluntary twitching of lids. {Agar.] Stomach, — Spasmodic pain at pit cf stomach, Eruectations. Great thirst, with desire for bitter substances. Respiratory, ~— Short and irritating cough; warse, at night, Copious, purulent expectoration. Night cough of phthisis.

Relationship. — Compare: Opium ; Agaricus; HHyoscy.; Ammon, brom, Dose, — One-quarter of a grain doses to third tritu- Tation.

remedies.name: Coffea Cruda
remedies.text:
(Unioasted Coffer) Great nervous agitation and restlessness. Extreme sensitiveness characterizes this remedy. Neuralgia in various parts; always .with great nervous excitability and intolerance of pain, driving to despair. Unustal activity of mind and -body. Bad effects of sudden etnotions, surprises, joy, etc. Nervous palpitation. Coffea is specially suited to tall, jean, stooping persons with dark complexions, temperament choleric and sanguine.

Mind. — Gayety, easy comprehension, irritability, excited; senses acute. Impressionable, especially to pleasurable impressions. Full of ideas, quick to act. Toss ing about in anguish. [Acom.]

Head.— Tight pain, worse from noise, smell, nar cotics. Scems as if brain were torn to pieces, as if nail were driven in head. Worse in open air. Sensitive hearing.

Face.— Dry heat, with red cheeks. Prosopalyia extending to molar teeth, cars, forehead, and scalp, Mouth. — Toothache ; temporarily relieved by holding ice-water in the mouth, [Mangan. opposite.) Hasty eating and drmking, Delicate taste, Stomach. -— Excessive hunger. Intolerance of tight clothing. After wine and liquor.

Female. — Menses too carly and long lasting, Dysmenorthera, large clats of black blood, Hvpersensire wulva and vayina. Voluptuaus itching.

Sleep. — Wakeful; on a constant move. Sleeps til) 3 A. M., after which only dozing. Wakes with a start, sleep disturbed by dreams. Sleepless, on account niental actrenty; flow of ideas, with nerveus excitability. Disturbed by itching of anus. Respiratory, — Short, dry cough of measles in nerv~ ous, delicate children.

Heart. — Violent irreguiar palpitation especially after excessive joy or surprise. Rapid high tension pulse and urinary suppression.

Extremities. — Crural neuralgia; worse, motion, afternoon and night; better, by pressure. Modalities. ~— !Verse, excessive emotions (joy), narcotics, strong odors, noise, open air, told, night. Beticr, warmth, from lying down; holding ice in mouth.

Relationship. — Incompatible: Camph.; Coccul, Complementary: Acon. . Compare: Coffea testa (excruciating facial neuralgia from decayed teeth); Acon.; Cham.; Nux; Cyp.; Caffein and plants containing it, as Kola, Thea, etc. Strong black coffee, drunk as hot as possible, is indispensable as an antidote in a large number of poisons. especially narcotics, Hot coffee by rectum in cases of extreme collapse. Caffcin is a direct heart stimulant, Raises the bloud pressure, increases pulse rate and stimulates the muscles of the heart. It is given to support the heart in extreme feebleness or threatened failure. Stimulates the respiratory centre, nerve centres and increases diuresis. Use the Caffeine Sodio- Salicylas, 1-4 grains, hypodermically. Caffrin, one of the best stimulants to act on the vaso-motor centres. Antidotes: Nux,; Tabac. Dose, — Third to two hundredth potency,

remedies.name: Colchicum
remedies.text:
(Meadow Saffron) Affects markedly the muscular tissues, periosteum, and synovial membranes of joints. Has specific power of retieving the gouty paroxysms, It seems to be more beneficial in chronic affections of these parts. The parts are red, hot. swolfien. Tearing pains; worse, in the evening and at night and from touch; stubbing the toes hurts exceedingly There is always great prostratior, internal coldness, and tendency to collapse. Eifects of night watching and hard study. Shocks as from electricity through one half of body. Head, — Headache chiefly frontal and tempora!, lyit also occipital and in nape of neck, worse afternoon and evening, Eyes.— Pupils unequal; left pupil contracted. Vatiations in visual acuity. Lachrymation worse in open air; violent tearing pain in eyes. Dim vision after reading. Spots before eyes. _ Ears. — liching in ears; sharp, shooting pains below tight tragus.

Face. — Pain in facial muscles, moving about. Tingling and edematous swelling; cheeks red, hot, sweaty. Very irritable with the pains. [Chom.] Pain behind angle of right lower jaw, Stomach, — The smell of food causes nausea even to fainting, especially fish. Profuse salivary secretion. Vomiting of mucus, hile and food; worse, any motion; great coldness in stomach. Craving for various things, but is averse to them when smelJing them, seized then with nausea. Gonty gastralgia. Abdomen immensely distended with gas. Burning or icy coldness in stomach and abdomen. Thirst for effervescent, alcoholic beverages. Pain in transverse colon.

Abdomen. — Distention of abdomen, inability to stretch out legs. Borborygmi. Pain over fiver. Czcum and ascending colon much distended, Futlness and continuous rumbling.

Stool. — Painful, scanty, transparent, jelly-like mucus; pain, as if anus were torn open, with prolapse. Autumnal dysentery; stools contain white shreddy particles in large quantities. ineffectual pressing; feels feces in rectum, but cannot expel them.

Female. — Pruritus of genitals. Cold feeling in thigh after period. Sensation of swelling in vulva and clitoris.

Urine. — Dark, scanty or suppressed; bloody, brown, black, inky; contains clots ‘of putrid decomposed blood, albumin, sugar, Heart.— Anxiety in region of heart. Impulse not felt. Pericarditis, with severe pain, oppression and dyspnoea, pulse threadlike. Sounds of heart become weaker, pulse of low tension. Extremities, -—- Sharp pain down left arm. Tearing in limbs during warm weather, stinging during cald. l'ins and needles in hands and wrists, fingertips numb. Pain in front of thigh, Right plantar reflex abolished. Limbs, lame, weak, tingling. Pain worse in evening and warm weather, Joints stiff and feverish; shifting rheumatism; pains worse at night. Inflammation of great toe, gout in heel, cannot bear to have it touched or mated, Tingling i in the finger nails.

Back. — Aching in lumbar and lumbo-sacral region. Tult pain across loins, Backache, better, rest and pressure. Sk'n.— Blotchy papular rash on face. Pink spots on hack, chest and abdomen. Urticaria. Modalities, — Jerse, sundown to sunrise; motion, lass of sleep, smell of food in evening, mental exertion. Betier, stooping. . Relationship. ~— Antidotes: Thuja; Camph.; Coccul., Nux; Puls, Compare: Colchicine (intestinal catarrh with shreddy membranes; convulsive jerkings of right hand; intense pain of rhcumation 3x trit.). Also, Cerbe; Arnica; Lilium; Arsen.; Porat. Dose, — Third to thirtieth attenuation.

remedies.name: Collinsonia Canadensis
remedies.text:
(Stone-Root) Pelvic and portal congestion, resulting in hemorrhoids and constipation, especially in females. Depressed arterial tension, general atony of muscular fiber. Chronic nasal, gastric, and pharyngeal catarrh, due to partal abstruction. Dropsy from cardiac disease. Pruritus in pregnancy, with piles. Constipation of children from intestinal atony. Said to be of special value when given efore operations, for rectal diseases.

Head.— Dull frontal headache; from suppressed hemorrhoids, Chronic catatrh. Yellow-cuated tongue. Bitter taste. {Colocy.; Bry.J Rectum. — Sensation of sharp sticks tn rectum. Dry feces. Most obstinate constipation, with protruding hemorrhoids. Aching in anus and hypogastrium. Constipation during pregnancy; with membranous dysmenorrhaa, foliowing labor. (Nwx.] Painful bleeding piles. Dysentery, with tenesmus. Alternate constipation and digrrhea, and great flatulence. ftching of onus, [Teucrium; Ratunh.j Female. -— Dysmenorrhoea; pruritus of vulva; prolapse of womb; swelling and dark redness of genitals; pain on sitting down. Membranous dysmenorrhea, with constipation. Pruritus. Cold feeling in thighs after menstruation. Sensation of swelling of labia and of clitoris. Respiratory.—- Cough from excessive use of voice, sharp pain in larynx. Hoarseness. Harassing, dry cough, Heart. — Paipitation; rapid but weak. Drapsy. After heart symptoms relieved, pifes or menses return, Chestpains alternate with hemorrhoids. Oppression, faintness, and dyspnoea. {Acon. ferox.] Modalities, — Worse, from the slightest mental emotion or excitement; cold. Setter, heat. Relationship, — Antidote: Nuz. Compare: Zscul.; Alocs; Haman.; Lycopus; Negundo; Sulph.; Nux. Dose.-- Tincture, to third attenuation. Higher potencies where there is organic heart affection.

remedies.name: Colocynthis
remedies.text:
(Bitter Cucumber) Often indicated in the transition season when the air is cold, but the sun is still powerful enough to heat the blood. Develops most of its symptoms in the abdomen and head, causing intense neuralgias. It is especially suitsable for irritable persons easily angered, and it] effects therefrom. Women with copious menstruation, and of sedentary habits. Persons with a tendency to corpulency. The neuralgic pains are nearly always reieved by pressure. Cramps and twitching and shortenimg of muscles. Cysto-spasm following operations on orifices. [fyper.] Urinous odor of perspiration. (Berb.; Nutr. ac.] Agontizing pain in abdomen, causing patient to bend double, is most characteristic. Sensations: Cutting, twisting, grinding, contracting and bruised; as if clamped with tron bands.

Mind. — Extremely irritable. Becomes angry when questioned. Mortification caused by offense. Anger, with indignation. (Cham.; Bry.; Nux.] Head. -— Vertigo when turning head to the left. Lateral cutting headache, with nausea, vomiting. Pains (better pressure and heat), with soreness of scalp. Burning pains, digging, rending, and tearing. Frontal headache; worse, stooping, lying on back, and moving eyelids, Eyes,— Pains sharp, boring, better pressurc. Sensation on stooping, as if eye would fall out.

Face. — Tearing, shooting, and swelling of face; left side great soreness. Get relief from pressure. [China.] Neuralgia, with chilfiness; teeth seems too long. Sounds re-echo w ears. Pain in stomach, always with pain of teeth or head.

Stomach. — Very bitter taste. Tongue rough, as from sand, and feels scalded. Canine hunger. Feeling in stomach as if something would not yield; drawing pain, Abdomen. — Agonizing cutting pain in abdomen causing ‘patient to bend over double, and pressing on the abdomen. Sensation as if stones were heing ground together in the abdomen, and would burst. Intestines feel as if bruised. Colic with cramps in calves. Cutting in abdomen, especially after anger. Each paroxysm is attended with general agitation and a chill over the cheeks, ascending fram the hypogastrium. Pain in small spot below navel. Dysenteric stool rencwed cach time by the least food or drink. Jelly-like stools. Musty odor. Distention. Female,— Boring pain in ovary, Must draw up double, with great restlessness. Round, small cystic tumors in ovaries or broad ligaments. Wants abdomen supported by pressure Beariug-down cramps, causing her to bend double, [Opium.]

Urine. — Intense burning along urethra during stool. Vesical catarrh, discharge like fresh white of egg. Viscid. [Phos. acid] fetid; small quantities, with frequent urging. Itching at orifice. Red, hard crystals, adhering firmly to-vessel. Tenesmus of bladder. Pains on urinating over whole abdomen.

Extremities. — Contraction of muscles. Pain in right dettoid. [(Guaco.] Cramp-like pain in hip; lies on affected side. Spontaneous luxation of the hip-joints, Stiffness of joints and shortening. of tendons. Sciatic pain, left” side, drawing, tearing; better, pressure ond heat; worse, gentle touch. Contraction of the muscles. Pain down right thigh; muscles and tendons feel too short; numbness with pains. [Gnephal.] Pain m left knee joint. .

Modalities. — Worse, from anger and indignation. Better, doubling up, hard pressure, warmth, lying with head bent forward.

Relationship. — Antidote: Coffea; Staphis.: Cham. Compare: Lobelie erinus (violent cork-screw-like pains in abdomen). Dipodiums punctatum (Writhing. Twisting like a dying snake. Intractable insomnia.) Diescor.; Chansom.; Coceul.; Merc.; Plum.; Magn. phos.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Comocladia Dentata
remedies.text:
(Guao) Important eye and skin symptoms. Affections of antrum. Sacro-iliac and abdominal pain, Throbbing pains worse by Acal.

Eyes. — Ciliary neuralgia with eyes fecling Jarge ond protruded, especially right. Pain in right eye: worse, near warm stove: feels as if pressed outward. Sees only glimmer of light with left eye. Glaucoma, sense of fullness; eyeball feels too large. Motion of eyes aggravates.

Face. — Swollen, with eyes projecting. Skin. —Itches, red and pimples. Keducss ail over, like scarlatina. Erysipetas. Deep ulcers, with hard edges. Leprosy. Red stripes on -skin. [Euphorb,] Eczema (papular) of the trunk and extremities; also pustular type. Chest.—- Acute pain in feft mammary gland. Pain from right side of chest down arm to fingers. Cough with pain under left breast, going through tv left scapula. Modalities, — Better, open air, scratching ; by motion. Worse, touch, warmth, rest; night.

Relationship. — Compare: Rhus; Anacard.; Euphord. .. Dose, — First to thirtieti potency.

remedies.name: Condurango
remedies.text:
(Condor Plant) Stimulates the digestive functions and thus improves the’ generat health, Allays the pain in gastralgia accompanying cancer of stomach. Modifies secretions of digestive glands. Varicose ulcers, Lupus. Paisful cracks in corner of mouth is a guiding symptom of this drug, Chronic gastric catarrh, syphilis, and cancer. Tumors; stricture of cesophagus. The active principle [Condurangin] produces locomotor ataxia.

Stomach. — Painful affections of the stomach; ulceration. Vomiting of food, and indurations, constant burning pain. Stricture of cesophagus, with burning pains behind sternum, where food seems to stick. Vomiting of food, and indurations in left hypochondrium with constant burning pain, Skin. — Fissures form about the muco-cutaneous outlets. Epithclioma of lips or anus. Ulcerative stage of carcinoma cutis when fissures form. Relationship, Compare: <sterias; Conium; Hydrast., Arsenic. Dose, — Tincture, or bark, 5-grain doses before meals in water.

remedies.name: Conium
remedies.text:
(Poison Hemlock) An old remedy, rendered classical by Plato’s graphic description of its employment in the death of Socrates. The ascending paralysis it produces, ending in death by faiture of respiration, shows the ultimate tendency of many symptoms produced in the provings, for which Conium is an excellent remedy, such as difficult gait, trembling, sudden loss of strength while walking, painful stiffness of legs, etc. Such a condition is often found in old age, a time of weakness, languor, loca! congestions, and sluggishness, This is the special environment that Conium chooses to manifest its action. It corresponds to the debdifity, hypochondriasis, urinary troubles, weakened memory, sexual debility found here. Troubles at the change of life, old maids and bachelors. Growth of tumors invite it also, General feeling as if bruised by blows. Great debility in the morning in bed. Weakness of body and mind, trembling, and paipitation. Cancerous diathesis. Arterio-sclerosis. Caries of sternum, Enlarged glands. Acts on the glandular system, engotging and indurating it, altering its structure like scrofulous and cancerous conditions, Tonic after grippe. Insomnia of multiple neuritis.

Mind. — Excitement causes mental depression. Depressed, timid, averse to society, and atraid of being alone, No inclination for business or study; takes no interest in anything. Memory weak; unable to sustain any mental effort.

Head. — Vertigo, when lying down, and when turning over in bed, when turning head sidewise, or turning eyes; worse, shaking head, slight noise or conversation of others, especially towards the lett. Headache, stupefying, with nausea and vomiting of mucus, with a feeling as of foreign body under the skull. Scorched feeling on top. Tightness as if both temples were compressed: worse after a meal, (Geis.; Atrophine.] Bruised, semifateral pains.

Eyes.— Photophobia and excessive lachrymation Cornea! pustules. Dim-sighted; worse, artificial light. On closing eyes. he sweats. Paralysis of ocular muscles. [Caust.) In superficial inflammations, as in phiyctenular conjunctivitis and keratitis. The slightest ulceration or abrasion will cause the intensest photopholia, Ears. — Defective hearmg; discharge from ear blood colored, Nose. — Bleeds easily -— becomes sore. Polypus.

Stomach. — Soreness about the root of tongue. Terrible nausea, acrid heartburn, and acid ernctations; worse on going to bed. Painfu) spasms of the stomach. Amelioration from eating and aggravation a few hours after meals; acidity and burning; painful spot the level of the sternum.

Abdomen. — Severe aching in and around the fiver. Chronic jaundice, and pains in right hypochondrium. Sensitive, bruised, swollen, knife-like pains. Painful tightness Stool. Frequent urging; hard, with tenesmus. Tremulous weakness ajter every stool. [Verat.; Ars.; -irg, n.) Heat and burning in rectum during stool.

Urine.— Much difficulty in voiding, /t flows and stops again, [Ledum.} Interrupted discharge. [Clematis.) Dribbling in old men. [Copaiva.]

Male. — Desire increased; power decreased. Sexual nervousness, with feeble erection. Effects of suppressed sexuoi appetite. Testicles hard and enlarged.

Female. — Dysmenorrhaa, with drawing-down thighs. Mamme lax and shrunken, Acrd, painful to touch. Stitches in nipples. Wants to press breast hard with hand. Menses delayed and scanty; parts sensitive. Breasts enlarge and become pamful before and during menses. (Cale. ¢.; Lac con.) Rash before menses. Itching around pudenda. Unready conception. Induration of os and cervix. Ovaritis; ovary enlarged, indurated; lancinating pain. It effects of repressed sexual desire or suppressed menses, or from excessive indulgence. Leucorrhea after micturition. Respiratory. -— Dry cough, almost continuous, hacking: worse, cvening and at night; caused by dry spot in larynx with itching in chest and throat, when lying dozen, talking er laughing, and during pregnancy. I: pectoration only after long coughing. Want of breath on taking the least exercise; oppressed breathing, comstriction of chest; pains in chest, Back, -—- Dorsal pain between shoulders. Il] effects of bruises and shocks to spine. Coccyodynia.

Extremities. — Heavy, weary, paratyzed; trembling ; hands unsteady: fingers and toes numb. Afitsetfur weakness, especially of lower extremities. Perspiretion of hands, Putting fect on chair relieves pain.

Skin. — -taitlury glands pain, with numb feeling down arm. Induration after contusions. Yellow skin, with papular eruption: yellow finger-nails Gisitds enlarged aud induraicd, also mesenteric. llying stitches through the glands. Tumors; piercing pains; worse, at night. Chronic ulcers with fetid discharge. Sieeat as soon as one ste ps, oF even when closing eyes. Night and morning sweat, with offensive odor, and smarting in skin.

Modalities. — Worse, lying down, turning or rising in hed: celibacy; before and during menses, from taking cold, bodily or mental exertion. #eiter, while fasting, in the dark, from letting simbs hang down, motion and pressure, Relationship. — Compare: Scirrhinum— Cancer nosode— (cancerous diathesis; enlarged glands; cancer of breast; worms); Faryt.; Hydrast.; fod.; Gels.: Hyos.: Curare, Dose. — Best in higher potencies given infrequently, especially for growths, paretic states, etc. Otherwise sixth to thirtieth,

remedies.name: Convallaria Majalis
remedies.text:
(Lily of the Valley) A heart remedy, Increases energy of hearts’ action, renders it more regular. Of use when the ventricles are overdistended and dilatation begins, and when there is an absence of compensatory hypertrophy, and when venous stasis is marked. Dyspneea, dropsy, aneuric tendency, Mind and Head.--Jull intellect. Grieves easily. Dull headache; worse, ascending, hawking. Scalp sensitive. Irritability. Hysterical manifestations, Face.— Hydrea in nose and lips; raw and sore. Epistaxis. Sees imaginary gray spot about three inches square.

Mouth. — Grating of teeth in the morning. Coppery taste. Tongue feels sore and scalded; broad and thick with heavy, dirty coating, Throat. — Raw feeling in back of throat when in- Spiring. Abdomen, — Sensitive. Clcthes feel too tight. Gurgling and pain on taking deep breath. Movement in abdomen like fist of a child. Colicky pains.

Urinary Organs.— Aching in bladder; feels distended. Frequent urination; offensive. Female.—Great sorencss in uterine region, with sympathetic palpitation of heart. Pain in sacro-itiae joints, running down leg. Itching at urinary meatus and vaginal orifice.

Respiratory.— Pulmonary congestion. Orthopnaa. Dyspnea while walking. Hot feeling in throat.

Heart.— Feeling as if ‘heart beat throughout the chest. Endocarditis, with extreme orthopneea. Sensation as if heart ceased beating, then starting very suddenly. Palpitation from the least exertion. Tobacco heart, especially when due to cigarettes. Angina pectoris. Extremely rapid and irregular pulse. Back and

Extremities. — Pain and aching in lumbar region; aching of legs; in big toe. Trembling of hands. Aching in wrists and ankles, Fever. — Chilly in back and down spine, followed by fever, little sweat. Thirst and headache durine chill. Dyspnea during fever.

Relationship. — Compare: Digii.; Crateg.; Liliunr; Adonis (feeble heart action due only to functional disturbance).

Modalities. — Better, in open air. Worse, in warm Toom, Dose.— Third attenuation, and for symptoms of heart failure, tincture, one to fifteen drops.

remedies.name: Copaiva
remedies.text:
(Balsam of Copaiva) Acts powerfully on mucous membranes, especially that of the urinary tract, the respiratary organs, and the skin, here producing a well-marked nettle-rash.

Head. — Excessive sensitiveness: pain in occiput. Dull. fronta} headache, passes to occiput and back again, with throbbing, worse right side and motion. Scalp sensitive. Sensitive-to sharp sounds.

Nose. — Rawness and soreness of nostrils with stopped-up feeling: dryness of posterior nares. Profuse, thick, fetid discharge from nasal passages, running down throat at night. Burning and dryness, crusts on erinaics bones. Marked catarrhal condition in upper piratory tract.

Stomach. — Food seems too salty. Gastric troubles during menstruation or following urticaria. Gas and intestinal flatulence, urging to stool and difficult passage with pain.

Urinary. — Burning pressure; painful micturition by drops. Retention, with pain in bladder, anus, and rectum, Catarrh of bladder; dysuria. Swelling of orifice. Constant desire to urinate. Urine smells of violets. Greenish, turbid calor; peculiar pungent odor. Rectum, -- Stools covered with mucus, with colic and chilliness. Burning and itching of anus, caused by piles.

Mate. — Testicles sensitive and swollen.

Female. — Itching of vulva and anus, with bloody purulent discharge. Profuse, strong-smelling menstrual discharge, with pains radiating to hip bones, with natssea. Respiratory. —- Cough, with profuse, gray, purulent expectoration. Tickling in Jarynx, trachea, and bronchi, Bronchial catarrh, with profuse greenish, offensive discharge.

Skin. — Hives, with fever and constipation. Roseola. Erysipelatous inflammation, especially around abdomen, Circumscribed, lenticular patches, with itching; mottled appearance. Chronic urticaria in children. Bullous eruptions.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Bell.; Mere. Compare: Cannab.; Canth.; Barosma; Cubeb; Apis; Vespa; Evig.; Senecio; Santalum (aching in kidneys; gonorrhoea) ; Sepia.

Dose. — First to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Corallium
remedies.text:
(Red Coral) The provings of coral develop much coryza and epistaxis, and even ulceration within the nostrils. It is to be thought of for whooping and spasmodic coughs, especially when the attack comes on with a very rapid cough, and the attacks follow so closely as to almost Tun into each other. Often preceded by sensation of smnothering, followed by exhaustion. Congestion of face after dinner. Patient becomes purple in face. Violence of paroasym, even with cxpectaration of Mood. Feeling as if cold air were streaming through skul] and air-passages. One is too cold when uncovered and too hot when covered; relieved by artificial heat.

Head. — Feels very large; violent pain as if parietal bones were forced apart; worse stooping. Eyes hot and painful, Nose. — Odors of smoke, enions, etc., Painful ulcer in nostrils. Profuse secretion of mucus dropping through postertor nares; air feels cold. Dry coryza; nose stopped up and ulcerated. Epistaxis, Mouth, — Food tastes like sawdust. Bread tastes like straw, Beer tastes sweet. Pain in articulation of left lower jaw. “Craves salt.

Respiratory. — Hawking of profuse mucws. Threat very sensitive, especially to air. Profuse, nasal catarrh, Inspired air feels cold. [Cistus.} Profise secretion of mucus dropping through postcrior nares. Dry, spasmodic. suffocative cough; very rapid cough, short, harking. Cough with great sensitiveness of airpassages: feel cold om deep inspiration. Continuous hysterical cough. Feels suffocated and greatly exhausted after whooping-cough. Male.-- Ulcers on glans and inner prepuce, with yellow ichor. Emissions and weakened sexual power. Profuse perspiration of genitals. Skin,--Red, flat ulcers. Coral-colored, then dark red spots, changing to copper-colored spots. Psoriasis of palms and soles. Relationship, —-Complementary : Sulph. Compare: Bellad.; D:oser.; Mephit.; Caust. Dose, — Third to thirtieth attenuation,

remedies.name: Coralorhiza
remedies.text: (Crawley Root) Hectic fever, coming on 9 to 10 a.M., and lasting till midnight. Intensely nervous and restless, burning of palms and soles; no thirst, chill or perspiration, Can bear only slightest covering.

remedies.name: Cornus Circiinata
remedies.text:
{Round-leaved Dogwood) Chronic malaria, hepatitis, jaundice. Weakness in morning. Pain in pit of stomach, with distended abdomen, Vesicular eruption associated with chronic liver disease or aphthous stomatitis. Mouth, — Ulceration of tongue, gums and mouth; aphthe, Burning in mouth, throat and stomach.

Stool. — Loose, windy, dark stool, immediately after dinner. Burning in anus. Dark, bilious, offensive diarthea, with sallow complexion.

Skin.— Vesicular eczema of face in infants, with nursing sore mouth.

Relationship.— Compare: Cornus alternifolia — Swamp Walnut — (Weak and tired; disturbed sleep, fever, restlessness, eczema; skit cracked; chest feels cold, as if full of ice); Cornus florida (chronic malaria; indigestion and distressing acid heartburn; general debility from loss of fluids and night sweats; neuralgic pains in arms, chest, and trunk, and sensation as if broken in two; intermittent fever, with drowsiness; feels cold, but is warm to touch; great exhaustion in intervals; general clammy sweat. Chill is preceded by drowsiness, heat ts associated with drowsmess).

Dose. — Tincture to sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Corydalis (dicentra Canadensis)
remedies.text:
(Turkey-pea) Syphilitic affections. Ulcers of mouth and fauces. Cancer cachexia pronounced. Gummata and nightpains, Chronic diseases, with atony. Tongue clean, broad, and full. Tissues flabby, doughy, cold. Gastric eatarrh. [Hydrest.]

Skin. — Dry, scaly scabs on face of ald people. Lymphatic glands swollen, Relationship. ~~ Nit. ac.; Kuti iod., Fluor. ac. Dose. ~ Tincture.

remedies.name: Cotyledon
remedies.text:
(Pennywort) Marked action on heart; oppression of chest; fulness in throat, Epilepsy. Numb aching in muscular and fibrous tissue. Sciatica. Well-marked pains through the breast to scapula. Catarrh of larynx and trachea, Hysterical joint.

Mind. — Lost, confused feeling. Could not articulate for some time on awaking. Pressing vertex headache. Ailments from suppressed emotion. Feeling os if a part of the bady were absent, Breast. — Pain under left nipple, and aching in right breast. Pain through to scapula from region of left breast. Pain at angles of scapulz. Full, bursting feeling, as if from obstruction at the heart. Choking fulhess in throat. Breathing oppressed. Extremities, — Aching in back and thighs. Aching in all joints. Skin sensitive, rubbing of trousers causes an acute sting. Legs and arms feel heavy and sore, Relationship. —- Compare: Ambra; Asafet.; Hepatice; Ignatia; Lachests.

Dose. — Tincture to third potency.

remedies.name: Crataegus
remedies.text:
(Hawthorn Berriea) Produces giddiness, lowered pulse, and air hunger and reduction in blood-pressure. Acts on muscle of heart, and is a Acart tentc, No influence’on the endocardium, Myocarditis. Failing compensation. Jrregularity of Acari. Insomnia of aortic sufferers; anaemia; cedema; cutaneous chilliness. Chronic heart disease, with extreme weakness. Very feeble and irregular heart action. General anasarca. Very nervous, with pain in back of head and neck. Collapse of typhoid. Hemorrhage from bowels. Cold extremities, pallor; irregular pulse and breathing. Painful sensation of pressure in left side of chest below the clavicle. Dyspepsia and nervous prostration, with heart failure. In the beginning of heart mischief after rheumatism. <Arterioscterosis. Said to have a solvent power upon crustaceous and calcareous deposits in arteries.

Head.— Apprehensive, despondent. Very nervous and irritable, with pain in back of head and neck. Mentaf dulness conjunctival isritation nasal discharges.

Urinary. — Diabetes, especially in children. Heart. -- Fatty degeneration, Extreme dyspnca on least excrtion, without much increase of pulse. Pain in regton of heart and under left clavicle. Heart muscles seem flabby, worn out. Cough. Heart dilated; first sound weak, Pulse accelerated, irrcgular, intermittent, Valvular murmurs, angina pectoris. Cutaneous chilliness, blueness of fingers and toes. Sustains heart in infectious diseases. Skin, — Excessive perspiration. Skin eruptions.
