Sleep. — Insomnia of aortic patients. Mod es.—~ Worse, in warm room. Actter, fresh air, quiet and rest, Relationship. — Sirophanius; Digit.; fberis; Naja; Cactus, Dose.-— Fluid extract or tincture, one to fifteen drops. Must be used for some time in order to obtain good results,

remedies.name: Cracus Sativa
remedies.text:
(Saffron) Is a remedy often useful in haemorrhages that are black and stringy. Tingling in various parts. Chorea and hysterical affections, Frequent and extreme changes in sensations and mental cenditions. Drowsiness and fassitude; better by literary lahor.

Mind. — Vacdlating; pleasant mania; sings and taughs. Happy and affectionate; then angry. Sudden changes from hilarity to melancholy, Vivid recollection from music heard. [Lye.]

Head. — Throbhs, pulsates, during climacteric; worce during menses, Eyes. — Appearance as of electric sparks. Must wipe eyes as if mucus or water were in them. Feeling in eves as after violent weeping, Seusation as if she had been looking through too sharp spectacles. Eyes feet as if is smokc, Ciliary neuralgia, pain from eyes to top of head. Sensation as if cold air was rushing through eye. (Fluor. ac.; Syph.] Asthenopia with extreme photophobia, Nose, — Epistaxis, Stomach, — Obstinate constipation duc to portal stagnation. Constipation in infants. Crawling and stitches in anus. Sexsotion of something alive in abdomen, stomach, etc., especially on left side. [Calend.} Female. — Sensation of something alive and moving in stomach and in the abdomen, which is swollen, or of something dead and heavy, Threatened abortion, especially when haemorrhage is dark and stringy. Urge ing of bieod to genitals, Menses dark, viscid, too frequent ard copious, bluck ond slimy. Uterine hemorrhage; clots with lony strings; worse from least movement. Jerking pain in interior of left breast, as if drawn toward back by means of thread. [Crot. tig.] A bounding feeling, as if something alive in right breast.

Respiratory. — Wheezy cougn, with frothy expectora~ tion, containing threads like fine twine; worse, lying down, Breath has offensive, sickly smell. Feeling as if the uvula is elongated in hysterical patients. UWemorrhages.-- Dark, stringy, clotted. Epistaxis; strings of dark blood hanging down the nose. Bloody urine.

Back. — Sudden feeling of coldness in back as if cold water were thrown over him; icy-cold extremities, Extremities. — Spasmodic contractions and twitchings of single set of muscles. Chorea and hysteria,with great alterations of feeling. Whole upper extremity falls asleep.

Modalities. — Worse, lying down, hot weather, warm toom, in morning, fasting, before breakfast, looking fixedly at an object. Better. in open air.

Relationship. — Antidote: Opium; Bell. Compare: Jpec.; Tritlium; Plat.; China; Sabina.

Dose. — Tincture, to thirtieth attentuation.

remedies.name: Crotalus Horridus
remedies.text:
(Rattlesnake) Snake poisons are supposed to be chemically Cyan. hydrates of Soda and other salts. Alcohol is the natural solvent of these salts and is an antidote. Low septic states, General disorganization of the blood, hrmorrhages and jaundice. A crotalin injection decreases the rate of coaguiation of the blood. In epilepsy the average rate is far greater than in normal conditions. Blood decomposition, hemorrhages (dark fluid that forms no clots), tendency to carbuncles, malignant scarlatina, yellow fever, the plague, cholera, give opportumty to use this remedy. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Plague. Sleeps into his symptoms, Mind.-— Weeping mood; clouded perception and memory; impatient. Loquacious, with desire to escape. Sadness, Head, — Vertigo, with weakness and trembling. Dull heavy occipital pain, on right side and right eye. Headache with pain in heart on Jying on left side. Headache; must walk on tip-toe to avoid jarring.

Eyes. — Very sensitive to light, especially lamp light. Yellow color of eyes, Iilusions: blue colors. Ciliary nexralgic; tearing, boring pain, as if a cut had been made aromd cre. For absorption of intra-ocular haemorrhages. into the vitreous, but particularly for noninflammatory retinal ha:morrhages. Diplopia.

Ears. — Auditory vertigo. Blood oozes from ears.

Nose. — Epistaxis, bleed black and stringy, ozena, after exanthemata or syphilis.

Face.— Acne. Lips swollen and numb. Leadencolored and yellow face. Lockjaw.

Mouth. — Tongue red and small, but fecls swollen. Tongue fiery red, dry in center, smooth and polished. Moldy smell of breath. Fills up with saliva. Tongue when protruding, goes to right.

Throat. — Dry, swollen, dark red. Spasm of cesophagus; cannot swallow any solid substance. Tight constriction. Gangrenous, with much swelling.

Stomach. — Intolerance of clothing around stomach. Unable to retain anything; violent vomiting of food; bilious vomiting, vomiting of blood. Constant nausea and vomiting every month, after mensturation, Cannot lie on right side, without vomiting dark-green matter. Black or coffee-grounds vomiting, Trembling, fluttering feeling below the epigastrium. Intolerance of clothing about epigastrium. Faintness and sinking at stomach, Ulceration of the stomach. Atonic dyspepsia. Gastritis in chronic alcoholism. Abdomen, — Distended, hot, and tender. Pain in region of liver.

Stool. — Black, thin, offensive, like coffee-grounds. Intestinal hemorrhage ; blood dark, fluid, non-coagutable. Blood oozes from rectum when standing or walking. Female, —- Prolonged menses. Dysmenorrhea; pain extends down thighs, with aching in region of heart. Uterine hzmorrhage, with faintness at stomach. Puerperal fever; offensive lochia, Phlegmasia alba dolens. Sensation as though uterus would drop out. Painful drawing in uterine ligaments. Cannot keep legs stilt.

Urinary. — Datk, bloody urine. Casts. Inflamed kidney. Albuminous, dark, scanty. [M/erc. cor.]

Heart. — Action feeble, pulse tremulous. Palpitation, especially at menstrual period.

Respiratory.— Cough, with bloody expectoration, Tickling from a dry spot in larynx, Extremities. — Hands tremble, swojlen, Lower extremities go to sleep easily, Right-sided paralysis.

Fever. — Malignant fevers of a hemorrhagic of putrescent character. Low bilious remittents, Yellow fever. Bloody sweat. Cerebrospinal meningitis. [Cictta; Cup. acct.) Skin, —Sallow. Yellow color of the whole body. Great sensitiveness of skin of right half of bady. Purpura hemorrhagtcu, Hemorrhage from every part of body Bloody sweat. Chilblains, felons. Dissecting wouids. Pustular cruptions. Insect stings. Post-vaccination eruptions. Bad effects of vaccination. Lymphangitis and septicemia. Boils, carbuncles, and eruptions are surrounded by purplish, mottled skin and cedema. Anthrax. Sore sensation relieved by pressure. Sleep. -- Dreams of the dead. farting in sleep. Yawning, Smothering sensation when awaking, Modalities. — Horse, right side: open air; evening and morning; in spring, coming on of warm weather; on awaking; damp and wet; jar.

Relationship.— Compare: Bothrops; Naja (more nervous phenomena); Lachesis (more markedly worse on left side}; Elaps (preferable in otorrhcea and af fections of right lung); Crotalus cascavella (thoughts and dreams of death. A magnetic state is produced). Bungarus (poliomyelitis), Antidote: Lach.; Alcohol.

Dose. — Third 10 sixth potency.

remedies.name: Croton Tiglium
remedies.text:
(Croton-oil Seed) Is a valuable remedy in diarrhoea, summer complaint, and skin affections, Feels tight all over. It is une of the antidotes to Rhus poisoning, as is evident from its wide and intense action upon skin and mucous surface, causing both irritation and inflammation, with formation of vesicles and mucous discharges. Has elective affinity for skin of face and external genitals. Burntng in the asophagus, Head. — Pressing pain in forehead, especially osbits, Eyes. -— Granular lids; pustules of cornea. Red and Taw appearance. Feel drown backward. Eruptions around eves. Tensive pain above right orbit. Stool. Copious watery stools, with much: urging; always forcibly shot out, with gurgling in intestines; worse, drinking the least quantity, or even while eating. Constant urging to stool, followed by sudden evacuation. Swashing sensation in intestines.

Urine. — Night urine foaming; dark orange color; turbid on standing; greasy particles floating on top. Day urine is pale, with white sediment. Chest, — Drawing- pain through the left chest into the back, Asthma, with cough; cannot expand the chest. Nursing women; every suck the child gives produces pain from nipple back. Inflamed breasts. Cough; as soon as he touches the pillow must get up. Sensitive to deep breathing.

Skin.— Feels hide-bound. Intense itching; but scratching is painful. Pustular eruption, especially on face and genitals, with fearful itching, followed by painfu) burning. Vesicles; confluent oozing. Vesicular erysipelas, itching exceedingly. Herpes zoster; stinging, smarting pains of the eruption, Modalities. ~ Worse, least food or drink; during summer; touch, night and morning, washing.

Relationship. — Compare: Momordica charantia — Hairy Mordica— (has marked drastic properties, producing colic, nausea, vomiting, cholera-like symptoms, abdomen seems full of fluid discharged explosively, thin, watery, yellow, Great thirst). Rhus; Anagallis; Anacard.; Sepia. Antidote: Ant. tart.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Cubeba
remedies.text:
(Cubebs) Mucous membranes generally, but especially that of the urinary tract, are chiefly affected by this remedy. Frequent urination of a nervous origin. Leucorrheea in little girls.

Urine. — Urethritis, with much mucus, especially i women, Cutting after urination, with constriction. Hematuria. Prostatitis, with thick yellow discharge. Cystitis, Respiratory. — Catarrh of nose and throat, with fetid odor and expectoration. Mucus trickles from pusterior nares. Rawness of throat and hoarseness. Relationship.-- Compare: Cucurbita; Copaiva; Piper meth.; Sandal. Dose. -— Second and third attenuation,

remedies.name: Cucurbita Pepo
remedies.text: (Pumpkin Seed) Intense nausea immediately after eating. Vomiting of pregnancy. Seasickness, Relationship. — Compare: Filir; Cuprum oxid. nig. Dose, — Tincture, The seeds are a valuable remedy for tape-worm Scald the seeds and pee! off the onter skins when softened, the green inner pulp being the part used. Dose: two ounces of seed, yielding one of pulp. May be mixed with cream and taken like porridge. Take in morning after twelve hours’ fasting, and follow in two hours by castor oil.

remedies.name: Cuphea
remedies.text:
(Flux-weed) Vomiting of undigested food. Cholera infantum, much acidity; frequent green, watery, acid stools, Tenesmus and great pain.. High fever; restlessness, aud sleeplessness, Ohstinate constipation.

Relationship. — Compare: Aithusa; Coto (intestinal catarrh, chronic, copious, exhausting diarrhcea), Typha latifolia (Cat-tail flag) diarrhoea, dysentery, summer complaint of children. Tincture and first attenuation. Dose, — Tincture.

remedies.name: Cuprum Aceticum
remedies.text:
{Acetate of Copper) Hay-fever, with burning excoriation, paroxysmal cough; tough, tenacious mucus, and fear of suffocation Protracted labor.

Head. — Violent throbbing and lancinating pains in forehead. Liit-sided brow ague. Brain seems void. Inclined to gape and cry. Loses consciousness; head reels when tn high-cetled room. Constaut protrusion and retraction of tongue. {Laches.]

Face.— Collapsed, hippocratic., Facial neuralgia in cheek-bone, upper jaw, and behind right ear, Better by chewing, pressure, and external warmth. Stomach, — Violent spasmodic pains in stomach and abdomen. Vomiting. Slimy brown diarrheea, Violent teresmus. Cholera, Respiratory. — Violent spasmodic cough, Short, difficult respiration. Spasmodic constriction of chest, Dyspneea.

Skin. — Leprous-like eruption, without itching, over whale body, in spots of various sizes.

Modalities. — Worse, mental emotions, touch, Better, chewing, pressure, night, lying on affected side, and warmth, Relationship. — Acts similarly to Cuprum met. but is more violent in action. Dose.-- Third to sixth trituration,

remedies.name: Cuprum Arsenitum
remedies.text:
(Arsenite of Copper — Scheele’s Green) A remedy for symptoms denending on deficient kidney action; various intestinal affections, cholera morbus and infantum, diarrhoea, and dysentery, Uremic convulsions, headache, vertigo and unconscious conditions resulting from brain oedema. Nephritis of pregnancy. Convulsions preceded by gastro-intestinal symptoms. Chlorosis. Bronchial asthma and with emphysema. Painful neuroses, enteroptosis.

Mouth. — Tongue thickly coated, dirty brown, white, metallic taste; thirst. Dry mouth. Abdomen, — Gastro-cnteritis. Violent abdominal pain Diarrhaa in phthisis, Cholera. |.4drs.; Verat.; Canep'.} Rumbling and sharp cutting pain. Dark liquid stools.

Back. — Persistent lameness. Pain in lumbar region and in lower left shaulder-biade; chest feels tight

Urinary.— Renal iefficiency and uramia. Garlichky eder, Diabetes. Urine of high specific gravity; increased, acetones and diacetic acid. Male. -— Perspiration of scrotum; is constantly damp and moist. Boils on scrotum. Purulent discharge of a white color from urethra; tingling and burning in uretbra; pain in prostate; pains in penis.

Extremities. — Cramps in calves of legs, worse after midnight, only relieved by getting out of bed and standing. Ulcers; gangrene.

Skin. — Cold, clammy perspiration of an intermittent nature, Acne, pustules on face and in the cruro-genital region; ulcers look like chancre. Gangrene; carbuncles.

Dose. — Second and third trituration.

remedies.name: Cuprum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Copper) Spasmodic affections, cramps, convulsions, beginning in fingers and toes, violent, contractive, and intermitting pain, are some of the more marked expressions of the action of Cuprum; and its curative range therefore includes tonic and clonic spasms, convulsions, and epileptic attacks. Chorea brought on by fright, Nausea greater than in any other remedy. In epilepsy, aura begins at knees, ascends to hypogastrium; then unconsciousness, foaming, and falling. Symptoms disposed fo appear periodically and in groups. Complaints begin m left side, [Lackcs.] Where eruptions strike in, as in scarlet fever, complaints may result, such as excessive vomiting, stupor, convulsions, which come within the sphere of this remedy. The pains are increased by movement and touch. Head.-—- Fixed ideas, malicious and morose. Uses words not intended, Fearful, Empty feeling. Purple, red swelling of head, with convulsions. Bruised pain in brain and eyes on turning them, Meningitis. Sensation as if water were poured over head.

Eyes. — Fixed, stary, sunken, glistening, turned upward. Crossed, Quick rolling of eyeballs, with closed oyes.

Face. — Distorted, pale bluish, with blue lips. Contraction of saws, with foam at mouth. Nose, -- Sensation of violent congestion of blood to nose. [Afeiilot.] Mouth.—Strong metallic, slimy taste. with flow of saliva, Constant protrusion and retraction of the tongue, like a snake, [Lach.] Paralysis of tongue. Stammering speech, Stomach. — Hiccough preceding the spasms. Nausea. Vomiting, relieved by drinking cold water; with colic, diarrhoea, spasms. Strong metallic taste. [Rhus.] When drinking, the fluid descends with gurgling sound. [Leur.] Craves cool drink.

Abdomen. — ‘Tense, hot and tender to touch; contracted, Neuralgia of abdominal viscera, Colic, violent and ffttermittent. Intussusception.

Stool. — Black, painful, bloody, with tenesmus and weakness. Cholera; with cramps in abdomen and calves, Female. — Menses too late, protracted. Cramps, extending into chest, before, during, or after suppression of menses. Also, from suppressed foot sweats. [¢l.J Ebullition of blood; palpitation. Chlorosis. Afterpains, Heart, — Angina pectoris. Slow pulse; or hard, full and quick, Palpitation, precordial anxiety and pain. Fatty degeneration. [PAytol,]

Respiratory. — Cough has a gurgling sound, better by drinking cold water. Suffocative attacks, worse 3 a.m. {4m. c.] Constriction of chest; spasmodic asthma, alternating with spasmodic vomiting. Whooping-cough, —hetter, swallow water [Coxst.] with vomiting and spasms and purple face, Spasm of the glottis. Dyspnara with epigastric uneasiness. Spasmodic dyspnea before menstruation, Extremities. — Jerking, twitching of muscles. Coldness of hands. Cramps in palms. Great weariness of limbs. Cramps in calves and soles, Epilepsy; auro begins in knees, Clenched thumbs, Clonic spasms, beginning in fingers and toes.

Skin. — Bluish, marbled. Ulcers, itching spots, and pimples at the folds of joiats.

Sleep. — Profound, with shocks in body, During sleep constant rumbling in abdomen.

Modalities. — Worse, before menses; from voiniting. Better, during perspiration, drinking cold water, Relationship. — Antidotes: Bell.; Hepar; Camph. Copper is found in Dulcum., Staphisag,, Conium and some other plants, Complementary: Cale. Compare: Cupr. sulph. (burning at vertex; incessant, spasmodic cough; worse at night; tongue and lips bluish; focally, Cupr. sulph. in 1-3 per cent. sol. in inoperable sarcoma}. Cupr. cyan, (meningitis basilaris) ; Cholas tcrrapina {cramps in calves and feet; rheumatism, with cramp-like pains); Plumb: Nux; Veratr.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency. Cuprum oxrydaium nigrum 1x (all kinds of worms, including tape-worms and trichinosis according to Zopfy’s 60 years’ experience), (Arrow-poison) Muscular paralysis without impairing sensation and consciousness. Paralysis of respiratory muscles. Reflex action diminished, Debility of the aged [Baryta] and from loss of fluids. Catalepsy. Nervous debility. Trismus. Glycosuria with motor paralysis. Curare decreases the output of adrenalin. Mind, — Indecision; no longer wishes to think, or act for herself, Head. — Lancinating pains all over head, Head drawn backward, Falling out of hair, Brain feeis full of fluid, Eyes. — Sharp, stitching pains over right eye. Black spots before vision. Ptosis of right side.

Ears.— Noises; unbearable earache. Lancinating pains start from ears; extending down to legs. Swelling of lobes of ear, Nose. — Ozena. Tubercles on nose; fetid lumps of bus.

Face. — Facia! and buccal paralysis. Tongue and mouth drawn. Red face. Tongue and movth drawn to right.

Female.— Dysmenorrhaa. Menses too early, during menses, colic, headache, kidney pain. Leucorrhera, thick, purulent, offensive. Respiratory. —- Threatened paralysis of respiration on falling asleep. Short breath, Short dry cough; provokes vomiting, followed by fainting. Chest sore to pressure, Very distressing dyspnea. Extremities, —— Tired pain up and down spine, Arms weak, heavy. Cannot lift the fingers. Weakness of hands and fingers in pianists. Legs tremble; give way in walking. Debility; paralysis. Catalepsy. Favors development of corns. Retlexes lessened or abolished.

Skin. — Leprosy. Dirty-looking skin. Boils, Tubercles on nose. Liver spots. Blood oozes through. Itch~ ing.

Modalities. — Worse, dampness, cold weather, cold wind; 2 a.M.; right side.

Relationship. — Compare: Cystisin (motor paralysis) ; Crotalus; Nux; Con. Curare antidotes Strychnin.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Cyclamen
remedies.text:
(Sow-bread) Anamic and chlorotic conditions. Affections of uterus. Gastro-intestinal and genito-vrinary tracts affected, inducing secondary anemia and various reflexes. Sleepiness, moroseness, and lassitude. Cough at night while asleep without waking, especially in children. [Cham.; Nitr. acJ Head.— Terrors ef conscience. Grieves over duty neglected. Depression, with weeping and desire to be alone. Aching in morning, with flickering before eyes; sneezing with itching in ear. Vertigo; things turn in a circle; better in the room; worse, open air, One-sided headache. Frequent sneezing with itching in ears.

Eyes. — Dim vision, worse on waking, with spots before eyes. Flickering of various colors. Convergent strabismus. Sees countless stars. Diplopia. Disturbance of vision, associated with gastric disturbances. Stomach.-—-Salty taste; hhiccough-like eructation worse, fat food, Diarrhea after every cup of coffee; hiccough. Satiety after a few mouthfuls. Disgust for meat, especially pork. Desire for femonade.

Rectum. — Pain about anus and perinenm, as if a spot were suppurating, when walking or sitting.

Female. — Menses profuse, black, membranous, clotted, too early, with labor like pains from back to pubes, Flow less when moving about. Menstrual irregularities with megrin and blindness, or fiery spots before eyes. FHiccough during pregnancy. Post-partum hemorrhage, with colicky bearing-down pains, with relief after gush of blood. After menses, swelling of breasts, with ntlky secretion, Extremities. — Pains in parts where bones lie near surface. Burning, serg puig in eels. Cramp-like contraction of right thumb and index finger. Pains in periosteum. Chilblains.

Skin. — Acne in young women, pruritus better scratching and appearance of menses.

Modalities. — "arse, open air, evenings, sitting, standing, and cold water, Setter, during menstrual flow, by moying about, rubbing parts: in warm room, Jemon- Relationship, —- Compare: Ambra; Pulsat.; Cinchona; Fer. cit. et Chin, Dose. — Third attenuation.

remedies.name: Cypripedium
remedies.text:
(Yellow Lady’s Slipper) The skin symptoms correspond to those of poisoning by Rhus, ior which it bas been found an efficient antidote, Nervousness in children; from teething and intestinal troubles. Debility after gout. J/fydrocephulaid symptoms, result of long exhausting diarrhea. Slecplessness, Head. -- Child crics out at night; is wakeful and hegins to faugh and play, Weadaches cf elderly people and during climacteric. Reiationshap, — Compare: .faebra; Kati broin.; Sentellar.;. Valerran; Tgnat. Skin relatives; Grindelia; Anacard.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth attenuation. For Poison Oak, 5 drops of tincture per dose, also locally.

remedies.name: Daphne Indica
remedies.text:
(Spurge Laurel) Acts on lower tissues, muscles, bones and skin. Sudden, lightning jerks in different parts of the body. Craving for tobacco. Burning in stomach, Parts of the hody feel separated. [Bapi.] Fetid breath, urine, sweat.

Head. — Feels as if skull would burst; as if head were separated from body. Heat in head, especially in vertex, Tongue coated on vne side only. [Rhus.) Foulsmelling, ptyalism hot. Urine, — Thick, turbid, yellowish, like rotten eggs. Extremities. -- Right toe swollen, painful. Pain shoots upward into abdomen and heart. Rheumatic pains in thighs and knees. Cold feeling on buttocks. Shooting pains, shift rapidly; worse, cold air.

Sleep. — Entire inability to sleep; sometimes caused hy aching in bones. Dreams, with nightmare. Dreams af cats, black cats. Starting on falling to sleep with chilliness and clamminess.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Bry.; Rhus. Compare: Bltor. ace: Aur; Mez.; Staph.

Dose. — First to sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Digitalis
remedies.text:
(Foxglove) Comes imto play in all diseases where the heart is primarily involved, where the pulse is zwrak, irregular, intermittent, abnormally slow, aud dropsy of external and internal parts, W'cakness and dilatation of the myocaraium., Other symptoms of organic heart disease, such as great weakness and sinking of strength, faintness, coldness of skin, and irregular respiration; cardiac irritability and ocular troubles after tobacco; jaundice from induration and hypertrophy of the liver, frequently calls for Digitalis, Jaundice with heart disease. Faint, as if dying. Bluish appearance of face. Cardiac muscular failure when asystole is present. Stimulates the heart's muscles, increases force of systole, increases length. Prostration from slight exertion, Collapse, Mind. —-Despondency; fearful: am+rious about the future. Dutlness of sense. Every shock strikes in epigastrium.

Head. — Vertigo, when walking and on rising. Sharp, shooting frontal pain, extending into nose, after drinking cold water or eating ice-cream. Heaviness of head, with sensation as if it would fall backward. Face Iiuish. Confusiun, fullness and noise in head. Cracking sounds during a nap. Blue tongue and lips.

Eyes. — Biuencss of eyelids. Dark hodies, like flies, before eyes. Change ta acuicness of perception af shades of green, Objects appear yreen and yellow. Mydriasis; lid margins red, swollen, agglutinated in morning. Detachment of retina, Stomach. -—-Sweet taste with constant ptvalism. Excessive natsea, not relieved by vomiting. Faiutness, great weakness in stomach. Burning in stomach extending to asophagus. After cold water or ice-cream, sharp pain in forehead, extending to nose. Faintness and yomiting from motion, Discomfort, even after a - small quantity af food, ur from mere sight or smell). Tenderness of epigastrium. Copious salivation. Newralgic pain in stomach, unconnected with taking food. Abdomen, —- Pain in left side apparently in descendjag colon and under false ribs. Severe abdominal pains, pufsation in abdominal aorta, and epigastric constriction, Enlarged, sore, painful kver. Stool, — White, chalk-like, ashy, pasty stools, Diartheea during jaundice. Urine, — Continued urging, in drops, dark, hot, burning, with sharp cutting or throbbing pain at neck of bladder, as if a straw was being thrust back and forth; worse at night. Suppressed. Ammoniacal, and turbid. Urethritis, phimosis, strangury. Full feeling after urination. Constriction and burning, as if urethra was too small. Brick-dust sediment. Female, —- Lahor-like pains in abdomen and back before menses. Uterine hemorrhage. Male. -—~ Nightly emission [Dtaitalin], with great weakness of genitals after coitus. Hydrocele; scrotum enlarged like a bladder. Gonorrheea, balanitis [Merc.], with cedema of prepuce. Dropsival swelling of genitals. {[Sulpi.] Enlarged prostate. Respiratory.-—-Desire to take a deep breath. Breathing irregular, difficult; deep sighing. Cough, with raw, sore ‘feeling in chest. Expectoration sweetish. Dyspn@a. Senile pneumonia. Great weakness in chest. Cannot bear to talk, Weemoptysis with weak heart.

Heart. — The least movrment causes violent palpitation, and sensation as if it would cease beating, if he moves. [Opposite: Gris] Frequent stitches in heart. frregular heart, especially of mitral discase. Very slow pulse. Intermtts; weak. Cyanosis. Inequality of pulse; it varies. Sudden scnsetion as if heart siood still. Pulse weak, and quickened by least movement. Pericarditis, copious serous exudation. Extremities, -- Swelling of the feet. Fingers go to sleep easily. Coldness of hands and feet. Rheumatic pain in joints. Shining, white swelling of joints. Muscular debility. : Sleep.— Starts from sleep in alarm that he is falling fram a height. Continuous sleepiness. Fever, — Sudden flushes of heat, followed by great nervous weakness.

Skin. — Erythema, deep red, worse on back, like tneasles. Blue distended veins on lids, ears, lips and tongue. Dropsical. Itching and jaundiced.

Modalities. — Worse, when sitting erect, after meals and music, Better, when stomach is empty; in open air. Relationship. —- Antidotes: Camph.; Serpentaria, In- - compatible : Chine. Compare: Nerium odorum (re- *Wembles in heart effects Digitalis, but also has an action like Strychnia on spinal cord. Spasms appear more in upper part of body. Palpitation; weak heart will be strengthened by it. Lock-jaw). Adonis; Crategus (a true heart tonic); Kalmia; Spigel.; Apocym.; Liatris; Stropk. Compare also: Diyitoxinum (Digitalis dissolved in Chloroform; which has yellow vision very marked, and distressing nausea, aggravated by champagne and acrated waters.) Nitri. spir. dulc. increases action of Digit. Tchthystoxvin, Eel Serum. (Experiments show great analogy between the serum and the venom of vipera. Indicated whenever the systole of the heart is insufficient, decompensated valvular disease, irregular pulse duc to fibrillation of the auricle. Asytole, iceble, frequent, irregular pulse, dyspnea and scanty urine. Liver enlarged, dyspnoea, albuminuria. No cedema ) Convailaria (heart disease with vertigo and diyestive disturbances). Dose. -- The third to thirtieth attenuation wall bring about reaction when the drug is homeeapathically indicated; but for palliative purposes the physiological dosage is required. For this purpose, the tincture made from the fresh plant, in doses of five to fifteen drops, when the cardiac stimulation is desired, or the infusion of 1% per cent. Dose, one-half to one ounce if the diuretic action is wanted. The tincture may he given on sugar or bread, and nothing liquid be taken for twenty minutes before or after its administration.

remedies.name: Dioscorea Villosa
remedies.text:
(Wild Yam) As a remedy for many kinds of pain, especially colic. and in severe, painful affections of abdominal and pelvic viscera; it ranks with the polychrests of the Materia Medica. Persons of feeble digestive powers; teadrinkers, with much flatulence. Mind. -- Calls things by the wrong name.

Head. — Dull pain in both temples; better pressure, but worse afterwards, Buzzing in head, Stomach. — Belching of large quantities of offensive gas. Neuralgia of stomach. Sinking at the pit of the stomach; pyrosis. Pain along sternum and extending into arms. Eructations of sour, bitter wind, with hiccough. Sharp pain in epigastrium, relieved by standing erect. Abdomen, — Pains suddenly shift to different parts; appear in remote localities, as fingers and toes. Rumbiing, with emission of much flatus. Griping, cutting in hypogastric region, with intermittent cutting in stomach and small intestines. Colic; better walking about; Pains radiate from ahdotnen to back, chest, arms; worse, bending forwards and while lying. Gallstone colic. Sharp pams from liver, shooting upward to right nipple, Pain from gall-bladder to chest, back, and arms, Renal colic, with pain in extremities.

Heart. — Angina pectoris; pain back of sternum into arms; labored breathing; fecble action of heart. Especially with flatulence and pain through chest and tightness across. Rectum. —- Hemorrhoids, with darting pains to liver; look hke bunches of grapes or red cherries; protrude after stool, with pain in anus. Diarrhcea (worse in morning}, yellowish, followed by exhaustion, as 1t flatus and faces were hot, Male. -- Relaration and coldness of organs. Pains shoot into testicles from region of kidneys. Strongsmelliag sweat on scrotum and pubes. Emissions in sleep, Sr from sexual atony, with weak knees, Female, — Uterine colic; pains radtate from uterus, Vivid dreams, Respiratory. —~ Tight feeling all along sternum. Chest does not seem to expand on breathing. Shortwinded, Extremities. - Lameness in back; worse, stooping. Aching and stiffness in joints. Sciatica; pains shoot down thigh; worse, right side; better, when perfectly still. Felons i beginning, when pricking is first felt. Nails brittie. Cramps in flexors of fingers and toes.

Modalities. — Worse, evening and night, lying down, and doubling up. Better, standing erect, motion in open air; pressure, Relationship. — Antidotes: Chamom.; Camph. Compare: Colocy. (differs in modalities); Nux; Cham., Bry.

Dose. — Tincture, to third petency.

remedies.name: -diosma Lincaris
remedies.text: (Buku —from Cape of Good Hope) Pathogenically it produces: Somnolence; nervous insomnia; night sweats. Erratic pains, with bad humor, desire to weep or fear of sickness. Violent vertigo. Cephalalgia, chiefly frontal, radiating to the occiput. , Eyes brilliant, with lachrymation or itching, the conditions accompanied by a species of stupefaction, with hardness of hearing or noises from aural pressure. Earthy face with disseminated rosaceous eruption. Nausea, fetid breath, with sensation of emptiness. Sensation of meteorism, with stinging pains in the spleen. Painfut sensation in the abdomen, with pubic pressure —the pressure of the clothing becomes unsupportable, with emission of high-colored, bloody urine. Frequent yellow diarrhcea, worse at night. Catamenia abundant, anticipating, sometimes metrorrhagic in type; crampy pains on ingesting food. Sensation of heat or of cold in the hands, with convulsive movements of the fingers. Weakness of the legs, aggravated by sitting down. Clinically, this pathogeny should be useful in cerebral affections with dullness or stupefaction; in convulsive or epileptiform attacks; in Aysterta; in hepatitis (cirrhosis or a trophy); in hematuria with ovarian or uterine lesions. In splenitis, where it should surpass Ceanothus. Mental disorders in nervous or ascetic individuals, particularly where there is constant fear of death, or erotic or maniac attacks. Gastralyia. Gastroenteritis. Sudden fright, with trembling and weakness of the legs. (Dr. C. Leal La Rota.)

remedies.name: Diphtherinum
remedies.text:
(Potentized Diphtheritic Virus) Adapted to patients prone to catarrhal affections of respiratory organs, scrofufous individuals. Diphtheria, laryngeal diphtheria, post-diphtheritic paralysis. Malignancy from the start. Glands swollen; tongue red, swollen; breath and discharge very offensive. Diphtheritic membrane thick, dark. Epistaxis; profound prostration. Swallows without pain, but fluids are vomited or returned by the nose. : Relationship. — Compare: Diphtherotoxin (Cahis) (Chronic bronchitis with rales. Cartier suggests it in the vago-paralytic forms of Bronchitis of the aged or in toxic bronchitis after grip.) Dose. — Thirtieth, two-hundredth or C. M. potency. Must not be repeated too frequently. (Cowhage) wath right-sided medicine, with pronounced liver and skin symptoms. <A general intense itching without eruption, Exalted nervous sensibility. Senile pruritus. Hemorrhoidal diathesis.

Throat.— Pain in throat, worse swallowing, below right angle of jaw, as if splinter were imbedded vertically, Pain in gums prevents sleep, Abdomen. — Colic from getting feet wet. Constipation, with intense itching; bloated abdomen, White stools. Swelling of liver. Hemorrhoids, with burning sensation, Skin, —/utense itching, with no swelling ar rash; worse across shoulders, also about elbows and knees and hairy parts. Jaundice. Yellow in spots; itching excessively at night, Herpes zoster, [-47s.]

Modalities. — Morse, at night, scratching, right side.

Relationship.— Compare: Rhus; Bell; Hep; Ni ac,; Fagopyr.

Dose. — Sixth potency. Tincture, drop doses, in hemorrhoids,

remedies.name: Doryphora
remedies.text:
{Colorado Potato-bug) The center of this drug’s action seems to be in the urinary organs, and hence its employment in gonorrheea and gleet. Urethritis in children from loca! irritation and gleet. Great trembling in extremities. Prostration. Swelling of body. Burning sensation.

Urinary. — Difficult micturition. Urethra inflamed, with excruciating pain when urinating. Pain in back and Joins. Severe trembling in limbs, Relationship. — Antidote: Stram. Compare: Agar.; Apis; Canth.; Lach.; Coecion.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Drosera
remedies.text:
(Sundew) Affects markedly the respiratory organs and wa: pointed out by Hahnemann as the principal remedy fo1 whooping-cough. Laryngeal phthisis is benefited by it. Phthisis pulmonum; vomiting of food from cough ing with gastric irritation and profuse expectoration Pains about hip-joint. Tuberenlar glands.

Head. — Vertigo when walking in open air, with mclination to fall to the left side. Coldness of left half of face, with stinging pains and dry heat of right half.

Stomach. — Nausea. Aversion to and bad effects from acids, Respiratory Organs,—Spasmodic, dry irritative cough, like whooping-cough, the paroxysms following cach other very rapidly; can scarcely breathe; chokes. Cough very deep and hoarse; worse, after midnight; yellow expectoration, with bleeding from nose and mouth; retching. Deep, hoarse vore; hoarseness; laryngitis, Rough, scraping sensation deep in the fauces and soft palate. Sensation as if crumbs were in the throat, of feather in laryux. Laryngeal phthisis, with rapid emaciation. Harassing and titillating cough in chitdren—not at all through the day, but commences as soon as the head touches the pillow at night. Clyyeyman’s sgre throat, with rough, scraping, dry sensation deep in the fauces; voice hoarse, deep, toneless, cracked, requires exertion to speak. Asthma when ialking, with contraction of the throat at every word uttered. .

Extremities.— Paralytic pains in the coxo-femoral joigt and thighs. Stiffness in joints of feet. All limbs feqt lame. Bed feels too hard, Fever. — Internal chilliness; shivering, with hot face, cold hands, no thirst. Is always too cold, even in bed. Modalities. —~ Worse, after midnight, lying down, on getting warm in bed, drinking, singing, laughing, Relationship. — Antidote. Cansph. Compare: Fisoroform 2 per cent. watery solution, 2-4 drops, after paroxysms, considered specific for whooping-cough. Chelid.; Corall.; Cupr.; Castanea; Argent.; Menyanth.

Dose. — First to twelfth attennation.

remedies.name: Duboisia
remedies.text:
(Corkwood Elm) Acts chiefly on the nervous system, eyes, upper respiratory tract. Recommended in pharyngitis sicca, with black, stringy mucus. It dilates the pupil, dries the mouth, checks perspiration, causes headache and drowsiness, On the eye it acts more promptly than Atropia, much stronger as a mydriatic. Red spot floats in the field of vision. Sensation as if stepping on empty space. Vertigo with pale face; rot gastric in origin. Scarlet fever; locomotor ataxia.

Mind. — Absent-minded, incoherent, silly and nonsenstcal, memory impaired. Head, — impossible to stand with eyes shut, tendency to fall backwards.

Eyes. — Conjunctivitis, acute and chronic. Mydriasis, Paralysis of accommodation. Hyperzmia of retina with weakness of accommodation, fundus red, blood-vessels full and tortuous; pupils dilated, with dim vision. Pain over eye, between it and brow, Respiratory, — Larynx dry, voice hoarse, phonation difficult. Dry cough with oppressed breathing, Extremities. — Loss of power in limbs, staggers; feels as if he stepped on empty space. Trembling, numbness and weakness.

Relationship.— Has been used as a substitute for Atropia in doses of 1-80 to 1-20 of a grain hypodermically. Antidotes: Morphia; Ptlocarp. Compare: Beliad.; Stram.; Hyos. Dose, — Third to twelfth potency.

remedies.name: Dulcamara
remedies.text:
(Bitter-sweet) Hot days and cold nights towards the close of summer are especially favorable to the action of Dulcamara, and is one of the remedies that correspond in their symptoms to the conditions found as effects of damp weather, colds after exposure to wet, especially diarrhea. it has a specific relation also to the séin, glands, and digestive organs, mucous membrancs secreting more profusely while the skin is inactive. The ricematic troubles induced by damp cold are aggravated by every cold change and somewhat relieved by moving about. Results from sitting on cold, damp ground. One-sided spasms with speechlessness. Paralysis of single parts. Congestive headache, with neuralgia and dry nose. Patients living or working in damp, cold Lasements. [Nat. sufph.} Eruptions on hands, arms or face around the menstrual period.

Head.— Mental confusion. Occipital pain ascending from nape of neck. Headache relieved by conversation, Rejects things asked for. Back part of head chilly, heavy, aching, during cold weather. Ringworm of scalp. Scaldhead, thick brown crusts, bleeding when scratched. Buzzing in head. Nose.—- Dry coryza. Complete stoppage of nose. Stuffs up when there ts a cold rain. Thick, yellow mucus, bloody crusts. Profuse coryza. Wants nose kept warm, least cold air stops the nose. Coryza of the new born.

Eyes. — Every time he takes cold it settles in eyes. Thick, yellow discharge; granular lids. NHay-fever; profuse, watery discharge, worse in open air.

Ears. — Earache, buzzing, stitches, and swelling of parotids. Middle-ear catarrh [Merc. dulc.; Kal. sur.) Face.— Tearing in cheek extending to ear, orbit, and jaw, preceded by coldness of parts, and attended by canine hunger. Humid eruption on cheeks and face generally. . Mouth — Saliva tenacious, soapy. Dry, rough tongue, rough scraping in throat, after taking cold in damp weather. Cold-sores on lips. Facial neuralgia; worse, slightest exposure to cold.

Stomach. — Vomiting of white, tenacious mucus. Aversion to food, Burning thirst for cold drinks, Heartburn. Nausea accompanies the desire for stool. Chilliness during vomiting. Abdomen. -- Colic from cold. Acts prominently on umbilical region. Cutting pain about navel. Swelling of inguinal glands. [Aderc.] Stool, — Green, watery, slimy, bloody, mucus, especially in summer, when the weather suddenly becomes cold; from damp, cold weather and repelled eruptions.

Urine. — Must urinate when getting chilled. Strangury, painful micturition. Catarrh of bladder from taking cold. Urine has thick, purulent sediment. Ischvria from wading with bare feet in cold water. Female.—- Suppression of menses from cold or dampness. Before appearance of menses, a rash appears on skin, or sexual excitement. Dysmenorrhca, with blotches all over; mammez engorged and sore, delicate, sensitive to cold. - Respiratory.— Cough worse cold, wet weather, with free expectoration, tickling in larynx. Cough, hoarse, spasmodic. Whooping-cough, with excessive secretion of mucus. Winter coughs, dry, teasing. Asthma with dyspnoea. Loose, rattling cough; worse wet weather. Must congh a long time to expel phlegm.

Back. — Stiff neck. Pain in small of back, as after long stooping. Stiffness and lameness across neck and shoulders, after getting cold and wet.

Extremities. — Paralysis: paralyzed limbs, fect scy cold. Warts on hands. Perspiration on palms of hands. Pain in shin-bores, Rheumatism alternates with diarrhea, Rheumatic symptoms after acute skin eruptions.

Skin. — Adenités. Pruritus, always worse in cold, wet weather, Herpes zoster, pemphigus, Swelling and indurated glands from cold. Vesicular eruptions, Sensitive bleeding ulcers. Little boils. Red spots, urticaria, brought on by exposure, or sour stomach. Humid eruptions on face, genitals, hands, etc, Warts, large, smooth, on face and palmar surface of hands. Anasarca. Thick, brown-yellow crusts, bleeding when scratched, Fever. — Dry burning heat all over. Chilliness towards evening, mostly in back. Icy coldness, with pains. Dry heat and burning of skin. Chilliness with thirst. Modalities, — Worse, at night; from cold in general, damp, rainy weather. Better, from moving about, external warmth Relationship. -- Antidotes: Camph.; Cupr. €omplementary: Baryte card, Incompatible: Bellad.; Laches, Compare: Pimpinelfo (lumbago and stiff neck; pain from nape to shoulder; chilliness), Rhus; Cimicif.; Cale.; Puls.; Bry.; Nat. sulph. Dose. ~ Second to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Echinacea
remedies.text:
(Purple Cone-flower) Symptoms of blood poisoning, septic conditions generally, Diarrhea in typhoid. Gonorrhea. Boils. Erystpelas and foul ulcers, Gangrene, Goitre with exophthalmic symptoms. Tendency to malignancy in acute and subacute disorders. J-ast stages of catcer to ease pain, Venom infection, Cerebrospinal meningitis. Puerpera! infections, Tired feeling. Files, Pustules. Acts of vermiform appendix thus has been used for appendicitis, but remember it promotes suppuration and a neglected appendicitis with pus formation would probably rupthre sooner under its use. Lymphatic inflammation; crushing injuries. Snake bites and bites and stings generally. Foul discharges with emaciation and great debility.

Head. — Confused, depressed, Aches with a peculiar periodical flushing of the face, even to the neck; dizziness and profound prastration.

Nose. — Foul-smelling discharge, membraneous formations protruding. Post-nasal catarrh with ulceration and fetor. Nose feels stuffed up. Right nostril raw, bleeding.

Mouth. — Canker; gums recede and bleed easily; corners of mouth and lips crack; tongue dry and swollen; sores; dirty brownish. Tongue, lips, and fauces tingle, with sense of fear about heart. [Acon.] White coating of tongue, with red edges. Promotes the flow of saliva.

Throat. — Tonsils purple or black, gray exudation extending to posterior nares and air-passages. Ulcerated sore throat.

Stomach. — Sour belching and heartburn, Nausea; better lying down.

Chest.— Pain as of a lump in chest and under sternum. Pain in pectoral muscles. [Aristolochia.]

Urine. — Albuminous, scanty, frequent, and involvntary, Female.—- Puerperal septicemia; discharges suppressed; abdomen sensitive and tympanitic.

Extremities. — ching in limbs and general lassitude.

Skin.— Recurring boils. Carbuncles. I rritations from insect Lites and poisonous plants. Lymphatics enlarged. Old tibial ulcers.

Fever. — Chilliness, with nausea. Caid flashes all over hack, Malarial fever. Relationship. -- Compare: Cenchris centortriz; Bothrops; Ars.; Loches.; Bapiis.; Rhus; Cistus; Hepar; Calendula. Dose.—- Tincture, one to five drops, every two hours, and larger doses. Locally, as a cleansing and antiseptic wash.

remedies.name: Elaps Corallinus
remedies.text:
(Coral-snake) Similar to snake-poisons generally. Has very marked black discharges. Cold things disagree. Desire for sweetened buttermilk, Nausea and vomiting. Prostrating diarrhea of consumption. Acidity of stomach, with faint feeling. Sudden pain in stomach. Spasm of esophagus; pharynx constricted; food and liquids suddenly arrested, and then fail heavily into stomach. Spasms followed by paresis. Cold feeling in stomach. Fruits and ice-water lie very cold. Right-sided paralysis. Must have oscillatory motion. Rheumatic constitutions.

Mind. — Depressed; imagines he hears someone talking: dreads to be left alone. Fear of rain, Can speak, but cannot understand speech.

Head. — Violent headache, extending from forchead to occiput. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Weight and pain in forehead.

Eyes. — Aversion to light; letters run together when reading. Veil before eyes. Burning in lids. Bloated around the eyes in the morning. Ears, —Cerumen flack and hard, with dificult hearing, or serous greenish discharge, offensive; buzzing, and illusion of hearing. Sudden attack of nightly deafness, with roaring and crackling in ears. Chronic otorrhea. Deufness, noises in ears, cracking in ears on swallowing.

Nose. — Chronic nasal catwrh, with fetid odor and greenish crusts. Ozana; ycllowish-green discharge. Mucous membrane wrinkled; nostrils plugged up with dry mucus. Pains from nose to ears on swallowing. Nostrils stopped up. Nasal bleeding. Pain at root of nose, Eruption about nose. . Throat, — Thick, very offensive, dry, greenish-yellow crusts upon the posterior pharyngeal wall and extremely foul breath. Spasmodic contraction of cesophagus. . Chest.—Coldness in chest ofter drinking, Hamorrhage from lungs black as ink and watery; stitches in apex of right lung. Fainting caused by stooping. Oppression in going unstairs. Peeling off of skin from palms and fingers. Cough, with terrible pain through lungs. Worse right and expectoration of black blood. Sensation of a sponge in cesophagus, Stomach, — Fecis cold. Sensation as if food turned like a corkscrew on swallowing; desire for sweetened buttermilk, Acidity after every mouthful.

Female. — Dysmenorrhoza, with black blood. Discharge of black blood between menses. Itching of vulva and vagina, Sleep. —- Dreams about dead persons.

Skin. — Glands and skin of axille affected; itching with tetter. Tips of fingers peel off. Extremities, — Icy cold feet. Vesicular eruptions on fect. Arms and hands swollen bluish. Knee-joints feel sprained. Pricking wnder the nails.

Fever.— Cold perspiration all over. Typhoid when ulcers have eaten into tissues, and black blood is discharged.

Relationship. — Compare: Kino — Eucalyptus rostrata {offensive dark discharge from right ear); Crotalus; Alumen; Carbo; Ars.; Lach.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Elaterium
remedies.text:
(Squirting Cucumber) This is an invaluable remedy in violent vomiting and purging, especially if the evacuations are copious and watery. It is a very efficient remedy in certain forms of dropsy, Much yawning and stretching. Beriberi; choleraic conditinns; urticaria and mental disorders coming on as a consequence of suppressed majaria. Irresistible desire to wander from home at night. Effects of damp weather. Stomach, — Nausea and vomiting, with great weakness, Griping pains in bowels.

Stool.— Watery, copious, furceful. Squirting diarrhaa; frothy, olive green, with cutting mm abdomen. Extremities, — Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs, knees, toes, and instep. Gouty pain in great toes. Pain extends down extreinities; pain in hip-joints with diarrhea. Arthritic nodules, Skin. —- Smarts, stngs, and burns, Dropsical. Urticarta front suppressed intermittent. Skin, orange color.

Fever.— Chill comes on with much yarsting oid sirctching, lasting all through chill, Pain in extremities, darting into fingers and tues, Chills and fever, with spurting diarrhcea.

Modalities. — Worse, irom exposure on damp ground.

Relationship. — Compare: Bry.; Croton; Gambogia.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency, As a hydragogue cathartic to produce free discharge in dropsies, Eiaterin 1-20 of a grain. Palliative only.

remedies.name: Epigea Repens
remedies.text:
(Trailing Arbutus) Chronic cystitis, with ¢ysuria; tenesmus after micturition; muco-pus and uric-actd deposit, gravel, renal calculi, Fine sand in urine of a brown cofer. Burning in neck of bladder whilst urinating and tenesmus afterward. Pyelitis, incontinence of urine. Relationship,—-Compare: Uva; Chimaph.; Lye.; Pareira. Epigea contains Arbutin, also Formic acid.

Dose. — ‘Tincture in 5-drop doses every three*hours, (Beechdrop) A remedy for sick, neurasthenic, and nervous headaches, especially in women, brought on or made worse by exertion, shopping, etc. Tongue coated yellow; bitter taste. Drowsy after meals. Loose stools. Sudinvolution, with pamful menstruation and congestion. Head, — Pressing pain in temples from without inwards; worse, left side. Viscid salivation; constant inclination to spit. Sick headache coming on when deviating from ordinary pursuits. Headaches from nerve tire caused by mental or physical exhaustion, preceded by hunger, Modalities. —JFerse, from working in open air. Better, from sleep.

Relationship. — Compare: Jris; Melilot,; Sanguinar. Fagus — Beech-nuts — (headache and salrvation; swelling of mouth; diead uf water}. Dose, — First to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Equisetum
remedies.text:
(Scouring-rush) Principal action on the bladder, A remedy for enuresis and dysuria, Urinary. —- Severe, dull pain in bladder, not relieved oy urinating. Frequent urging with severe pain af the close of urination, Urine flows only drop by drop. Sharp, burning, cutting pain in urethra while urinating Incontinence in children, with dreams or night-mares when passing urine. Incontinence in old women, also with involuntary stools. Retention and dysuria during ptegnancy and after delivery. Much mucus in urine. Albuminuria Involuntary urination.

Kidney. — Deep pain in region of right kidney, extending to lower abdomen, with urgent desire to micturate. Right lumbar region painful.

Modalities. — }Vorse, right side; movement, pressure, touch, sitting down; better, in afternoon from lying down. Relationship, — Compare: Ferr, phus.; Apis; Canth.; Linaria; Chimaph. Eyuisitum contains silica, Dose. — Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Erechtites
remedies.text:
(Fire-weed) A hemorrhagic remedy. Epistaxis of bright hlood, Hemorrhage from any part, especially lungs; always attended by excitement of the circulation, Flashes of heat and coldness.

Skin. — Symptoms like Rhus poisoning. Relationship.—- Compare: FErig.; Miullef.:; Hamai.; Rhus.

Dose.— Tincture, Lotally for Poison Oak, (Fleabane) Hemorrhages are caused and cured by this remedy, Persistent hemorrhage from the bladder. Hemorrhage from the uterus, with painful micturition. Profuse bright-red blood. Pain in leit ovary and hip. Chronic gonorrhea, with burning micturition; continual dribbling. Dysentery, with soreness and burning in bladder. Tympanites, Female. -~ Metorchagia, with violent irritation of rectum and bladder, and prolapsus uteri. Bright-red flow. Menorrhagia; profuse leucorrheea; bloody lochia returns after least motion, comes in gushes; between periods, Irucorrhaca with urinary irritation; pregnant women with “weak uterus;” a bloody discharge on slight exertion. Bleeding hemorrhoids; nosehleed instead of menses. [#ry.]

Modalities. — Worse, leit side. Relationship. —- Terebinthina stmilar.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency. Oil of Erigeron 1X internally for tympanites. An enema of one dram of the oil with the yolk of an egg and pint of milk will reduce the most enormous tympanites,

remedies.name: Eriodyction
remedies.text:
(Yerba Santa) A remedy for asthmatic aud bronchial affections. Bronchial phthisis. with night-sweats and emaciation, Asthma relieved hy expectoration. Cough after inflrenca. Furthers reabsorption of effusion in piural cavity.

Head. — Dizzy, feels intoxicated. Pressure outwards; worse, occiput. Pain in ears. Coryza. Burning in throat. Fou) mouth in morning. Coryza with dizziness and sneezing.

Respiratory. — Wheezing; asthma, with coryza and amucous secretions. Dull pain in right lung. Burning in fauces.

Male. — Sorc. dragging in testicle, could not bear any pressure; better yeutle support. Relationship. —-Compare: Grind.; Aral.; Eucalyp.; Ipec. Dose. -— Tincture and first attenuation.

remedies.name: Eryngium Aquaticum
remedies.text:
{Button Snake-root) A temedy for urinary disorders. Stranguary, etc., with nervous erethism, Thick, yellow tucous discharges, Influenza. Uridrosis, sweat of urinous odor in evening, Respiratory. -— Congh, with sense of constriction. Smarting in throat and larynx, Urinary. -- Tenesmus of bladder and urethra. Difficult and frequent micturition, Pain behind pubes. Spasmodic stricture. Renal colic. ([Pareira, Cale.) Congestion of kidneys with dull pain in back, running down the ureters and limbs. Irritalle bladder from enlarged prostate gland, or from pressure of uterus.

Male. — Discharge of prostatic fluid from slight causes, Seminal emissions without erections, with lassitude, [Dioscor.; Phos. ac.]

Relationship. — Compare: Contum: Cannab.; Dios. ; Ocim.; Ciemat. Dose. ~- Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Eucalyptus Globulus
remedies.text:
(Blue Gum-tree) A remedy with marked effects on catarrhal processes, malaria, and intestinal disturbance. Influence, Fevers of a relapsing character. Produces diuresis and great increase of urea. Haemorrhages internally and locally. [Hamam.] Typhoid. Symptoms of exhaustion and toxemia. Conditions of the mucous surfaces of the air passages, genito-urinary organs and gastro-intestinal tract. A gastro-intestinal irritant with pain iri stomach and upper intestines several hours after eating. Head —~ Exhilaration, Desire for exercise. Dull congestive headache. Caryza; sore throat. Eyes smart and burn. Nose, -— Stuffed-up sensation; thin, watery coryza; tightness acrass bridge. Chronic catarrhal, purulent and fetid discharge, Ethmoid and frontal sinus involved. Throat,-— Relaxed, aphthous condition of mouth and throat. Excessive secretion of saliva. Burns, feels full. Constant sensation of phlegm in throat Enlarged, ulcerated tonsils and inflamed throat. (Use tincture locally.) Stomach. — Slow digestion. Much fetid gas. Beating and goneness with pulsation im epigastric arteries. Spleen hard and contracted.

Abdomen. — Acute diarrhaw. Aching pains in bowels with feeling of impending diarrhea. Dysentery, with rectal heat; tenesmus; hemorrhage, Diarrhea; stools thin, watery, preceded by sharp pains. Typhoid diarthea, .

Urinary.— Acute nephritis complicating influcnza, Hematuria. Suppurative inflammation of kidneys. Urine contais pus and is deficient in urea. Bladder feels loss of expulsive force. Burning and tenesmus; catarrh of bladder; diuresis; urethral caruncic.

Respiratory. — Asthma, with great dyspnea and palpitation, Moist asthma. Expectoration white, thick mucus. Bronchitis in the aged. Bronchorrheea. [Bals. Peru.| Profuse expectoration of offensive muco-pus. Irritative cough. Whooping-cough in rachitic children. Fetid form of bronchitis, bronchial dilatation and emphysema.

Female. — Leucorrheea, acrid, fetid. Ulcer around orifice of urethra. Extremities.—-Rheumatic pains; worse at night, walking or carrying anything. Stiff, weary sensation. Pricking sensation, followed by painful aching. Nodular swellings over metacarpai and metatarsal joints.

Skin. — Glandular enlargetnents and nodular swelling over joints. Foul and indolent ulcers. Herpetic eruptions. Fever, — Elevation of temperature. Continued and typhoid fevers. Scarlet fever (protective and curative.) Discharges show a tendency to foulness, high temperature, accelerated jut not strong puise. Use the tincture.

Relationship. — Compare: Hucalyptus — tereticoris (menstrual cough and prostration). Lucalypiol (depresses temperature of healthy body more than Quinine: acts on kidneys like Terchinth.) ; Iydrast.; Kali sulpa. Eucalyptus newtralizes ill effects of Sirychnin. Angophora — Red Gum — (dysentery, pains, tenesmus; better lying flat on face; obstinate constipation). Eucalyptus rostrata — Kino.

Dose. — Tincture, and lower potencies. Also Oil of Eucaiyptus in five-drop doses. The volatile wil possesses, in common with other terpenes, the property of converting water, in presence of air and sunhght, into hydrogen peroxide, or to cenvert oxygen into ozone, which is the explanation usually given of its deodorizing and antiseptic propertics. (Merrell.) Locally, in catarrhal affections, especially when of a suppurating or putrid nature, In cough, give tincture in syrup of Toh. (Rose-apple) Eugenia produces a state of intoxication like alcohol, Everything appears beautiful and larger; excitement soon changing to depression. Acne, simple and indurated. The pimples are painful for some distance around. Acne rosacea. Nausea; bettcr smoking. Comedoses.

Head. — Headache as if a board were lying on right side. Talkative. Mot lachryimation.

Extremities.— Nightly cramp im soles of feet. [Cupr.; Zing.) Skin cracks about toes, Fissures between toes. Skin recedes from the nails, forming pus.

Relationship. — Compare: Eugenia chckun — Myrtus chekan (chronic Bronchitis}; Antim.; Berd. aguif,

remedies.name: Euonymus Atropurpurea
remedies.text:
(Wahoo. Burning Bush) Brunettes more easily affected, producing headache, mental disturbances and much distress in hepatic and renal region; alvumiuuria. Migraine. Passive Cungestien and torpor of liver — chronic catarrhal affections of stomach and intestines, — Weak heart.

Mind. — Menta} confusion, despondent, irritable; loss of memory, unable to recall familiar names, Head.— Heavy frontal headache. Sore, tired feeling; bruised fecling of scalp. Pain over right eye extending back through the head. Bilious headache; coated tongue, bad taste, constipation. Vertigo, obscure vision and gastric derangement, associated with albumunuria, Stomach, — Mouth dry, pasty taste; thirsty, stomach full and uncomfortable.

Abdomen. — Flatus and pain. Anus very sore and burning. Constipation with hemorrhoids and severe backache. Diarrhoea; stools variable and profuse, bloody. Fain about umbilical region, Urinary.— Urine scanty, high-volored; acidity incggased, poured out rapidly.

Back. — Dall pain hetween shoulders and about renal and splenic region; pain in lumbar region better Iving down.

Extremities. — Aching in all joints, especially ankles. Feet feet swollen and tired. Modalities, — Better cool draught, pressure. Worse evening.

Relationship. — Exonymus Liuropawa — Spindle-trec (Liver disorders, liliousness, lumbago, gastric deranyements with albuminuria. Cutting pains in matar bones, tongue, penis up to bladder); Podophyl; stmmon. pic.; Chel; Evorymin ix trit. (albuminuria}, Dose. — Tincture aud lower attenuations,

remedies.name: Eupatorium Aromaticum
remedies.text:
(Pool-root) Nervous erethism; resilessness and morbid watchfulness. Hysteria and chorea, Low fevers, with extreme restlessness. Aphtious disease. Sore nipples. Sore mouth in infants. Vomiting of bile, pain in stomach, headache, and fever.

Relationship. — l/yosc.; Passifior.; Hydr. mur.

Dose. — Tincture, locally, in sore mouth and sore nipples. Internally, tincture to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Eupatorium Perfoliatum
remedies.text:
(Thoroughwort) Known as “Bone-set,” from the prompt manner in which it relieves pain in limbs and muscles that accompanies some forms of febrile disease, like malaria and influenza. Eupatorium acts principally upon the gastrohepatic organs and bronchial mucous membrane. It is a boon in miasmatic districts, along rivers, marshes, etc., and in all conditions where there is a great deal of bone-pain. Cachexia from old chronic, bitions intermittents. Worn-out constitutions from inebrity. Slugxishness of all organs and fwnctions. Bone-pains, general and severe. Soreness. Marked periodicity. [.4rs.: China; Cedron.) Head. — Throbbing pain. Pressure as if a cap of lead pressed over the whole skull. Vertigo; sensation of falling to feft. Vomiting of hile. Top and back of head with pain and soreness of eyeballs, Periodical headache, every third and seveuth day. Occipital pain after lying doum, with sense of weight. Mouth. ~— Cracks in corners of mouth, yellow coated longue, thirst. Stomach, — Tongue yellow, Taste bitter, Hepatic region sore, Great thirst. Vomiting and purging of hile, of green liyuid several quarts at a time. Vomiting preceded by thirst. Hiccough. | Sulph. ac., Ilydrocy. ae.) Avoids tight clathing. Stool, — Frequent, green, watery. Cramps, Consti-~ pated, with sore liver. Respiratory.—- Coryza, with sneezing. foarsencss and cough, with soreness in chest; must support it. /sfluencsa, with great soreness of muscles and hones. Chronic loose cough, chest sore; worse at night. Cough relieved by getting on hands and knees.

Fever. — Perspiration relieves all symptoms except headache. Chil! between 7 and 9 a. “4, preceded by thirst with great soreness and aching of bones, Nausea, vomiting of bile at close of chill or hot stage; throbbing headache. Knows chill is coming on becanse he cannot drink envugh.

Extremities. — Aching pain w back. Aching in bones of extremilics with sorencss of flesh. Aching in arms and wrists. Sweliing of left great toe. Gouty soreness and inflammed nodosities of joints, associated with headache. Dropsical swelling.

Modalities. — forse, periodically. Beiter, by conversation, by getting on hands and knees, Relationship. — Compare: Bryon. ; Sepia.; Natr. mur. ; Chelidon, Nyctanthes arbor-tristis (bilious fever; insatiable thirst; bitter vomiting at close of chill; also constipation of children). [(Collinson.] Dose, — Tincture, to third attenuation,

remedies.name: Eupatorium Purpureum
remedies.text:
(Queen of the Meadow) Albuminuria, diabetes, strangury, irritable bladder, enlarged prostate are a special field for this remedy. Excellent in renal dropsy. Chills and pains run upwards. Impotency and sterility. Homesickness.

Head. — Left-sided headache with vertigo. Pain from left shoulder to occiput. Sick headache beginning in morning, worse afternoon and evening, worse in cold xiv.

Urinary. — Deep, dull pain in kidneys. Burning in bladder and urethra on urinating. Insufficient flow; milky. Strangury. Hamaturia. Constant desire; biadder feels dull, Dysuria. Vesical irrttability in women. INiabetes instpidus.

Back.— Weight and heaviness in loins and back.

Female. — Pain around left ovary. Threatened abortion. External genitals feel as though wet.

Fever.— No thirst during chill, but much frontal ache. Chill commences in back. Violent shaking, with comparatively little coldness. Bone-pains, Relationship. — Compare: Senecio; Cannadb, sat. ;. Helon.: Phos. ac.; Triticum; Epigea.

Dose. — First potency.

remedies.name: Euphorbia Lathyris
remedies.text:
(Gopher-Plant) The symptoms puint to its use in erysipelas, Poisonoak, whooping-cough. Rheumatic pains during rest. Paralytic weakness in joints.

Mind. — Delirium and hallucinations. Stupor, coma.

Eyes. — Almost closed from adema of lds. Nose, — End of nose very much inflamed externally. Very sensitive and ademutous mucous membranes with ulceration, Face.— At first ruddy glow on cheeks, afterwards death-like pallor. Cold perspiration in beads on forehead. Red, puffed, and in spots suppuratmg. Erythema, beginning on face, gradually extending into the hairy parts, and then spreading over whole hody, taking aight days to do so; eruption glossy, rough, edemafous, with burning and smarting; aggravated by touch and cold air; ameliorated by close room aud sweet-oil applications. Fine bran-like desquamation. Scnsation of cobwebs. Stinging, smatting, and barning of face when touched. Mouth, — Tongue coated, slimy; acrid taste. Breath cold, musty odor. Stomach.-~ Nausea and vomiting of copious clear water, intermingled with white, gclatinous lumps. Stool.—~ Drastic purgation from large doses; mild laxative condition from smaller doses; followed sevcral weeks afterwards by obstinate constipation. Stools of white, transparent, gelatinous mucus; later mingled with blood. Urine. ~ Copious flow of urine.

Male. — Infiammation of serotum, resulting in deep acrid ulcers, with intense itching and burning; worse, touching the parts from washing.

Respiratory.— Labored breathing. Breath cold, musty oder, Cough; first, a hacking, as from inhaiation of sulphur; later on, paroxysmal, like whoopingcough, in regular paroxysms, ending in diarrhea and vomiting, with sleepiness between each paroxysm.

Heart.— Weak and fluttering heart-action. Pulse 120, full, botmnding, somewhat irregalar. Sleep, — Restlessness at night. Sleep disturbed, anxious dreams.

Fever. — Temperature increased. Body bathed in profuse perspiration, standing out like beads on forehead; later, coid, clammy perspiration on forehead, Skin. — Es ythema, beginning on uncovered parts, on face, and spreading over whole body: glossy, rough, eedematous, with buraing and smarting. Fine bran-like desquamation following in the wake of the erythema. Eruption roth, scaly, smarting, and burning; when scratched forms deep, ragged ulcers; skin where ulcerated remaws red. Modalities. -~ !#orse, touch and cold air; Beller, chose raom and sweet-oil application.

Relationship. — Antidoted hy Khus tox, (skin symptoms); Feratr. alb. (vomiting, purging, cough and coma).

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency,

remedies.name: Euphorbium
remedies.text:
(Spurge — The Resinous Juice of Euphorbia Resinifera) An irritant to the skin and mucous membranes. Burning pain in bones, Pains in limbs and paralytic weakness in the joints. Important respiratory and skin symptoms. Terrible burning pains. Pains of cancer. Everything appears larger than it really is, Head. — Acute mania, Violent, pressive headache. Face,— Erysipelas; yellow blisters. Burning in cheek ; worse, left. Eyes inflammed and agglutinated in morning. Red swelling of cheeks. Nasal pruritus with mucous secretions from naso-pharynx. Stomach, — Great hunger. Sialorrheea (profuse salty saliva). Waterbrash. Thirst for cold drinks.

Abdomen. — Sunken; spasmodic, flatulent — colic. Stonts fermented, profuse, clayey. Feels hollow.

Respiratory. — Breathing oppressed, as if chest were not wide enough. Spasmodic, dry cough, day and night, with asthma. Violent, fluent coryza, with burning and cough, Constant cough, with stitches from pit ot stomach to sides of chest. Croup, dry, hollow, cough. Warm feeling in chest. as if hot food had heen swallowed.

Extremities. — Paralytic pams. Pain in bip-joint and coceyx.

Skin. — Erysipelatous inflammation, especially of the cheek, Biting and stinging, red, swolfen. Vesicular erysipelas, Carbuncle: old, torpid, indolent ulcers with liting, lancinating pain. Old torpid ulcer. pustules; wangrene, [Echinac.; Secale.) Ulcerating carcinoma and epitheliama of the skin.

Relationship. — Compare: Euphorbia amygdaloides — Wood Spurge (in pain in antrum, illusion of smell, odor of mice. Sense of taste blunted. Diarrhoea; stools dificult, with painful anal spasm). Euphorbia corollata— Large Flowering Spurge (in gastro-enteric disturbance, with deathly nausea. Vomiting of food, water, and mucus, and copious evacuations. Attacks recur after short intermissions. Feeling of clawing in stomach; cold sweat). (Verat. alb.) Euphorbia Cyparissias — (Intense action on skin; burning and itching with sensation of chilliness. Mere contact with the leaves produces these symptoms,) Euphorbia heteredoxa — Alvetos (alleviates the burning pains of cancer). Euphorbia pilulifera — Pillbearing Spurge — (Humid asthma, cardiac dyspnoea, hay-fever, and bronchitis. Urethritis, with intense pain on urinating, and much urging. <Acrid leucorrheea; worse feast movesnent. Hamorrhages from sunstroke and traumatism). Compare, also: Psoralea—A Columbian plant — (Pain of cancer, vleers. Leucorrhea fetid. Pruritus. Uterine tumors.) Croton; Jatropha; Colchic, Antidotes: Caemph.; Opium. Dose. --- Third to sixth potency.

remedies.name: Euphrasia
remedies.text:
(Eyebright) Manifests itself in inflaming the conjunctival membrane especially, producing profuse lachrymation. Patient is better in open air. Catarrhal affections of mucous membranes especially of eyes and nose. Profuse arrid lachrymation and bland coryza; worse. evening. Indolent and hypochondriaral, Head.— Bursting headache with dazzling of eyes, Catarrhal headache, with profuse discharge from eyes and nose, .

Nose. — Profuse, fluent corysa, with violent cough and abundant expectoration.

Eyes. — Catarrkal conjunctivitis; discharge of acrid matter. The eyes water all the time. Acrid lachrymation: bland coryza. [Opposite: Cepa.] Discharge thick and excoriating. [Mercur. thin and acrid] Burning and swelling of the lids. Frequent inclination to blink, Free discharge of acrid matter. Sticky mucus on cornea; must wink to remove it. Pressure in eyes. Little blisters on cornea. Opacities. Rheumatic iritis. Ptosis. [Gels.; Caust.] ; Face, — Redness and heat of cheeks. Stiffness of upper lip.

Stomach. — Vomiting from hawking mucus, Nausea and bitterness after smoking. Rectum, — Dysentery. Prolapse ani. Pressure down in anus when sitting. Constipation, Female, — Menses painful; flow fasts only an hour or day; late, scanty, short. Amscnorrheca, with ophthalsmia.

Male. — Spasmodic retraction of genitals, with pressure ahove pubic bone. Condyloma and sycotic excrescences. Prostatitis, Nocturnal irritability of biadder; dribbling urine.

Respiratory. — Frequent yawning when walking in open air. Profuse, fluent coryza in morning, with much cough and expectoration. Influenza. Gags when clearing the throat iu morning. Whooping-cough onty in day-time, with profuse lachrymation, Skin. — First stage of measles: eye symptoms marked. Consequence of external injuries, Sleep. — Yawning when walking in open air. Sleepy during day, Fever. -- Chilly and cold. Sweat mostly on chest, at night during sleep, Modalities. — Worse, in evening, indoors, warmth; south winds; from light. Better, from coffee, in dark.

Relationship. — Antidotes: Campk.; Puls. Compare: Hydrophylism — Burr-flower ~ (catarrhal inflammation of cyes; hot lachrymation with itching, swollen lids, dull headache; also for effects of Poison-Oak); Cepa: Ars; Gels.: Kati hyd.; Sabadiila.

Dose. — Third to s:xth potency,

remedies.name: Eupion
remedies.text:
(Wood-tar distillation) Marked female symptoms, and backache. A remedy far uterine displacements, Pain iu back, followed by a Mland leucorrhawa. Menses teo early and copious; flow thin. Jntense sweat from slightest exertion, Disgusting dreams, Sensation as if whole body were made ot jelly.

Head. — Vertigo; everything turns round on sitting up in bed. Heat at vertex; stitches from vertex down limbs into abdomen and genitals. Sore painful spots en head. Painful pulsation in forehead. Female, .—~ Burning in right ovary. Gushing leucorrhaa, Chronic tubal disease. Uterine flexions, Menses too carly and copious. During menses, irritable and disinclined to talk: burning and stitches in chest and heart. After menses, ycilow lexcorrhas, with severe backache. When pain in back ceases, the discharge gushes out. Sore paiu between labia during urination. Pruritus pudendi; labia swollen. Extremities. -- Cramps in the calves; worse at night.

Back. — Sacrum pains, as if broken, Severe backache; must lean against something for support. Pains extended into pelvis.

Relationship. — Kreosot.; Graph.; Lach.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Fagopyrum
remedies.text:
(Buckwheat) Its action on the skin, producing pruritus, is very marked. Visible pulsation of arteries. Fluent coryza. Offensive excretions. Itching erythema. Pruritus senilis. Post-nasal catarrh; dry crusts, granular appearance of posterior narcs with itching.

Head. — Inability to study or remember. Depressed and irritable. Itching of eyes and ears. Pains deep in head, with upward pressure. Itching in and around eyes and ears. Head hot, better bending backward, with tired neck. Occipital headache. Bursting pains.

Nose. — Sore, red, inflammed. Fluent coryza, with sneezing, followed by dryness and crust jormation. Eyes. —/tching and smarting, swelling, heat and soreneéss.

Throat. — Soreness and feeling of excoriation, deep down pharynx. Uvula elongated, tonsils swoilen.

Stomach. — Eructations of scalding, hot, acid, watery substance; better, coffee. Bad taste in the morning, Persistent, morning nausea.

Drooling. - Heart. — Pain around heart, better lying on back, extending to left shuuldcr and arm. Yhyohbing in all arteries after retiing, Palpitation with oppression. Pulse irregular, intermittent, rapid. Light feeling in chest.

Female. — Pruritus vulva, with yellow leucorrhaa, worse, rest. Burning in right ovary.

Extremities. — Stiffness and bruised sensation in the muscles of the neck, with sensation as if nape of neck could not support head. Pain in shoulder, with pain along fingers. Vehement itching in arms and legs; worse towards evening. Feet numb and pricking. Streaking pains in arms and legs.

Skin. — ichiny; worse scratching. touch and retiring. Sore red blotches, Blind boils. Itching of knees and elbows and hairy portions. Jtehing uf hands, deep im. Vesicular, pustular, phlegmonous dermatitis. Skin hot, swolten.

Modalities. — Setter, cold water, coffee; worse, in afternoon; from sunlight, scratching.

Relationship. — Compare: Dolichos; Bovisia; Urtica, Dose. — Third potency and t2x.

remedies.name: Fel Tauri
remedies.text:
(Ox-gall) Disordered digestion, diarrhea, and pain in nape of neck are among its chief symptoms. Obstruction of gall ducts. Biliary cafculi, Stomach. ~- Eructations, gurgling in stomach and episgastric region. Violent peristaltic movements. Tendency to slecp after cating.

Relationship. — Compare: Merce. dulc.; Cholestertn. In Biliary Lithiasis, China, Dose. — Lower triturations.

remedies.name: Ferrum Iodatum
remedies.text:
(Iodide of Iron) Scrofulous affections, glandular enlargements, and tumors call for this remedy. Crops of boils. Acute nephritis following eruptive diseases. Uterine displacements. Stomach, — Food seems to push up into throat, as if it had not been swallowed. - Abdomen. — Fullness, even after a little food; stuffed feeling, as if she could not lean forward.

Throat. — Sore, as if of a splinter, shooting in different directions. Respiratory.—-Coryza; discharge of mucus from nose, trachea, and larynx Pressure beneath sternum. Scrofulous swelling of nose. Chest feels oppressed. remoptysis.

Urinary.— Urine dark. Sweet smelling. Crawling Sensation in urethra and rectum, Sensation as if urine were stopped at fossa navicularis. Difficulty in retaining urine.

Femaie. — On sitting, feeling as if something presscd upward in vagina. Much bearing down. Retroversion and prolapse of uterus. Leucorrbora like boiled starch. Menses suppressed, Itching and soreness of vulva and vagina. Dose, — Third trituration,

remedies.name: Ferrum Magneticum
remedies.text:
(Loadstone) Marked symptoms in intestinal tract. Paralytic weakness. Small warts on hands. .

Stemach. — During 2 meal, fiatufence ; afterwards lassitude taciturn and hot, pain in epigastrium, especially on breathing. Abdomen. —- Movements and grumbling m abdomen. Loose evacuations with much flatulency, especially Jeft side with pultings in legs. Abundant and frequent emission of fetid flatus.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Ferrum Metallicum
remedies.text:
(Iron) Best adapted to young weakly persons, anemic aud chlorotic, with pseudo-plethora, who Rush easily : cold extremities; overscnsitivencss; worse after any active effort. IVeakness from mere speaking or walking though looking strong. Pallor of skin, mucous membranes, fave, alternating with flushes. Orgasms of blood to face, chest, head, lungs, etc. Muscles flabby and relaxed.

Mind. — Irritability. Slight noises unbearing, Excited irom slightest opposition. Sanguine temperament.

Head. — Vertigo on seeing flowing water. Stinging headache. Ringing in ears before menses. ffammeriny, pulsating, congestive headache; pain extends to teeth, with cold extremities. Pain in back of head, with roarig itt neck, Eyes. — Watery, dull red; photophobia; letters run together, Face. — Fiery-red and finshed from least paia, emotion, or exertion. Red parts become white, Wloodless and puffy. Nose. Mucous membrane relaxed, boggy, anamic, pale.

Mouth. — Pain in tecth; relieved by ice-cald water, Earthy, pasty taste, tike rotten eggs.

Stomach. — Poracions appetite, or absolute loss of appetite, Loathing of sour things. Attempts to eat bring on diarrheea Spits up food by the mosthful, |Phos.] Eructations of food after eating, without nausca. Nausea and vomiting after eating. Vontiting immediaicly after eating. Vomiting after midnight. intolerance of cggs. Distention and pressure in the stomach after eating. Heat and burning in stomach, Soreness of abdominal walls. Flatulent dyspepsia. |Carho; Arg, nit]

Stool. — Undigested, at uight, while eating or drinkmg, painless, Ineffectual urging; stool hard, followed ly backache or cramping pain in rectum; prolapsus recti; itching of anus, especially young children.

Urine. — Involuntary; worse daytime. Tickling in urethra extending to bladder.

Female. — Menses remit a day or two, and then return. Discharge of long pieces from uterus. Women who are weak, delicate, chlorotic, yet have a fiery-red face. Menses too early, too profuse, last too long; pale, watery. Sensitive vagina. Tendency to abortion. Prolapse of vagina. Respiratory.~-~ Chest oppressed; breathing difficult. Surging of blood to chest. Hoarseness. Cough dry, spasmodic. Hemoptysis, [Milicfol.] With the cough pain in occiput.

Heart. — Palpitation ; worse, movement. Sense of oppression. Anamic murmur. Pulse full, but sof? and yielding; also, small and weak. Heart suddenly bleeds tuto the blood vessels, and as suddenly draws a reflux, leaving pallor of surface. Extremities, — Rheumatism of the shoulder. Dropsy after loss of vital fluids. Lumbago; better, slow walking. Pain in hip-joint, tibia, soles, and heel.

Skin. — Pale; flushes readily: pits on pressure, Fever. — General coldness of extremities; head and face hot. Chill at 4 a. Mm. Heat in pafms and soles, Profuse, debilitating sweat.

Modalities. — Better, walking slowly about. Better after rising. Worse, while sweating; at night; while sitting stil], After cold washing and cverheating. Midnight aggravation.
