Relationship. — Antidotes : Ars.: Hep. Complementary: Chin.: Alum.: Homamel. Compare: Kummer (similar ie respiratory and digestive sphere and contains orgauic iron.) Frrrum aceticum (epistaxis; especiatly adapted to thin, pale, weak children who grow rapidly and are easily exhausted; varices of the fest; copious expectoration of greenish pus; asthma; worse, sitting still and lying: phthisis, constant cough, vomiting of food after eating, hemoptysis). Ferrum avscnicum (enlarged spleen, with fever, undigested stool: albuminuria). Ferrum bromatum (sticky, excoriating leacorrheea ; uterus heavy and prolapsed, scalp feels numb). Ferrums cyanatum {neuroses with irritable weakness and hypersensitiveness, especially of a periodical character; epilepsy; cardialgia, with nausea, flatulence, constipation, alternating with diarrhoea; chorea}. Ferrum magneticum (small warts on hands). Ferram muriaticum (Arrested menstruation; tendency to seminal emissions or copious urination at puberty; very dark, watery stools; diphtheria; phtegmonous ervsipelas; pvelitis; hamoptysis of dark, clotty blood; dyspareunia; pain in right shoulder, right elbow, and marked tendency to cramps and round red spots on cheeks; bright crystals in urine. Anemia, 3x, after ineals). Ferrnm sulphuricem (pain in gall-biadder; toothache; acidity; eructation of food in mouthfuls); Ferrum perniirieum (cough, with florid complexion) ; Feriu tartaricum (cardialgia; heat at cardiac ‘orifice of stomach), Compare also: Graph.; Mongan.; Cupr. Ferrum protoxalatum (Anemia).

Dose. — States of debility where the blood is poor in hematin require materia! doses; plethoric, hemorrhagic conditions call for small doses, from the secund to the sixth potency.

remedies.name: Ferrum Phosphoricum
remedies.text:
(Phosphate of Iron) Forr. phos. In the early stages of febrile conditions, it stands midway between sthenic activity of Aconite and Bell, and the asthenic sluggishness and torpidity of Gels, The typical Ferr. phos. subject is not ful] blooded and robust, but nervous, sensitive, anemic with the false plethora and easy flushing of Ferrum, Prostration marked; face more active than Gels, The superficial redness never assumes the dusky hue of Gels. Pulse soit and flowing; no anxious restlessness of leon. Susceptibility to chest troubles. Bronchitis of young children. In acute exacerbation of tuberculosis, a fine palliative of wonderful power. The remedy for first stage of all febrile distarbances and inflammations before exudation sets in: especially for catarrhal affections of the respiratory tract. Mery. phos, 3x increases hemoglobin. In pale, anemic subjects, with violent local congestions. FJaemorrhages, bright from any orifice, Head. — Soreness to toucli, cald, noise, jar. Rush of Iood to head. Il] effects of sun-heat. Throbbing sensation. Vertigo. Headache beticr cold applications, Eyes.— Red, inflammed, with burning sensation. Fecling as of sand under lids. Hyperamia of optic disc and retina, with blurced vision

Ears.— Noises. Throbbing. First stage of otitis. Membrana tympani red and bulging. Acute otitis; when Bellad. fails, prevents suppuration, Nose. — First stage of colds in the head. Predispasition to colds. Epistaxis; bright red hiood.

Face. — Flushed; cheeks sore and hot. Florid complexion. Facial neuralgia; worse, shaking head and stooping, Throat. — Mouth het; fauces red, indamed. Ulcerated sore throat. Tonsils red and swollen. Eustachian tubes inflamed, Sore throat of singers. :Subacute laryngitis with fauces inflamed and red (2x). After operations on throat and nose to control bleeding and relieve soreness. First stage of diphtheria. Ranula in vascular, sanguine constitutions.

Stomach. — Aversion to meat and milk, Desire for stimulants. bontiting of ttudigested food. Vumiting of bright red blood. Sour eructatrons.

Abdomen. — First stage of peritunitis. Hemorrhvuids. Stools watery, bloody, undigested. First stage of dysentery, with much blood in discharges.

Urinary. — Urine spurts with every cough. Incontineuce. Irritation at neck of bladder, Polyuria, Jin nal cnuresis. Female. ~ Menses every three weeks, with besringdown sensation and pain on top of head. Vagsnisinus. Vagiua dry and hot. Respiratory. -- First stage of all inflammatory affections, Cangestions of lungs. Heaimoptysis. Short, painjul tickling cough. Croup, Hard, dry cough, with sore chest. Jloarseness. Laprctoration of pure blvod at puewmonia. [AMillefol.] ' Heart. — Palpitation; pulse rapid. First stage of cardiac diseases. Short, quirk, soft pulse. Extremities. -— Stiff neck. Articular rheumatism. Crick in back; Rheumatic pain in shoulder; pains extend to chest and wrist. Whitlow, Palms hot, Hands swollen and painful.

Sleep. — Restless and sleepless. Anxious dreams. Night sweats of anzmia. Fever, — Chill daily at } p.m. All catarrhal and inflammatory fevers; first stage, Modalities. — Worse, at night and 4 to 6 a. m.; touch, jar, motion, right side. Better, cold applications. Relationship, — Compare: Ferrum pyrophosph. (congestion of brain and headache following great loss of blood ; tarsal cysts); lcon.; Gelsen.; China, Dose. —- Third to twelfth potency, FERRUM PICRICUM {Picrate of Iron) Is considered a great remedy to complete the action of other medicines, The symptom that specially calls for it is failure uf the function of an organ under exertion; e. g., the voice fails after public speaking, Acts best in dark-haired patients, plethoric, with sensitive livers. Warts and epithelial growths; corns with yellowish discoloration. Senile kypertrophy of the prostate. Epistaxis. Chronic deafness and tinnitus due to gout. Meatus dry. Pseudo-leucemia, Ears. — Deafness before menses. Crackling in ears and low-pitched voice. Vascular deafness. Dental netralgia, radiating towards ears and eyes. Humming in ears as from telegraph wires. Stomach. ~— Indigestion, furred tongue, headache after meals, especially in bilious, dark-haired persons.

Urinary. — Pain along entire urethra, Frequent snicturition at night, with full feeling and pressure in reetum. Smarting at neck of bladder and penis. [Barosma.] Retention of urine, Extremities. — Pain in right side of neck and down tight arm. Locomotor ataxia, ocular stage. Warty hands.

Dose. — Second and third trituration,

remedies.name: Ficus Religiosa
remedies.text:
(Ashwathya) This East Indian drug causes and cures haemorrhages of many kinds. Hiematemesis, meno:rhagia, hemoptysis, etc. Bloody urine. Head. -—- Melancholic — quiet; burning at vertex; vertigo and slight headache, Stomach. — Nausea, vomiting of bright red blood; pain and sick feeling in stomach.

Respiratory. — Difficult breathing ; cough with vomiting of blood; pulse very weak. Relationship. --- Compare : Acalypha; Mitlefol.; Thlaspi; Ipecac.

Dose. — First potency.

remedies.name: Filix Mas
remedies.text:
(Male Fern) A remedy for worm symptoms, especially with caustipation, Tapeworm. Soporific conditions. Torpid inflammations of fymphane glands, (Maceration of fresh root.) Pulmonary tubeculosis m young patients, no fever, with limited, ulcerated lesions, formerly: classified as serofula. Eyes. ~- Blindness, monocular amblyopia.

Abdomen. — Bloated. Gnawing pain; worse cating sweets. Diarrhea and vorniting. Worm colic, with itching of nose, pale face, Llue rings around eyes. Painless hiccongh.

Relationship. — Compare: Cina; Granat.; Kouwsso. Dose. -- First to third potency, For the expulsion of tapeworm, a full dose of 4% to 1 dram of the Oleoresin, fasting.

remedies.name: Fluoricum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Hydrofiuoric Acid) Acts especially upon lower tissues, and indicated in deep, destructive processes, bed-sores, ulcerations, varicose veins, and ulcers. Patient is compelled to move about energetically, Complaints of eld age, or the prematurely aged, with weak, distended blood vessels. Hob-nailed liver of alcoholics.

Mind. — Indifference towards those loved best; inability to realize responsibility; buoyancy. Mentally elated and gay, Head, — Alopecia. Caries of skin. Pressure on sides of head from within outward. Caries of ossicles and mastoid, with copious discharge: worse warmth. {Silica;> worse cold.] Exostosis, Eyes. — Sensation as of wind blowing through eyes. Lachrymat fistula, Violent itching of inner carthus.

Nose. — Chronic nasal catarrh with ulceration af the septum; nose obstructed and dull heavy pain in forehead. Mouth, — Dental fistula, with persistent bloody, salty discharge, Syphilitic ulceration of throat, which is very sensitive to cold. Teeth feel warm. Affects teeth and bones of upper jaw.

Stomach. — Heaviness and weight in stomach. Heat in stomach before meals. Sour eructations. Averse to coffee, wants fancy dishes. Stomach symptoms relieved by tight clothes. Desire for highly seasoned food.

Abdomen. — Soreness over liver, Flatus and eructations.

Stool. — Bilious diarrhea, with aversion to coffee.

Male. — Burning in urethra. Sexual passion and desire increased, with erections at night, during sleep. Srwollen scrotum, Urine, — Scanty, dark. In dropsy. produces frequent and free discharge, with great relief, Female. — Menses copious, frequent, too long. Ulceration of uterus and os. Copious and excoriating leucorrhea. Nymphomania. Respiratory, -- Oppression of chest, difficult breathing, great dyspnea. Hydrothorax, Extremities. — Inflammation of joints of fingers. Feeling as of a splinter under nail, Nails crumble. Caries and necrosis, especially of long bones.

Skin. — Varicose veins. Nevi. Ulcers; red edges and vesicles. Decubitus; worse, warmth. Itching of cicatrices. Feels as if burning vapor were emitted from pores. itching especially of the orifices, and in spots, worse warmth. Nails grow rapidly. Periostea] abscess. Profuse, sour, offensive perspiration. Syphilitic tubercles. Dropsy of limbs in ofd, feeble constitutions. Atony of capillary aud venous system.

Modalities. — Worse, warmth, morning. Better, cold, while walking. : Relationship. -- Compare: Thiosinaminum (action on cicatricial tissues; adhesions, strictures, tumors); Cate. fluor.; Sitica. Complementary: Silica.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Formalin
remedies.text:
(Aqueous Solution (35 per cent) of Formaldehyde Gas) Ts a powerful disinfectant and deodorant; a potent poison. . Prevents growth and kills almost any pathoyenic micro-organism. It seems to have the peculiar property of eating into malignant tumors, leaving the surrounding healthy tissue uncharred and unchanged. A plug of cotton wool soaked in a 20 per cent. solution of Formaldehyde, and applied for a few hours, will produce a necrotic slough, which must be scraped away before the next application, otherwise it hardens. Formalin in hot water as vapor most valuable therapeutic agent in pertussis, in phthisis, in catarrhal affections of upper air-passages. Mind. —- Forgetfulness. Anxiety. Unconscious.

Head. — Coryza; eyes water; vertigo, Mouth. — Ptyalism, thick saliva; loss of taste.

Stomach. — Food feels as if it were a ball in stomach. Burning in mouth and stomach.

Abdomen. — Intense urging to stool, watery stools.

Urinary. — Anuria; albuminous urine.

Respiratory. — Dyspn@e. Larynyismus — stridulus. Whooping-cough.

Fever. — Chills in forenoon, followed by long fever. Bones ache during whole paroxysm. During fever forgets where he was. .

Skin. — Puckers skin like leather; wrinkles; scales off. Eczema in neighborhood of wound. Damp sweat most inarked on right upper extremity.

Relationship. — Antidote: .4mmonia water. Compare: Ammonium formaldehyde, known commercially as Cystogen. (Dose, five to seven grains two to four times daily, dissolved in hot water, after meals. Prevents the decomposition of urine in the bladder, kidneys, and ureters. Turbid urine rendered clear and fon-irritating; phosphatic deposits dissolved, and growth of pyogenic bacteria arrested}, Also, Uretropin. <A diuretic and solvent of uric acid concretions; relieves cystitis associated with putrefaction Three to five grains well diluted. When administered invariably appears in the cerebro-spinal fluid and therefore advised ia threatened meningeal infection. Doge.---As vapor in hot water in respiratory affec tions; 1 per cent, spray, otherwise 3x potency.

remedies.name: Formica Rufa (myrmexine)
remedies.text:
(Crushed Live Ants) An arthritic medicine. Gout and articular rheumatism; pains worse, motion; better, pressure. Right side most affected. Chronic gout and stiffness in joints. Acute outbursts of gouty poisons, especially when assuting the neuralgic forms, Tuberculosis, carcinoma, and lupus; chronic nephritis. Complaints from overlifting. Apoplectic diseases. Has a marked deterrent influence ans the formation of polypi.

Head. — Vertigo. Headache with cracking in left ear, Brain feels too heavy and large. Sensation as if a bubble burst in forehead. Forgetful in the evening. Exhilarated. Coryza and stopped-up feeling in nose. Rheumatic iritis. Nasal polypi.

Ears. — Ringing and buzzing. Cracking in left ear with headache. Parts around ear feel swollen. Polypi.

Stomach. — Constant pressure at the cardiac end of the stomach, and a burning pain there. Nausea, with headache, and vomiting of yellowish bitter mucus. Pains shift from stomach to vertex. Abdomen and

Stool.— In the morning, difficult passages of small quantities of flatus; afterwards diarrheea-like urging in the rectum. Pain in bowels before stool. Severe pain in the bowels, with shuddering chilliness. Constriction in the anus.

Urine. — Bloody, albuminous, with much urging; quantities of urates.

Respiratory. — Hoarseness, with dry, sore throat; cough worse at night, with aching in forehead and can- Strictive pain in chest; pleuritic pais, Sexual. — Seminal emissiors; weakness. “Slothful to venery.” Extremities. — Rheumatic pains; stiff and contracted joints. Muscles feel strained and torn from their attachment. Weakness of lower extremities. Paraplegia. Pain in hips. Rheumatism comes on with suddenness and restlessness. Sweat does not relieve.

Skin. — Red, itching and burning. Nettle-rash, Nodes around joints. [Ammon, phos.] Profuse sweat without relief.

Modalities. — Worse, cold and cold washing, before a snowstorm. Better, warmth, pressure, rubbing. Combing hair. Relationship. Compare: Formic acid. Chronic myalgia Muscular pains and soreness. Gout and articular rheumatism, which appear suddenly. Pains usually worse on right side, motion and better from pressure. Failing vision. (Increases muscular strength and resistance to fatigue. Feels stronger and more “fit” in ordinary walking. Marked diuretic effect, greater climination of products of disassimilation, particularly urea). Tremor. Tuberculosis, chronic nephritis and carcinoma, lupus, ete, have been treated successfully with injections of Formic acid of a dilution corresponding to the 3d and 4th centesimal. In prescribing it for varicose veins, polypi, catarrh, Dr. J. H. Clarke orders an ounce or two of a solution of Yormic acid in the proportion of one part of the acid to eleven of distilled water. Of this one teaspoonful is taken in a tablespoonful of water alter food once or twice daily. Pam in aponeurosis and muscles of head. neck and shoulders before a snowstorm, hus: (Duleam Tirtica and Juniprrus contain Formic acid), Cale, fluor.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth attenuation.

remedies.name: Fragaria
remedies.text: (Wood-strawberry) Acts on digestion and mesenteric glands, Chilbiains; worse during hot weather, Lack of mammary secretion. Psilosis. (Spruce.) Mouth. — Tongue swollen; strawberry tongue. Skin. —~ Urticaria; petechial and erysipelatous eruptions. Swelling of whole body. Relationship,-—Compeare: Apis; Galega —- Goat's Rue — (increases the quantity and quality of the milk in nursing women, also the appetite),

remedies.name: Fraxinus Americana
remedies.text:
(White Ash) Enlargement of the uterus. Fibrous growths, subinvolution, and prolapse, Uterine tumors, with bearingdown sensations, Fever sores on lips. Cramps in feet. Cold creeping and hot flashes. Infantile eczema.

Head.— Throbbing pain in back of head. Depression, with nervous restlessness, anxiety. Hot spot on top of head.

Female. — Uterus enlarged, and patulous. Watery, unirritating Jeucorrhea. Fibroids with bearing-down sensation, cramping in feet, worse in afternoon and night.

Abdomen. — Tenderness in left inguinal region; bearmg down pain, extending down thigh.

Relationship. — Compare: Fraxinus cxcelsior — European ash— (Gout; rheumatism. Infusion of ashleaves). Galega — Goat's Rue-~Backache; debility; anemia and impaired nutrition, Epiphegus; Sepia; Lil- Huet, .

Dose. — Ten to fifteen drops of Sincture, three times a day.

remedies.name: Fuligo Ligni
remedies.text:
(Soot) Acts on glandular system,.mucous membranes and cbstinate ulcers, epidermis, tetters, eczema. Chronic irritations of mucous membranes of mouth; pruritus- \ulve; uterine hemorrhage; cancer, especially of scrotum-—chimney sweeper’s cancer; epithelial cancers; cancer of womb with metorrhagia; sadness, thoughts of suicide.

Relationship. — Compare: Kreosot, Dose, — Sixth trituraticen.

remedies.name: Fucus Vesiculosus
remedies.text:
(Sea Kelp) A powerful remedy for obesity and goitre; also exophthalmic. Digestion is furthered and flatulence diminished, QObstinate constipation; forehead feels as if compressed by an iron ring.

Relationship. — Compare: Phytol; Thyroidine; Badtaga; loduam.

Dose. — Tincture, teaspoonful doses three times a day.

remedies.name: Fuchsina
remedies.commonName: A Coloring Substance Used in Adulteration of Wine
remedies.text: (A Coloring Substance Used in Adulteration of Wine) Produces redness of ears, deep red discoloration of mouth, swollén gums, with burning and tendency to salivation; deep red urine, alhbuminous, and light red, profuse diarrhea, with abdominal pains, Cortical substance of kidneys degenerated. Useful in corticat nephritis with albuminuria. Dose, — 6x to 30th potency.

remedies.name: Galium Aparine
remedies.text: (Goose-Grass) Galicum acts on the urinary organs, is a diuretic and of use in dropsies, gravel and calculi. Gas power of suspending or modifying cancerous action, Has clinical confirmation of its use in cancerous ulcers and nodulated tumors of the tongue, Invctcrate skin affections and scurvy. lavors healthy granulations on ulcerated surfaces. Dose, — Fluid extract; dram doses, in cup of water or milk, three times a day.

remedies.name: Gallicum Acidum
remedies.text:
(Gallic Acid) Should be remembered as a remedy in phthisis, It checks the morbid secretions, gives tone to the stomach, and increases the appetite. Hamorrhages, Itching of skin, Pyrosis, Mind, — Wild delirium at night; very restless, jumps out of bed; sweats; is afraid to be alone; is rude and abuses every one, Head.— Pain in back of head and neck. Thick, stringy discharge from nose; photophobia with burning of lids.

Respiratory.— Pain in lungs; pxluionary hamorrhage; excessive expectoration. Much mucus in throat in the morning. Dry at night.

Rectum. — Copious stool; anus feels constricted. Faint feeling after stool.- Relationship. —-Compare: Ars.; Jod.; Phos. Dose, — First trituration.

remedies.name: Gambogia
remedies.text:
(Gummi Gutti) The use of this drug in Homeopathy has been confined to its action on the alimentary tract. It produces a diarrhea very similar to Croton. From its pathogenesis, it is very evident that it has very intense and definite action especially on the gastro-enteric tract.

Head. — Heavy, with inertia, and drowsiness. Itching and burning in eyes; lids stick together, with sneesing. Gastro-enteric

Symptoms. — Feeling of coldness at edge of teeth. Great irritability of the stomach; burning, smarting, and dryness of the tongue and throat. Pain in the stomach after food. Tenderness in epigastrium. Pain and distention of abdomen from flatulence, after stool. Rumbling and rolling. Dysentery, with retained scybala, with pain in sacral region. Diarrhcea, with sudden ond forcible ejection of bitious stools, Tenesmus after, with burning at anus. 3eo-cecal region sensitive to pressure. Profuse, watery diarrhcea in hot weather, particularly old people. Pain in coccyx.

Modalities. — Worse, towards evening and at night.

Relationship. — Compare: Croton; Aloes; Pod.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency. Gatmboge painted on the chest in lung tuberculosis is considered by Abrams specific and incipient cases are symptomatically cured in several weeks,

remedies.name: Gaultheria
remedies.text:
(Wintergreen) Jufiammatory rheumatism, pleurodynia, sciatica, and other neuralgias, come within the sphere of this remedy. Cystic and prostatic irritation, undue sexual’ excitement, and renal inflammation. . Head, — Neuralgia of head and face.

Stomach. — Acute gastritis, severe pain in epigastrium ; profonged vomiting. Uncontrollable appetite, notwithstanding irritable stomach. Gastralgia from nervous depression. (Give five drops of Ix of Oil.) Skin.—Smarting and burning. Intense erythema, worse, cold bathing ; better, olive oil and cool air blowing on part. Relationship. —- Compare: S‘pir@a. ‘Gaultheria contains Arbutin. Salycyl. acid. Methytium saticylicusn (an artificial Gaultheria oi! for rheumatism, especially when the salicylates cannot be used. Pruritus and epididymitis, locally}, After Cantharis in burns.

remedies.name: Gelsemium
remedies.text:
(Yellow Jasmine) Centers its action upon the nérvous system, causing vartous degrees of motor paralysis. General prostration, Disziness, drowsiness, dullness, and trembling. Slow pulse, tired feeling, mental apathy. Parelysis of various groups of muscles about the eyes, throat, chest, larynx, sphincter, extremities, ete. Muscular weakness, Complete relaxation and prostration, Lack of muscular co-ordination. General depression from heat of sun, Sensitive to a falling barometer; cold and dampness brings on many complaints. Children fear falling, grab nurse or crib. Sluggish circulation. Nervous affections of cigarmakers.

Mind. — Desire to be quiet, tou be left alone. Duilness, languor, listless. “Discernings are lethargied.” Delirious on falling to sleep. Emotional excitement, fear. etc., lead to bodily ailments, Bad effects from fright, fear, exciting mews. Stage fright. Child starts and grasps the nurse, and screams as if afraid of falling. [Bor]

Head. — lertigo, spreading from occiput. Heaviness of head; band-feeling around and occipital headache. Dull, heavy ache, with heaviness of eyelids; bruised sensation; better, compression and lying with head high. Pain in temple, extending into car and wing of nose, chin. Headache, with muscular soreness of neck and shoulders, Headache preceded by blindness; better, profuse urination, Scalp sore to touch. Delirious on falling asleep. Wants io have head raised on pillow.

Eyes. — Ptosis; eyelids heavy; patient can hardly open them. Double vision. Vision blurred, smoky. [Cycl.; Phas. Dim-sighted; pupils dilated and insensible to light. Orbital neuralgia, with coniraction and twitching of muscles. Bruised pain back of the orbits. One pupil dilated, the other contracted. Deep inflammations, with haziness of vitreous, Serous inflammations. Albuminuric retinitis. Detached retina, glaucoma and descemetitis, Hysterical amblyopia.

Nose. — Sneezing; fullness at root of nose. Dryness of nasal fosse. Swelling of turbinates. Watery, excoriating discharge. Acute coryza, with dull headache and fever, Face, — Hot heavy, flushed, besotied-looking. [Bept.; Op.) Neuralgia af face. Dusky hue of face, with vertigo and dim vision. Facial muscles contracted, especially around the meuth. Chin quivers. Lower jaw dropped.

Mouth. — Putrid taste and breath. Tongue numb, thick, coated, yellowish, trembles, paraylzed. Throat, — Difficult swallowing, especially of warm food. Itching and tickling in soft palate and nasopharynx. Pain in sterno-cleido-mastoid, back of paratid. Tonsils swollen, Throat eels rough, burning. Postdiphtheritic paralysis. Tonsillitis; shooting pain into ears. Feeling of a lump in throat that cannot be swalfawed. Aphonia. Swallowing causes pain in ear. [Hep.; Nux.] Difficult swallowing. Pain from throat to ear, Stomach. — As a rule, the Gelsemium patient has no ‘thirst. Hiccough; worse in the evening. Sensation of emptiness and weakness at the pit of the stumach, cr of an oppression, like a heavy load, Stool. -- Diarrhea from emotional excitement, fright, bad news. [Fhos. ac.] Stool painless ur involuntary. Cream-colored (Calc.}, tea-green. Partial paralysis of #ctum and sphincter.

Urine. — Profuse, clear, watery, with chilliness and tremulousness. Dysuria. Partial paralysis of bladder; flow intermittent. [Clematis.]

Female.— Rigid os. ([Beil.] Vaginismus. False labor-pains; pains pass up back, Dysmenorrhara, with scanty flow; menses retarded. Pain extends to back and hips. Aphonia and sore throat during menses. Sensation as if uterus were squeezed. [Cham.; Nux v.; Ustilago.]

Male. — Spermatorrhaa, wifhou! ercctions. Genitals cold and retaxed. [Phos. ae.] Scrotum continually sweating, Gonorrheea, first stage; discharge scanty; tendency to corrode; little pain, but much heat; smarting at meatus.

Respiratory. — Slowness of breathing, with great prostration. Oppression about chest. Dry cough, with sore chest and fluent coryza, Spasm of the glottis. Aphonia; ‘acute bronchitis, respiration quickened, spasmodic affections of lungs and diaphragm. Heart,— 4 feeling as if it were necessary to keep in motion, or else heart's action would cease. Slow pulse. {D19.; Kalm.; Apoc. can.) Palpitation; pulse soft, weak, full and flowing. Pulse slow when quiet, but greatly accelerated on motion. Weak, slow pulse of old age.

Back. — Dull, heavy pain. Complete relaxation of the whole muscular system. Languor; muscles feel bruised. Every little exertion causes fatigue. Pain in neck, esbecially upper sterno-cleido muscles, Dull aching in lumbar and sacral region, passing upward. Pain in muscles of back, hips, and lower extremities, mostly deep-seated.

Extremities. — Loss of power of muscular control. Cramp in muscles of forearm. Professional neuroses. Writer’s cramp. Excessive trembling and weakness of all limbs. Hysteric convulsions, Fatigue after slight exercise, Sleep. — Cannot get fully to sleep. Delirious on falling asleep. Insomnia from exhaustion; from uncontrollable thinking; tobacco, Yawning. Sleepless from nervous irritation. [Coffea.]

Fever.— Wants to be held, because he shakes so. Pulse slow, full, soft, compressible. Chilliness up and down back. Heat and sweat stages, long and exhausting. Dumb-ague, with much muscular soreness, great prostration, and violent headache. Nervous chills. Bilious remittent fever, with stupor, dizziness, faintness; thirstless, prostrated. Chill, without thirst, along spine; wave-like, extending upward from sacrum td occiput. Skin. ~ Hot, dry, itching, measlelike eruption. Erysipelas. Meastes, catarrhal symptoms; aids in bringing out eruption, Retrocedent, with livid spots, Scarlet fever with stupor and flushed face. Modalities, —- Vorse, damp weather, fog, before a thunder-storm, emotion, or excitement, bad ews, tobacco-smoking, when thinking of his ailments; at 10 A.M. Better, bending forward,* by profuse urination, open air, continued motion, stimulants.

Relationship. — Compare: Ignatia (gastric affections of cigarmakers}; Baptisa; Ipecac.; Acon.: Bell; Cimicif.; Magnes. phos. (Gelsem. contains some Magnes, phos.) Antidotes: China; Coffea; Dig. pose. — Tincture, to thirtieth attenuation; first to shige most often used.

remedies.name: Gentiana Lutea
remedies.text:
(Yellow Gentian) Stomach symptoms marked. Acts as a tonic, increasing appetite.

Head. — Vertigo, worse, rising or motion; better open air. Frontal headache, better eating and open air. Brain feels loose, head tender. Aching in eyes. Throat. ~— Dry, Thick saliva.

Stomach. — Acid risings, ravenous hunger, nausea, weight and aching in stomach. Inflation and cension of stomach and abdomen. {Pothos.] Colic, umbilical region sensitive to touch, Flatulence.

Relationship. — Compare: Gentiana quingue flora (inintermittent fever; dyspepsia, cholera infantum, weakness); Gentiana cruciaia (throat symptoms in addition to similar stomach symptoms; dysphagia; vertigo with headache; pressing inward sensation in eyes; constricted throat and head and abdomen. Distension, fulness and tightness in abdomen. JHydrast.; Nux.

Dose. — First to third attenuation.

remedies.name: Geranium Maculatum
remedies.text:
(Crane’s-bill) Habitual sick headaches. Profuse hemorrhages, pulmonary and from different organs. Vomiting of blood. Ulceration of stomach, Atonic and foul ulcers, Head. — Giddiness, with diplopia; better, closing eyes. Ptosis and dilated pupils. Sick headache. Mouth — Dry; tip of tongue burning. Pharyngitis.

Stomach. — Catarrhal gastritis with profuse secretion, tendency to ulceration and passive hemorrhage. Lessens the vomiting in gastric ulcer, Stool, — Constant desire to go to stool, with inability to pass anything for some time. Chronic diarrhoea, with offensive mucus, Constipation.

Female. — Menses too profuse. Post-partum hzmorrhage. Sore nipples. [Eup. orom.] Relationship. Compare: Gcranin. 1x. Constant hawking and spitting in elderly people. Erodium—~ Hemlock — Stork’s bill— (a popular haemostatic in Russia, and especially used for mctrorrhagia and menorrhagia) ; Hydrastisin; Cinch.; Sabin.

Dose. — Tincture, half-dram doses in gastric ulcer. Tincture, to third attenuation, as a general rule. Locally, in ulcers, it will destroy the pyogenic membrane.

remedies.name: Gettysburg Water
remedies.text: Stringy mucus from throat and posterior nares. Rawness Neck muscles rigid. Joints weak. Cannot lift things, Ligaments rigid. Subacute gouty state,

remedies.name: Ginseng
remedies.text:
(Aralia Quinquefolia — Wild Ginseng — Panax) Acts on the lower part of the spinal cord. Lumbaga. _ Sciatica, and rehumatism. Paralytic weakness. Hiccough.

Head. — Vertigo, with gray spots before eyes: semi-lateral headache; occipital; difficult opening of eyelids; objects appear double. Throat.—-Tonsilfitis, just like Bellad, but in darkcomplexioned people, Abdomen. — Tensc, painful, rumbling. Pain in right side. Loud gurgling in ileo-cecal region. Perityphlitis.

Male. — Rieumatic pains after frequent emissions, Weakness of genital organs. Voluptuous tickling at th} end of urethra. Sexual excitement. Pressure in testicle. Extremities, — Hands feel swollen. Skin feels tight. Contraction. Coldness in back and spine. Bruised pain in small of back and thighs; nightly digging in right lower limb to toes. Burning heat in tips of fingers. Eruption on upper inner thighs. S#ff, contracted joints, heaviness of lower limbs. Crackling in joints. Stiffness in back, Relationship. — Compare: Aral.; Coca, Dose. -— Tincture, to third potency. GLONOINE = GL. = Glycerine O = Oxygen N=Nitrogen (Nitro-glycerine) (Spirits Glycetinus Nitrate) Great remedy for congestive hesdaches, hyperemia 3f the brain from excess of heat or cold. Excellent for -he intercranial, climacteric disturbances, or due to nenstruai suppression. Childrép get sick when sitting vefore an open fire. Surging of blood to head and ‘cart. Tendency to sudden aad violent irregularities vf the circulation. Violent convulsions, associated with ‘erebral congestion. Sensation of pulsation throughout ody, Pulsating pains. Cannot recognize localities, Head. — Confusion, with dizziness. Effects of sunstroke; heat on head, as in type-setters and workers inder gas and electric light. Head heavy, but cannot ‘ay it on pillow. Cannot bear any heat about head. etter from uncovering head. Throbbing headache. Vertigo on assuming upright position. Cerebral congesion. Head feels enormously large, as if skull were too ‘mall for brain. Sun headaches; increases and decreases with the sun. Shocks in head, synchronous with pulse. Headache in place of menses. Rush of blood to head in pregnant women. Threatened apoplexy. Meningitis.

Eyes. — See everything half light, half dark, Letters appear smaller. Sparks before eyes.

Mouth. — Pulsating toothache.

Ears. — Throbbing; Each heat of heart is heard in ears; full fecling, Face. — Flushed, hot, livid, pale; sweaty; pains in root of nose; faceache. Dusky face, Throat. — Neck feels full. Collars must be opened. Chokes and swells up under ears.

Stomach.— Gastralgia in anemic patients with feeble circulation. Nausea and vomiting. Faint, gnawing, and empty fecling at pit of stomach, Abdomen. — Constipation, with itching, painful hemorrhoids, with pinching in ahdamen hefore and after stool. Diarrhoa; copious blackish, lumpy stools.

Female. — Menses delayed, or sudden cessation with cangestion to head. Climacteric flushing.

Heart. — Laborious action. Fluttering. Palpitation with dyspnea. Cannot go uphill, Any exertion brings on rush of blood to heart and fainting spells. Throbbing in the whole body to finger-tips.

Modalities. — Better, brandy. Worse, in “sun; exposure to suu-rays, gas, open fire: jar, stooping, having hair cut, peaches, stimulants; lying down; from 6 a. M. to noon. Relationship, — Antidote: Acon. Compase: Amyl. nit.; Bellad.; Opium; Stram.; Vevas. vir.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency, For palliative (non-homeopathic) purposes, in angina pectoris, asthma, heart-failure, etc., physiological doses—i. e., 1/100 of drop—must be given. Here it is the great emergency remedy. The conditions calling for it are small, wiry pulse. pallor, arterial spasm, anemia of brain, collapse, feeble heart, syncope, dicratic pulse, vertigo,—the opposite of those indicating a homeeopathic dosage. Often thus used to lower the arterial tension in chronic interstitial] nephritis.

remedies.name: Glycerinum
remedies.text:
(Glycerine)} Used homeopathically, dynamized Glycerine seems to act deeply and long, building up tissue, hence of great use in marsamus, debility, mental and physical, diabetes, etc. It disturbs nutrition im its primary action, and, secondarily, seems to improve the general state of nutrition. (Dr. Wm. B. Griggs.) ‘Head.— Feels full, throbs; mentally confused. Severe headache two days before menstruation. Occiput feels full.

Nose.— Stopped up, sneezing, irritating coryza. Sensation of crawling on mucous membrane, Postnasal dripping.

Chest. — Hacking cough with sense of weakness. Chest seems full. Influenzal pneumonia.

Stomach. — Fermentation, burning in stomach and cesophagus.

Urinary.— Profuse and frequent urination. Increased specific gravity and sugar. Diabetes.

Female. — Profuse, Jong-lasting flow with bearing down heaviness in uterus. General sense of exhaustion, Extremities. — Rheumatic pains of a remittent type. Feet painful and hot, feel enlarged. Relationship, — Compare: Lactic acid; Gelseminm; Cale.

Dose. — Thirticth and higher potencies. Pure Glycerine in teaspoonful doses, t. % d., with lemon juice for pernicious anzmia.

remedies.name: Gnaphalium
remedies.text:
(Cut-weed) A remedy of unquestioned benefit in sciatica, when pain is associated with numbness of the part affected. Rheumatism and morning diarrhoea, Polyuria, Face. — Intermittent pains of superior maxillary of both sides. . Abdomen, — Borborygmus. Colic; pain in various parts of the abdomen, Irritated prostate. First stage of cholera infantum; vomiting and purging.

Female. — Weight and fullness in pelvis, Dysmenorrhaca, with scanty aud painful menses. Back, — Chronic backache in lumbar region; better resting on back. Lumbago with numbness in lower part of back and weight in pelvis.

Extremities. — Cramps in calves of legs and feet when in bed. Rheumatic pain in ankle joints and legs. intense pain along the sciatic nerve; numbness allernates with pain. Frequent pains in calves and feet. Gouty pains in big toes. Better, drawing limbs up, flexing thigh on abdomen. Gouty concretions. |4mmon, benz.] Anterior crural neuralgia. [Stopé.] Pain in joints as if they lacked oii. Chronic muscular rheumatism of back and neck. Relationship. ~- Compare: Xanthoryl.; Chamom.; Pulsot.

Dose. — Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Golondrina
remedies.text: (Euphorbia Polycarpa) An antidote to suake-poison, Its use also renders the body immune to the influence of the snake venom, and thus as a prophylactic. [/ndigo.] Relationship. —- Compare: The Euphorbias; Cedron; Gymucema sylvesire (will abolish the taste of bitter things; sense of taste altered; powdered root for snakebite}; Sisyrinchiam — Blue-eyed grass —- Ten to fifteen drop doses of tincture (rattlesnake bites).

remedies.name: Gossypium
remedies.text:
(Cotton-plant) A powerful emmenagogue, used in physiological doses. Howiceopathically, it corresponds to many reflex conditions, depending on disturbed uterine function and pregnancy. Gossypium will relieve tardy menses, especially with sensation that the flow is about to start and yet does not do so. Tall, bloodless patients, with nervous chills. Head, — Pain in cervical region with tendency fer head to draw backward with nervousness, * Stomach, — Nausea, with inclination to vomit before breakfast. Anorexia, with uneasy feeling at scrobiculum at time of menses, Female. — Labia swollen and itching. Intermittent puin tH ovaries. Retained placenta. Tumor of the breast with swelling of axillary glands. Morning sickness, with sensitive uterine region. Suppressed menstruation. Menses too watery. Backache, weight and dragging in pelvis.

Relationship. — Compare: Action similar to Ergot when made from fresh green root, Lilium; Cimicif.; Sabina.

Dose. — Tincture, fo sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Granatum
remedies.text:
(Pomegranate) As a vermifuge for the expulsion of tapeworm, and home:opathically for the following symptomatic indications. Salvation, with nausea, and yertigo. Spasm of the glottis.

Head. — Feels empty. Sunken eyes; pupils dilated; weak sight. Vertigy very persistent.

Stomach. — Constant hunger. Poor digestion. Loses flesh. Vomiting at night.

Abdomen. — Pain in stomach and abdomen; worse about umbilicus [Cocc.; Nux m,; Plemb.]; ineffectual urging. Itching at anus. Dragging in vaginal regiou, as if hernia would protrude. Swelling resembling um- Lilical hernia, Chest.— Oppressed, with sighing. Pain between shoulders; even clothing is oppressive. Skin. —Jtching wi paims. Sensation as if pimples would break out. Jaundiced complexion, Extremities. — Pain around shoulders, as if heavy load had been carried. Pain in all finger-joints. Tearing in knee-joint. Convulsive movements, .

Relationship. — Compare: Peiletierine (one of its constituents —an anthelminitic, especially for tapeworm); Cina; Kousso. Dose, — First to third potency.

remedies.name: Graphites
remedies.text:
(Black Lead) Like all the carbons, this remedy is an anti-psoric of great power, but especially active in patients who are rather stout, of fair complexion, with tendency to skin affections and constipation, fat, chilly, and costive, with delayed menstrua! history, take cold easily. Children impudent, teasing, laugh at reprimands. fradicates tendency to erysipelas, Anzmia with redness of face. Tendency to obesity. Swollen genitals. Gushing leucorrhea. Aids absorption of cicatricial tissue.

Mind. — Great tendency to start. Timid, Unable to decide. Want of disposition te work. Fidgety while sitting at work, Music mukes her weep. Apprehensive, despondency, indecision. Head. -~ Headache in moruing on waking, mostly on one side, with inclination to vomit, Sensation of cobweb on forehead. Feeis numb and pithy. Rheumatic pains on one side of head, extending ty teeth and neck. Burning on vertex. Humid, itching eruption on hairy scalp, emitting a fetid oder. Cataleptic condition.

Eyes. — Ophthalmia, with intolerance of artificial light. Eyelids rcd and swollen. Blepharitis, Dryness of the lids. Eczema of lids; fissured.

Ears. — Dryness of inner eay. Cracking in ears when eating. Moisture and eruptions behind the ears. Hears beticr in noise, Hardness of hearing. Hissing in the ears. Detonation in ear like report of a gun. Thin, white, scaly membrane covering membrana tympani, tike exfoliated epithelium. Fissures in and behind the ear.

Nose. — Sore on blowing it; is painful internally. Smeil abnormally acute; cannot tolerate flowers. Scabs and fissures in nostrils.

Face. — Feels as if cobwebs were on it. Itching pimples. Moist eczema around mouth and chin. Erysipelas, burning and stinging.

Mouth. — Rotten color from mouth, Breath smells like urine. - Stomach,— Aversion to meat. Sweets nauseate. Hot drinks disagree. Nausea and vomiting after each meal. Morning sickness during menstruation. Pressure in stomach. Burning in stomach, causing /iisger. Eructation difficult. Constrictive pain in stomach. Recurrent gastralsia, Abdomen, — Nauseous feeling in abdomen, Fullness and hardness in abdomen, as from incarcerated flatulence; must foosen clothuig,; presses painfully at abdominal ring. Croaking in abdomen, Inguinal region sensitive, swollen. Pain of gas opposile the side on which he lies. Chronic diarrhoza, stools brownish, liquid, undigested, offensive, Very fetid gas preceded by colic.

Stool. — Constipation; large, difficult, knotty stools united by mucus threads. Burning hemorrhoids, Prolanse, diarrhea; stools of brown fivid, :nixed with undigested substance, very fetid, sour odor. Smarting, sore anus, itching, Lump stool, conjoined with threads of mucus. Varices of the rectum, Uzine. -— Turbid, with sediment. Sour smelling.

Female. — Meuses too atc, with constipation ; pale and scanty, with tearing pain in epigastrium, and itching before, Hoarseness, coryza, cough, sweats and morning sickness during menstruation. Leucorrhcea, paic, thin, profuse, white, excoriating, with great weakness iu back. Mamme swollen and hard. Nipples sore, cracked, and blistered. Decided aversion to coitus. Male.--Sexual debility, aversion to coition; no ejaculation; herpetic eruption on organs.

Respiratory.— Constriction of chest; spasmodic asthma, suffocative attacks wakes from sleep; must eat something. Pain in middle of chest, with cough, scraping and soreness. Chronic hoarseness with skin affections. Inability to control the vocal chords; hearseness on beginning to sing and for breaking voice (Cartier).

Extremities. — Pain in nape of neck, shoulders and back and limbs. Spinal pains. Pain in small of back with great weakness, Excoriation between thighs. Left hand numb; arms feel asleep; finger-nails thick, black, and rough, matrix inflamed. ([Psor.; Fluor. ac.] (Edema of lower limbs. Toe-nails crippled. Stiffness and contraction of toes. Nails brittle and crumbling. Nails deformed, painful, sore, thick, and crippled, Cracks or fissures in ends of fingers. Skin. -— Rough, hard, persistent dryness of portions of skin unaffected by eczema. Early stage of keloid and fibroma. Pimples aud acne. Eruptions, oozing out a sticky vrudation, Rawness ir bends of limbs, groins, neck, behind ears. Unacalihy skin; every little injury swppurates. Ulcers discharging a glutinous fluid, thin and sticky. Swelling and induration of glands. Gouty nodosities. Cracks in nipples. mouth, between toes, anus, Phlegmonous erysipelas of iace; burning and stinging pain. Swelling of feet. Wens. Chronic Poison oak.

Modalities. — Worse, warmth, at night, during and after menstruation. Better, in the dark, from wrapping up. ; Relationship. — Complementary: Argent. nit. (follows well in gastric derangements) ; Caustic.; Hep.; Lycop.; Ars.; Tuberc. Compare: Puls.; Calc.; Sep.; Sulph.; Fluor. ac. Antidote: Nusz.; Acon.; Ars.

Dose. — Sixth to thirtieth potency. Locally, as a cerate, in sore nipples.

remedies.name: Gratiola
remedies.text:
(Hedge Hyssop) Acts especially on gastro-intestinal tract. Useful in mental troubles from overweening pride. Especially useful in females.~“Nux symptoms in females often met by Gratiola. vo . Head. -— Sick headache. Rush of blood with vanishing of sight. Sensation as if brain was contracting and head became smaller. Tightness in forehead, with wrinkles in skin. Eyes dry, burn. Myopia. Stomach, — Vertigo during and after meals; hunger and feeling of emptiness after meals. Dyspepsia, with much distention of the stomach, Cramps and colic after supper and during night, with swelling of abdomen and constipation. Dysphagia for liquids. Stool, + Diarrhea; green, frothy water, followed by anal burning, forcibly evacuated without pain. Constipation, with gouty acidity. “ Hemorrhoids, with hypochondriasis. Rectum constricted, Sleep. — Insomnia. Female. -—- Nymphomania. Menses too profuse, premature, and too long, Modalities. — Worse, drinking toc much water.

Relationship. — Compare: Dig., Euph,; Tab.; Cham.; Ammon, pic.

Dose. — Second to third potency.

remedies.name: Grindelia
remedies.text:
(Rosin-wood) Both Grindelia robusta and Grindelia squarrosa have been used for the symptoms here recorded, There is practically no difference in their action, although the G. Squarrosa is credited with more splenic symptoms, dull pains and fullness in left hypochondrium ; gastric pains associated with splenic congestion, Induces paralysis, beginning in extremities. Its action is shown on the heart first quickening, then retarding it, Produces a paresis of the pneumo-gastric, interfering with respiration. Smothering after falling asleep Asthmatic conditions, Cheyne-Stokes respiration, and chronic bronchitis, call for it. Raises the blood pressure. Nausea and retching of gastric ulcer. Sugar in urine, An effective antidote to Rhus-poisening, focally and internally; also for burns, blisters, vaginal catarrh and herpes zoster. Hyperchlorhydria when attended with asthmatic and other neurotic symptoms. Hyperwmia of gastric mucous membrane with difficult respiration.

Head. — Feels full, as from quinine. Pain in cyeballs, running back to brain; werse, moving eyes. Pupils dilated. Purulent ophthalmia and iritis.

Respiratory. — An efficacious remedy for wheezing and oppression in bronchitic patients. The sibilant rales are disseminated with foamy mucus, very difficult to detach. Acts on the pulmonary circulation. Asthma, with profuse tenacious expectoration, which relieves, Stops breathing when falling aslech; wakes with a start, and gasps for breath. Must sit up to breathe. Cannot breathe when lying down, Pertussis, with profuse mucus secretion, . [Coceus.] Bronchorrhoea, with tough, whitish, mucus expectoration. Sibilant rales. Weak heart and respiration, Cannot breathe lying down, Spleen.— Cutting pain in region of spleen, extending to hips. Spleen enlarged. [Cranoth., Carduns.]

Skin. — Rash, like with severe burning and itching. Vesicular and papular eruptions. Herpes zoster. Itching and burning. Poison oak, Ulcers, with swollen, purplish skin.

Relationship. — Compare: Tart-emet. Eriodictyon; Lach,; Sanguinar.

Dose. — Tincture, to twelfth potency.

remedies.name: Guaco
remedies.text:
(Mikania, Climbing Hemp Weed) Acts on nervous system and female organs. Antidote to bites of scorpions and serpents. [Golondrina.) Cholera. Bulbar paralysis. Syphilis. Cancer. Deafness—tongue heavy and difficult to move. Spinal irritation, Spinal symptoms most marked and vérified. Beer drinkers threatened with apoplexy. Headache, red face. Heaviness and difficulty in moving tongue.

Throat. — Larnyx and trachca constricted; difficult deglutition. Tongue feels heavy, difficult to move.

Female. — Leucorrhea copious, corroding, putrid, debilitating. Itching and stnarting at night, as if fire were running out of parts.

Urine. — Increased, cloudy, phosphatic. Pain over region of bladder, Back. — Pain between scaputx, extending to forearm. Burning in nape of shoulders. Pain along spine; worse, bending, Weariness through hips and lumbar Trgion, Extremities, — Pain in deltoid, shoulders, elbows, arms, and fingers. Pain about hip-joint. Legs heavy. Pain in ankle-joints and soles. Paralysis of lower extremitics.

Modalities. — forse, from. motion. Relationship. —- Compare Wi val oc.; Lathyt.; Caust.

Doge. — Third to sixth potency. .

remedies.name: Guaiacum
remedies.text:
(Resin of Lignum Vite) Chief action on fibrous tissue, and is especia!ly adapted to the arthritic diathesis, rheumatism, and tonsillitis. Secondary syphilis. Very valuable in acute rheuma- - tism. Free foul secretions, Promotes suppuration of, abscesses. Sensitiveness and aggravation from Socal heat. Contraction of limbs, stiffness and immobility.

Mind. — Forgetful; thoughtless; staring. Slow to comprehend.

Head. — Gouly and rheumatic pain in head and face, Catena to neck. Tearing pain in skull; worse, cold, wet weather. Feels swollen, and blood-vessels distended. Aching in left ear. Pains often end in a stitch, especially in head.

Eyes.— Pupils dilated. Eyelids appear too short. Pimples areund eyes.

Stomach. — Tongue furred. Desire for apples. Aversion to milk, Burning in stomach. Constricted epigastric region.

Abdomen.— Much wind in bowels. Diarrhea, cholera infantum, Urinary. — Sharp stitches after urinating. Constant ‘desire.

Respiratory. — Feels suffocated. Dry, tight cough. Pleuritic stitches, Chest pains in articulations of ribs, with shortness of breathing till expectoration sets in. Female,— Ovaritis in rheumatic patients, with irregular menstruation and dysmenorrhea, and irritable bladder, Back — Pain from wh, ra neck. Aching in nape, ‘Sul ect and sore shoulders. Stitches between scapule to cciput. Contractive pain between scapula.

Extremities. — Rheumatic pain in shoulders, arms and hands. Growing pains. [Pkos. ac.] Pricking in nates. Sciatica and jumbago. Gouty tearing, with contractions. Immovable stiffness, Ankle pain extending up the leg, causing lameness.” Joints swollen, painful, and intolerant of pressure; can bear no heat. Stinging pair in limbs. Arthritic lancinations followed by contraction of limbs. A feeling of heat in the affected limbs.

Modalities. — Worse, from motion, heat, cold wet weather; pressure, touch, from 6 p,m. to 4 a.M. Better, external pressure, Relationship. — Guaiacol (in the treatment of gonorrheeal epididymitis, 2 parts to 30 vaselia,Jocally). Antidote: Nux. Compare: Merc.; Caust.; Rhus; Mezer.; Rhodod.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth attenuation. GUAREA @allwood) Eye symptems have been verified. Chemosis and pterygium have been cured with it. Lupus of an ochrered color, Eyes. —Conjunctiva inflamed, swollen. Tearing pain in eyeballs; tension, forced-out feling. Objects appear gray, upside down, Eye symptoms alternate with diminished hearing.

Head.— Sensation as if brain were falling forwards; as from a blow on head.

Respiratory.— Cough with sweat, pain and tightness of chest; larynx irritated, Dose, —~ Tincture.

remedies.name: Gymnocladus
remedies.text:
(Ameticang§pfiee-tree) Sore throat, dark livid redness of fauces,sandaerysipelatous swelling of face are most marked. Desire for heat and quiet. Headache, with biuish-white coattng of tongue.

Face.— Sensation as of flies crawling over face. Erysipelas. Great sensibility of teeth, Throat.- Sore; dark livid redness of fauces and tonsils. Sticking pain, Mucus in throat and hawking. Tickling, wtih dry cough. Relationship, -- Compare: Lachnant.; Laches.; Aitianth.: Rhus, Dose. — Lower attenuations,

remedies.name: Haematoxylon
remedies.text:
(Logwood) Sense of constriction is characteristic. Sessation as if a ber lay across chest. Angina pectoris.

Head.— Feels constricted; heavy, hot. Eyelids heavy.

Stomach.— Painful digging from abdomen to throat, causing pain in region of heart with oppression, Colic, tympanitis. Borborygmi and diarrhea. Swollen, painful.

Chest.— Constriction, extending ‘to epigastrium. Sensation of a bar across chest. Convulsive pain in heart region with oppression, Great soreness in region of heart, Palpitation, Female.— Pain in hypogastrium, attended with slimy, whitish leucorrhea. Weak feeling, with painful bearing down sensation at menstrual period, Relationship. — Compare: Cactus; Colocy.; Naja.

Dose. — Third potency.

remedies.name: Hamamelis Virginica
remedies.text:
(Witch-hazel) Venous congestion, hemorrhages, varicose veins, and hemorrhoids, with bruised soreness of affected parts, seem to be the sperial sphere of this remedy, Head. — Feeling as of a bolt from temple to temple. Fullness, followed by epistaxis. Eyes feel forced out. tens absorption of intraocular hemorrhage.

Eyes. — Painful weakness; sore pain in eyes; bloodshot appearance; inflamed vessels greatly injected. Hastens absorption of intraocular hemorrhage, Nose. — Blecding from nose profuse; flow passive, non-coagulable, Bad odor from nose.

Throat. — Mucous membrane distended and bluish; varicosis of throat.

Stomach.— Tongue feels burnt. Thirst. Blisters on side. Hamatemesis. Throbbing and pain in stomach.

Stool.— Anus feels sore and raw. Hamorrhoids. bleeding profusely, with soreness. Dysentery. Putsation in rectum, Urine. — Hxmaturia. with increased desire.

Female. — Ovarian congestion and neuralgia; feel very sore. Vicarious menstruation. Uterine hasnorrhage, bearing-down pain in back, Menses dark, profuse, with sorencss in abdomen. Metrorrhagia, occurring midway between menstrual periods. Vagina very tender. Profuse leucorrhea, Vulva itches. Milk-leg, hemorrhoids, and sore nipples, after counfinment. Metrorrhagia; passive flow. Vaginismus, ovaritis, soreness over whole abdomen, Phlegmasia alba, Male. — Pain in spermatic cord, running into testes. Varicocele. Pain in testicles. Orchitis, Testicles enlarged, bet, and painful. Epididymitis. : Respiratory. — azmoptysis; tickling cough, Chest feels sore and constricted. Back. -—— Sore pain down cervical vertebra. Severe pain in lumbar and hypogastric region, extending down legs.

Extremities. — Tired iceling in arms and legs. Very sore muscles and joints. Varicose veins. Chilliness in back and hips,. extending down legs, Skin. — Bluish chilblains, Phlebitis. Purpura. Varicose veins and ulcers; very sore. Burns. Ecchymosis. Traumatic inflammations. [Arnica.]

Modalities. — Worse, warm, moist air.

Relationship. — Compare in hemorrhoids: Calc. fuor.; Aloe; Mur. ac. in varicose veins, Mangtfcra indica, Compare: Arnica; Calend.; Trillium; Bcilis; Sulph. ac.: Pulsarilla, Antidote: Arnica, Complementary: Ferrum.

Dose. — Tincture, to sixth attenuation. Distilled extract Jocally.

remedies.name: Hedeoma
remedies.text:
(Pennyroyal) Female symptoms are most marked; usually associated with nervous disturbances. Red sand in urine. Pain along ureter. Flatulent colic, Antidotes effects of Poison-oak. [Grindclia.]

Head. — Dull, heavy feeling in morning. Sore pain, as from acut. Weak, faint; better, lying down.

Stomach. — Gastritis. Everything taken into stomach causcs pain, Tongue coated thin white. Nausea.

Abdomen. — Distended, sore, and sensitive, Urine. -- Frequetit urging, cutting pains. Pain along left ureter. Dragging pain from kidney to bladder. Dull burning pain over left kidney.

Female. — Bearing-down pains, with much bachache; worse, least movement. Leucorrhera, with itching and burning.

Extremities. — Pain in thumb-joint, Pain, coldness, and paretic condition. Twitchings, jerkings, soreness. Tendo-Achilles painful, as if sprained and swollen; walking painful. ‘ Relationship. — Compare: Mentha; Sepia; Lilium; Ocimum (uric acid diathesis, pain in ureters); Leonurus (hxmorrhages and dysentery). Dose. —- First potency.

remedies.name: Hekla Lava
remedies.text:
(Lava Scoriz from Mt. Hecla) Marked action upon the jaws. Of great use in exostosis, gum abscess, difficult teething. Nodosities, caries of bone, etc. QOsteitis, periostitis, osteosarcoma; rachitis. Tttmors in general.

Face. — Ulceration of nasal bones. Factal netralgns from carious teeth, Toothache, with swelling about jaws. Abscess of gums. Enlargement of maxillary bone. Cervical glands enlarged and indurated.

Relationship.— Cowpare: Sifiia; Mercur.; Phos.; Conchiolinum — Mother of pearl (diaphysis of bone affected; parts extremely sensitive to touch). Amphisbana — Snail-like lizard (great affinity for the jaw bones, worse by air and dampness). Slag — (Great itching of parts).

Dose. — Lower triturations.

remedies.name: Helleborus
remedies.text:
(Snow-rose) Produces a condition of sensorial depression. Sees, hears, tastes imperfectly, and general muscular weakness, which may ge on to complete paralysis, accompanied by dropsical effusions, Hence, a remedy int low states of vitality and serious disease. Characteristic aggtavation from 4 to ® p.m. [Lycop.] State of effasion’ in hydrocephalus. Mania of a melancholy type.

Mind. — Slow in answering. Thoughtless; staring. Involuntary sighing, Compicte unconsciousness, Picks lips and clothes.

Head. — Forehead wrinkled in folds. Cold sweat. Stupefying headache. Holls head day and night;; moaning, sudden screams. Rores head into pillow; beats it with hands. Dulf pain in occiput, with sensation of water swashing inside. Headache culminates in vomiting. Eyes. ~-- Eyeballs turn upwards; squinting, vacant look, Pupils dilated. Eyes wide open, sunken, Night blindness, Nose. — Dirty, dry nostrils, Rubs nose, Smell dimmished. Nose pointed.

Face. — Pale, sunken. Cold sweat. Wrinkled. Neuralgia on left side; parts so tender be cannot chew.

Mouth. — Horrible smell from mouth. Lips dry and cracked. Tongue red and dry. Falling of lower jaw. Meaningless picking of lips. Grinding of teeth. “Chewing motion. Greedily swallows cold water, though waconscious. Child ourses greedily, with disgust for food. Ptyalism, with sore corners of mouth.

Abdomen. — Gurgling, as if bowels were full of water. Swollen, painful to touch, Stool. — Jelly-like, white mucus; involuntary Urine, ~ Suppressed; scanty, dark; coffee-grounds sediment. Frequent urging. Child cannot urinate. Bladder overdistended, .

Respiratory. — Frequent sighing. Respiration irregular, Chest constricted; gasps for breath. Hydrothorax. [Mere. suiph.] Extremities, — Automatic motion of one arm and leg. Limhs heavy and painful. Stretching of limbs. Thumb drawn into palm. [Cupr.] Vesicular eruption between fingers and toes.

Sleep. — Sudden screams in sleep. Soporous sleep. Cri encephalique. Cannot be fully aroused, Skin. — Pale, dropsical, itching. Livid spots on skin. Sudden, watery, swelling of skin. Falling off of hair and nails.

Modalities. — Worse, irom evening until morning, from uncovering.

Relationship. — Heliebor. fatidus or, Polymnia (splenic affections, chronic ague cake; hypertrophied uterus; glandular enlargements; hair and nails falling off ; skin peeling} ; Helicbor, ovientalis (salivation). Antidote: Camphor; Cinch. Compare: Threatening effusion; Tuberc; 4pis; Zinc.; Opium; Cinch.; Cicuta; lodoform.

Dose. — Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.name: Helian Thus
remedies.text: (Sunflower) Old cases of intermittent fever. Vomiting, black stools, congestion and dryness of mouth and pharynx, redness and heat of skin. Symptoms aggravated by heat and relieved by vomiting. Spleen remedy. Marked effects on stomach, with nausea and vomiting. Stools Diack, [Zeptendra.] Dry tnouth. Externally, as a vulnerant like Arnica and Calendula,

remedies.name: Heloderma
remedies.text:
(Gila Monster) The result of the bite is a benumbing paralysis like paralysis agitans or locomotor ataxia. There is no tetanic phase—a condition almost reverse in objective symptoms to Hydrocy. acid or Strychnia. Homeopathically, it is indicated in many forms of disease characterized by great coldness—-“aretic” coldness. Cold waves from occiput to feet or ascending. Head,— Very depressed. Sensation as if would fall to right side. Cold band around head; cold pressure within the skull. Eyelids heavy. Pain beginning in right ear, extending round back of head to left ear. Face. Cold crawling feeling, as if facial muscles were tight.

Mouth. — Tongue cold, tender, and dry. Very thirsty. Swallowing difficult. Breath cold.

Chest.— Cold feeling in lungs and in heart. Slow Jabored thumping of heart. Back. —Coldness across scapule. Burning along spine. Extremities. —Numbuess and trembling. Cuoldness. Sensation as if walking on sponge, and as if feet were swollen. Staggering gait. Cock’s gait. When walking, tifts feet higher than usual, and puts down hee! hard. Feet cold as ice or burn. Stretching relieves pains in muscles and Jimbs, Fever. — Internal coldness, as if frozen to death. Cold rings atound body. Cold waves, [Abies c.; Acon.] Cald spots. Arctic coldness, Temperature subnormal —96°. [Camph.] Relationship, — Compare: Lacerta—Green Lizard (skin eruptions. Vesicles under tongue. Increased mental acumen. Difficult swallowing. Constant accumulation of saliva in the mouth. Nausea; violent pressure in stomach). Camphor; Lachesis, Dose. — Thirtieth potency.

remedies.name: Helonias
remedies.text:
(Blazing Star) Sensation of weakness, dragging and weight in the sacrum and pelvis, with great languor and prostration, are excellent indications for this retnedy. There is a sensitiveness expressed as a consciousness of a womb. Tired, backachy females. The weakness shows itself also in a tendency to prolapse and other malposition of the womb,” The menses are often suppressed and the kidneys congested. It seems as if the monthly congestion, instead of venting itself as it should through the uterine vessels, had extended to the kidneys, With it all, there is a profound melancholia. Patient must be doing something to engage the mind. Remember it, for womeu with profapsus from atony, enervated by indolence and luxury (better when attention is engaged — hence when the doctor comes), ar for those worn out with hard work; tired, strained muscles burn and ache; sleepless. Diabetes mellitus, and insipidus. Constant aching and tenderness over kidneys, Mind. — Profound melancholy. Patient is better when attention is engaged, when doing something. Irritable; cannot endure the least contradiction.

Head. — Burning sensatiori on top. Headache, better mental exertion. Back, — Pein and weight in back; tired and weak. Aching and burning across the lumbar region; can trace outlines of kidneys by constant burning. Boring pain in lumbar region, extending down Jegs. Great languor, better exercising.

Female. — Dragging in sacral region, with prolapse, especially after a miscarriage, Pruritus vuive. Backache after miscarriage. [Kali c.] Weight and soreness in womb; conscious of womb. Menses too frequcnt, foo profuse, Leucorrlhwa. Breasts swollen, nipples painful and tender. Parts hot, red, swollen; burn and itch terribly. Albuminuria during pregnancy. Dehility attending the menopause.

Urine. — Afhuminous, phosphatic; profuse and clear, saccharine., Diabetes, Modalities. ~ @rttcr, when doing something {mental diversion). M/’erse, motion, touch.

Relationship. — Compare: -Jyrimonia (painful kidneys, impaired digestion and menstrual difficulties; Bronchorrheea aud catarrh of bladder. Tincture J-10 gtt.). Aleiris; Liliwm,; Puts.; Senecio; Stannum, Dose. — Tincture, to sixth attenuation.

remedies.name: Hepar Sulphuris Calcareum
remedies.text:
(Hahnemann’s Caicium Sulphide) Suits especially scrofulous and lymphatic constitutions who are inclined to have eruptions and glandular swellings. Unhealthy skin. Blondes with sluggish character and weak muscles. Great sensitivencss to all impressions, Sweating patient pulling blanket around him, Locally, it has special affinity to the respiratory mucous membrane, producing croupous catarrhal inflammation, profuse secretion; also easy perspiration, After abuse of Mercury, The tendency to suppuration is most marked, and has heen a strong guiding symptom in practice. Chilliness, -hypersensitiveness, splinter-like pains, craving for sour and strong things are very characteristic. Feeling as tf wind were blowing on .some fart. The side of the body on which he lies at night becomes gradually insufferably painful; he must turn, Pellagra (material doses required). Syphilis after antispecific gross medication.

Mind. — Anguish in the evening and night, with thoughts of suicide. The slightest cause irritates him. Dejected and sad. Ferocious. Hasty speech, Head, — Vertigo and headache, when shaking the head or riding, Boring pain in the right temple and in root of nose every morning. Scalp sensitive and sore. Humid scald-head itching and burning. Cold sweat on head.

Eyes. — Ulcers on cornea. Iritis, with pus im anterior chamber; purulent conjunctivitis, with marked chemosis, profuse discharge, great sensitiveness to touch and air. Eyes and lids red and inflamed. Pain in the eyes, as if pulled back into the head. Boring pain in upper bones of the orbits. Eyeballs sore to touch. Objects appear red and too large. Vision chscured by reading; field reduced one-half. Bright circles before eyes. Fypopion, Ears. — Scurfs on and behind the ears. Discharge of fetid pus from the ears. Whiezing and throbbing in ears, with hardness of hearing. Deafness after scarlet fever. Pustules in auditory canal and auricle. Mastoiditis.

Nose. — Sore, ulcerated. Soreness of nostrils, with catarrhal troubles. Sneezes every time he goes into a cold, dry wind, with running from nose, later, thick, offensive discharge. Stopped up every time he goes out into cold air, Smelt like old cheese. Hay-fever. (Hepar 1x will often start secretions and profuse drainage in stuffy colds.} Face. — Yellowish complexion.
